traduction: Si Min muuyii Min njippinat e maɓɓe immorde ka kammu aaya daaɗe maɓɓe ɗen ñalla ko ɗe yankinaniiɗe mo.
explication: Si Men Muuyii jippinngol Maande e maɓɓe immorde ka kammu Men jippinay nde e maɓɓe, daaɗe maɓɓe ɗen ñalla yankinanaade nde hara ko ɗe hoyuɗe, kono Men Muuyaali ɗum ka ndarndagol ɓe: Mbelaɓe gomɗinay ko wirnii kon?

arabe: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ
traduction: Arataa e maɓɓe waaju immorde ka jurmotooɗo on fuɗɗaangu si wonaa ɓe laatike ɗuuriiɓe ngu.
explication: Arataa e ɓee sirkooɓe immorde e waaju fuɗɗaa- ngu jippineede immorde ka Hinnorante On e Hujjaaji maggu tinndinɗi ɗin fii Ngootimmbaaku Makko e Goongugol Annabaajo Makko on si wanaa ɓe ɗuuroto gaayi jentagol mo e goongin- gol mo.

arabe: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii ɓe njeddii aroyay e maɓɓe kabaruuji ko ɓe laatinoo koɓe njalkitano.
explication: Gomɗii ɓe fennii ko Nulaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen addani ɓe kon, aroyay e maɓɓe goonginal kumpital ko ɓe wonunoo jalkitude kon, Lepte ɗen jippoo e maɓɓe.

arabe: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ
traduction: Enee, ɓe nji'aani fa'ade e leydi ndin, no foti heewde ko Min puɗini e mayri immorde e kala noone tedduɗo?
explication: Ɓee luttay e deppitagol e dow keefeeru maɓɓe hara ɓe ndaaraali faade e leydi ndin no foti hewde ko Men fuɗini e mayri immorde e kala noone e nooneeji puɗi fotuɗi ndaarugol ɗuuɗuɗi nafoore?!

arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Pellet, wonii e ɗuum [ko jaŋtaa ɗoo] aaya, ɓurɓe heewɓe e maɓɓe laataaki gooŋɗinɓe.
explication: Pellet, wonii e fuɗinngol ka leydi puɗi luutondirɗi nooneeji daliili ɓannguɗo fii Hattannde On fuɗinɗo ɗi e dow wurnitugol mayɓe ɓen, ɓurɓe ɓen e maɓɓe wonaali gomɗinɓe.

arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa ko Kaŋko woni tedduɗo Jurmeteeɗo On.
explication: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- ko Kanko woni Fooluɗo goɗɗo foolataa Mo, ko O Yurmeteeɗo jeyaaɓe makko ɓen.

arabe: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
traduction: Jaŋto tuma nde Joomi maaɗa noddunoo Muusaa, ɗum woni ar e yimɓe tooñooɓe ɓe.
explication: Jaŋto -an Nulaaɗo- tuma nde Joomi maaɗa noddunoo Muusaa ko O Yamirɗo mo yo o aru ka yimɓe tooñirɓe ɓen yeddugol maɓɓe Alla e maccinɗinngol yimɓe Muusaa ɓen.

arabe: قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
traduction: Yimɓe Fir'awna, kaa on kulataa
explication: Ɓen ko yimɓe Fir'awna ɓen, yo o yamir ɓe e hoore no newori kulol Alla e ɗoftaade Yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin e woɗɗitaade haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin.

arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
traduction: O maaki: "Joom am , min miɗo huli wota ɓe njeddam.
explication: Muusaa (yo o his) maaki: "Min dey, miɗo huli wata ɓe fennan e nder ko mi yottinta e maɓɓe kon Nulal maaɗa ngal"

arabe: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
traduction: Ɓernde am nden ɓittoo hara ɗemngal am ngal wellitaaki, awa Nul to Haaruuna.
explication: Ɓernde am nden ɓittoo sabu ko ɓe fennatan mi kon, ɗemngal am ngal soko fii wowlugol, awa Nulu Jibriila (yo o his) faade e kotoo am Haaruuna fii yo o wonu walloowo lam.

arabe: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ
traduction: No woodani ɓe e dow am bakkaat miɗo huli fii wota ɓe mbaram.
explication: No wonani ɓe e dow am bakkaatu sabu warugol qibtiyankoojo, miɗo huli wata ɓe warto lam.

arabe: قَالَ كَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ
traduction: O Daali: "Wonaa non, njahee onon ɗiɗo, Miɗen ngon'di e mooɗon ko Min heɗiiɓe".
explication: Alla Daalani Muusaa (yo o his): "wanaa non, ɓe warataa ma, yaadu e kotoo maaɗa Haaruuna wonndude e Aayeeje Amen tinndinɗe ɗen e goongugol mooɗon. Pellet, Menen Meɗen wonndiri e mooɗo ballal ngal e semmbinngol ngol ko Men jentiiɓe ko wowloton kon e ko wowlante ɗon kon, hay e huunde e ɗum fuutotaako Men.

arabe: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Aree ka Fir'awna wi'on: "Minen dey ko min Nulaaɓe Jooma winndere nden."
explication: Aree ka Fir'awna, wi'anon mo: "Menen ɗoo ɗiɗo ko men Nulaaɓe e maaɗa immorde ka Jooma tageefooji ɗin fow."

arabe: أَنۡ أَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
traduction: Ɗuum woni accitu ɓiɗɓe Isra'iila ɓen wond'ude e amen.
explication: Fii yo a accitu ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen ɓen, wonndude e amen.

arabe: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدٗا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
traduction: O wi'i: "Enee, min ne'aano ma ka amin ɗoo hari ko a boobo, ñiiɓuɗaa ka amin ɗoo duuɓi e ngurndam maaɗam?"
explication: Fir'awna wi'ani Muusaa (yo o his): "Enee, men ne'aano ma ka amen ɗoo hari ko o penuujo, ñiiɓuɗaa hakkunde duuɓi e ngurndam maaɗam, ko hommbo yamirmaa nodditagol Annabaaku?"

arabe: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
traduction: NGolluɗaa gollal maaɗa ngal ngollunoɗaa ngal, an ko e yedduɓe ɓen njeyaɗaa.
explication: Golluɗaa fiyaake mawɗe tuma warunoɗaa qibtiyankoojo on fii jinngngol gorko jeyaaɗo ka yimɓe maaɗa, an ko a yeyaaɗo e yedduɓe neemaaji am ɗin e dow maaɗa.

arabe: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذٗا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
traduction: O maaki: "Mi waɗii ɗum, ontuma min ko mi jiyaaɗo e majjuɓe ɓeen".
explication: Muusaa (yo o his) maakani Fir'awna: "Mi warii on gorko hari min ko e majjuɓe ɓen mi jeyaa ado Wahayu arude e am."

arabe: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمٗا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Mi dogi on, tuma nde mi kulunoo on, Joomi am okkin mi Ganndal o waɗin mi jiyaaɗo e Nulaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Mi doguno on ɓaawo warugol mo, mi yahi ka saare Madyana, nde mi hulunoo wata on warto lam fii makko, Joomi am okkin mi ganndal, O waɗin mi jeyaaɗo e Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen ɓe O Nulata ɗum faade e yimɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٞ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
traduction: Ɗum ko neema mo mbajitirtaa mi ɗum, fii a maccinɗinii ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen.
explication: Ko ne'uɗaa mi kon a maccinɗinaali lam wonndude e maccinɗinngol maaɗa ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen ɗum ko neema mo wajitirtaa mi ɗum e goonga, kono ɗum haɗataa lam e noddugol ma [ka Diina].

arabe: قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Fir'awna wi'i: " Ko hommbo jeyi winndere nde?"
explication: Fir'awna wi'ani Muusaa (yo o his): "Ko hommbo jeyi tageefooji ɗin, on mo aaƴotoɗaa wonndema an ko a Nulaaɗo makko?!"

arabe: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
traduction: O maaki: "Ko Jooma kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndi e ko woni kon hakkunde majji, si on laatike yananaaɓe."
explication: Muusaa jaabii Fir'awna o maaki: "Jooma tageefooji ɗin ko Kanko woni Jooma kammuuli ɗin e Jooma leydi ndin, e Jooma ko woni kon hakkunde majji. Si tawii on laatike ko on yananaaɓe wonnde pellet, ko Kanko woni Jooma majji haray rewee Mo Kanko tun.

arabe: قَالَ لِمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسۡتَمِعُونَ
traduction: O wi'ani ɓeen wonɓe banŋe makko: "Enee; on leɗataako?"
explication: Fir'awna wi'ani ɓen wonuɓe fee makko immorde e koohooɓe ɓen ka yimɓe makko: "Enee, on jentotaako jaabawol Muusaa ngol, e ko woni kon e makko immorde e aaƴagol fenaande?!"

arabe: قَالَ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
traduction: O maaki: "Joomi mooɗon e Jooma baabiraaɓe adiiɓe ɓen."
explication: Muusaa maakani ɓe (yo o his): " Ko Alla woni Joomi mooɗon e Jooma baabiraaɓe mooɗon adinooɓe ɓen."

arabe: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
traduction: [Fir'awna] wi'i: "Pellet, Nulaaɗo mooɗon on Nulaaɗo fa'ade e mooɗon ko o kaangaaɗo."
explication: Fir'awna wi'i: "Pellet, on aaƴiiɗo wonnde ko o Nulaaɗo faade e mooɗon ko o feetuɗo, o anndaa ko honno o jaaborta, himo wowla kadi ko hakkile jaɓataa."

arabe: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
traduction: O maaki: "Ko Jooma funna'ange e hirna'ange e ko woni kon hakkunde majji, si on laatike kakkilooɓe."
explication: Muusaa maaki: "On Alla Mo mi noddata on faade e Muuɗum, ko Kanko woni Jooma funnaange e hirnaange, e Jooma ko woni kon hakkunde majji si tawii no laatanii on hakkillaaji ɗi hakkilirton ɗum".

arabe: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ
traduction: [Fir'awna] wi'i: "Mi wooɗndii si jogitike deweteeɗo tan am, mi waɗete jiyaaɗo dummbaaɓe ɓeen".
explication: Fir'awna wi'ani Muusaa ɓaawo ronkugol makko hujjondirgol e makko: "Mi woondii si a rewii reweteeɗo tanaa am, mami waɗi jeyaaɗo e sokaaɓe ɓen."

arabe: قَالَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكَ بِشَيۡءٖ مُّبِينٖ
traduction: O maaki: "enee, hay si mi addanii ma hu'unde ɓanngunde?"
explication: Muusaa (yo o his) maakani Fir'awna: "A waɗay lam jeyaaɗo sokaaɓe ɓen, hay si mi addanii ma ko ɓannginta goongugol am e ko mi addan maa kon immorde ka Alla?"

arabe: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
traduction: [Fir'awna] wi'i: "Awa addu ɗum, si tawii ko e gooŋɗu ɓe ɓe njiyaaɗaa."
explication: O wi'i: "Addu ko jaŋtiɗaa kon wonnde no tinndini e goongugol maaɗa si a laatike ko e goonguɓe ɓen jeyaɗaa, e nder kon ko nodditiɗaa ɗum".

arabe: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: O wernii tuggordu makko ndu, jaka ko ndu mbooɗdi (ngoolwa) ɓannguba.
explication: Muusaa werlii tuggordu makko ndun ka leydi, e juhayee, ndu waylii biidaane ɓannguɗo wonannde yi'ooɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
traduction: O yaltini junngo makko ngo, jaka yoo ko ngo ranwungo wonan'de ndaarooɓe ɓe.
explication: O naadi junngo makko ngon ka jiiba makko tawi ngo wonaa ranewo, o yaltini ngo ko ngo ranewo, ndaneeri jalbeendi wanaa ndaneeri culɗugol, ndaarooɓe ɓen no seedora ngo non.

arabe: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٞ
traduction: [Fir'awna] wi'ani mbatu ngu fee makko: "Pellet, ooɗoo ko bileejo keewɗo ganndal".
explication: Fir'awna wi'ani koohooɓe yimɓe makko, ɓen wonu ɓe baŋŋe makko: "Pellet, oo gorko ko mbileejo annduɗo mbilewu".

arabe: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ
traduction: Homo fa'andii jaltinirgol on ka leydi mooɗon mbilewu makko ngu. Ko hulɗun njamirɗon?
explication: Himo faandori mbilewu makko ngun yaltinngol on ka leydi mooɗon. Ko honɗum woni feere mooɗon nde haanuɗen jogaade fii makko?

arabe: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i : "Neeɓnu mo e musiɗɗo makko on, nulaa e ca'e ɗen mooɓooɓe (wileeɓe)".
explication: Ɓe wi'ani mo: "Nennan mo nennaa kotoo makko kadi, wata yaccor leptugol ɓe, nulu ka ca'e Misra muuɓayɓe mbileeɓe ɓen".

arabe: يَأۡتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٖ
traduction: Ɓe ngddane kala bileejo gannduɗo.
explication: Yoɓe addane kala mbileejo annduɗo mbilaaku ngun.

arabe: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
traduction: Wileeɓe ɓen mooɓaa fii fodoore ñalaande anndaande.
explication: Fir'awna mooɓi mbileeɓe makko ɓen fii jippirgol e Muusaa e nder nokkuure anndaa nde e jamaanu hettaaɗo.

arabe: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّجۡتَمِعُونَ
traduction: Yimɓe ɓen mbii'anaa: "Taw si onon ko on mooɓike(ndenndi)"
explication: Yimɓe ɓen wi'anaa: "Taw si onon ko on mooɓotooɓe fii yo on yi'u fooluɗo on, e hara ko Muusaa kaa ko mbileeɓe ɓen?"

arabe: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
traduction: Mbelejo'o lajo'o minen min njokkay wileeɓe ɓen, si ɓe laatike ko kamɓe ngoni foolɓe ɓen.
explication: Jortagol wonnde men jokkay mbileeɓe ɓen ka diina maɓɓe, si tawii ko kamɓe fooli Muusaa.

arabe: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
traduction: Tuma nde wileeɓe ɓen ngrnoo; ɓe mbi'ani Fir'awna: "Enee,  no woodani min njoɓdi si tawii ko min ngoni foolɓe ɓe?"
explication: Tuma nde mbileeɓe ɓen arunoo ka Fir'awna fii yo ɓe foolotir e Muusaa ɓe wi'ani mo: "Yalli no woodani men njoɓdi jawdi maaɗum teddungal si tawii ko menen fooli Muusaa?"

arabe: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
traduction: O wi'i : "Eyyo,  on tuma on njeyaama e ɓaɗtinaaɓe ɓen".
explication: Fir'awna wi'ani ɓe: "Eyyo, njoɓdi no woodani on, haray si on foolii mo, on wonay ɓaɗtiniraaɓe ka am jonnugol on darjaaji ɓamtiiɗi".

arabe: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ
traduction: Muusaa maakani ɓe: "mbeddee, ko mbernoton kon".
explication: Muusaa maakani ɓe tawi ko o hooliiɗo Ballal Alla ngal himo ɓanngina wonndema ko o jogii kon wanaa mbilew: "Liɓee ko liɓoton kon immorde e ɓokkoy mooɗon e cawoy mooɗon".

arabe: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
traduction: Ɓe liɓi ɓoggi maɓɓe  e cawoy maɓɓe kon, ɓe mbi'i: "Sabu teddungal Fir'awna, ko minen ngoni foolooɓe ɓe".
explication: Ɓe liɓi ɓokkoy maɓɓe e cawoy maɓɓe koy, ɓe wi'i ka liɓugol koy: "Sabu manngu Fir'awna ko menen woni foolooɓe ɓen, ko Muusaa woni foolaaɗo on".

arabe: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ
traduction: Muusaa wernii tuggordu makko ndu, tawi kayru hundu moɗa ko ɓe fekindii ko.
explication: Muusaa liɓi tuggordu makko ndun, ndu waylii mboddi, tawi kayru hindu moɗa ko ɓe hulɓiniray-noo kon yimɓe ɓen immorde e mbilewu ngun.

arabe: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
traduction: Wileeɓe ɓe nduuyi ɓe cujji.
explication: Tuma nde mbileeɓe ɓen yi'unoo tuggordu Muusaa ndun hindu moɗa ko ɓe liɓi kon immorde e mbilewu maɓɓe ɓe suuyi ɓe sujji.

arabe: قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i : "Min ngoŋɗinii Jeyɗo Winndere nde,
explication: Ɓe wi'i: "Men gomɗinii Jooma tageefooji ndin fow".

arabe: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
traduction: Joomum Muusaa e Haaruuna".
explication: Jooma Muusaa e Haaruuna (yo ɓe his).

arabe: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
traduction: [Fir'awna] wi'i: "Enee, on ngooŋɗinat mo, ko adii mi duŋanaade on? Pellet, ko kaŋko woni mawɗo mooɗon anndinɗo on on mbilewu ngu, kono a nganndon, mami taƴ juuɗe mooɗon e koyɗe mooɗon [taƴa] luutindira. Mami fetu on, on fof mooɗon".
explication: Fir'awna añiri mbileeɓe ɓen gomɗinal maɓɓe ngal, o wi'i: "Enee, on gomɗinay mo ko adii mi duŋanaa- de on ɗum?! Pellet, ko Muusaa woni mawɗo mooɗon anndinɗo on on mbilewu ngun. Hari on fow on haldiino fii yaltinngol yimɓe [saare] Misra nden e nder mayre, kono aray ka anndon ko mi fawata on kon immorde e lepte, mami taƴu sanne koyngal mo kala e junngo makko ngun mi luutindirira hakkunde majje taƴugol koyngal ñaamal ngal wonndude e junngo nano ngon maaɗum yunnitugol, mami fetu on sanne on fow mooɗon e julle tamaro, mi accataa hay e gooto e mooɗon".

arabe: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Tanaa alaa, minen ko fa'ade ka Joomi amin min nduttotoo".
explication: Mbileeɓe ɓen wi'ani Fir'awna: "Tanaa alaa e kon ko kammbirantaa men taƴugol e fetugol ka aduna, lepte maaɗen iway, menen ko faade ka Joomi amen men ruttotoo, aray O naadoya men ka Yurmeende Makko Duumotoonde.

arabe: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Minen miɗen tamƴinii nde Joomi amin yawtani min ngoopi amin ɗin,tawde min laatike adiiɓe gooŋɗinnde ɓen.
explication: Menen meɗen jortii nde Alla montanta men goopi amen feƴƴuɗi ɗi men waɗɗitii ɗum; sabu men wonii adiiɓe gomɗinnde Muusaa goongina mo.

arabe: ۞ وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
traduction: Min mbahayini fa'ade e Muusaa: "Ɗuum woni roƴidu e Jiyaaɓe Am ɓeen. Pellet, onon ko on jokkiteteeɓe".
explication: Men Wahayini e Muusaa Yamirgol mo yo o roƴidu e ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen jemma. Pellet, Fir'awna e wonnduɓe e makko ɓen ɓe jokkitay ɓe fii yo ɓe artir ɓe.

arabe: فَأَرۡسَلَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
traduction: Fir'awna nuli to ca'e mooɓooɓe.
explication: Fir'awna nuli yoga e konunkeeɓe makko ɓen ka ca'e mooɓooɓe hiɓe mooɓa konu ngun fii yo ɓe ruttu ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen nde o anndunoo yaltugol maɓɓe Misra.

arabe: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرۡذِمَةٞ قَلِيلُونَ
traduction: [O wi'i:] Pellet, ɓee ko ɓe mojobum pamarum.
explication: Fir'awna wi'i ka famɗinngol fiyaake ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen: "Pellet, ɓee ko ɓe fedde famɗunde".

arabe: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
traduction: Pellet, kamɓe heɓe tikkinnde min.
explication: Pellet, kamɓe hiɓe waɗude ko men tikkiranta ɓe.

arabe: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ
traduction: Enen non en fof ko en reentiiɓe.
explication: Enen non ko en hebilaniiɓe ɓe, ko en finuɓe.

arabe: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
traduction: Min njaltini ɓe immorde e gese e caatli.
explication: Men yaltini Fir'awna e yimɓe makko ɓen ka leydi Misra joomiraari gese alɗuɗe, e canɗi ilooji ndiyam.

arabe: وَكُنُوزٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ
traduction: E ngaluuji e ñiiɓirde teddunde.
explication: E joomiraare ngaluuji jawdi, e koɗanɗe moƴƴe.

arabe: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
traduction: Ko wano nii, Min ndonini ɗum ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen.
explication: Ko wano Men yaltiniri nii Fir'awna e yimɓe makko ɓen e ɗii neemaaji, Men waɗani noone ɗii neemaaji ɓaawo maɓɓe ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen ka leydi Saami.

arabe: فَأَتۡبَعُوهُم مُّشۡرِقِينَ
traduction: Ɓe njokkiɓe de puɗal.
explication: Fir'awna e yimɓe mu'un ɓen yahi e batte [teppe] ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen ka waqtu puɗal naange.

arabe: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ
traduction: Tuma nde jamaaji ɗin ɗin yi'ndirnoo, yimɓe Muusaa ɓe mbi'i: "Enen en hewtoyte".
explication: Tuma nde Fir'awna e yimɓe mu'un ɓen fewtundirnoo e Muusaa e yimɓe mu'un, nokku ka wonnoo fedde kala no yi'ude ndeya, yimɓe Muusaa ɓen wi'i: "Pellet, Fir'awna e yimɓe mu'un ɓen ɓe hewtitoto en, en alaa dartantooɗo en ɓe".

arabe: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
traduction: O maaki: "Ɗuum waɗataa, pellet, Joomi am no won'di e am o feewnat kam".
explication: Muusaa maakani yimɓe makko ɓen: "Fiyaake ɗen wanaa no miijorton non. Pellet, Joomi am no wonndiri e am semmbinngol e wallugol, O fewnay lam O tinndina lam faade e laawol daɗugol".

arabe: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٖ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
traduction: Min mbahayini e Muusaa, ɗum woni piyir tuggordu maaɗa ndu maayo ngon, ngo seekii ceekol kala seekol na foti e tulde mawnde.
explication: Men Wahayini e Muusaa ko Men yamiray ɓe mo yo o piyir maayo ngon tuggordu makko ndun, o piyiri ngo ndu, maayo ngon seekii ngo wonti boli sappoo e ɗiɗi yeru limoore leƴƴi ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen, kala huntere e ceeki maayo ngon foti e fello mawngo ka tiiɗugol e ka tabitugol haa nokku ka ndiyam ilataa e majje.

arabe: وَأَزۡلَفۡنَا ثَمَّ ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
traduction: Min ɓanni ton heddiiɓe ɓe.
explication: Men ɓanni Firawna e yimɓe makko ɓen haa ɓe naati ka maayo ko ɓe sikkuɓe wonnde laawol ngol ko lummbu ngol.

arabe: وَأَنجَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
traduction: Min ndaɗni di Muusaa e won'ɗuɓe e makko ɓe fof maɓɓe.
explication: Men danndi Muusaa e ɓen wonnduɓe e makko immorde e ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen, hay gooto e maɓɓe halkanooka.

arabe: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
traduction: Refti Min njooli heddii ɓe ɓe.
explication: Refti Men halkiri Fir'awna e yimɓe makko ɓen yooleede ka maayo.

arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Pellet, wonii e ɗuum [ko jaŋtaa ɗoo] aaya, ɓurɓe heewude e maɓɓe laataaki gooŋɗinɓe.
explication: Pellet, no e seekanagol maayo ngon Muusaa e daɗugol makko e halkeede Fir'awana e yimɓe makko ɓen ɗum ko Aaya tinndinɗo e dow goongugol Muusaa. Ɓurɓe heewude e ɓen wonndunooɓe e Fir'awna ɓe wonaano gomɗinɓe.

arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa, ko Kaŋko woni Tedduɗo jurmeteeɗo.
explication: Anndu Joomi maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo-ko Kanko woni tedduɗo Yoɓtotooɗo ayɓe Makko ɓen, Yurmeteeɗo on tuubuɗo e maɓɓe.

arabe: وَٱتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَأَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
traduction: Janngan ɓe kumpital fii Ibraahiima.
explication: Janngu e taweede maɓɓe -an Nulaaɗo- fillayee fii Ibraahiima.

arabe: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
traduction: Tuma nde o wi'annoo baaba makko e yimɓe makko ɓe; ko holɗum ndewoton?
explication: Tuma nde o wi'annoo baaba makko Aajara e yimɓe mu'un ɓen: "Ko honɗum wonuɗon rewude gaanin Alla?"

arabe: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامٗا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Miɗen rewde sanamuuji, min ñallat ufnanaade ɗi".
explication: Yimɓe makko ɓen wi'ani mo: "Ko sanamuuji men rewata, men ñalla ñiiɓude e rewugol ɗi, ko men jokkuɓe ɗi".

arabe: قَالَ هَلۡ يَسۡمَعُونَكُمۡ إِذۡ تَدۡعُونَ
traduction: O maaki: "mati i hiɗi nanana on, nde noddoton".
explication: Ibraahiima maakani ɓe: "Yalli sanamuuji ɗin no nana noddaandu mo'on ndun tuma noddoton ɗi?"

arabe: أَوۡ يَنفَعُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَضُرُّونَ
traduction: Maa hiɗi nafa on ma ɗi lorra on?
explication: Kaa hiɗi nafa on si on ɗoftike ɗi, maaɗum ɗi lorra on si on yeddii ɗi?

arabe: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
traduction: Ɓe mb'i: "Ko woni, men tawii baabiraaɓe amen ɓe konii ɓe ngolliratnoo".
explication: Ɓe wi'i: "Ɗi nanantaa men dey si men noddii ɗi, ɗi nafataa men kadi si men ɗoftike ɗi, ɗi lorrataa men kadi si men yeddiiɗi. Ko woni, tigi-tigi on, menen men tawiino baabiraaɓe amen ɓen hiɓe gollira nii, meɗen ñentinnde ɓe".

arabe: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
traduction: O maaki: "Enee, on nji'ii kon ko ngonɗon e rewde?"
explication: Ibraahiima maaki: "Enee, on taskike on yi'ii ko wonuɗon e rewude gaanin Alla immorde e sanamuuji ɗin".

arabe: أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلۡأَقۡدَمُونَ
traduction: Onon e baabiraaɓe mon adinooɓe ɓe.
explication: Kon ko baabiraaɓe mooɗon aranɓe ɓen laatinoo no rewa.

arabe: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوّٞ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Pellet, kamɓe ko ɓe añɓe am, si wonaa Jooma winndire nden.
explication: Pellet, kamɓe ɓe fow maɓɓe ko ɓe ayɓe am; sabu kamɓe ko ɓe meere si wanaa Alla Jooma tageefooji ɗin fow.

arabe: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهۡدِينِ
traduction: On Talɗo kam, ko Kaŋko feewnata kam.
explication: On Taguɗo lam ko Kanko fewnata lam faade e moƴƴere aduna e Laakara.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِي هُوَ يُطۡعِمُنِي وَيَسۡقِينِ
traduction: On ko Kaŋko ñamminta kam O yarnan-mi.
explication: On ko Kanko tun ñamminta lam si mi weelaama, O yarna lam si mi ɗonɗaama.

arabe: وَإِذَا مَرِضۡتُ فَهُوَ يَشۡفِينِ
traduction: Si mi nawnii, ko Kaŋko sellinta kam.
explication: Si mi nawnii ko Kanko tun woni sellinayɗo lam immorde e nawnaare nden, mi alaa sellinoowo ngoo tanaa makko.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحۡيِينِ
traduction: E oon barayɗo kam refti o wurnitan mi.
explication: E On tawɗo ko Kanko tun warata lam si lajal am ngal timmii, O wurnita lam kadi ɓaawo mayde am nden.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
traduction: Oon mo mi tamƴinii kadi nde O yaafatoomi goopi am ɗin Ñande [njoɓdi] Diina ka.
explication: Ko Kanko tun mi jortii yawtanay lam goopi am ɗin Ñalnde njoɓdi ndin.

arabe: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
traduction: Joomam, okkam Ganndal wattidaa mi e moƴƴuɓe ɓe.
explication: Ibraahiima noddi Joomi makko o maaki: Joomam okkam faamugol Diina kan, wattidaa mi e moƴƴuɓe ɓen immorde e Annabaaɓe adiiɓe lam ɓen, ɗum woni naadaa mi ka Aljanna wonndude e maɓɓe".

arabe: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقٖ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
traduction: Mbaɗanaa kam jaŋto moƴƴo ka sakkitiiɓe ɓen.
explication: Waɗanaa mi jaŋta labaaɗo e mantoore moƴƴere e ɗen gire aroyay ɗe ɓaawo am.

arabe: وَٱجۡعَلۡنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
traduction: Mbaɗaa mi jiyaaɗo e ronooɓe Aljanna Neemaaji ɗin.
explication: Waɗaa lam jeyaaɗo e ɓen ronooɓe galleeji Aljanna ɗin ɗi neemintoo e nder muuɗum jeyaaɓe Maaɗa gomɗinɓe ɓen, hoɗinaa lam e nder majji.

arabe: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
traduction: Njaafɗaa baaba am, pellet, kaŋko o laatinoke jiyaaɗo e majjuɓe ɓeen.
explication: Yawtanaa baaba am; kanko o laatinoke jeyaaɗo e majjuɓe ɓen gaay Goonga kan sabu sirku ngun, Ibraahiima du'anii ben makko ko adii ɓanngannde mo wonndema kanko ko o jeyaaɗo e yimɓe Jahiimi ɓen. Tuma nde ɗum ɓanngannoo mo, o danndii mo o du'anaaki mo [hannde kadi].

arabe: وَلَا تُخۡزِنِي يَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُونَ
traduction: Wota A hersinoyam Ñande ɓe Immital.
explication: Wata A wirtiroyam Lepte ɗen Ñalnde yimɓe ɓen immintinoytee fii hasboore nden.

arabe: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٞ وَلَا بَنُونَ
traduction: Ñande nde jawdi e ɓiɗɓe nafataa.
explication: Ñalnde nde nafataa e muuɗum jawdi ndi neɗɗo on faggitii ɗum ka aduna makko, wanaa kadi ɓiɗɓe ɓe o laatinoo himo wallitora ɗum.

arabe: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٖ
traduction: Si wonaa on arduɗo ka Alla e ɓernde hisnde.
explication: Si wanaa on arduɗo ka Alla e ɓernde hisunde; hara sirku e naafiqaaku alaa e mayre, yiingo e hawtaare alaa e mayre, haray pellet, kanko o nafturay jawdi makko ndi o nafkunoo ndin ka Laawol Alla, e ɓiɗɓe makko wonuɓe du'anaade mo ɓen kadi.

arabe: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
traduction: Aljanna oon ɓatinanee hulooɓe Alla ɓeen.
explication: Aljanna on ɓannanee hulirooɓe Joomi mu'un ɓen ɗoftagol Yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin, e woɗɗitagol haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin.

arabe: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِلۡغَاوِينَ
traduction: Jahiim ngeen feññinanee bewɓe ɓern.
explication: Ka Mofturu Yiite ngen feññinanee majjuɓe ɓen, ɓen majjuɓe gaay Diina Goongaha kan.

arabe: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
traduction: Ɓe wi'nee: "Honto woni ko laatinoɗon kon hoɗon ndewa".
explication: Ɓe wi'anee ka maƴinngol ɓe: Honto ko wonunoɗon rewude kon immorde e sanamuuji ɗin?

arabe: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
traduction: Ga Alla? Taw si ɗi walla on ma ɗi wallat hoore majji?
explication: On reway ɗi gaanin Alla? Taw si ɗi walliray on haɗanngol on Lepte Alla ɗen, kaa kannji ɗi wallay ko'e-majji?

arabe: فَكُبۡكِبُواْ فِيهَا هُمۡ وَٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ
traduction: Ɓe kippee e ndeer magge kamɓe e bewɓe ɓen.
explication: Woɓɓe e maɓɓe werlee e hoore woɓɓe ka Jahiima e ɓen majjinɓe ɓe.

arabe: وَجُنُودُ إِبۡلِيسَ أَجۡمَعُونَ
traduction: E konnuuji ibliisa ɗiin ɗi fof majji.
explication: E wallooɓe Ibliisa ɓen immorde e Seytanuuji ɗin fow, hay gootil e majji ittintinaaka.

arabe: قَالُواْ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i tawi kamɓe heɓe wennjondira ndeer ton:
explication: Ɓen sirkooɓe wonunooɓe rewde tanaa Alla, ɓe jogitii ɓe kafidaaɓe gaanin Alla, tawi kanɓe hiɓe wennjondirde e ɓen rewnooɓe ɓe gaanin Alla, ɓe wi'i:

arabe: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
traduction: "Min woondirii Alla, min woniino e ndeer majjere ɓanngunde.
explication: Men woondirii Alla gomɗii hari men laatike e nder majjere ɓanngunde gaayi Goonga kan.

arabe: إِذۡ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Tuma nde min njeddunoo on e Jooma winndere nde"
explication: Tuma nde men fotindirnoo on e Joom tageefooji ɗin fow majji, men rewiri on wano men rewirta Mo non.

arabe: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
traduction: Majjinaani min si ngonaa bonɓe ɓen.
explication: Majjinaali men gaayi Laawol Goongawol ngol si wanaa ɓen bonɓe nodduɓe faade e rewugol ɓe gaanin Alla.

arabe: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
traduction: Alanaa min tefooɓe.
explication: Laatanaaki men tefooɓe ɓe no tefanoya men ka Alla fii yo O danndu men immorde e lepte Makko ɗen.

arabe: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٖ
traduction: Wonaa kadi giɗo ñallamɓereejo(tigi tigi).
explication: Laatanaaki men giɗo laaɓuɗo giggol mo no hiwa men o tefanoya men.

arabe: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةٗ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Sinndo no woodannoo min ndutteede, min laatoo jiyaaɓe e gooŋɗinɓe ɓen.
explication: Sinndo no woodannoo men artireede ka ngurndam aduna, men wona jeyaaɓe e gomɗinɓe Alla ɓen.

arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Pellet, wonii e ɗuum [ko jaŋtaa ɗoo] aaya, ɓurɓe heewɓe e maɓɓe laataaki gooŋɗinɓe.
explication: Pellet, wonii e koo ko jaŋtaa ɗoo immorde e fillayee fii Ibraahiima (yo o his), e waɗtinirde fennuɓe ɓen tasakuyee, wonannde taskotooɓe ɓen, ɓurɓe heewude e maɓɓe wonaali gomɗinɓe.

arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa, ko Kako woni Tedduɗo jurmeteeɗo.
explication: Anndu Joomi maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- ko Kanko woni tedduɗo Yoɓtotooɗo ayɓe Makko ɓen, Yurmeteeɗo on tuubuɗo e maɓɓe.

arabe: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen njeddii Nulaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen fenni Nulaaɓe ɓen, tuma nde ɓe fennunoo Nuuhu (yo o his).

arabe: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
traduction: Tuma nde Nuuhu musiɗɗo maɓɓe on mbiannoo ɓe: "Enee, on kulataa [Alla]?"
explication: Tuma nde Saalihu musiɗɗo maɓɓe on ka dammbe (asko) wi'annoo ɓe: Enee, on hulataa Alla, acciron rewugol tanaa Makko sabu kulol Makko?!

arabe: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
traduction: Min dey, ko mi nulaaɗo e mooɗon koolaaɗo.
explication: Min dey, ko mi Nulaaɗo mooɗon, Alla Nulii lam e mooɗon, ko mi hoolaaɗo mi ɓeydataa e dow ko Alla Wahayini kon e am, mi uytataa kadi.

arabe: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
traduction: Kulee Alla ɗoftoɗon mi.
explication: Huliree Alla ɗoftagol Yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin e woɗɗitagol haɗaani Makko ɗin, ɗoftee lam e ko mi yamirta on kon, e ko mi haɗata on kon e muuɗum.

arabe: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Mi toraaki on e dow ɗum njoɓdi, njoɓdi am ndin fawaaki si wonaa Jooma winndere nde.
explication: Mi ɗaɓɓiraali on njoɓdi fii ko mi yottinanta Joomi am kon e mooɗon, njoɓdi am ndin fawaaki si wanaa Alla Jooma tageefooji ɗin wanaa e tanaa Makko.

arabe: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
traduction: Kulee Alla ɗoftoɗon mi.
explication: Huliree Alla ɗoftagol Yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin e woɗɗitagol haɗaani Makko ɗin, ɗoftee lam e ko mi yamirta on kon, e ko mi haɗata on kon e muuɗum.

arabe: ۞ قَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلۡأَرۡذَلُونَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Enee, hara men ngooŋɗinte, ja'asɓe ɓen no njokkumaa?"
explication: Yimɓe makko ɓen wi'ani mo: Enee, hara men gomɗinte -an Nuuhu- men jokka ko adduɗaa kon men gollira, hara le pellet, jokkuɓe ma ɓen ko e yimɓe jaasuɓe ɓen ɓe jeyaako e hoohooɓe e teddinaaɓe ɓen alaa e maɓɓe?!

arabe: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: O maaki: "Ko holɗum woni ganndal am e ko ɓe ngonoo e gollude?".
explication: Nuuhu maakani ɓe (yo o his): E ko honɗum woni ganndal am e ko ɓee gomɗinɓe wonunoo e gollude? Mi laataaki fawtaniiɗo ɓe sakko mi mofta golle maɓɓe ɗen.

arabe: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّيۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ
traduction: Hasboore maɓɓe nde fawaaki si wonaa e Joomi am, sinndo hoɗon so'aynoo.
explication: Hasbugol ɓe fawaaki si wanaa Alla, On Annduɗo gunndooji maɓɓe ɗin e feeñuɗi maɓɓe ɗin wanaa ka am, sinndo hiɗon so'aynoo, on wowlataano ko wowluɗon kon.

arabe: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Min mi ngonaani raɗotooɗo gooŋɗinɓe ɓen.
explication: Mi wonaali raɗotooɗo gomɗinɓe ɓen ka mbatu am, ka jaabagol ko lanndiɗon kon fii yo on gomɗin.

arabe: إِنۡ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: Min mi ngonaani si wonaa jerrtinoowo ɓannguɗo.
explication: Min mi wonaali si wanaa jertinoowo ɓannguɗo jertinngol, miɗo rentinira on e Lepte Alla ɗen.

arabe: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Min woondii si a accaani aan Nuuhu, ma a laato sanne jiyaaɗo e rajmeteeɓe ɓen".
explication: Yimɓe makko ɓen wi'i mo: Men woondii si a tertaaki kon ko noddataa men e muuɗum, ma a wonu sanne jeyaaɗo e yenneteeɓe ɓen e warirteeɓe ɓen fiɗeede kaaƴe.

arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي كَذَّبُونِ
traduction: O maaki: "Joom am, pellet, yimɓe am ɓen ɓe fenni kam".
explication: Nuuhu noddi Joomi makko o maaki: Jooma, pellet, yimɓe am ɓen ɓe fennii lam, ɓe goonginaali lam e ko mi addi kon immorde ka maaɗa.

arabe: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Ñaawu hakkunde am e maɓɓe ñaawoore, ndanndaa mi e ɓeen wonnduɓe e am joyaaɓe e gooŋɗinɓe ɓen.
explication: Ñaawu hakkunde am e maɓɓe ñaawoore halka- ynde ɓe sabu nanngitagol maɓɓe e dow meere nden, danndaa mi e ɓen gomɗinɓe wonnduɓe e am immorde e kon ko halkirtaa ɗum yedduɓe ɓen ka yimɓe am.

arabe: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
traduction: Min danndi mo e ɓeen won'ɗuɓe e makko ka ndeer laana ƴoltiika(loowaaka).
explication: Men jaabinani mo du'aa makko on, Men danndi mo e ɓen gomɗinɓe wonnduɓe e makko ka nder laana hebbinaaka yimɓe e muumi.

arabe: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا بَعۡدُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ
traduction: Refti Min yooli ɓaawo [maɓɓe] heddiiɓe ɓen.
explication: Refti Men yooli ɓaawo maɓɓe heddiiɓe ɓen, ɓen le, ko yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen.

arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Pellet, wonii e ɗuum [ko jaŋtaa ɗoo] Aaya, ɓurɓe heewde e maɓɓe laataaki gooŋɗinɓe.
explication: Pellet, wonii e ɗum ko jaŋtaa immorde e fillayee Nuuhu e yimɓɓe makko ɓen, e daɗugol Nuuhu e ɓen gomɗinɓe wonnduɓe e makko, e halkeede yedduɓe ɓen ka yimɓe makko ɗum ko tasakuyee wonannde taskotooɓe ɓen, ɓurɓe heewude ɓen e maɓɓe wonaali gomɗinɓe.

arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa, ko Kaŋko woni Tedduɗo jurmeteeɗo.
explication: Anndu Joomi maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- ko Kanko woni tedduɗo Yoɓtotooɗo ayɓe Makko ɓen,Yurmeteeɗo on tuubuɗo e maɓɓe.

arabe: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٌ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Aadiŋkooɓe ɓen njeddiino Nulaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Aadinkooɓe ɓen fenniino Nulaaɓe ɓen tuma nde ɓe fennunoo Nulaaɗo maɓɓe on Huudu (yo o his).

arabe: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
traduction: Tuma nde Huudu musiɗɗo maɓɓe on wi'annoo ɓe: "Enee, on kulataa [Alla]?"
explication: Tuma nde Saalihu musiɗɗo maɓɓe on ka dammbe (asko) wi'annoo ɓe: Enee, on hulataa Alla, acciron rewugol tanaa Makko sabu kulol Makko?!

arabe: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
traduction: Min dey, ko mi Nulaaɗo e mooɗon koolaaɗo.
explication: Min dey, ko mi Nulaaɗo mooɗon, Alla Nulii lam e mooɗon, ko mi hoolaaɗo mi ɓeydataa e dow ko Alla Yamira lam kon yottinngol ɗum, mi uytataa ɗum kadi.

arabe: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
traduction: Kulee Alla ɗoftoɗon mi.
explication: Huliree Alla ɗoftagol Yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin e woɗɗitagol haɗaani Makko ɗin, ɗoftee lam e ko mi yamiri on kon, e ko mi haɗi on kon e muuɗum.

arabe: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Mi toraaki on e dow ɗuum njoɓdi, njoɓdi am ndin fawaaki si wonaa Jooma winndere nde.
explication: Mi ɗaɓɓiraali on njoɓdi fii ko mi yottinanta Joomi am kon e mooɗon, njoɓdi am ndin fawaaki si wanaa Alla Jooma tageefooji ɗin wanaa e tanaa Makko.

arabe: أَتَبۡنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةٗ تَعۡبَثُونَ
traduction: Enee, on mahat Ma'ande e kala tulde hoɗon pija?
explication: Enee, on mahay e kala nokkuure hentiinde toowunde maadi fii maande e fijindaaru ndu alaa nafa ruttatooɗo on ka aduna mooɗon maaɗum ka Laakara mooɗon?!

arabe: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَخۡلُدُونَ
traduction: Njogitoɗon kuɓeeje a wi'ayma onon ko on luttinteeɓe [ka aduna].
explication: Jogitoɗon caŋeeji e kuɓeeje wasi on luttinte e nder nduu adunaaru, hara on eggataa e mayru?!

arabe: وَإِذَا بَطَشۡتُم بَطَشۡتُمۡ جَبَّارِينَ
traduction: Si on njaggitii, njanggiton ko ndunndarankooɓe.
explication: Si on jaggitirii warugol maaɗum piyugol, jaggiton ko on ndunndarankooɓe ko aldaa e yurmeende.

arabe: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
traduction: Lulee Alla ɗoftoɗon mi.
explication: Huliree Alla ɗoftagol Yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin e woɗɗitagol haɗaani Makko ɗin, ɗoftee lam e ko mi yamirta on kon, e ko mi haɗata on kon e muuɗum.

arabe: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Kulee oon ɓeydirɗo on ko ngannduɗon.
explication: Hulee tikkere Alla Okkuɗo on immorde e neemaaji makko ɗi annduɗon.

arabe: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنۡعَٰمٖ وَبَنِينَ
traduction: O ɓeydiri on neemoraaɗi e ɓiɓɓe worɓe.
explication: O okki on neemoraaɗi, O okki on ɓiɗɓe worɓe.

arabe: وَجَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ
traduction: E gese e canɗi.(gite).
explication: O okki on gese e canɗi ilooji.

arabe: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
traduction: [O maaki] min dey, miɗo hulani on Lepte Ñalaande mawnde.
explication: Min, miɗo hulani on -onon yimɓe am- Lepte Ñalaande mawnde nden ko Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "No fotana min ter, si a waajike ma si a laataaki jiyaaɗo e waajotooɓe ɓeen".
explication: Yimɓe makko ɓen wi'ani mo: Ko waajotoɗaa men kon e si a waajaaki no fotana amen ter, men gomɗintaa ma, men ruttataako gaayi ko men woni kon e muuɗum.

arabe: إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
traduction: Pellet, ɗuum wonaani si wonaa jikku adinooɓe ɓeen.
explication: ɗum wonaali si wanaa diina adinooɓe ɓen e naamuuji maɓɓe e jikkuuji maɓɓe.

arabe: وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
traduction: Minen Min ngonaani leptoyteeɓe.
explication: Men wonaali leptoyteeɓe.

arabe: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Ɓe njeddi mo, Min kalki ɓe. Pellet, wonii e ɗuum [ko jaŋtaa ɗoo] Aaya, ɓurɓe heewude e maɓɓe laataaki gooŋɗinɓe.
explication: Ɓe jokki yiddugol Annabaajo maɓɓe on Huudu (yo o his), Men halkiri ɓe henndu rimardu ndu sabu fennugol maɓɓe ngol. pellet, wonii e ngol halkugol hangol tasakuyee wonannde taskotooɓe ɓen, ɓurɓe heewude ɓen e maɓɓe wonaali gomɗinɓe.

arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa, ko Kaŋko woni Tedduɗo jurmeteeɗo.
explication: Anndu Joomi maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- ko Kanko woni tedduɗo Yoɓtotooɗo ayɓe Makko ɓen Yurmeteeɗo on tuubuɗo immorde e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Samuudiŋkooɓe ɓeen njeddiino Nulaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Samuudinkooɓe ɓen finniino Nulaaɓe ɓen sabu fennugol maɓɓe Annabaajo maɓɓe on Saalihu (yo o his).

arabe: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
traduction: Tuma nde Saalihu musiɗɗo maɓɓe on wi'annoo ɓe: "Enee, on kulataa [Alla]?"
explication: Tuma nde Saalihu musiɗɗo maɓɓe on ka dammbe (asko) wi'annoo ɓe: Enee, on hulataa Alla, acciron rewugol tanaa Makko sabu kulol Makko?!

arabe: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
traduction: Min dey, ko mi Nulaaɗo e mooɗon koolaaɗo.
explication: Min, ko mi Nulaaɗo mooɗon, Alla Nulii lam e mooɗon, ko mi hoolaaɗo e nder ko mi yottinanta Mo kon, mi ɓeydataa e dow mu'un mi uytataa ɗum kadi.

arabe: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
traduction: Kulee Alla ɗoftoɗon mi.
explication: Huliree Alla ɗoftagol Yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin e woɗɗitagol haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, ɗoftee lam e ko mi yamiri on kon, e ko mi haɗi on kon e muuɗum.

arabe: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Mi toraaki on e dow ɗuum njoɓdi, njoɓdi am ndi fawaaki si wonaa Jooma winndere nde.
explication: Mi ɗaɓɓiraali on njoɓdi fii ko mi yottinanta Joomi am kon e mooɗon, njoɓdi am ndin fawaaki si wanaa Alla Jooma tageefooji ɗin wanaa e tanaa Makko.

arabe: أَتُتۡرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
traduction: Enee, hara on ngaccete e koo ko woni ɗoo ko on hooliiɓe?!
explication: Enee, on tamƴini nde acceteɗon e nder koo ko wonuɗon e muuɗum immorde e moƴƴereeji e neemaaji ko on hooliiɓe hara on hulaa?!

arabe: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
traduction: E ndeer gese e canɗi.(gote.)
explication: E nder gese e canɗi ilooji.

arabe: وَزُرُوعٖ وَنَخۡلٖ طَلۡعُهَا هَضِيمٞ
traduction: E remuruuji e tamarooje hara dukke majje ko ɓennduɗe.
explication: E awruuji e tamarooje dimɗe majje ɗen ko newiiɗe ɓennduɗe.

arabe: وَتَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتٗا فَٰرِهِينَ
traduction: Hoɗon lesa pelle ɗeen [mbaɗon] cuuɗi ko on haawitiiɓe.
explication: Hiɗon taƴa pelle ɗen fii yo on waɗu cuuɗi hoɗon e majji hara onon ko ŋelirɓe lesugol ɗi.

arabe: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
traduction: Kulee Alla ɗoftoɗon mi.
explication: Huliree Alla ɗoftagol Yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin e woɗɗitagol haɗaani Makko ɗin, ɗoftee lam e ko mi yamiri on kon, e ko mi haɗi on kon e muuɗum.

arabe: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
traduction: Wota on ɗofto jamaruyee fantinooɓe ɓeen.
explication: Wata on ɗowor yamaruyee fantinirooɓe ɓen e dow wonkiiji mu'un waɗɗitagol geddi ɗin.

arabe: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ
traduction: Ɓeen bonnooɓe ka leydi hara ɓe moƴƴintaa.
explication: Ɓen bonnirooɓe ka leydi sabu ko ɓe saakata kon immorde e geddi ɗin, hara ɓe moƴƴinirtaa pittaali maɓɓe jogitagol ɗotaare Alla nden.

arabe: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَحَّرِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Pellet, an ko a jiyaaɗo wilaaɓe ɓeen".
explication: Yimɓe makko ɓen wi'ani mo: Anndu, an ko a jeyaaɗo e ɓen mbilɗaaɓe laawi ɗuuɗuɗi, haa mbilewu ngun fooli hakkillaaji maɓɓe ɗin, ngu naɓi ɗi.

arabe: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا فَأۡتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
traduction: An a wonaani si wonaa ɓannduŋke yeru amen, awa addu aaya, si tawii a laatike jiyaaɗo e gooŋɗuuɓe ɓen.
explication: A wonaali si wanaa ɓanndunke wano amen alaa ko senndumaa e amen haa tawa a wonay Nulaaɗo, awa addii maande tinndinaynde wonndema an ko a Nulaaɗo, si tawii ko a goonguɗo e ko nodditiɗaa kon wonndema ko a Nulaaɗo.

arabe: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٞ لَّهَا شِرۡبٞ وَلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
traduction: O maaki: "baaɗoo ko naaqawa, no woodani mba yarannde, no woodani on onon kadi yarannde ñalaande anndaande".
explication: Saalihu maakani ɓe -nde tawnoo Alla okkii mo maande nden, ɗum le, ko ngelooba mba Alla yalti e nder fetere nden-: mbaaɗoo ko ngelooba himba yi'ee himba meemee, no woodani mba geɓal immorde e ndiyam ɗam, onon kadi no woodani on geɓal anndaangal, mba yarataa e nden ñalaande tawnde ko nde geɓal mooɗon, onon kadi wata on yaru dey e nden ñalaande tawnde ko nde geɓal mabba.

arabe: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
traduction: Wota on memir mba ko boni, sakko nannga on Lepte Ñande Mawnde.
explication: Wata on memir mba ko lorrata mba immorde e borogogol maaɗum piyugol, sakko heɓa on sabu ɗum Lepte immorde ka Alla O halkira on ɗe e nder ñalaande mawnde sabu ko woni kon e mayre immorde albalaa'uuji jippotooɗi e dow mooɗon.

arabe: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصۡبَحُواْ نَٰدِمِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mborii mba, ɓe ngonti nimsuɓe.
explication: Ɓe fottani boraade mba, ɓurɗo ɓe malkiseede on borii mba, ɓe wonti nimsuɓe e dow ko ɓe huuwi kon nde ɓe anndunoo pellet, feere alaa Lepte ɗen jippoto e maɓɓe, kono nimse tuma yi'ugol Lepte ɗen ɗum nafataa.

arabe: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Lepte ɗen nanngi ɓe. Pellet, ngonii e ɗuum [ko jaŋtaa ɗoo] Aaya, ɓurɓe heewde e maɓɓe laataaki gooŋɗinɓe.
explication: Lepte ɗe ɓe fodanoo ɗen nanngi ɓe, ɗen le; ko dillannde nden e haacaango ngon, pellet, wonii e koo ko jaŋtaaɗoo immorde e fillayee fii Saalihu e yimɓe makko ɓen tasakuyee wonannde taskotooɓe ɓen, ɓurɓe heewude e maɓɓe wonaali gomɗinooɓe

arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa, ko Kako woni Tedduɗo Jurmeteeɗo.
explication: Anndu Joomi maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- ko Kanko woni tedduɗo Yoɓtotooɗo ayɓe Makko ɓen, Yurmeteeɗo on tuubuɗo immorde e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Yimɓe Luutu ɓeen njeddi Nulaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Yimɓe Luutu ɓen fenni Nulaaɓe ɓen, sabu fennugol maɓɓe Annabaajo maɓɓe on Luutu (yo o his).

arabe: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
traduction: Tuma nde Luutu musiɗɗo maɓɓe on wi'annoo ɓe: "Enee, on kulataa [Alla]?"
explication: Tuma nde Luutu wi'annoo ɓe: Enee, on hulataa Alla, acciron sirkangol Mo sabu kulol Makko?!

arabe: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
traduction: Min dey, ko mi Nulaaɗo e mooɗon koolaaɗo.
explication: Min, ko mi Nulaaɗo mooɗon, Alla Nulii lam e mooɗon, ko mi hoolaaɗo e nder ko mi yottinanta Mo kon, mi ɓeydataa e dow mu'un mi uytataa kadi.

arabe: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
traduction: Kulee Alla ɗoftoɗon mi.
explication: Huliree Alla ɗoftagol Yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin e woɗɗitagol haɗaani Makko ɗin, ɗoftee lam e ko mi yamirta on kon, e ko mi haɗata on kon e muuɗum.

arabe: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Mi toraaki on e dow ɗum njoɓdi, njoɓdi am ndin fawaaki si wonaa Jooma winndere nde.
explication: Mi ɗaɓɓiraali on njoɓdi fii ko mi yottinanta Joomi am kon e mooɗon, njoɓdi am ndin fawaaki si wanaa Alla Jooma tageefooji ɗin wanaa e tanaa Makko.

arabe: أَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلذُّكۡرَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Enee, on ngarat e worɓe ɓe immorde e winndere nde?!
explication: Enee, on aray worɓe ɓen immorde e yimɓe ɓen ka duburiiji maɓɓe?!

arabe: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ
traduction: Ɗalon ko Joomi mooɗon tagani on kon immorde e sonnaaɓe mooɗon? Ko woni, onon ko on yimɓe yawtuɓe Keerol.
explication: Accon arugol e kon ko Alla tagiri fii yo on huntude tuuyaaji mooɗon e mu'un immorde e farjuuji sonnaaɓe mooɗon?! Ko woni, onon ko on yawtirɓe keeri Alla ɗin ndee ɓoylaare añaande.

arabe: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡرَجِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Min ngooɗndiri si a accaani aan Luutu, ma a laato sanne jiyaaɗo e yaltiteeɓe ɓen".
explication: Yimɓe makko ɓen wi'ani mo: Men woodii si a accaali an Luutu haɗugol men e ngaal gollal e añidugol men e maggal, ma a wonu sanne an e ɓen wonnduɓe e maaɗa jayaaɓe e yaltinteeɓe ɓen ka saare amen.

arabe: قَالَ إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقَالِينَ
traduction: O maaki: "Min dey, miɗo jiyaa e añɓe ɓen golle mooɗon ɗen".
explication: Luutu maakani ɓe: Min dey, miɗo jeyaa e añuɓe ɓen konnii ɗee golle mooɗon ɗe wonuɗon e gollude ɗum.

arabe: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهۡلِي مِمَّا يَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: Jooma, danndam min e ɓeynguure am ndeen kon ko ɓe ngollata.
explication: O noddi Joomi makko, o maaki: Jooma, danndam, danndaa ɓeynguure am ndin kadi kon ko saatii heɓude ɓee immorde e Lepte ɗen sabu bonɗi ɗi ɓe gollata ɗin.

arabe: فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
traduction: Min danndi mo e ɓeynguure makko nden, ɓe fof maɓɓe.
explication: Men jaabini du'aa makko on, Men danndi mo kanko e ɓeynguure makko nden ɓe fow maɓɓe.

arabe: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
traduction: Si wonaa jiidiraare(nayeejo debbo) nden ka halkaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Si wanaa debbo makko on, on ɗon gomɗii o wonii geddo, o woni jeyaaɗo e yahuɓe halkaaɓe ɓen.

arabe: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
traduction: Refti Min oƴƴi heddii ɓe ɓen.
explication: Refti ɓaawo yaltugol Luutu e ɓeynguure makko nden ka saare (Saduuma) Men halki yimɓe makko heddiiɓe ɓen ɓaawo makko ko ɓuri saɗtude halkugol.

arabe: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرٗاۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
traduction: Min toɓini e dow maɓɓe toɓo, bonii toɓo jeertinaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Men saaƴini e dow maɓɓe kaaƴe immorde ka kammu yeru saaƴinngol toɓo, bonii toɓo ɓee ɓe Luutu wonunoo jertinnde, o rentina ɓe kadi immorde e Lepte Alla si ɓe jokkii ko ɓe woni kon e muuɗum immorde e waɗɗitagol bonɗi ɗin.

arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Pellet, wonii e ɗuum [ko jaŋtaa ɗoo] aaya, ɓurɓe heewuɓe e maɓɓe laataaki mgooŋɗinɓe.
explication: Pellet, wonii e koo ko jaŋtaa ɗoo immorde e Lepte jippiiɗe ɗen e yimɓe Luutu (yo o his), sabu waɗugol maɓɓe pankare ɗen, ko tasakuyee wonannde taskotooɓe ɓen, ɓurɓe heewude e maɓɓe wonaali gomɗinɓe.

arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa, ko Kako woni Tedduɗo Jurmeteeɗo.
explication: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- ko Kanko woni tedduɗo Yoɓtotooɗo ayɓe Makko ɓen, Yurmeteeɗo on tuubuɗo immorde e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: كَذَّبَ أَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Yimɓe fitaare(sutu) nden njeddiino Nulaaɓe ɓeen.
explication: Yimɓe saare joomiraare leɗɗe sukkuɗe nden takko madyana, ɓen fenniino Nulaaɓe ɓen, tuma nde ɓe fennunoo Annabaajo maɓɓe on Su'aybu (yo o his).

arabe: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
traduction: Tuma nde Su'aybu wi'annoo ɓe: "Enee, on kulataa [Alla]?"
explication: Tuma nde Su'aybu Annabaajo maɓɓe on wi'annoo ɓe: Enee, on hulataa Alla, acciron sirkangol Mo sabu kulol Makko?!

arabe: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
traduction: Min dey, ko mi Nulaaɗo e mooɗon koolaaɗo.
explication: Min, ko mi Nulaaɗo mooɗon, Alla Nulii lam e mooɗon, ko mi hoolaaɗo e nder ko mi yottinanta Mo kon, mi ɓeydataa e dow ko O Yamiri lam kon yottinngol ɗum mi uytataa kadi.

arabe: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
traduction: Lulee Alla ɗoftoɗon mi.
explication: Huliree Alla ɗoftagol Yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin e woɗɗitagol haɗaani Makko ɗin, ɗoftee lam e ko mi yamiri on kon, e ko mi haɗi on kon e muuɗum.

arabe: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Mi toraaki on e dow ɗuum njoɓdi, njoɓdi am ndin fawaaki si wonaa Jooma winndere nde.
explication: Mi ɗaɓɓiraali on njoɓdi fii ko mi yottinanta Joomi am kon e mooɗon, njoɓdi am ndin fawaaki si wanaa Alla Jooma tageefooji ɗin wanaa e tanaa Makko.

arabe: ۞ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡسِرِينَ
traduction: Kumnee ɓetu ngu, wata on laato jiyaaɓe e ustooɓe ɓeen.
explication: Timminanee yimɓe ɓen ɓetu ngun tuma nde yeeyoton ɓe, wata on wonu jeyaaɓe e ɓen ustooɓe ɓetu ngun si hiɓe yeeyude yimɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَزِنُواْ بِٱلۡقِسۡطَاسِ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمِ
traduction: Manndikiree(pe'esirɗe) manndikirɗe peewɗe ɗeen.
explication: Manndikiree si hiɗon manndikannde tanaa mooɗon manndikirɗe feewuɗe ɗen.

arabe: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
traduction: Wata on ustan yimɓe ɓen piiji maɓɓe ɗin, wota on lancito ka leydi hara ko on bonnooɓe.
explication: Wata on ustan yimɓe ɓen hakkeeji maɓɓe ɗin, wata on hebbinir bone ɗen ka leydi waɗɗitagol geddi ɗin.

arabe: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلۡجِبِلَّةَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
traduction: Kulee oon Takɗo on, o tagoore adinoongu ngun.
explication: Hulee On Taguɗo on, O tagi kadi moftaaji adinooɗi ɗin huliron Mo fii wata O jippin e mooɗon Lepte Makko ɗen.

arabe: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَحَّرِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Pellet, an ko a jiyaaɗo wilaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Yimɓe Su'aybu ɓen wi'ani Su'aybu: Pellet, an ko a jeyaaɗo ɓen ɓe mbilewu heɓi ɗum laawi ɗuuɗuɗi haa mbilewu ngun fooli hakkille maaɗa ɗen, ngu wirni ɗe.

arabe: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
traduction: Aan a wonaani si wonaa ɓannduŋke yeru amen, tawde miɗen cikkumaa ko a jiyaaɗo e fenooɓe ɓeen.
explication: A wonaali si wanaa ko a ɓanndunke wano amen, alaa ko senndumaa e amen, ko honno wonirtaa Nulaaɗo? Men jikkaama si wanaa ko a fenoowo e kon ko nodditiɗaa ɗum wonndema an ko a Nulaaɗo.

arabe: فَأَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
traduction: Awa fukku e dow amen kunte kammu ngun, si tawii a laatike jiyaaɗo e gooŋɗuɓe ɓeen.
explication: Awa liɓu e hoore amen kunte immorde ka kammu si tawii a wonii goonguɗo e ko nodditiɗaa kon.

arabe: قَالَ رَبِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: O maaki: "Ko Joomi am woni gannduɗo ko ngolloton kon".
explication: Su'aybu maakani ɓe: ko Joomi am woni Annduɗo kon ko golloton immorde e sirku e geddi, hay e huunde e golle mooɗon ɗen suuɗanaaki Mo.

arabe: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
traduction: Ɓe njeddi mo, nanngi ɓe Lepte ñalaande ɗowdiinde nden. Pellet, ɗen laatino Lepte ñalaande mawnde.
explication: Ɓe jokkindiri fennugol ngol, heɓi ɓe Lepte mawɗe nokku ka ɗowdini ɓe duulere ɓaawo ñalaande saɗtunde nguli, o saaƴini e dow maɓɓe yiite nge sunni ɓe. Pellet, ñalnde halkeede maɓɓe ɗum wonuno ñalaande mawnunde kulol.

arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Pellet, wonii e ɗuum [ko jaŋtaa ɗoo] aaya, ɓurɓe heewɓe e maɓɓe laataaki gooŋɗinɓe.
explication: Pellet, wonii e koo ko jaŋtaa ɗoo immorde e halkeede yimɓe Su'aybu ɓen (yo o his) tasakuyee, wonannde taskotooɓe ɓen, ɓurɓe heewude e maɓɓe wonaali gomɗinɓe.

arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: Pellet, Joomi maaɗa, ko Kaŋko woni Tedduɗo Jurmeteeɗo.
explication: Anndu Joomi maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- ko Kanko woni tedduɗo Yoɓtotooɗo ayɓe Makko ɓen, Yurmeteeɗo on tuubuɗo immorde e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: E pellet, kayre ko nde jippinaande Joom winndere nde.
explication: E pellet, ndee Alqur'aanaare tellinaande e Muhammadu (yo Alla juulu e makko hisina) ko jippinaande immorde Jooma tageefooji ɗin.

arabe: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلۡأَمِينُ
traduction: Jippinii nde ruuhu koolaaɗo oon.
explication: Jippinii nde Jibriila hoolaaɗo on (yo o his).

arabe: عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنذِرِينَ
traduction: E ɓernde maaɗa fii yo a laato jiyaaɗo e jeertinooɓe ɓen.
explication: O jippinii nde ka ɓernde maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- fii yo a wonu jeyaaɗo e ɓen Nulaaɓe jertinooɓe yimɓe ɓen, ɓe hulɓiniraɓe Lepte Alla ɗen.

arabe: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيّٖ مُّبِينٖ
traduction: E ɗemngal Aarabi ɓanngungal.
explication: O jippininde e ɗemngal Aarabu ɓanngungal.

arabe: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِي زُبُرِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
traduction: Pellet, kayre hende ka ɗeri aranɓe ɓeen.
explication: Pellet, ndee Alqur'aanaare nde jaŋtanooma ka defte adinooɓe ɓen, gomɗii Defte kammuyankooje adinooɗe ɗen wewliniriino nde.

arabe: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
traduction: Enee, hara laatanaaki ɓe Ma'ande, nde tawata anndiino nde ɓiɓɓe Israa'iila annduɓe ɓen?
explication: Kaa hara wonanaali ɓee fennuɓe ma maande e goongugol maaɗa, nde tawata annduɓe ɓen ka ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila no anndi goongugol ko jippinaa kon e maaɗa, wano Abdullaahi bun Salaami.

arabe: وَلَوۡ نَزَّلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضِ ٱلۡأَعۡجَمِينَ
traduction: Sinndo Min njippinno nde e dow yoga e ajamiyaŋkooɓe ɓen.
explication: Sinndo Men jippinno ndee Alqur'aanaare e dow woɓɓe e ɓen ajamiyankooɓe ɓe wowlataa ɗemngal Aarabu ngal,

arabe: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: o janngi nde e dow maɓɓe, ɓe laatotaako gooɗinɓe nde.
explication: O janngi nde e dow maɓɓe, ɓe wonataa gomɗinɓe nde; sabu arma ɓe wi'a: Men faamataa nde, koni yo ɓe yettu Alla ɓaa O jippinii [nde] ka haala maɓɓe.

arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكۡنَٰهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
traduction: Ko wano nii Min naatniri ɗum e ɓerɗe bonɓe ɓen.
explication: Ko wano nii, Men naadiri fennugol ngol e keefeeru ngun e nder ɓerɗe bonɓe ɓen.

arabe: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
traduction: Ɓe ngooŋɗintaa nde, haa ɓe nji'a Lepte mu'usuɗe ɗen.
explication: Ɓe waylataa ko ɓe woni kon e muuɗum immorde keefeeru ngun, ɓe gomɗintaa haa ɓe yi'a Lepte muusuɗe ɗen.

arabe: فَيَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
traduction: Ɗe ngara e maɓɓe e juhayee, hara ɓe so'aa.
explication: Ɗee Lepte ara e maɓɓe e juhal, hara ɓe anndaa arugol majje haa ɗe juha ɓe.

arabe: فَيَقُولُواْ هَلۡ نَحۡنُ مُنظَرُونَ
traduction: Sakko ɓe mbi'a: "Taw si ko min neeɓnanteeɓe?"
explication: Hara hiɓe wi'a tuma Lepte ɗen jippotoo e maɓɓe e juhal immorde e saɗtugol nimse ɗen: Taw si ko men nennanteeɓe haa men tuuba ka Alla?!

arabe: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
traduction: Enee, ko Lepte amen ɗen ɓe keñorta?
explication: Enee, hara ko Lepte Amen ɗen ɓee heeferɓe hawjanta hara hiɓe wi'a: Men gomɗintaa ma haa liɓaa kammu ngun e hoore amen kunte, wano aaƴorɗaa non?!

arabe: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ إِن مَّتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ سِنِينَ
traduction: A tinii si Min ndakmitii ɓe duuɓi.
explication: Humpitam -an Nulaaɗo- si Men dakmitii ɓee heeferɓe ɗuurniiɓe e gomɗinngol ko adduɗaa kon, e neemaaji jamaanu juutungu.

arabe: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
traduction: Refti ari e maɓɓe  ko ɓe laatinoo heɓe podee.
explication: Refti ari e maɓɓe ɓaawo ngun jamaanu ngu ɓe heɓi e muuɗum ɗin neemaaji, ko ɓe wonanoo fodeede kon immorde e Lepte ɗen.

arabe: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
traduction: Nafaali ɓe ko ɓe laatinoo kon heɓe ndakmitoo.
explication: Ko honɗum nafi ɓe ɗin neemaaji ɗi ɓe wonunoo e muuɗum ka aduna?! Gomɗii ɗin neemaaji taƴii, ɗum nafaali hay e huunde.

arabe: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
traduction: Min kalkatanii saare woo, si wonaa hara no woodani nde jeertinooɓe.
explication: Men halkataa mofte woo si wanaa ɓaawo ngantinirgol e majje nulugol Nulaaɓe ɓen e jippinngol defte ɗen.

arabe: ذِكۡرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
traduction: [Ɗuum] ko waaju, Min laataaki tooñooɓe.
explication: Waaju e anndintingol ɓe, Men wonaali tooñirɓe leptugol ɓe ɓaawo ngantinorgol e maɓɓe nulugol Nulaaɓe ɓen e jippinngol defte ɗen.

arabe: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتۡ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
traduction: Wonaa seytanuuji ɗin njippini nde.
explication: Seytanuuji ɗin jippinaali ndee Alqur'aanaare ka ɓernde Nulaaɗo on (yo Alla juulu e makko hisna).

arabe: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُمۡ وَمَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
traduction: [Ɗuum] haananaaɗi, ɗi kattantaa ɗum kadi.
explication: Sellataa nde ɗi jippinta ka ɓernde makko, wurin ɗi hattanaaka ɗum.

arabe: إِنَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّمۡعِ لَمَعۡزُولُونَ
traduction: Pellet, kannji ko ɗi follateeɗi ga keɗagol ngol.
explication: Ɗi hattantaake ɗum, sabu kannji ko ɗi woɗɗinti- naaɗi gaayi nokku mayre on immorde ka kammu, ko honno ɗi yottorta e mayre, sakko ɗi jippina nde?!

arabe: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ
traduction: Wota a noddu deweteeɗo goo wond'ude e Alla, sakko laatoɗaa jiyaaɗo e Lepteteeɓe ɓen.
explication: Wata a rewu wonndude e Alla reweteeɗo goo kafidaa mo e Makko, sakko wonaa sabu ɗum jeyaaɗo e leptoyteeɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَأَنذِرۡ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَ
traduction: Jeertin gorol maaɗa ɓurɓe ɓadaade ɓen.
explication: Jertin -an Nulaaɗo- ɓurɗo ɓadaade refti ɓurɗo ɓadaade ka yimɓe maaɗa, fii wata heɓu ɓe Lepte Alla si ɓe heddike e dow sirku ngun.

arabe: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Lesɗinan balbe maaɗen, wona nde ɓen jokkuɓe ma immorde e gooŋɗinɓe ɓen.
explication: Newinan banŋe maaɗa konngol e kuugal wonan- nde ɓen jokkuɓe ma immorde e gomɗinɓe ɓen ka yurminngol ɓe newanoo ɓe.

arabe: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: Si ɓe njeddii ma, haray maaku: "Min dey, ko mi danndiiɗo ko ngolloton".
explication: Si ɓe yeddii ma, hara ɓe jaabaaki ko yamirɗaaɓe kon e muuɗum immorde e Ngootimbaaku Alla e ɗoftagol Mo, haray maakan ɓe: Min dey, ko mi pottitiiɗo kon ko golloton immorde e sirku ngun e geddi ɗin.

arabe: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
traduction: Hoolor On Tedduɗo Jurmeteeɗo.
explication: Tuugo e fiyakuuji maaɗin fow e On Tedduɗo yoɓtotooɗo ayɓe Makko ɓen, Yurmeteeɗo ɓen ruttiiɓe e maɓɓe faade ka Makko.

arabe: ٱلَّذِي يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
traduction: On jioowo ma saha de darotoɗaa.
explication: On sutiiɗo ma O Senike fewndo darantoɗaa Julde nden.

arabe: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
traduction: E baylitogol maaɗa e hakkunde sujjooɓe ɓeen.
explication: Seniiɗo On no sutii waylitagol maaɗa iwa e alahaali yaha e alhaali goo e hakkude juulooɓe ɓe, suuɗanaaki Mo hay huunde e ko waɗataa kon, wanaa kadi ko tanaa maaɗa waɗata kon.

arabe: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
traduction: Pellet, ko Kaŋko woni Nanoowo gannduɗo On.
explication: Pellet, ko Kanko woni Nanoowo ko janngataa kon immorde e Alqur'aana e jaŋta ka nder Julde maaɗa, Annduɗo On, annuyee maaɗa.

arabe: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
traduction: Taw si mi humpitay on ko e hommbo Seytanuuji ɗin njippotoo?
explication: Taw si on accay mi humpita on, ko e hoore hommbo Seytanuuji ɗin jippotoo, ɗin ɗi aaƴiɗon wonndema kannji ɗi jippinii ndee Alqur'aanaare?

arabe: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ
traduction: Hiɗi njippoo e dow kala fekindotooɗo bakkodinɗo.
explication: Seytanuuji ɗin no jippoo e dow kala heewuɗo penaale ɗuuɗuɗo bakkaatu e geddi immorde e ndureeɓe(wageebe) ɓen.

arabe: يُلۡقُونَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ كَٰذِبُونَ
traduction: Hiɗi mbernoo nanɗe ɗen, ko ɓurɓe heewude e majji ko penooji.
explication: Seytanuuji ɗin no wujja nanɗe ɗen immorde ka mbatu ɓurngu toowude, ɗi werlo ɗum faade e weldiiɓe majji immorde e ndureeɓe ɓen, ɓurɓe heewude e ndureeɓe ɓen ko ɓe fenooɓe, hay si ɓe goongii e nder konngol, ɓe fenay ɓe wattida e maggol penaale teemedere.

arabe: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ
traduction: Yimooɓe ɓeen ko jokkata ɓe, ko bewɓe ɓeen.
explication: Ɓen yimooɓe ɓe aaƴiɗon wonndema Muhammadu (yo Alla juulu e makko hisna) ko jeyaaɗo e maɓɓe, ko jokki ɓen, ko seluɓe ɓen peewal ngal e laawol focciingol ngol, hiɓe fillitoo ko ɓen wowlata kon immorde e gimi.

arabe: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادٖ يَهِيمُونَ
traduction: Enee, a tinaani won'dema kamɓe heɓe yinoo e kala aynde?
explication: Kaa a tinaali -an Nulaaɗo- wonndema no jeyaa e feeñirde bewre maɓɓe nden wonnde kamɓe hiɓe wemmboo e nder kala aynde nde ɓe feƴƴi, tuma goo e mantugol, tumagoo kadi e ŋiñugol, e tanaa majji kannji ɗiɗi tumagoo kadi.

arabe: وَأَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفۡعَلُونَ
traduction: E tawde kamɓe heɓe wowla ko ɓe ngollataa.
explication: E tawde kamɓe hiɓe fena, ɓe wi'a: Men waɗii huunde kaari, hara ɓe waɗaali nde.

arabe: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٖ يَنقَلِبُونَ
traduction: Si wonaa ɓeen gooŋɗinɓe ɓe ngolli golle moƴƴe ɓe njaŋtii Alla ko ɗuuɗi ɓe yoɓtii ɓaawo ɓe tooñaama. Aray ka ɓeen tooñuɓe annday ko honde e waylitorde ɓe mbaylitotoo.
explication: Si wanaa ɓen gomɗinɓe immorde e yimooɓe ɓen ɓe golli golle moƴƴe ɗen, ɓe jaŋtii Alla jaŋtagol heewungol, ɓe fooli ayɓe Alla ɓen ɓaawo ɓe tooñii ɓe wano Hassaanu geɗal Saabitu (yo Alla weltor mo). Ɓen tooñirɓe sirkanngol Alla e jaggitugol e hoore jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, aray ka ɓe annda ko hennde e ruttorde ɓe ruttotoo faade e muuɗum, aray ɓe ruttoo faade e darorde mawnde, e hasboore sewunde.

arabe: طسٓۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَكِتَابٖ مُّبِينٍ
traduction: Taa Siin,[1] ɗeen ko aayeeje Alqur'aanaare nden e deftere ɓanngunde.
explication: (Taa Siin) hari yewtere fii yeru ɗee feƴƴiino ka cortewol Albaqara. Ɗee Aayeeje jippinaaɗe e dow maaɗa, ko ɗen woni Aayeeje Alqur'aanaare nden, e Deftere ɓanngunde ko jilɓi alaa e mayre, kala taskiiɗo nde o annday pellet, kayre ko nde immorde ka Alla.

arabe: هُدٗى وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Ko nde Peewal e welo-welo wonan'de gooŋɗinɓe ɓen.
explication: Ɗee Aayeeje, ko fewnayɗe faade e Goonga kan, ko ɗe wewlinayɗe gomɗinɓe ɓen Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on.

arabe: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ
traduction: Ɓeen ɓe no ñiiɓa e Juulde nden ɓe totta askal on,  kamɓe heɓe njananaa fii Laakara on.
explication: Ɓen ɓe no totta Julde nden no ɓuri timmirde, ɓe jonnira Jakka jawle maɓɓe ndin naɓirgol ɗe ka ɗe haani yaarude ton, hara kamɓe ko ɓe yananaaɓe ko woni kon ka Laakara immorde e Mbarjaari e Lepte.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
traduction: Pellet, ɓeen ɓe ngooŋɗinaani Laakara on, Min cuɗanii ɓe golle maɓɓe ɗen, kamɓe heɓe mbumo.
explication: Pellet, ɓen heeferaaɓe ɓe gomɗinaali Laakara on e ko woni kon ton immorde e Mbarjaari e Lepte, labinanaama ɓe golle maɓɓe bonɗe ɗen, ɓe duu- mii e gollugol ɗe, hara kamɓe ko ɓe wemmbiiɓe ɓe yi'ataa ko hewtinta ɓe e peewal ngal.

arabe: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ وَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرُونَ
traduction: Ko ɓeen ngoni ɓen, ɓe woodani ɗum Lepte bonɗe ɗen, kamɓe ka Laakara ko kamɓe ngoni hayruɓe ɓeen.
explication: Ɓen sifaaɓe koo ko jaŋtaa, ko ɓen woni ɓe wooda- ni ɗum lepte bonɗe ka aduna sabu wareede e daheede, kamɓe kadi ka Laakara ɓe ɓuroyay yimɓe ɓen fow hayrere, nokku ka ɓe hayroyta wonkiiji maɓɓe e ɓeynguureeji maɓɓe ɗin Ñalnde Darngal sabu luttineede maɓɓe ka Yiite.

arabe: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مِن لَّدُنۡ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
traduction: E pellet, an haɗa lonnginee Alqur'aanaare nden immorde ka Ñeeño gannduɗo.
explication: E pellet, an -Nulaaɗo- hiɗa lonngineede ndee Alqur'aanaare jippinaandee dow maaɗa immorde ka Ñeeño e nder tagugol Makko e fewjugol Makko e Sari'a Makko, Annduɗo hay e huunde suuɗanaaki Mo immorde e nafaaji jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: إِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهۡلِهِۦٓ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوۡ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٖ قَبَسٖ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُونَ
traduction: Tuma nde Muusaa maakannoo ɓeynguure makko nden: "Min dey, mi haynike yiite,  mi addana on ka nge woni ɗon kumpital ma mi addana on docotal kuɓɓungal, bela jo'o onon on itwoto.
explication: Jaŋto -an Nulaaɗo- fewndo Muusaa maakannoo yimɓe makko ɓen: Min dey mi yi'ii yiite, mi adda-noyay on ka nge woni ɗon kumpital immorde e Huɓɓuɗo nge On, O fewna en e laawol ngol, maaɗum le, mi addana on jolɓol yiite ƴettaangol e magge jortagol wonnde on iwloray nge immorde e jaangol ngol.

arabe: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِيَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Tuma nde o arnoo e magge, o noddaa: Ɗuum woni barkinaama on wonɗo ka yiite e ɓen wonɓe banŋe magge, e Senaare wonanii Alla Jooma winndere nden.
explication: Tuma nde o yottinoo nokku ka yiite nge o hayninoo ngen woni ɗon, Alla noddi mo: Ko woni, Seninaama On wonɗo ka yiite, e ɓen wonuɓe ɓanŋe magge immorde e Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen, e mawninngol Jooma winndere nden e Seninngol Mo e kala ko gasantaa Mo immorde e ɗin sifaaji ɗi majjuɓe ɓen sifotoo Mo.

arabe: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
traduction: Eey ma Muusaa, ko woni, ko Min woni Alla Tedduɗo Ñeeñɗo On.
explication: Alla Daalani mo: Ko an yo Muusaa, ko woni, ko Min woni Alla On Tedduɗo Mo goɗɗowoo foolataa, ko Mi Ñeeño e nder Tagugol Am ngol e Hoddirgol Am ngol e Sari'a Am on.

arabe: وَأَلۡقِ عَصَاكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنّٞ وَلَّىٰ مُدۡبِرٗا وَلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفۡ إِنِّي لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
traduction: Liɓu tuggordu maaɗa ndun, Tuma nde o yi'unoo ndu hundu dilla, a wi'ayma kayru ko ndu mbooɗdi, o hucciti ko o doguɗo o yiltitaake. Ko an yo Muusaa: "Wata a hul, Min dey Nulaaɓe ɓen kulataa to Am".
explication: Liɓu tuggordu maaɗa ndun, Muusaa jaɓi, nde Muusaa yi'unoo ndu hindu waylitoo dilla a wi'ayma kayru ko ndu mboddi, o hucciti fii dogugol ndu o ruttaaki. Alla Daalani mo: Wata a hulu ndu, Min Nulaaɓe ɓen hulataa ka Am mboddi wanaa tanaa mboddi kadi.

arabe: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنَۢا بَعۡدَ سُوٓءٖ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
traduction: Si wonaa oon tooñɗo, refti o lomtini ko moƴƴi ɓaawo bone ɗen. Pellet, Min ko Mi cuhroowo Jurmeteeɗo.
explication: Kono, mo tooñirii wonkii muuɗum waɗɗitagol junuubu, refti o tuubi ɓaawo ɗum, haray Min ko Mi Surroowo mo, Yurmeteeɗo mo.

arabe: وَأَدۡخِلۡ يَدَكَ فِي جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٖۖ فِي تِسۡعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
traduction: Naatnu junngo ma ngon ka jiiba maaɗa, ngo yaltay ko ngo ranewo ko aldaa e bone, [ɗum no jeyaa] e ndeer aayeeje jeenay nulaaɗe e Fir'awna e yimɓe makko ɓen, pellet, kamɓe ɓe laatike yimɓe faasiqiiɓe.
explication: Naadu junngo maaɗa ngon ka wuddere dolloke maaɗa hikkiinde e ndaande nden, ngo yaltay ɓaawo ko naaduɗaa ngo kon hara hingo rawniri wa gilaasi ko aldaa e colɗo, ɗum ko tawaaɗum e Aayeeje jeenay seedotooɗe goongugol maaɗa ɗen tawdaa e junngo ngon: Ko tuggordu ndun, e kokke ɗen, e uytagol dimɗe ɗen, e waame ɗen, e kanuuji ɗin, e mbuɗuuji ɗin, e totiiji ɗin, e ƴiiƴam ɗam- faade e Fir'awna e yimɓe makko ɓen, pellet, kamɓe ɓe wonii yimɓe yaltirɓe e doftaare Alla sabu yeddugol Mo.

arabe: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةٗ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: Tuma nde arnoo e maɓɓe Aayeeje amen ɗen ko yi'eteeɗe, ɓe mbi'i: "Ɗu'um, ko mbilewu ɓanngungu".
explication: Tuma nde ɗee Aayeeje Amen arunoo e maɓɓe, ɗen ɗe Men semmbiniri ɗum Muusaa ko ɗe ɓannguɗe feeñuɗe, ɓe wi'i: Ndee huunde nde Muusaa ardi e muuɗum immorde e Aayeeje ko mbilewu ɓanngungu.

arabe: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ ظُلۡمٗا وَعُلُوّٗاۚ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
traduction: Ɓe njeddi [aayeeje ɗen], tawi wonkiiji maɓɓe ɗin no yananaa fii majje, tooñe e mawnintinaare. Ndaaru ko honno laatornoo battane yedduɓe ɓen.
explication: Ɓe yeddi ɗee Aayeeje ɓannguɗe ɓe qirritaaki ɗe, wonkiiji maɓɓe ɗin yananaa wonndema ko ɗe immorde ka Alla; sabu tooñe maɓɓe ɗen e mawnitinaare maɓɓe nden gaayi Goonga kan, tasko -an Nulaaɗo- ko honno wonirnoo battane bonnirooɓe ɓen ka leydi keeferaaku maɓɓe ngun e geddi maɓɓe ɗin, gomɗii Men halkii ɓe, Men yirbiniiɓe ɓe fow maɓɓe.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ عِلۡمٗاۖ وَقَالَا ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٖ مِّنۡ عِبَادِهِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min ngokkii Daawuuda e Sulaymaana Ganndal ɓe maaki: "Yettoore nden woodanii Alla On ɓurnuɗo min e dow ɗuuɗuɓe immorde e jeyaaɓe makko gooŋɗinɓe ɓen".
explication: Gomɗii Men okkii Daawuuda e geɗaljo makko on Sulaymaana ganndal, no jeyaa e maggal ganndal haala colli ɗin, Daawuuda e Sulaymaana maaki ka jarnugol Alla O Teddii O Mawnii: Yettoore nden ko Alla heeranii On ɓurnirɗo men Annabaaku ngun e dow heewuɓe immorde e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen gomɗinɓe ɓen, e eltaneede jinnaaji ɗin e Saytanuuji ɗin.

arabe: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمۡنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيۡرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
traduction: Sulaymaana roni Daawuuda, O maaki: "eey mon yimɓe, min nganndinaama haala colli ɗin, men okkaama immorde e kala hu'unde, Pellet, ɗumɗoo ko ɗum woni ɓural ɓanngungal".
explication: Sulaymaana roni ben makko Daawuuda Annabaaku ngun e ganndal ngal e laamu ngun, o maaki ka yewtirgol neema Alla mo O neemini e makko on e ben makko: Ko onon yo yimɓe, Alla anndinii men faamugol hitooji colli ɗin, O okki men immorde e kala huunde nde O okki ɗum Annabaaɓe ɓen e lamɓe ɓen. Pellet, ndee huunde nde Alla O Senike okki men, ko ɗum woni ɓural ɓanngungal.

arabe: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيۡرِ فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ
traduction: Sulaymaana mooɓanaa koneeli makko ɗi immorde ka jinnaaji e ka yimɓe e ka colli, kamɓe ko ɓe yuɓɓinaaɓe.
explication: Koneeli Sulaymaana ɗin mooɓanaa mo immorde e ɓanndunke e jinna e colli ɗin, kamɓe hiɓe soggee wonndunde e njuɓɓudi.

arabe: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمۡلِ قَالَتۡ نَمۡلَةٞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمۡلُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمۡ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
traduction: Haa nde ɓe ngrnoo e aynde korndolli ɗin, korndolil mbi'i i'i: "eey mon korndolli, naatee ka koɗanɗi mooɗon, fii wata Sulaymaana e koneeli mu'um ɗin muncu on, tawa kamɓe ɓe tinaa".
explication: Ɓe seeraali hiɓe soggee haa nde ɓe arunoo ka aynde ñuuƴi ɗin (ɗum ko nokkuure to Saami) ñuungil goo e ñuuƴi ɗin wi'i: ko onon yo ñuuƴi, naatee ka koɗanɗe mooɗon fii wata Sulaymaana e koneeli makko ɗin halku on hara kamɓe ɓe anndaa fii mo'on, nde tawnoo si ɓe anndii fii mo'on ɓe yaaɓataa on.

arabe: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكٗا مِّن قَوۡلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
traduction: [Sulaymaana] moosi ko o jaluɗo immorde e konngol maggi ngol, o maaki: "Jooma, lonnginam no mi yettira neema maaɗa mo neeminɗaa e dow am on, e jibibinɓe lam ɓen, e nde mi gollata ko moƴƴi mbeltoraa ɗum, naatnaami ka Yurmeende Maaɗa wond'ude e jiyaaɓe Ma moƴƴuɓe ɓe".
explication: Tuma nde Sulaymaana nanunoo haala maggil kan, o moosi ko o jaluɗo fii ɗum ko ngil wowli, o maaki ko o noddayɗo Joomi makko Senayee wonanii Mo: Jooma, hawrinndinam lonnginaa mi kadi no mi yettira neema Maaɗa mo neeminirɗaa lam on min e jibinɓe lam ɓen, hawrinndinaa mi kadi fii yo mi gollu golle moƴƴe ɗe weltortaa ɗum, naadaa mi kadi ka Yurmeende Maaɗa wonndude e jeyaaɓe Maaɗa moƴƴuɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيۡرَ فَقَالَ مَالِيَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلۡهُدۡهُدَ أَمۡ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَآئِبِينَ
traduction: O ƴewtii colli ɗin, o maaki: "Ko heɓi kam, mi yiaani Hud-huda. Kaa ndu laati jiyaandu e wirniiɗi ɗin?"
explication: Sulaymaana ndarti colli ɗin o yi'aali hud-huda, o maaki: Ko heɓi lam, mi yi'aali hud-huda? Ko haɗayɗum haɗi lam yi'ugol ndu, kaa ndu wonu jeyaandu e wirniiɗi ɗin?

arabe: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدًا أَوۡ لَأَاْذۡبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوۡ لَيَأۡتِيَنِّي بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
traduction: Maa mi lepta ndu sanne lepte caɗtuɗe ma maa mi hirsandu sanne, ma ndu addana kam hujja ɓannguɗo.
explication: O maaki tuma nde ɓanngannoo mo wirnagol mayru: Maa tun mi lepta ndu lepte saɗtuɗe, maaɗum mi hirsa ndu fii leptugol ndu ko ndu wirnii kon, maaɗum le ndu addana lam hujja ɓannguɗo mo no ɓannguna nganto mayru e wirnagol ngol.

arabe: فَمَكَثَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٖ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهِۦ وَجِئۡتُكَ مِن سَبَإِۭ بِنَبَإٖ يَقِينٍ
traduction: Ndu ñiiɓe ko woɗɗaani, ndu wi'i: "mi huɓindike ko a huɓindaaki ɗum, mi addanii ma immorde to Saba'i kumpital yananaangal".
explication: Hud-hudaaru ndun ñiiɓi ka ndu wirnii ton seeɗa nii, tuma ndu arunoo ndu wi'ani Sulaymaana (yo o his): Mi ƴellitike e dow ko a ƴellitaaki e muuɗum, mi addanii ma immorde ka yimɓe Saba'i kumpital goongawal sikke alaa e maggal.

arabe: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ ٱمۡرَأَةٗ تَمۡلِكُهُمۡ وَأُوتِيَتۡ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَلَهَا عَرۡشٌ عَظِيمٞ
traduction: Min dey, mi tawii sonnaajo no laamii ɓe homo okkaa immorde e kala hu'unde, no woodami mo kadi jullere [laamu] mawnde.
explication: Min dey mi tawii debbo no laamii ɓe, on debbo no okkaa kala huunde immorde e sabuuji doole laamu, himo jogii jullere laamu mawnde himo fewja e hoore mayre fiyakuuji yimɓe makko ɓen.

arabe: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوۡمَهَا يَسۡجُدُونَ لِلشَّمۡسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمۡ لَا يَهۡتَدُونَ
traduction: Mi tawii mo kaŋko e yimɓe makko ɓen heɓe cujjana na'ange nge ga Alla; Seytaane no cuɗaniɓe golle maɓɓe ɗen o faddii ɓe ga Laawol ngol, kamɓe ɓe peewataa.
explication: Mi tawii oo debbo, mi tawii yimɓe makko ɓen kadi hiɓe sujjana naange ngen gaanin Alla Seniiɗo Toowuɗo On, Seytaane labinani ɓe ko ɓe woni kon e muuɗum immorde e golle sirku ngun e geddi ɗin, o martini ɓe gaayi Laawol Goongawol ngol, kamɓe ɓe feewataa e maggol.

arabe: أَلَّاۤ يَسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡخَبۡءَ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُخۡفُونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَ
traduction: Ko haɗata ɓe cujjana Alla oon jaltinoowo ko suuɗii kon ka kammuuli e ka leydi homo Anndi ko cuuɗoton e ko peñinton.
explication: Seytaane labinani ɓe golle sirku ngun e geddi ɗin; fii wata ɓe sujjan Alla Kanko tun, On yaltinoowo ko O suuɗi kon ka kammu immorde e toɓo ngon, e ka leydi immorde e puɗi ɗin, hiMo Anndi golle ɗe suuɗoton ɗen, e ɗe feññinton ɗen, hay huunde e ɗum suuɗanaaki Mo.

arabe: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ۩
traduction: Alla, Deweteeɗo alaa si wonaa Kaŋko Jooma Arsi Tedduki kin.
explication: Alla, reweteeɗo e goonga alaa tanaa Makko, Jooma Arsi Mawki kin.

arabe: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
traduction: O maaki: "Aray min ndaara si a gooŋɗu, maaɗum si laati jiyaaɗo e fenɓe ɓen".
explication: Sulaymaana (yo o his) maakani hud-huda: Aray men ndaara si a goongu e koo ko nodditiɗaa ɗum, maaɗum si a wonu jeyaaɗo e fenuɓe ɓen.

arabe: ٱذۡهَب بِّكِتَٰبِي هَٰذَا فَأَلۡقِهۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
traduction: Yahdu e nduu talkuru am mbernoɗaa ndu ka maɓɓe, refti kuccaa ɓe ndaaraa ko holɗum ɓe nduttata.
explication: Sulaymaana winndi ɓatakuru, o jonnindu hud-huda, o wi'ani hud-huda: Yahidu e nduu ɓatakuru am werloɗaa nde ka yimɓe Saba'i jonnuɓe ndu, pottitoɗaa ɓe sera nokku ka nanataa ko ɓe jaabondita kon e fiyaake mayru.

arabe: قَالَتۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ إِنِّيٓ أُلۡقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَٰبٞ كَرِيمٌ
traduction: [Sonnaajo on] wi'i: "eey mon mbatu, min dey wernaama ka am talkuru teddundu".
explication: Lamɗo on jaɓi ɓatakuru ndun, o wi'i: Ko onon yo tedduɓe, min dey ɓatakuru teddundu mawnundu werlaama ka am.

arabe: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
traduction: Pellet, nduu ko immorde e Sulaymaana, pellet, ko woni e mayru ko: "Innde Alla kuuɓuɗo Yurmeende keeriiɗo Yurmeende Oon".
explication: Ko woni e nder nduu ɓatakuru nulaandu immorde e Sulaymaana udditiraandu sabu "Innde Alla Huuɓuɗo Yurmeende Heeriiɗo Yurmeende":

arabe: أَلَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَيَّ وَأۡتُونِي مُسۡلِمِينَ
traduction: Wota on townitano kam, ngaree e am ko jebbiliiɓe.
explication: Wata on mawnintino, aree ka am hara ko on ɗoftiiɓe jebbilaniiɓe ko mi noddi on kon e muuɗum immorde e Ngootimmbaaku Alla e accitugol ko wonoɗon e mu'un kon immorde e sirkanngol Mo, nokku ka rewoton naange ngen wonndude e Makko.

arabe: قَالَتۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ أَفۡتُونِي فِيٓ أَمۡرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمۡرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشۡهَدُونِ
traduction: O wi'i: "eey mon mbatu, mbaɗtee kam e feere e ɗee fiyaake am, mi laataaki taƴoowo fiyaake haa tawteɗon e am".
explication: Lamɗo on wi'i: Ko onon yo tedduɓe e koohooɓe, ɓannginanee lam feere feewunde nden e fiyaake am on, mi wonaali ñaawoowo fiyaake haa tawdeɗon e am, feññinon feere mooɗon nde e nder mu'un.

arabe: قَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أُوْلُواْ قُوَّةٖ وَأُوْلُواْ بَأۡسٖ شَدِيدٖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ إِلَيۡكِ فَٱنظُرِي مَاذَا تَأۡمُرِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Enen ko en jooma doole e jooma hare caɗtuɗe, fiyaake ɗen ko ka maaɗa woni, ndaaru ko holɗum njamirtaa".
explication: Tedduɓe ɓen ka yimɓe makko wi'i: Enen ko en jooma doole mawɗe, e jooma aalaaji hare dolnuɗi ka hare, feere nden ko ko fewjuɗaawoo ndaaru ko honɗum yamirtaa men haray menen ko men hattanɓe e dow siinugol ɗum.

arabe: قَالَتۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُواْ قَرۡيَةً أَفۡسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓاْ أَعِزَّةَ أَهۡلِهَآ أَذِلَّةٗۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
traduction: [Debbo on] wi'i: "Pellet, laamɓe ɓen si ɓe naatii e saare ɓe mbonnat nde, ɓe mbaɗa tedduɓe mayre ɓen hoyɓe, ko wanonii ɓe ngollirta.
explication: Laamiiɗo on wi'i: Pellet, lamɓe ɓen si ɓe naatii e saare immorde e ca'e ɗen ɓe bonniray nde sabu ko ɓe jokkata kon warugol e jattugol, ɓe waɗa koohooɓe mayre e tedduɓe mayre hoyɓe ɓaawo ko ɓe wonunoo kon e muuɗum immorde e teddu- ngal e neema, ko wanonii lamɓe ɓen gollirta tuma kala ɓe fooli yimɓe saare; fii yo ɓe aawu mirin e kulol ka wonkiiji.

arabe: وَإِنِّي مُرۡسِلَةٌ إِلَيۡهِم بِهَدِيَّةٖ فَنَاظِرَةُۢ بِمَ يَرۡجِعُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
traduction: Awa miin, mi nulay e maɓɓe neldaari, mi ndaara ko holɗum nulaaɓe ɓen nduttodata.
explication: Awa min, mi nulay haa e jooma nduu ɓatakuru e yimɓe makko ɓen neldaari, mi ndaara ko honɗum nulaaɓe ɓen ardata e muuɗum ɓaawo jonnugol ndii neldaari.

arabe: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٖ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمۡ تَفۡرَحُونَ
traduction: Tuma nde ɓe arnoo ka Sulaymaana, o maaki: "Enee, on ɓeydiray kam jawdi, kon ko Alla okkimmi, no ɓuri moƴƴude diini kon ko O okki on, ko woni, onon hoɗon farnora neldaari mooɗon ndin".
explication: Tuma nde nulaaɓe makko ɓen arunoo e ɓen wonnduɓe e makko immorde e wallooɓe mo hiɓe ronndii neldaari ndin faade ka Sulaymaana, Sulaymaana mettinani ɓe fii addugol neldaari ndin; o maaki: Enee, hara on ɓeydanay lam jawle fii yo on rutta lam e mo'on? Ko Alla okki lam kon immorde e Annabaaku e laamu ngun e jawdi ndin ɓuri moƴƴude kon ko O okki on, ko woni, ko onon woni ɓen farnorayɓe ko neldaɗon immorde e jawle aduna.

arabe: ٱرۡجِعۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٖ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخۡرِجَنَّهُم مِّنۡهَآ أَذِلَّةٗ وَهُمۡ صَٰغِرُونَ
