explication: Men waɗi e ndin leydi ndi Men jippini toɓo e mun, gese leɗɗe tamarooje e inabuuje. Men ɓulliti ton ɓulli ndiyam, ko ɗe yarniree.

arabe: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
traduction: fii no ɓe ñaamira dimɗe mun ɗen e kon ko ɓe golliri juuɗe maɓɓe ɗen. E ɓe njettataa (Alla)?
explication: Men waɗiri ɗen gese, fii no yimɓe ɓen ñaamira e majje, immorde e kon ko Alla neemini e maɓɓe, hara ɓe yannganaaki ɗum. E ɓee yettirtaa Alla e ɗii neemaaji ɗon, rewugol Mo Kanko tun, gomɗina kadi Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen?

arabe: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Senaade woodanii takɗo nooneeji ɗin On fof: gila e ko leydi ndin fuɗinta kon, haa e woŋkiiji maɓɓe ɗin, e kon ko ɓe nganndaa!
explication: Senaade woodanii Alla, O toowii. On fuɗɗuɗo nooneeji ɗin fow: gila e puɗi e leɗɗe, haa e wonkiiji yimɓe ɓen, tawde O waɗirii ɓe deyel e gorel, e kon ko ɓe anndaa fii mun, e tagu Alla ngun ka njorndi e maayo ekn.

arabe: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ
traduction: Ma'ande goo kadi wonanii ɓe: e jemma on, Miɗen corta e makko ñalawma on, tawa ɓe ngontii e niwre.
explication: Hujja goo wonanii yimɓe ɓen e fii wootinɗingol Alla, tawde Meɗen naɓira ndaygu ngun, naɓugol ñalorma on, adda jemma on, tuma Men sortata ñalorma on e makko, Men waɗta ɗum niwre, haa yimɓe ɓen naatii e mayre.

arabe: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرّٖ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
traduction: E na'ange ngen, hinge doga haa e ñiiɓirde magge; ɗum ko eɓɓoore pooluɗo, gannduɗo On.
explication: Maande goo hollaynde ɓe gootaagu Alla ngun, ko ngee naange dogaynge haa e ñiiɓirde nge Alla anndi eɓɓoore mun, nge haɗta ɗon. Nden, ko eɓɓoore Fooluɗo Mo fooletaake On, Annduɗo Mo huunde e fiyakuuji tagu Makko ngun wirnanaaki Mo.

arabe: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
traduction: E lewru ndun, Min eɓɓani ndu jipporde, haa ndu waɗtinira wa baaŋal tamaro kiiɗngal.
explication: Maande goo kadi tinndinnde e gootaagu Alla seniiɗo On, ko nduu lewru, ndu Men eɓɓani jipporde jemma kala. Ndu fuɗɗora toksuru, hooti ndu mawna, hooti ndu fanɗita, haa ndu waɗtinira wano baaŋal tamarohi e noone mun ka soyɗugol e ka hiɗɗugol.

arabe: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ
traduction: Wonaa na'ange ngen woni ko haanini hewtitagol lewru ndun, wonaa jemma on woni ko aditotoo ñalaema on; kala majji non, ko e laawol mum woni dokde.
explication: Maandeeji naange ngen e lewru ndun, e jamma on e ñalorma on, ko Alla elti ɗi. Ɗi haɗtanaa yawtugol ko ɗi eɓɓanaa kon. Wanaa naange ngen woni ko waawi hewtitorgol lewru ndun, waylugol dogudu magge maa naɓugol ndaygu magge, wanaa jemaa on kadi haɗtanaa aditagol ñalorma on, ado o lannude. Ɗi fow majji non, e kala koode e ruugayɗi, ko eltanaaɗi laawi heeriiɗi.

arabe: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
traduction: Ma'ande goo wonanii ɓe, won'de Min roondike geyngol maɓɓe ngol, ka laana hebbinaaka;
explication: Maande goo wonanii ɓe e fii gootaagu Alla ngun, e ko O neemini kon e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, wonnde Men roondike daɗunooɓe ɓen ndiyam tuufaana ɗam, e geyngol Aadama ngol, fewndo Nuuhu, ka laana hebbiniranooka taguuji Alla. Hari tagu kala e resondirayngel e mun no roondaa e ka laana.

arabe: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ
traduction: Min tagani ɓe sugu makko, ko ɓe mbaɗɗoo.
explication: Maande goo wonanii ɓe e fii gootaagu Alla ngun, e ko O neemini e jeyaabe Makko ɓen kon, wonnde Men taganii ɓe sugu laana Nuuhu kan, ko ɓe waɗɗoo.

arabe: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ
traduction: Si Miɗen njiɗuno, Min njoolayno ɓe; hara faabo alanaa ɓe, wanaa kadi ɓe daɗndeteeɓe,
explication: Si Meɗen yiɗunoo, Men yoolayno ɓe; hara faabo woo alanaa ɓe ontuma, wanaa daɗndoowo ɓe e kon ko Men haajani ɓe.

arabe: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
traduction: si wonaa yurmeende immornde e amen, e dakmitagol haa e saanga.
explication: Si wanaa hara Men yurmira ɓe daɗndugol ɓe yoolagol, Men accira ɓe fii no ɓe dakmitora haa e happu, mo ɓe yawtataa, belajo'o, ɓe waajitoray ɓe gomɗina.

arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
traduction: Si ɓe mbi'anaama: "ndentee e kon ko woni yeeso mon e ɓaawo mon, mbelajo'o, on njurminte"...!
explication: Si ɓee sirkooɓe ɗuurniiɓe e gomɗingol wi'anaama: rentee e ko sutaniɗon ka laakara e caɗeele mun, rentoron e aduna feƴƴoowo, belajo'o, Alla neeminira on yurmeende Makko nden. Kono ɓe ronki waɗde ɗum, ɓe ɗuurnii fii mun.

arabe: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
traduction: Aaya woo e aayeeje Joomi maɓɓe ɗen araali e maɓɓe, si wanaa ɓe ɗuurnooɗe.
explication: Tuma kala nde Aaya Alla tindinɗe e wootinɗingol Alla, heertinana Mo dewal nagl, ari e ɓee sirkooɓe saɗta-feereeɓe, ɓe wonay ɗuurnii ɓe mo, salii ɓe waajitorde mo.

arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
traduction: Si ɓe mbianaama kadi: "Wintee(nafqe) e kon Alla arsiki on", yedduɓe ɓen mbi'ana gooŋɗinɓe ɓen: "E men ñamminay on tawɗo si Alla muuyuno, O ñamminayno mo? On ngonaani, si wanaa e ndeer majjere ɓanngunde".
explication: Si saɗta feere'en ɓee wi'anaama kadi: walliree waasuɓe ɓen e wonduɓe ɓen jawle mon ɗe Alla arsiki on ɗen. Ko ɓe jaaborta, ko wiide gomɗimɓe ɓen: kere men ñamminay on tawɗo si Alla muuyuno, O ñamminayno mo? Men lunndotaako muuyɗe Makko ɗen. Onon ɓee gomɗimɓe, on wonaali, si wanaa e faayere ɓanngunde, woɗɗitiinde goonga.

arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
traduction: Hiɓe mbi'a: "Ko holnde tuma woni ndee Fodoore, si on laatike gooŋɗuɓe?"
explication: Heeferɓe yedduɓe ummital ɓen no wi'a: ko honnde tuma woni ngal ummital, si tawii onon ɓee gomɗimɓe, on laatike goonguɓe e ɗum?

arabe: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ
traduction: Ɓe habbaaki, si wonaa ha'acaango wooto, nanngayngo ɓe, hara hiɓe njeddondira.
explication: Ɓee fennuɓe ummital habbaaki, si wanaa wuttaandu aranuru ndun ka allaandu, ngun juhaɓe, fewndo ka ɓe yeddondirta fii aduna, immorde sooda yeeya, e rema reena ekw.

arabe: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةٗ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
traduction: Ɓe mbaawoytaa wasiyagol on tuma, wonaa ɓe ruttoytooɓe e yimɓe maɓɓe ɓen.
explication: Si ngon haacaango maƴinoyiiɓe, ɓe waawoytaa wasiyagol ontuma, wanaa fere fii ruttitoyagol ka cuuɗi e ka ɓeynguure maɓɓe; ko ɗon fii maɓɓe lannata, ka ɓe sokolooji mum en fii aduna.

arabe: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ
traduction: Wutte e alaandu, ɓe njaltira e genaale ɗen, ɓe keñora ka Joomi maɓɓe,
explication: Wuttee ɗiɗaɓun ka Allaandu, ɓe fow ɓe yalta e genaale maɓɓe ɗen, ɓe heñora ka Joomi maɓɓe, fii hasbeede yoɓee.

arabe: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
traduction: hiɓe mbi'a: "Ee bone amen! Ko hommbo immini men e genaale amen?" Ko ɗum woni ko Hinaranke On fodnoo; Nulaaɓe ɓe o gooŋɗini
explication: Ɓee heeferɓe yeddunooɓe ummital ninɓe, ɓe wi'a: Ee hayrere amen! Ko hommbo immini men e genaale amen? Ɓe jaabee: ko ɗum woni ko Alla fodunoo, wonnde pellet, waɗay; Nulaaɓe ɓen goonginii e ko ɓe yottiniri ɗum kon, immorde e Joomi maɓɓe.

arabe: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
traduction: (Ummital) ngal wonaano, si wanaa haacaango wo'oto, tawi ɓe fof ɓe ngaaddaama ka Amen.
explication: Fii immintineede ka genaale ngol wonaano, si wanaa baɗte wuttaandu ɗiɓaɓuru ndun, tawi tagu ngun fow addaama laakara ka Amen, fii hasbeede.

arabe: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: Hannde non, woŋkii tooñirtaake hay hu'unde. On yoɓitirtaake, si wonaa kon ko ngollaynoɗon.
explication: Ñaawoore nden Ñalnde, ko nunɗal waɗirta, tawde onon jeyaaɓe ɓen, on tooñirtaake ɓeydaneede bonɗi maa ɗuytaneede moƴƴi, hay huunde. Ko yoɓirteɗon, ko njoɓdi kon ko gollaynoɗon aduna.

arabe: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلٖ فَٰكِهُونَ
traduction: Yimɓe Aljanna ɓe hannde, pellet, heɓe e ndeer soklio, hiɓe neeminoo;
explication: Yimɓe Aljanna ɓen Ñalnde Darngal, pellet, ɓe wonoyay e nder neema, yejjitinoowo ɓe kala huunde, hakkee neemaaji ñiiɓuɗi, ɗi ɓe yi'oyta. Ɓe neeminora ɗi weltaare.

arabe: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
traduction: kamɓe e genndiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen,e ley ɗowɗe, heɓe coɓɓindii e hoore danɗe.
explication: Hiɓe dakmito kamɓe e genndiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen, e hoore danɗe, ley ɗowɗe yaajeendi Aljanna.

arabe: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
traduction: Hino woodani ɓe toon, ɓiɗɓe leɗɗe, hino woodani kadi, ko ko ɓe noddata.
explication: Hino woodani ɓe ka Aljanna ton, noone kala e ɓiɗɓe leɗɗe laaɓuɗe: immorde e inabu, e ƴibbe, e rummaana. Hino woodani ɓe kadi, kala ko ɓe lamndotoo e muuyanteeji maa nooneeji neema. Ko ɓe lamndii woo ɗum, ɓe heɓay.

arabe: سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡلٗا مِّن رَّبّٖ رَّحِيمٖ
traduction: "Salaamun", konngol [kisal], immorde e Joomiraaɗo, jurmotooɗo.
explication: E hoore neemaaji maɓɓe ɗin fow, hino woodani ɓe kadi, konngol kisiyee, immorde e Joomiraaɗo, Hinnotooɗo ɓe. Si O salminii ɓe, ɓe wonay e on kisiyee, noone kala. Ɓe heɓa hiwraango, ɓurngo kala hiwraango darja.

arabe: وَٱمۡتَٰزُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
traduction: "ceertee non hande, onon ɓee bonɓe!
explication: Sirkooɓe ɓen wi'anee Ñalnde Darngal: sertee non e gomɗimɓe ɓen, haanaa ka ɓe jillondira e mon, tawde njoɓdi mon, no seedi e njoɓdi maɓɓe, sifaaji kadi wano non.

arabe: ۞ أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: Mi ahodaano e mon, onon ɓiɗɓe Aadama, won'de wota on ndewu seytaane? Tawde pellet, ko o gaño mon ɓannguɗo,
explication: Mi ahodaano e mo'on, Mi haɗiri on, onon ɓiɗɓe Aadama ɓen, e konngol Nulaaɓe Am ɓen, wiide on: wata on ɗofto seytaane, faggitagol noone kala e keeferaaku maa geddi? Tawde pellet, kanko seytaane, ko o gaño mon ɓannginɗo ngayngu. Ko honno haqqilɗo ɗoftorta gaño mun ɓannginɗo ngayngu?

arabe: وَأَنِ ٱعۡبُدُونِيۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
traduction: [Mi yamiri on] kadi dewugol Kam. Ko ngol woni laawol pocciingol ngol.
explication: Mi yamiri on kadi, onon ɓiɗɓe Aadama ɓen, wonnde yo on rewan Min tun, hara on kafidaali Lam e goɗɗum. Ko rewugol Lam Min tun ngol, ɗoftoo Lam, woni laawol focciingol, ɗowayngol e welayee Am e naatugol Aljanna. Kono on waɗaali ko mi ahodunoo e mun kon, Mi yamiri on.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمۡ جِبِلّٗا كَثِيرًاۖ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡقِلُونَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii o majjinii tagu ɗuuɗungu e mon. E on wonaano haqqilooɓe?
explication: Gomɗii seytaane majjinii tagu ɗuuɗungu e mon. E on wonaano ɓe haqqille mun yamiraynoo ɗoftagol Joomi mun, rewa Mo Kanko tun, ɗe rentina on e ɗoftagol seytaane, tawɗo ko gaño feññinanɗo on ngayngu?

arabe: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
traduction: Ko ngee woni Jahannama, nge ngonnoɗon fodaneede ngen.
explication: Ko ngee woni Jahannama, nge wonanoɗon fodaneede ngen aduna, sabu keeferaaku mon ngun. Hari hinge wirnaninoo on, kono hannde, e hino nge, on yi'irii nge gite mon.

arabe: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
traduction: Naatiree nge hannde, sabu ko njeddiratnoɗon.
explication: Naatee e magge hannde, meeɗiron nnuleeki magge, sabu ko yeddiraynoɗon Alla kon, ka nguurndam mon aduna.

arabe: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ أَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
traduction: Hannde, Min notay e kunndule maɓɓe ɗen, juuɗe maɓɓe ɗen yewta Min, koyɗe maɓɓe ɗen kadi seeditoo e kon ko ɓe ngonnoo e paggitagol".
explication: Hannde, Men notay e kunndule maɓɓe ɗen, ɓe wonta mbobooɓe, hara ɓe waawataa yeddude geddi e keeferaaku ko ɓe wonunoo e mun kon. Juuɗe maɓɓe ɗen yewta Men ko ɗe huuwi aduna, koyɗe maɓɓe ɗen kadi seeditoo e kon ko ɓe wonunoo e faggitaade e geddi.

arabe: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَٱسۡتَبَقُواْ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبۡصِرُونَ
traduction: Si Min njiɗuno, Min mehayno gite maɓɓe ɗen, ɓe adondira e laawol ngol. Kono ko honno ɓe njiirata?
explication: Si Men yiɗuno, Men mehayno gite maɓɓe ɗen, hara ɓe yi'ataa, ɓe adondira e laawol ngol, fii lummbitirgol ka Aljanna. Kono ɓe woɗɗondirii e ɗum, tawde gite maɓɓe ɗen mehaama.

arabe: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مُضِيّٗا وَلَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
traduction: Si Min njɗuno kadi, Min montatno ɓe e nokku maɓɓe on; hara ɓe hattantaa feƴƴugol ɓe yiltotaako.
explication: Si Men yiɗuno kadi, Men waylayno fii maɓɓe, Men femmpira ɓe koyɗe ɗen, hara ɓe hippataa sottude e nokku maɓɓe on: ɓe waawataa feƴƴude yeeso, wanaa fii yiltorgol ɓaawo.

arabe: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
traduction: Kala mo Min njuutni nguurndam mum, Men njiltitay mo e tagoore. E ɓee haqqiltaa?
explication: Kala mo Men juutni nguurndam mun e yimɓe ɓen, Men yiltitiray mo ɓaawo. E ɓee kan haqqiltaa? ɓe annda aduna wanaa luttirde, ko saare laakara nden heddotoo?

arabe: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ وَقُرۡءَانٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: Min ngaanndinaali mo (kaŋko Muhammadu) gimɗi; ɗuum haananaa mo. [Deftere] nden wonaani, si wanaa jaŋtoore e janngeteende ɓanngunde,
explication: Men anndinaali Muhammadu (jom kisiyee) gimɗi; ɗum haananaa mo, tawde o yahdaa e mun, sakko heɓon ka wi'on wonnde ko o yimoowo. Ko Men anndini mo kon wonaali, si wana jantoore e Qur'aanaare ɓanngannde taskoɗoo.

arabe: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيّٗا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
traduction: fii yo o jeertin nde, on gonɗo guurɗo (ɓernde), Konngol lepte ngol jojja e he'eferɓe ɓen.
explication: Fii yo jertinir nde, kala laatiiɗo wuuruɗo ɓernde, tawde ko on ɗon nafitorta nde. Konngol lepte ngol kadi jojja e hoore yedduɓe ɓen, tawde hujja nanngirii ɓe jippangol nde ngol, nde yottinee e maɓɓe. hujja woo heddoraaki ɓe, mo ɓe ngantinora.

arabe: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
traduction: E ɓe yiaani, won'de Min tagiranii ɓe neemoraaɗi, e ko juuɗe Amen ngolli, hara heɓe njeyinooɗi;
explication: E ɓe yi'aali, wonnde Men taganii ɓe neemoraaɗi, hara hiɓe jeyinoo ɗin; ɓe waɗa ɗi sottinirɗi haajuuji maɓɓe.

arabe: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
traduction: Min eeltani ɓe ɗi: no e majji ɗi ɓe waɗɗotoo, no e majji ɗi ɓe ñaamata;
explication: Men eltani ɓe ɗin neemoraaɗi, Men waɗti ɗi e sooke maɓɓe: tawi ko e goɗɗi ɗin ɓe waɗɗotoo ɓe ronndina, ɓe ñaama e tebbeeli goɗɗi ɗin.

arabe: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
traduction: hino woodani ɓe toon, nafooje e njaram. E ɓee kan njettataa (Mo)?
explication: Hino woodani ɓe ton, nafooje goo, hara wanaa waɗɗeteeɗi ɗin e ñaameteeji teew mum tun. Ɗum ko wano leeɓi baali ɗin, e leeɓi gelooɗi ɗin, e leeɓi be'i ɗin e coggeeli majji ɗin ɗi ɓe moƴƴinirta ndaɗɗudi e comci. Ɓe heɓoyay ton kadi, nooneeji njaram ka ɓe yaroyta kocce. E ɓee kan yettataa Alla neeminirɗo ɓe ɗii neemaaji ekw?

arabe: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
traduction: Ɓe jogitorii ga Alla deweteeɗi, joortagol ɓe faabeedee.
explication: Sirkooɓe ɓen jogitorii gaanin Alla reweteeɗi maɓɓe, jortagol ɗi faaboto ɓe, ɗi daɗnda ɓe lepte Alla ɗen.

arabe: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّحۡضَرُونَ
traduction: Ɗi kattanaa paabagol ɓe; ko ɓe konu tawneteengu e majji.
explication: Ɗin reweteeɗi ɗi maɓɓe, ɗi hattanaa faabagol hay ko'e-majji, wanaa fii faabagol rewayɗi ɓe ɗin acca Alla. Wurin, ɗin sanamuuji ko waɗtidoyteeɗi e maɓɓe ka lepte, kala maɓɓe waɗta daɗndinoraa-de oya.

arabe: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
traduction: Wota konngol maɓɓe sunine. Pellet, Miɗen nganndi ko ɓe cuuɗata e ko ɓe peññinta.
explication: Wata wiide ɓe : wanaa a Nulaaɗo, maa wonnde ko a yimoowo, ekn fow e mun, wata sunine, an Nulaaɗo. Menen, Meɗen anndi ko ɓe suuɗata e ɗum, e ko ɓe feññinta e mun. Hunnde e mun suuɗaaki Men. Ma Men yoɓitoy ɓe ɗum.

arabe: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: E neɗɗaŋke on yiaani, won'de Min tagirii mo e toɓɓere maniiyu? Kono tawaa mo ko o wennjoowo ɓannguɗo!
explication: E neɗɗanke, yedduɗo ummital ɓaawo maayde on, miijitaaki, wonnde Men tagirii mo e toɓɓere maniiyu? Refti o rewri sagaraaji haa jibinaa o mawni, refti o wonti ɗuuɗuɗo yeddondiral e wennjondiral! Kanko o yi'aali ɗum, haa o dallinora wonnde ummital waɗay?

arabe: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلٗا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٞ
traduction: O fiyani Min yeru, kono o yejjiti tageede makko; o wi'i: "Ko hommbo wuurnitata ƴi'e ɗen, si ɗe ndappii?"
explication: On yedduɗo majji, o yejjiti fewndo o dallinoraynoo ƴi'e wuɗuɗe ɗen, wiide ummital gasataa; wi'ugol: ko hommbo wuurnitata ɗe? O yejjitii wonnde o tagano, hari o woodaaka.

arabe: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ
traduction: Maaku: "Ko guurnitoowo ɗe, ko takɗo ɗe on ka laawol aranol. Ko Kaŋko woni gannduɗo fii kala tagoore;
explication: An Muhammadu, maakan ɓe ka jaabagol ɓe: wuurnitoowo ɗee ƴi'e wuɗuɗe, ko taguɗo ɗe On ka laawol aranol. Mo tagii huunde ka arannde mayre, O ronkataa wuurnitude nde. Ko Kanko seniiɗo On woni annduɗo fii kala tagu. Hunnde e fii maggu suuɗaaki Mo.

arabe: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارٗا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ
traduction: On mbɗanɗo on yiite, iwde e leɗɗe kecce, tawa ko e majje kuɓɓirton nge.
explication: On waɗanɗo on, onon yimɓe ɓen, yiite, iwde e leɗɗe kecce, tawa ko e majje woni ko huɓɓinirton yiite. Awa faamon, kala waawuɗo hawtude benya- ndirdi ɗiɗi (woni hecciɗugol leɗɗe ɗen, e yiite huɓɓinirteenge e majje ngen), ko haɗttanɗo wuurnitugol maayɓe.

arabe: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
traduction: Kere takɗo kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin wonaani kaɗtanɗo tagugol yeru maɓɓe? Ɗuum ko pellet! Ko Kaŋko woni Ɗuuɗuɗo tageefo, gannduɗo.
explication: Kere taguɗo kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin e kala mawnuɗi wonɗi e majji, On haɗtanaa wuurnitugol maayɓe immintina ɓe? Ɗum ko pellet, Himo haɗtana ɗum. Ko Kanko woni Ɗuuɗuɗo tageefo, Taguɗo kala huunde, Annduɗo fii majji. Huunde suuɗaaki Mo e majji.

arabe: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
traduction: Ganndon fiyaaku makko on, si o faandanike hu'unde, ko o wi'anat nde tan: "Laato", nde laatoo.
explication: Anndon fiyaaku Alla on, si O faandnike waɗufol huunde, ko O wi'anay nde tun: laato, nde laatora no O yiɗiri non. Hino jeyaa ɗum, wiide si O faandike wuurnitugol maa warugol maa immintingol ekn, O waɗay tun.

arabe: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
traduction: Senaare woodanii oon mo laamateeri kala hu'unde ngoni e juuɗe Mum! Ko ka makko rutteteɗon.
explication: Senaade e laaɓal, woodanii On Mo sirkooɓe ɓen askinta ronkugol e Mun! On Mo tawata, ko e juuɗe Makko laamateeri kala huunde woni, Himo waɗira ɗum no O haajiri. Ko e juuɗe Makko soktirgal huunde woni. Ko ka Makko tun, woni ruttorde mon laakara, O yoɓitoya on njoɓde golle mon.

arabe: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفّٗا
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii cappniraaɗi ɗin saffaaji.
explication: Mi wonndirii Malaa'ikaaji sappiniraaɗi sappeejii, fii dewal majji.

arabe: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجۡرٗا
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii coggirayɗi (duule) ɗin coggugol.
explication: Mi woondirii Mlaa'ikaaji soggirayɗi duule ɗin, haa ka Alla muuyiri jipporde majje.

arabe: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii janngiratɗi ɗin, ganndintinorgol:
explication: Mi woondirii Malaa'ikaaji janngooji daalol Alla ɗin.

arabe: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمۡ لَوَٰحِدٞ
traduction: "Pellet, deweteeɗo mon on, ko bajjo,
explication: Pellet, reweteeɗo mon On, onon yimɓe ɓen, e hoore goonga, ko bajjo, Mo alaa kafidiiɗo: On woni Alla.

arabe: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
traduction: Jeyɗo kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin, e kon ko woni hakkunde ɗin ɗiɗi, Jeyɗo kadi puɗirɗe ɗen.
explication: Jeyɗo kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, e kon ko woni hakkunde ɗin ɗiɗi, jeyɗo kadi puɗal e mutal naange ngen, hitaande nden fow.

arabe: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
traduction: Min cuɗirii kammu (hikkii ngu) aduna ngun: cuɗaari koode ɗeen,
explication: Men labinirii kammu hikkii ngu aduna ngun, cuɗaari koode ɗen, nannditayndi e kaŋŋe jalɓuɗe.

arabe: وَحِفۡظٗا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ مَّارِدٖ
traduction: e deenirgol (ngu) kala seytaane daɗaandu.
explication: Men reeniri kammu hikkii ngu aduna ngun, koode ɗen, fii daɗugol kala seytaane yatundu e ɗoftaare Alla.

arabe: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ
traduction: Ɗi kaɗtanaaka keɗitagol mbatu [Maleykaaji toowu ngu ngun; tawde hiɗi peroree e kala baŋŋe,
explication: Ɗin seytanooji haɗtanaaka heɗitagol matu Malaa'ika ka kammu, tuma ɓe wowlata ko Joomi maɓɓe wahayini e maɓɓe, immorde e sari'aaji; tawde ontuma, hiɗi feroree baŋ-woo baŋ.

arabe: دُحُورٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ وَاصِبٌ
traduction: ka faɗagol (ɗi). Hino woodani ɗi kadi, lepte duumiiɗe.
explication: Ɗum ko fii raɗagol wata ɗi heɗito Malaa'ika'en. E hoore ɗum, hino woodani ɗi kadi laakara, lepte muusuɗe, duumiiɗe, ɗe taƴondirtaa.

arabe: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ ثَاقِبٞ
traduction: Si wonaa ndun bifti ndu e majji, jilannde [haala], ndu rewnree hoodere tufatnde.
explication: Si wanaa ndun seytaiiru biftii ndu e majji, jilannde haala, woni konngol e haala Malaa'ika'en, ko tawata fii mun hewtaali yimɓe leydi ɓen; ontuma, ndu jokkintiniree hoodere huɓɓunde, ko sunna ndu. Hino ara ka tawata ndu hewtinii ngol konngol jilaangol, e musidal mayru, haa ngol hewtoya ndaarooɓe ɓen, ado ndu fiɗireede hoodere sunnaynde nden, ɓe ɓeydita ɗon, penaale teemedere.

arabe: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٖ لَّازِبِۭ
traduction: Laɓndo ɓe: si ko kamɓe ɓuri saɗtude takde kaa ko ɓen ɓe Min tagi? Min tagirii ɓe kamɓe, loopal narnungal.
explication: An Muhammad, lamndo ɓee heeferɓe yedduɓe fii ummital: si tawii ko kamɓe ɓuri saɗtude tagugol, e tiiɗugol ɓalli, e mawnugol cemmbe, diini ɓen ɓe Men tagi ka kammuuli e ka leydi, wonndude e Malaa'ika'en? Men tagirii ɓe kamɓe, loopal narnungal. Ko honno ɓe yeddirta fii ummital, e hoore ko e loopal lo'ungal narnungal ɓe tagiraa?

arabe: بَلۡ عَجِبۡتَ وَيَسۡخَرُونَ
traduction: Si ko woni, a haawi, heɓe njalnora!
explication: Si ko woni, a haawi, an Muhammad, e kattal Alla ngal, e no O toppitora fiyakuuji tagu Makko ngun, haawiɗaa kadi, ko sirkooɓe ɓen yeddata kon fii ummital. Hakkee non ko ɓe saɗtini fennugol fii maggal, hiɓe jalnora ko wowlataa fii maggal.

arabe: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ لَا يَذۡكُرُونَ
traduction: Si ɓe mbaajaama, ɓe mbajitortaa;
explication: Si ɓee sirkooɓe waajoraama kala noone e waaju, ɓe waajitortaa mo, sakko ɓe nafitora; hakkee ko ɓe yoori ɓerɗe.

arabe: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يَسۡتَسۡخِرُونَ
traduction: si ɓe nji'ii ma'ande, ɓe njalkita,
explication: Si ɓe yi'ii maande e maandeeji Annabiijo on (yo o his), tinndinde e goonga makko kan, ɓe fantina jalkitugol e haaweede.

arabe: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ
traduction: ɓe mbii'a: "Ɗuum wonaani, si wonaa mbilewu ɓanngu ngu.
explication: Ɓe wi'a: Ko Muhammadu addi koo wonaali, si wanaa mbilewu ɓanngu ngu.

arabe: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
traduction: Eyoo si min maayii, min ngontii mbullaari e ƴi'e, haray ko min immintinoyteeɓe?"
explication: yoo si men maayii, men wontii mbullaari e ƴi'e wuɗuɗe, haray men immintinoyte ɓaawo ɗum? Waawaa wonnde.

arabe: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
traduction: Baabiraaɓe amin adinooɓe ɓeen kadi e minen?"
explication: Baabiraaɓe amen, adinooɓe men kadi ɓen, immintinoyte ɓaawo maayde maɓɓe?

arabe: قُلۡ نَعَمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ دَٰخِرُونَ
traduction: Maaku: "pellet! Hara le ko on hoynaaɓe".
explication: Maakan ɓe jaaboɗaa ɓe an Muhammad: Pellet, on immintinoyte ɓaawo nde on wontude mbullaari e ƴi'e woɗuɗe. Baabiraaɓe mon adinooɓe ɓen kadi wano non. On fow on immintiniroyte jaasere e hoyneede.

arabe: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
traduction: Nganndon ɗum, ko wuttaandu wo'oturu pet, tawee jaka yoo, heɓe ndaara,
explication: Anndee ɗum, ko wuttaandu wooturu pet ka alaandu (ɗiɗaɓuru ndun) tawaa jaka yoo, fow maɓɓe hiɓe ndaara kulaleeji Ñalnde Darngal, hiɓe habbitii ko Alla huuwata ɓe.

arabe: وَقَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'a: Ee bone amen ! Ko ndee woni Ñaaande njoɓdi kuuɗe".
explication: Sirkooɓe fennunooɓe ummital ɓen wi'oya ontuma: Ee halkaare amen ! Ko ndee woni Ñalaande njoɓdi kuuɗe ɗen, nde Alla yoɓitaya jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, golle ɗe ɓe ardinnoo ka nguurndam maɓɓe aduna.

arabe: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
traduction: "Ko ndee woni Ñalaande ñaawoore, ko njeddatnoɗon fii mum".
explication: Ɓe wi'anee ontuma: ko ndee tigiri, woni Ñalaande ñaawugol hakkunde jeyaaɓe ɓen, nde Ñalaande nde fennaynoɗon fii mun aduna.

arabe: ۞ ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
traduction: Mooɓee tooñɓe ɓen, e nandadiiɓe maɓɓe ɓen, e kon ko ɓe ngonnoo e rewde,
explication: Malaa'ika'en wi'anee nden Ñalnde: Mooɓee sirkooɓe tooñirɓe sirku maɓɓe on, e gartooɓe maɓɓe ɓen ka sirkugol e ka fennugol, e ɗin sanamuuji ɗi ɓe rewaynoo ɓe acca Alla. Ɓe holloya ɓe laawol Yiite ngol, ɓe soggiroya ɓe ton, tawde ko ton woni jaaƴorde maɓɓe.

arabe: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
traduction: ko woori Alla. Coggireeɓe ka laawol Jahiimi.
explication: Malaa'ika'en wi'anee nden Ñalnde: Mooɓee sirkooɓe tooñirɓe sirku maɓɓe on, e gartooɓe maɓɓe ɓen ka sirkugol e ka fennugol, e ɗin sanamuuji ɗi ɓe rewaynoo ɓe acca Alla. Ɓe holloya ɓe laawol Yiite ngol, ɓe soggiroya ɓe ton, tawde ko ton woni jaaƴorde maɓɓe.

arabe: وَقِفُوهُمۡۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسۡـُٔولُونَ
traduction: Ndarnon ɓe, tawde ko ɓe laɓnditeteeɓe".
explication: Darnon ɓe fii ñaaweede, ado ɓe naadeede ka Yiite. Ɓaawo ɗum, soggiron ɓe ka Yiite.

arabe: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
traduction: "Ko heɓi on, on mballindirtaa?"
explication: Ɓe feliroyee wi'aneede: ko heɓi on, on wallindirtaa hakkunde mon, wano wallindiraynoɗon aduna? Fewndo aaƴotoɗon wonnde sanamuuji mon ɗin walloyay on?

arabe: بَلۡ هُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مُسۡتَسۡلِمُونَ
traduction: Ko woni kamɓe ɓe hannde, ko ɓe jebbilii ɓe,
explication: Ko woni kamɓe on hannde, ko ɓe doftiiii ɓe yamiroore Alla hoyɓe. Alaa ka ɓe wallindira, tawde ɓe alaa ɗum feere.

arabe: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
traduction: woɗɓe e maɓɓe peewtita ɓeya, ɓe laɓndondira;
explication: Woɗɓe e maɓɓe fewtita yoga, ɓe wona e felindirgol wennjondira, ka ɗin ɗiɗi nafataa nden ñalnde.

arabe: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
traduction: ɓe mbi'a: "Ko onon ngoni ko ardiranaynoo men, ka ɓaŋŋe ñaamo".
explication: Jokkunooɓe ɓen wi'ana jokkanooɓe ɓen: ko onon ɓee koohooɓe, wonunoo ko ardiranaynoo men, ka baŋŋe diina e goonga; wonon e cuɗinangol men keeferaaku e sirkangol Alla e faggitagol geddi, doginon men e goonga ka Nulaaɓe Alla ɓen addunoo kan.

arabe: قَالُواْ بَل لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: (Koohooɓe) ɓen mbi'a: "Ko woni kon, on meeɗaano won'de gooŋɗinɓe.
explication: Jokkanooɓe ɓen kadi jaabitoo ɓeya: wanaa non woniri. Ko woni kon, ko e keeferaaku wonunoɗon, on meeɗaali wonnde gomɗimɓe, wurin, ko on yeddunooɓe wonunoo.

arabe: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا طَٰغِينَ
traduction: Doole woo min ngalanaano on. Si ko woni, on ngonno yimɓe bewɓe.
explication: Doole woo men alanaano on e hoore ko jokkunoɗon men kon, haa men yolla on e keeferaaku maa sirku maa faggitagol geddi. Si ko woni, on wonuno yimɓe fantimɓe e yeddugol e majjere.

arabe: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
traduction: Konngol Joomi men ngol, jojjii e min; pellet, ko en meeɗooɓe [lepte ɗen].
explication: Koongol Joomi men ngol ka kammbol Makko wiide: "Mi hebbiniroyte Jahannama, e kala ɓen jokku ɓe ma" (Cortewol Saad, aaya 85), ko haanungol jojjude; ɗum holli, ko en meeɗooɓe ko Joomi men kammbiri kon, feere mun alaa.

arabe: فَأَغۡوَيۡنَٰكُمۡ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
traduction: Min mbewinno on, tawde hay minen, ko min bewnooɓe".
explication: Men nodduno on e majjere e keeferaaku, tawde non, ko men majjunoo laawol goonga ngol, wonunoo.

arabe: فَإِنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
traduction: Kamɓe on nden ñande, ko ɓe haawtoyteeɓe ka lepte.
explication: Jokkuɓe e jokkanooɓe nden ñalnde, fow ko hawtoyteeɓe ka lepte.

arabe: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
traduction: Ko nii Minen Min ngollirtata bomɓe ɓen.
explication: Ko wano nii Men huuwirta ɓee bomɓe, ka meeɗinirgol ɓe lepte ɗen.

arabe: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
traduction: Kamɓe si ɓe mbi'anooma: "deweteeɗo alaa si wonaa Alla", ɓe mawnintinoo.
explication: Ɓee sirkooɓe si wi'ananooma aduna: Rewteeɗo alaa si wanaa Alla, fii gollitirgol ngol konngol, sela kala ko lunndii ngol, ɓe salora ɗoftagol ɗum, townitanagol goonga kan.

arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٖ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
traduction: ɓe mbi'a: "Kere men ngaccitiray deweteeɗi amen ɗin, fii yimoowo kaangaaɗo?"
explication: Ɓe hujjinora keeferaaku maɓɓe ngun, wiide: kere men accitiray reweteeɗi amen ɗin, fii yimoowo haangaaɗo? Wiide ɓe ɗum, ko Nulaaɗo Alla on ɓe faandii (yo o his).

arabe: بَلۡ جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Si ko woni, (Nulaaɗo) on ko goonga ardi, o goongini nulaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Ko ɓe tukkiri Nulaaɗo on kon hino ñiddi. Tawde pellet, Nulaaɗo jom kisiyee on, meeɗaali wonnde haangaaɗo, wanaa yimmowo. Ko woni goonga, ko wiide ko Alqur'aanaare o ardi, noddaynde e wootinɗongol Alla, jokka Nulaaɗo Makko on. Nulaaɗo on non, o goonginii ɓeya Nulaaɓe, e ko ɓe addunoo kon, immorde ka Alla, immorde e tawhiidi, e tabintingol ummital. O lunndakki e ɗum.

arabe: إِنَّكُمۡ لَذَآئِقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡأَلِيمِ
traduction: Pellet, ko on meeɗay ɓe lepte mu'usuuɗe ɗen.
explication: Onon ɓee sirkooɓe, pellet, ko on meeɗay lepte muusuɗe ɗen, Ñalnde Darngal, sabu keeferaaku mun ngun e fennugol Nulaaɓe ɓe.

arabe: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: On njoɓetetaake, si wonaa yeru kon ko ngollatnoɗon.
explication: Onon ɓee sirkooɓe, on yoɓitoytaake, si wanaa yeru kon ko huuwaynoɗon aduna, e yeddugol Alla, faggitoo geddi.

arabe: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
traduction: si wonaa jiyaaɓe Alla laɓɓinaaɓe ɓen,
explication: Jeyaaɓe Alla gomɗimɓe, ɓen ɓe Alla laɓɓiniri fii ko rewa Mo, ɓe laɓɓinani Mo dewal ngal, ɓen ɗon daɗoyay e ɗen lepte.

arabe: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
traduction: hino woodani ɓen ɗoon, fanndaare ganndaandi:
explication: Hino woodani ɓen jeyaaɓe laɓɓinaaɓe, fanndaari ndi Alla arsikata ɓe, tinndiraandi laaɓugol e labegol e duumagol mun.

arabe: فَوَٰكِهُ وَهُم مُّكۡرَمُونَ
traduction: muuyanteeɗi, kadi ko ɓe teddinteeɓe,
explication: Oon arsuka ko muuyanteeɗi ceertuɗi ɓurɗi laaɓude, ko ɓe nafoo, e hoore ɗum, ko ɓe teddiniraaɓe mbarjaari toowundi, e yi'ugol yeeso Alla teddungo ngon.

arabe: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
traduction: ka aljannaaji neeminiiɗi,
explication: Ɓe heɓay ɗin fow, ka Aljannaaji neeminiiɗi, ñiiɓuɗi, tabituɗi, ɗi taƴondirtaa, sakko lanna.

arabe: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
traduction: e hoore danɗe, ko ɓe feewtondirɓe.
explication: hara hiɓe waalii tuugi fewntondiri e hoore danɗe.

arabe: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينِۭ
traduction: Hara kore heɗe mbannginii e maɓɓe, immorde e ɓulirde
explication: Hara kore sanngara hino wannginee e maɓɓe, laaɓinrɗam wano ndiyam iloojam.

arabe: بَيۡضَآءَ لَذَّةٖ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
traduction: daneeje, lewñunde, fii yarooɓe,
explication: Ranwudam mbaadi , lewñunde na dakmitoo heen e kala yarooɓe nde.

arabe: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
traduction: mu'usuuɗe hoore alaa e majjam, wonaa ɗam ciwrinirteeɓe ɗam.
explication: On sanngara, nanndaa e sanngara aduna on, tawde ɗam sottintaa haqqil, wanaa muusinayɗam kadi hoore. Ko hisinayɗam ɓanndu e haqqille kala yaruɗo ɗam.

arabe: وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ عِينٞ
traduction: Hino woodani ɓe (toon): raɓɓuɓe ndaarɗe, yaaja giteeɓe,
explication: Hino woodani ɓe ka Aljanna ton: rewɓe ɓe alaa e ɗuuɗa giteyaagal worbe janbe, yooɗa giteeɓe.

arabe: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيۡضٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
traduction: wa'aɓe wa ɓoccooɗe maraaɗe.
explication: Ɓen rewɓe no wa'i wa boofo soomaaɗa maraa sabu ranwude, ɗe junngo meemaali.

arabe: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
traduction: Woɗɓe e maɓɓe peewtita ɓeya, ɓe laɓndondira.
explication: Yoga e yimɓe Aljanna ɓe fewtita yoga, ɓe lamndondira fii ko feƴƴi aduna.

arabe: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٞ
traduction: Goɗɗo e maɓɓe wi'a: "Min miɗo marunoo gonndiijo,
explication: Goɗɗo e ɓen gomɗimɓe wi'a: Min miɗo marunoo wonndiiɗo yeddaynooɗo ummital ka aduna.

arabe: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصَدِّقِينَ
traduction: wi'atnooɗo: "Kere ko a jiyaaɗo e gooŋɗinɓe ɓen?
explication: Wi'anaynooɗo lam, e hoore yeddugol jalkita: kere an wonndiiɗo, hiɗa jeyaa e goongimɓe immintineede maayɓe ɓen?

arabe: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
traduction: Eyoo si en maayii, en wontii mbullaari e ƴi'e, tawa ko en yoɓitoyteeɓe?"
explication: Eyoo si en maayii, en wontii mbulmbulndi e ƴi'e kiɗɗe, haray ko en immintinoyteeɓe yoɓitee njoɓdi golle men ɗen aduna?

arabe: قَالَ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
traduction: O wi'a: "Taw si ɗon njiɗi ƴeewde?"
explication: Wondinooɗo makko gomɗimɓe on, wi'ana wonndiiɓe mun ɓen ka Aljanna: on ƴeewiday e am, anndugol battane wonndinooɗo lam yeddunooɗo ummital on?

arabe: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
traduction: O ƴeewa, o haynoo oya ka leri dulbunge,
explication: Kanko o ƴeewa, o haynoo wondinooɗo makko on, ka tummbere Dulbunge.

arabe: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرۡدِينِ
traduction: o wi'a: "Mi wooɗndirii Alla ! A ɗeɓɓi fii no mi halkorde!
explication: o wi'a: mi woondirii Alla ! An oo wondinooɗo lam, a eɓɓuno halkitirgol fii am, naatugol Yiite, sabu ko noodiraynoɗaa lam e keeferaaku, yedda fii ummital.

arabe: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
traduction: Si wonaano moƴƴere Joomi am nden, mi tawdeteno e [lepteteeɓe ɓeen].
explication: Si wanaa moƴƴere Alla nden e am, woni sabu mi feewiri gomɗinal, mi tawdeteno e lepteteeɓe ɓen, wano maa.

arabe: أَفَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
traduction: Wonaa noon en maayataa,
explication: Wonaa non enen yimɓe Aljanna ɓen, en maayataa.

arabe: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
traduction: si wonaa maayde men aranere nden, en wngonaani kadi lepteteeɓe?"
explication: En maayataa, si wanaa maayde men aranere nden aduna. Wurin ko en duumotooɓe ka Aljanna, en wonaali kadi lepteteeɓe, wano yedduɓe ɓen huuwirtee.

arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
traduction: Pellet, ko ɗuum ɗoo woni maloore mawnude ndeen.
explication: Pellet, ko ndii njoɓdi ndi Joomi men warjori en naatugol duumoo Aljanna, daɗa Yiite ɗoo, woni maloore mawnunde nden, nde yeru mun alaa.

arabe: لِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا فَلۡيَعۡمَلِ ٱلۡعَٰمِلُونَ
traduction: Ko fii sugu ɗuum ɗoo, woni yo gollooɓe ngollan.
explication: Ko fii sugu ndii njoɓdi mawndi ɗoo, woni ko waɗɗii nde gollooɓe gollanta. Tawde ko ndii woni ngeyngu tonatoongu.

arabe: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
traduction: Hara ko ɗuum ɓuri moƴƴude jipporde, kaa ko leggal "Zaqquumi" [ngal kaaɗugal]?
explication: Hara ko on neema mo Alla marani jeyaaɓe Makko laɓɓinan ɓe Mo dawal ɓen, ɓuri moƴƴude jipporde e teddungal, kaa ko leggal "Zaqquumi" huɗaangal ka Alqur'aana ngal? Tawngal ko ñaametee heeferɓe ɓen, ngal fayintaa ngal duncataa e ittugol heege!

arabe: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ
traduction: Min mbaɗii ngal jarrabuyee tooñɓe ɓen.
explication: Men waɗii ngal leggal, jarrabuyee, wonannde tooñirɓe geddi e keeferaaku ɓen. Tawde ɓe wi'uno: Yiite ñaamay leɗɗe, ɗum holli, leggal fuɗataa ka Yiite.

arabe: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٞ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
traduction: Ngal, ko leggal jaltatngal ka tummbere Dulbunge.
explication: Laggal zaqquumi ngal, ko yaltirayngal ka kaaniri: ko ka tummbere Dulbunge, ngal yaltirta.

arabe: طَلۡعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
traduction: Dimɗe maggal, hono wa'i no ko'e seytanooji.
explication: Dimɗe ngal leggal, hino kaaniri nannditi wa ko'e seytanuuji. Si hunnde non kaanii, ko ɗum woni nde kaanii kadi kabaaru; ɗum holli, ñaametee maggal on, ko ko ñiddi.

arabe: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
traduction: Kamɓe ɓe, pellet, ko e maggal ɓe ñaamirta, ɓe kebbinira ngal deedi maɓɓe.
explication: Kamɓe heeferɓe ɓen, pellet, ko e dimɗe ngal leggal haaɗungal, woni ko ɓe dekkirta, ɓe hebbinira deedi maɓɓe heegaaɗi.

arabe: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبٗا مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ
traduction: Refti hino woodani ɓe e dow maggal, njaram patinaaɗam.
explication: Refti hino woodani e caggal nyaamgol leggal ngal, njaram, jillaaɗam, fatinaaɗam haa ñiddi.

arabe: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرۡجِعَهُمۡ لَإِلَى ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
traduction: Refti ruttorde maɓɓe ndeen, ko ka Dulɓoowe.
explication: Refti ruttorde maɓɓe nden, ko ka lepte Dulɓoowe: ɓe iwa e lepte, ɓe yaha e lepte.

arabe: إِنَّهُمۡ أَلۡفَوۡاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ ضَآلِّينَ
traduction: Ɓe tawu baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓeen, ko majjunooɓe,
explication: Ɓee heeferɓe, ɓe tawu baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen, majjunooɓe laawol peewal ngol; ɓe jokkitii ɗon, ko aldaa e hujja.

arabe: فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ يُهۡرَعُونَ
traduction: ɓe ngoni e yaccagol njokka baɗteeji maɓɓe.
explication: Ɓe woni e yaccagol jokka batteeji majjere baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen ko yaawi.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ ضَلَّ قَبۡلَهُمۡ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii, ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e adamɓe ɓen, majjiino, ado maɓɓe.
explication: Gomɗii ko ɓuri ɗuuɗde e aramɓe ɓen, majjiino, ado maɓɓe. Wanaa yimɓe maa ɓen, an Nulaaɗo, adii majjude e mofte ɗen.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii le, Min nuluno e maɓɓe, jeertinooɓe.
explication: Gomɗii le, Men nunulo e ɗen mofte adinooɓe, Nulaaɓe, ko jertina e lepte Alla ɗen, kono ɓe yeddi.

arabe: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
traduction: Kono ndaaru baɗtane ɓren jeertinanooɓe, no wa'anoo!
explication: Ndaaru an Nulaaɗo, ko honno baɗtane ɓen jertinanooɓe salii, no wa'unoo! Ko Yitte ɓe sakkitori naatude, luttirooɓe ton, sabu salaare e fennugol ɓe Nulaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen.

arabe: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
traduction: Si wonaa jiyaaɓe Alla, laɓɓinaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Si wanaa jeyaaɓe Alla, laɓɓinaaɓe ɓen; ko ɓen ɗon daɗoyta lepte ɗen ɗe ɓeya heeferɓe yeddunoo waɗtiniroya.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٞ فَلَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمُجِيبُونَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Nuuhu nodduno Min, Min moƴƴii jaabotooɓe.
explication: Gomɗii Nuuhu nodduno Men (yo o his) fewndo yimɓe makko ɓen fennunoo mo, e hoore ko o noddi ɓe e mun kon, iskin ko Men woni moƴƴuɓe noototooɓe. Tawde Men yaccinno toraare makko nden e maɓɓe.

arabe: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
traduction: Min ndaɗni mo, kaŋko e yimɓe makko ɓeen, e suno mawnngo ngon,
explication: Men daɗndi mo, kanko e ɓeynguure makko nden, wondude e gomɗimɓe mo ɓen, lorra yimɓe makko, e yoolagol tuufaan ngol, nelangol ngol e yimɓe makko yeddunooɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَجَعَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ
traduction: Min mbɗi gelngol makko ngol, heddotooɓe ɓen.
explication: Men daɗndi ɓeynguure makko makko nden e gomɗimɓe mo ɓen tun. Ɓeya kan, Men yooliri ɓeya keeferaaku maɓɓe ngun.

arabe: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
traduction: Min ngaccani mo mantoore, e sakkitiiɓe ɓeen.
explication: Men heddinani mo e mofte hikkotooɗe ɗen, mantoore moƴƴere, nde ɓe mantirta mo.

arabe: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٖ فِي ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Kisal wonii e Nuuhu, e ndeer winndere nden.
explication: Nuuhu hisii o daɗii wowleede bone, e mofte sakkitiiɗe ɗen. Wurin, mantoore e jantoore moƴƴere, heddoto fii makko.

arabe: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
traduction: Ko non woni ko Min mbarjorta moƴƴimɓe ɓen.
explication: Ko sugu ndii njoɓdi, ndi Men warjorii Annabi Nuuhu, woni ko Men warjorta moƴƴinooɓe dewe mun ɗen, ɓe rewi Alla tun.

arabe: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Kaŋko, ko o jeyanooɗo e jiyaaɓe Amen gooŋɗinɓe ɓen.
explication: Kanko Nuuhu, ko o jeyanooɗo e jeyaaɓe Amen gomɗimɓe, woni e ɗoftaare Alla ɓen.

arabe: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
traduction: Refti Min njooli heddii ɓe ɓeen.
explication: Refti Men yooliri hedditiiɓe ɓen, waame mbo Men wurti e maɓɓe on. Ɓe fow maɓɓe ɓe gasi.

arabe: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
traduction: Hino jeyanoo e jokkunooɓe mo ɓe Ibraahiima.
explication: Awa Ibraahiima, ko jeyanooɗo e jokkuɓe diina makko, rewi laawol makko ka wootinɗingol Alla.

arabe: إِذۡ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٍ
traduction: Tuma nde ardunoo e Joomi makko, e ɓernde hisnde.
explication: Janto nde o ardunoo ka Joomi makko, ɓernde hisunde e sirku, laaɓanɗo Alla e tagu Makko ngun.

arabe: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
traduction: Nde o maakannoo ben makko e yimɓe mum ɓeen: "Ko holɗum ndewoton?
explication: Nde o maakannoo baaba makko e yimɓe mun sirkaynooɓe ɓen: Ko honɗum rewton gaanin Alla?

arabe: أَئِفۡكًا ءَالِهَةٗ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
traduction: E ko deweteeɗi pefindaaɗi, ko wanaa Alla, paalaɗon?
explication: E ko reweteeɗi fefindaaɗi, faalaɗon rewude ko wanaa Alla?

arabe: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Ko cikkuɗon e Joomiraawo tagoore ngon?"
explication: Ko sikkuɗon, onon yimɓe am, e Joomiraawo tageefo ngon, si on hawroyii e Makko, hara on rewaano Mo? Ko sikkuɗon O gollata on ontuma?

arabe: فَنَظَرَ نَظۡرَةٗ فِي ٱلنُّجُومِ
traduction: O ndaariri ndaarande to koode,
explication: Annabi Ibraahiima ndaariri ka koode, himo taskoo ɗaɓɓa feere, no daɗira yaltidugol e maɓɓe.

arabe: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٞ
traduction: o maaki: "Ko mi ñawnɗo".
explication: O ngantinori yaltidugol e yimɓe makko ɓen ka iidi maɓɓe, wiide: ko mi nawnuɗo.

arabe: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ
traduction: Ɓe ngacci mo, ɓe nduŋti.
explication: Ɓe acci mo caggal ɗon, ɓe hucciti.

arabe: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
traduction: O mooltii e deweteeɗi maɓɓe ɗin, o maaki: "E on ñaamataa?
explication: O moltii e reweteeɗi maɓɓe ɗin gaanin Alla, o jalnori ɗi maakugol: E on ñaamataa ko sirkanooɓe on ɓen moƴƴinani on kon?

arabe: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
traduction: Ko heɓi on, on kaalataa?"
explication: Ko heɓi on, on wowlataa, on jaabotaako? Ko sugu ɗum ɗoo rewetee gaanin Alla?

arabe: فَرَاغَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضَرۡبَۢا بِٱلۡيَمِينِ
traduction: O naatnani, fiyirde ɗi ñaamo ngon.
explication: Ibraahiima moltorani ɗi, piyirgol ɗi junngo makko ñaamo ngon, fii muncugol ɗi.

arabe: فَأَقۡبَلُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يَزِفُّونَ
traduction: Ɓe peewti e makko, hiɓe njaawno.
explication: Rewaynooɓe ɗin sanamuuji ɓen, fewri ka makko, hiɓe yaawno.

arabe: قَالَ أَتَعۡبُدُونَ مَا تَنۡحِتُونَ
traduction: O maaki: "E on ndeway  ko lesuɗon!,cehɗon).
explication: Ibraahiima fewtitiri ɓe tabitaal, o feli ɓe, o maaki: E on reway kon ko lesirɗon juuɗe mon, accon Alla?

arabe: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: hara le ko Alla tagi on, e ko ngolloton?"
explication: Ko Alla tagi on, O tagi golle mon ɗen, wano ɗin sanamuuji ɗi leston. Ko Kanko tun hanndi e Mo rewon, hara on renndidaani Mo e goɗɗum goo.

arabe: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنٗا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Mahanee mo mahdi, mbugoɗon mo ka dulɓayange".
explication: Nde ɓe ronkunoo teeɗoragol mo hujja, ɓe yahri doole, ɓe diisonsiri haa ɓe fottani ko ɓe waɗata ibraahiima; ɓe wi'i: mahanee mo maadi, hebbiniron ndi carma, huɓɓon ɗe yiite, refti buɗon mo ton.

arabe: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
traduction: Ɓe pa'andanii mo feere; kono Min mbɗi ɓe sooybe ɓen.
explication: Yimɓe Annabi Ibraahiima ɓen faandanii mo bone, no ɓe gaynira fii makko,ɓe ɓoortondira e makko, kono Men waɗi ɓe kamɓe sooyuɓe ɓen; nde Men waɗannoo mo yiite ngen ɓuuɓol e kisiyee.

arabe: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
traduction: O maaki: "Min on, ko mi peroowo ka Joomi am, aray nde O feewnata kam.
explication: Ibraahiima maaki: Min on, ko mi feroowo ka Joomi am, mi yalta e leydi yimɓe am ɓen, no mi heɓira feere rewugol Mo; aray nde O fewnata lam e ko moƴƴanta lam aduna e laakara.

arabe: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
traduction: Joomi am, weeɗam geɗal moƴƴuɓe".
explication: Joomi am, arsikam ɓiɗɗo moƴƴo, ko wallitoo lam, semmbina lam e yimɓe am ɓen, tuma mi ferata.

arabe: فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٖ
traduction: Min mbeltiniri mo, geɗal muññiiɗo.
explication: Men jaabiniri toraare makko nden, humpitugol mo ko welata mo, fewndo Men wewlinirnii mo geɗaljo mawnoowo, muññoytooɗo; on woni Ismaa'iila (yo o his).

arabe: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
traduction: Nde on yottinoo e makko jahal, [Ibraahiima] maaki: "Ko an ɓiɗɗo am, min mi yi'ii e ɗoyngol, won'de miɗo hirse. Ndaaru ko yi'iɗaa". [Ismaa'iila] maaki: "eey ma baaba'en, mbaɗee ko njamiraɗon kon, on tawoyay kam, si Alla jaɓii, jiyaaɗo e muñiiɓe ɓen".
explication: Nde Ismaa'iila mawnunoo, o yottodi e ben makko jahal, ben makko Ibraahiima hoyɗi, koyɗol Annabaaɓe ɓen non, ko wahayu. O humpiti geɗal makko wiide mo: ko an yo ɓiɗɗo am, mi yi'ii e koyɗol, wonnde miɗo hirse. Ndaaru ko yi'uɗaa e ɗum. Ismaa'iila jaabii baaba'en mun, wiide: Baaba'en, waɗee ko yamiraɗon kon fii hirsugol lam, on taway lam, si Alla jaɓii, jeyaaɗo e muñooɓe e weltorɓe ñaawoore Alla nden.

arabe: فَلَمَّآ أَسۡلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلۡجَبِينِ
traduction: Nde ɓe jebbilaninoo (yamiroore Alla nden), o hippiri mo tiinde nde,
explication: Nde ɓe jebbilaninoo yamiroore Alla nden, Ibraahiima hippiri geɗal makko, tiinde nden, fii hirsugol mo.

arabe: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ
traduction: Men noddiri mo wi'ide: "eey ma yo Ibraahiima !
explication: Men noddi Ibraahiima fewndo o hittiniraynoo waɗugol yamiroore Alla nden, ka hirsugol geɗaljo makko on, wiide: ko an yo Ibraahiima!

arabe: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
traduction: Pellet, a gooŋɗiinii koyɗol ngol. Ko Minen Min njoɓirte moƴƴinooɓe ɓeen".
explication: Pellet, a laatinirii koyɗol maa ngol, fiɓugol hirsude geɗaljo maa on. Awa ko wano Men yoɓitirt maa non firtingol ma nden huunde saɗtunde, woni ko Men yoɓitirta moƴƴinooɓe ɓen; Men ɓoora ɓe e kulaleeji e saɗteendeeji.

arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡبَلَٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
traduction: Pellet, ko ɗuum ɗoo woni jarrabuyee ɓannguɗo oon.
explication: Pellet, ko ɗum ɗoo woni jarrabuyee ɓannguɗo on. Ibraahiima hawrii e mun.

arabe: وَفَدَيۡنَٰهُ بِذِبۡحٍ عَظِيمٖ
traduction: Min cootiri mo kirse mawɗe.
explication: Men soktiri Ismaa'iila, dammol mawnungol, ko hirsee, hara wanaa kanko.

arabe: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
traduction: Min ngaccani mo mantoore, e sakkitiiɓe ɓen.
explication: Men accani Ibraahiima, mantoore labaande, e mofte sakkitiiɗe ɗen.

arabe: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
traduction: "Kisal wonii e Ibraahiima".
explication: Alla hiwrike mo, O du'anike mo kadi kisal e kala lorra.

arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
traduction: Ko wano nii Min njoɓirta moƴƴinooɓe ɓeen.
explication: Ko wano Men yoɓitiri Ibraahiima e ɗoftaare makko nden, Men yoɓitirta moƴƴinooɓe ɓen.

arabe: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Kaŋko, ko o jiyaaɗo e jiyaaɓe Amen gooɗinɓe ɓen.
explication: Kanko Ibraahiima, ko o jeyanooɗo e jeyaaɓe Amen gomɗimɓe, hunnuɓe sifaaji jeyeede Alla.

arabe: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
traduction: Min mbeltiniri Ishaaqa, Annabaajo jiyaaɗo e moƴƴuɓe ɓen.
explication: Men wewlintiniri mo geɗaljo goo, wonoowo Annabaajo, e jeyaaɗo moƴƴo; on woni Ishaaqa. Ɗum ko njoɓdi ɗoftagol mo Alla ngol, ka hirsugol Ismaa'iila, ɓiɗɗo makko bajjo on nun.

arabe: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنٞ وَظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينٞ
traduction: Min kebbini barki e makko e Ishaaqa. Hino e geñngol maɓɓe ngol: moƴƴinɗo, e tooñuɗo hoore-mun ɓanngini.
explication: Men jippini barki e makko, e dow geɗal makko Ishaaqa. Men ɗuɗɗinani ɓe neema; wano ɗuuɗireede ɓiɗɓe. Hino e geyngol maɓɓe ngol non, moƴƴinɗo ɗoftagpl Joomi mun, e tooñirɗo hoore-mun yeddugol faggitoo ɓanngina bone.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min moƴƴike e dow Muusaa e Haaruuna,
explication: Gomɗii Men moƴƴorike e dow Muusaa, e nene gooto makko on Haaruuna, Annabaaku ngun.

arabe: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُمَا وَقَوۡمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
traduction: Min ndaɗni ɓe, kamɓe e yimɓe maɓɓe ɓeen, e ngoƴo mawnungo,
explication: Men daɗndi ɓe, kamɓe e yimɓe maɓɓe ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen, maccinireede Fir'awna, e yoolagol.

arabe: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
traduction: Min mballi ɓe, ɓe ngoni foolɓe ɓen.
explication: Men walli ɓe e Fir'awna e konu mun, ɓe fooli ayɓe maɓɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَبِينَ
traduction: Min ngokki ɓe deftere ɓannginnde ndeen.
explication: Men okki Muusaa e neene gooto makko on Haaruuna, Deftere Tawreeta nden, immorde ka Alla, ɓanngunde, nde jilɓuya alah e mayre.

arabe: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ
traduction: Min peewniri ɓe, e laawol pocciingol ngol.
explication: Men fewniri ɓe, e laawol focciingol ngol. Ngol woni laawol diina lislaamu kan, ɗowirayngol e welayee seniiɗo taguɗo On.

arabe: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
traduction: Min ngaccani ɓe mantoore, e sakkitiiɓe ɓeen.
explication: Men accani ɓe mantoore e jantoore labaande, e mofte sakkitiiɓe ɓen.

arabe: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
traduction: "Kisal woni e dow Muusaa yo Haaruuna".
explication: Alla hiwrorike ɓe hiwraandu teddundu, O mantii ɓe, O du'oranike ɓe hisugol e kala bone.

arabe: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
traduction: Ko wano nii Min noɓitirta moƴƴimɓe ɓen.
explication: Ko wano Men yoɓitiri non Muusaa e Haaruuna, woni ko Men yoɓitirta moƴƴinooɓe ɗfotagol Joomi mun ɓen.

arabe: إِنَّهُمَا مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Kamɓe ɗiɗo, ko ɓe jiyanooɓe e jiyaaɓe Amen gooɗiinɓe ɓen.
explication: Muusaa e Haaruuna, ko jeyanooɓe e jeyaaɓe Amen gomɗimɓe Alla, golliri sari'a Makko on.

arabe: وَإِنَّ إِلۡيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Pellet, Ilyaasa kadi, ko jeyanooɗo e Nulaaɓe ɓeen.
explication: Pellet, Ilyaasa kadi, ko jeyanooɗo e Nulaaɓe Alla ɓen. Alla moƴƴorino e makko Annabaaku e Nulal.

arabe: إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
traduction: Jaŋto nde o maakannoo yimɓe makko ɓen: "E on kulataa [Alla]?
explication: Janto nde o maakannoo yimɓe mako ɓen o nulaa e mun ɓen, ka ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila: Ko onon yo yimɓe am, e on hulirtaa Alla ɗoftagol yamirooje Makko ɗen, wano wootinɗingol Mo, e woɗɗitagol haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, wano sirku?

arabe: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلٗا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
traduction: E ko "Ba'ala" ndewoton, ngaccon ɓurɗo moƴƴude tagoore nde?
explication: E on reway sanamuuru mon wi'eteende "Ba'ala" ndun, accon ɗon Alla, ɓurɗo moƴƴude tagu On?

arabe: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
traduction: Woni Alla, Jeyɗo on, Jeyi baabiraaɓe mon adinooɓe ɓeen?"
explication: Ko Alla woni Joomi mon, woni taguɗo on, O tagi baabiraaɓe mon ɓen ado ɗum. Ko On hanndi e reweede, wanaa goɗɗum goo, wano sanamuuji mon, ɗi duncataa ɗi lorrataa.

arabe: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
traduction: Ɓe njeddii mo, awa non, ko ɓe tawnoyteeɓe (ka lepte).
explication: Yimɓe makko ɓen alaa waɗi, si wanaa fennugol mo. Awa ɗum wonay sabu ɓe tawnoyteebe e lepte ɗen.

arabe: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
traduction: Si wonaa jiyaaɓe Alla laɓɓinaaɓe ɓeen.
explication: Si wanaa ɓen yimɓe makko gomɗinnooɓe laɓɓini dewe mun ɓen, ɓen ɗon daɗoyay tawnoyeede e lepte ɗen.

arabe: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
traduction: Min ngaccani mo mantoore, e sakkitiiɓe ɓen.
explication: Men accani mo mantoore e jantoore labaande, e mofte sakkitiiɓe ɓen.

arabe: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلۡ يَاسِينَ
traduction: "Kisal woni e dow Ilyaasiina'en".
explication: Alla hiwrike mantii Ilyaasna'en.

arabe: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
traduction: Ko wano nii Min njoɓirta moƴƴimɓe ɓeen.
explication: Ko wano Men yoɓitiri non Ilyaasa'en, woni ko Men yoɓitirta jeyaaɓe Amen gomɗimɓe moƴƴinooɓe ɓen.

arabe: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Kaŋko, ko o jeyanooɗo e jiyaaɓe Amen gooŋɗinɓe ɓen.
explication: Kanko Ilyaasa, ko o jeyanooɗo e jeyaaɓe Amen gomɗimɓe goongini gomɗingol Joomi mun.

arabe: وَإِنَّ لُوطٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Pellet, Luutu kadi, ko jiyanooɗo e Nulaaɓe ɓeen.
explication: Pellet, Luutu kadi, ko jeyanooɗo e Nulaaɓe Alla ɓen nuliranooɓe e yimɓe mun, wewlingol e jertingol.

arabe: إِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
traduction: Jaŋto nde Min ndaɗndunoo mo, kaŋko e ɓeynguure makko nden fof,
explication: Janto nde Men daɗndunoo mo, kanko e ɓeynguure makko nden fow, e lepte wurtanooɗe e yimɓe makko ɓen.

arabe: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
traduction: si wonaa nayeeja debba, tawaaɗo e luttunooɓe ɓeen,
explication: Si wanaa debbo makko on, on jeyano e yimɓe makko leptaaɓe ɓen; tawde ko o yedunooɗo.

arabe: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
traduction: refti Min oƴƴi heddii ɓe ɓeen.
explication: Refti Men halki fennunooɓe mo, heddii ɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَإِنَّكُمۡ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيۡهِم مُّصۡبِحِينَ
traduction: Onon non, hoɗon ndewa e hoore-maɓɓe, dawol mon.
explication: Onon yimɓe Makkah ɓen non, hiɗon rewa e galleeji maɓɓe, tuma setorton Saami, e dawol mon.

arabe: وَبِٱلَّيۡلِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
traduction: e  jemma. E on kaqqiltaa?
explication: Hiɗon rewa e hoore-maɓɓe kadi, ka jemma. E on haqqiltaa, waajitoron ko heɓi ɓe kon, ɓaawo ɓe fennude ɓe yedda ɓe faggitoo bonunnda mo adaaka e mun?

arabe: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Pellet, Yuunusa kadi, ko jiyanooɗo e Nulaaɓe ɓeen.
explication: Pellet, Yuunusa kadi, ko jeyanooɗo e Nulaaɓe Alla ɓen nuliranooɓe e yimɓe mun, wewlingol e jertingol.

arabe: إِذۡ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
traduction: Jaŋto nde o dogirnoo ka laana hebbinaaka,
explication: Janto nde o dogunoo yimɓe makko ɓen, ko aldaa e duŋayee Joomi makko. O waɗɗoyii laana hebbiniraaka yimɓe e dolle.

arabe: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُدۡحَضِينَ
traduction: o urbinii, o jiyaa e foolaaɓe ɓeen.
explication: Laana kan eɓɓi yoolagol, hakkee ko ka heewi. Ɓe urbinii nder ton, ndaarugol ko homɓe gasetee bugedee ka maayo, fii ɗuytugol teddeendi makka ndin; Yuunusa jeyaa e ɓen foolaaɓe ka urba, ɓe bugii mo ka maayo.

arabe: فَٱلۡتَقَمَهُ ٱلۡحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
traduction: Liinngii ngii moɗi mo, ko o pelniiɗo.
explication: Nde ɓe buginoo mo ka maayo, linngii ngii moɗi mo, fewndo ka o felnii; tawde o yehii ka maayo, o duŋinaaki e Joomi makko.

arabe: فَلَوۡلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحِينَ
traduction: Si wonaano tawde homo jeyanoo e subbunhinotooɓe ɓen,
explication: Si wanaano tawde Yuunusa ko jeyanooɗo e jantotooɓe Alla ko ɗuuɗi, si wanaano subbunhinagol makko ngol ka nder reedu lingii ngii

arabe: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
traduction: o ñiiɓayno e reedu maggii, ha ñalnde ummintinoytee.
explication: O ñiiɓayno ka reedu lingii ngii, haa Ñalnde Darngal, ɗon wona yenaande makko.

arabe: ۞ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٞ
traduction: Min mberlii mo ka ladde, ko o ñawnɗo.
explication: Men sorti mo e reedu lingii ngii, Men werlii mo ka ladde, ko o lo'uɗo, battane ko o ɓooyi kon ka reedu maggii.

arabe: وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ شَجَرَةٗ مِّن يَقۡطِينٖ
traduction: Min puɗini e mayre, leggal buudi.
explication: Men fuɗinani mo e e ladde yeewnde nde, leggal buudi, ka o ɗuwora o ñaama.

arabe: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
traduction: Min nuli mo e ujune teemeder yimɓe, maa ko ɓuri.
explication: Men nuli mo e yimɓe makko hawraynooɓe: ujune teemedere maa ɓuri ɓe.

arabe: فَـَٔامَنُواْ فَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
traduction: Ɓe ngooŋɗini, Min ndakmiti ɓe haa e dumunna.
explication: Ɓe gomɗini mo, ɓe goongini ko o addi kon, Alla dakmiti ɓe e nguurndam maɓɓe aduna ɗam, haa dumunna maɓɓe on timmi.

arabe: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
traduction: Laɓndii ɓe:" E ko Joomi maa woodanta ɓiɓɓe rewɓe, kamɓe kan worɓe?
explication: Muhammad, lamndorii ɓee sirkooɓe "ŋiñugol": E on waɗanay Alla ɓiɗɓe rewɓe ɓe añanɗon hoore-mon, heertinanon ɓiɗɓe worɓe ɓen fii mon? Ko honɗum e senndoore nii?

arabe: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثٗا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ
traduction: Kaa Min tagir Maley'ikaaaji dewwɗinaaɗi, hara ko ɓe seediiɓe?"
explication: Ko honno ɓe aaƴorta wonnde Malaa'ika'en ko rewɓe, ɓe tawanooka tageede majji, ɓe seeditaaki ɗum?

arabe: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنۡ إِفۡكِهِمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ
traduction: Paamee, kamɓe e pepindaale maɓɓe ɗen, hiɓe mbi'a:
explication: Pellet sirkuɓe ɓe e pennugol mum en e fepindaade ɓe penaale e dow Alla ɓe ngaskina ɓiɗɗo e dow Makko, ɓe ko fenooɓe e koɓe noddittoo ko.

arabe: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
traduction: "Allah jibinii"; pellet, ɓe penat
explication: Pellet sirkuɓe ɓe e pennugol mum en e fepindaade ɓe penaale e dow Alla ɓe ngaskina ɓiɗɗo e dow Makko, ɓe ko fenooɓe e koɓe noddittoo ko.

arabe: أَصۡطَفَى ٱلۡبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلۡبَنِينَ
traduction: Hara O cuɓay ɓiɓɓe rewɓe ɓen e dow worɓe ɓen?
explication: Hara Allah suɓan hoore Makko, ɓiɗɓe rewɓe ɓen ɓe añanɗon hoore-mon, e dow ɓiɗɓe worɓe ɓe yiɗanɗon hoore-mon ɓen? Kallaa! wanaa non!

arabe: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ
traduction: Ko heɓi on, si ɗon ñaawira noon?
explication: Ko heɓi on, onon ɓee sirkooɓe, hiɗon ñaawira ndee ñaaaworaa ooñiinde, waɗanon Alla ɓiɗɓe rewɓe, suɓaoɗon hoore-mon worɓe ɓen?

arabe: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
traduction: E on miijtottaako?
explication: E on miijitotaako wonnde ko e meere wonɗon e mun? Tawde si on taskike, on yi'iray non bonnde fiɓnde mon nden.

arabe: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: Kaa hoɗon njogii hujja ɓannguɗo?
explication: Kaa hiɗon jogii hujja e dalil ɓanngirɗo Deftere maa Nulaaɗo?

arabe: فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
traduction: Haray ngaddee deftere mon nden, si wonii ko on gooŋɗuɓe!".
explication: Haray addee deftere mon ka hujja mon on woni ɗon, si wonii ko on goonguɓe e haala!

arabe: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبٗاۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
traduction: Ɓe mbaɗi hakkunde makko e Maleykaaji, asko; hara non, Maleykaaji no nganndi, ɓen ko tawnoyteeɓe (ka lepte).
explication: Sirkooɓe ɓen waɗi hakkunde Allah e Malaa'ika'en, asko dammbe, ɗum ko ko ɓe aaƴinoo wonnde Malaa'ika'en, ko ɓiɗɓe Allah rewɓe! Hara non, ɓen Malaa'ikaaɓe no anndi, pellet, Alla tawnoyay ɓen sirkooɓe, e hasboore nden.

arabe: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
traduction: Senaare woodani Allah, e ko ɓe cifotoo!
explication: Allah senike O laaɓii, gaay e kon sirkooɓe ɓen sifotoo, dammbude Mo ɓiɗɗo e genndiraawo, ekw immorde e ka yahdaa e Makko!

arabe: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
traduction: Si wonaa jiyaaɓe Allah laɓɓinaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Si wanaa jeyaaɓe Allah, laɓɓinaaɓe ɓen. Ɓen ɗon sifortaa Allah, ko yahdaani e Makko.

arabe: فَإِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
traduction: Nganndon onon e ko ndewoton kon,
explication: Anndon onon ɓee sirkooɓe, e ko rewoton kon gaanin Allah.

arabe: مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
traduction: on ngonaani majjinooɓe ɗuum [goɗɗo goo],
explication: On wonaali majjinirooɓe kon ko rewoton, woɗɓe goo e diine goonga.

arabe: إِلَّا مَنۡ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
traduction: si wonaa tawɗo on ko naatoowo ka Dulɓaynge.
explication: Si wanaa on mo Allah winndani naatugol ka Yiite. On ɗon yeddiray saɓu ɗum, o naata nge. Onon non, e reweteeɗi mon ɗin, on alaa nden feere.

arabe: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
traduction: [Maleykaaji mbi'i'i]: "Alaa e amen, mo alanaa ɗum, darorɗe ganndaande;
explication: Malaa'ika'en ɓanngini jeyeede maɓɓe ka Allah, daɗndinoo e ko sirkooɓe ɓen aaƴoriɓe kon, wi'ugol: Alaa e amen, mo alanaa ɗum, darorde anndaande, fii rewugol Alla ɗoftoo Mo.

arabe: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
traduction: Ko minen ngoni oni saffinaaɓe ɓeen;
explication: Menen Malaa'ika, ko men darnaaɓe saffinaa, fii rewugol Allah ɗoftoo Mo. Ko memen kadi woni subbunhinantooɓe Allah ɓen, sifaaji yahduɗi e Makko.

arabe: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحُونَ
traduction: Ko minen kadi ngoni subbunhinotooɓe ɓen.
explication: Menen Malaa'ika, ko men darnaaɓe saffinaa, fii rewugol Allah ɗoftoo Mo. Ko memen kadi woni seninooɓe Allah ko O haandaani ko sifaaji.

arabe: وَإِن كَانُواْ لَيَقُولُونَ
traduction: Ɓe ngoniino e bii'gol:
explication: Sirkooɓe Makkah ɓen woniino e wi'ugol, ado nuleede Muhammadu (yo o his): Sinno hara meɗen joginoo Deftere sugu Defte arane ɗen, wano Tawreeta, ko pellet, men laɓɓinanayno Alla dewalngal. Hara non, ko e fenaande ɓe woni. Tawde Muhammadu addanii ɓe Alqur'aana, ɓe yeddi nde. Kono non, aray nde ɓe anndata, fii lepte saɗtuɗe, haɓɓiiɗe ɓe ɗen, Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
traduction: "Hara deftere iwnde e adinooɓe ɓeen, no woodannoo min,
explication: Sirkooɓe Makkah ɓen woniino e wi'ugol, ado nuleede Muhammadu (yo o his): Sinno hara meɗen joginoo Deftere sugu Defte arane ɗen, wano Tawreeta, ko pellet, men laɓɓinanayno Alla dewalngal. Hara non, ko e fenaande ɓe woni. Tawde Muhammadu addanii ɓe Alqur'aana, ɓe yeddi nde. Kono non, aray nde ɓe anndata, fii lepte saɗtuɗe, haɓɓiiɗe ɓe ɗen, Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
traduction: min ngonayno jiyaaɓe Allah laɓɓinaaɓe.
explication: Sirkooɓe Makkah ɓen woniino e wi'ugol, ado nuleede Muhammadu (yo o his): Sinno hara meɗen joginoo Deftere sugu Defte arane ɗen, wano Tawreeta, ko pellet, men laɓɓinanayno Alla dewalngal. Hara non, ko e fenaande ɓe woni. Tawde Muhammadu addanii ɓe Alqur'aana, ɓe yeddi nde. Kono non, aray nde ɓe anndata, fii lepte saɗtuɗe, haɓɓiiɗe ɓe ɗen, Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: فَكَفَرُواْ بِهِۦۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Ɓe njeddi nde, kono aray ɓe nganndoya !
explication: Sirkooɓe Makkah ɓen woniino e wi'ugol, ado nuleede Muhammadu (yo o his): Sinno hara meɗen joginoo Deftere sugu Defte arane ɗen, wano Tawreeta, ko pellet, men laɓɓinanayno Alla dewalngal. Hara non, ko e fenaande ɓe woni. Tawde Muhammadu addanii ɓe Alqur'aana, ɓe yeddi nde. Kono non, aray nde ɓe anndata, fii lepte saɗtuɗe, haɓɓiiɗe ɓe ɗen, Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ سَبَقَتۡ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Konngol Amen ardinoke, fii jiyaaɓe Amen, Nulaaɓe ɓen,
explication: Gomɗii Konngol Amen ardinoke, fii Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen, wonnde ko ɓe wallirteeɓe e hoore ayɓe maɓɓe ɓen, hujja e dolle ɗe Alla neeminiri ɓe. E wonnde poolal ngal, ko fii konu Amen, haɓirayngu fii Alla ngun, no daalol Alla ngol ɓamtora.

arabe: إِنَّهُمۡ لَهُمُ ٱلۡمَنصُورُونَ
traduction: won'de pellet, ko kamɓe ngoni walleteeɓe ɓen,
explication: Gomɗii Konngol Amen ardinoke, fii Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen, wonnde pellet, ko ɓe wallirteeɓe e hoore ayɓe maɓɓe ɓen, hujja e dolle ɗe Alla neeminiri ɓe. E wonnde poolal ngal, ko fii konu Amen, haɓirayngu fii Alla ngun, no daalol Alla ngol ɓamtora.

arabe: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
traduction: e won'de ko konu Amen ngun, woni foolooɓe ɓen.
explication: Gomɗii Konngol Amen ardinoke, fii Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen, wonnde ko ɓe wallirteeɓe e hoore ayɓe maɓɓe ɓen, hujja e dolle ɗe Alla neeminiri ɓe. E wonnde poolal ngal, ko fii konu Amen, haɓirayngu fii Alla ngun, no daalol Alla ngol ɓamtora.

arabe: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
traduction: Ɗuurno ɓee, ha e saanga;
explication: An Nulaaɗo, ɗuurno ɓee sirkooɓe saɗta feereeɓe, haa e saanga nde Allah humpitu maa, arugol lepte maɓɓe ɗen.

arabe: وَأَبۡصِرۡهُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ
traduction: ndaaraa ɓe, ɓe aray nji'a!
explication: Ndaaraa ɓe, tuma lepte ɗen jippotoo e maɓɓe, ɓe aray yi'ude, ka yi'ugol nafataa ɓe!

arabe: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
traduction: E hara ko lepte amen men ɗen ɓe keñorta?
explication: E hara ko lepte Alla ɗen, ɓee sirkooɓe heñorta?

arabe: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
traduction: Si ɗe njippike ka tannde (dingiral)maɓɓe, haray bimmbi waajonooɓe ɓeen bonii !
explication: Si lepte Allah ɗen jippike e maɓɓe, haray bimmbi maɓɓe on bonii !

arabe: وَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
traduction: Ɗuurno ɓee, ha e saanga;
explication: An Nulaaɗo, ɗuurno e maɓɓe, haa Allah ñaawa fii leptugol ɓe ngol.

arabe: وَأَبۡصِرۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ
traduction: ndaaraa, ɓe aray nji'a!
explication: Ndaaraa; kamɓe kadi, ɓe aray yi'ude lepte Allah ɗen yanooje e maɓɓe.

arabe: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
traduction: Senaare woodanii Joomi maa, Jeyɗo teddungal, e  ko ɓe cifotoo !
explication: Senayee woodanii Joomi maa, an Muhammadu, O laaɓii e kon ko sirkooɓe ɓen siforta Mo e ustiiɗi !

arabe: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
traduction: Kisal wonii e Nulaaɓe ɓen,
explication: Kisiyee Allah e mantoore Makko, wonii e Nulaaɓe Makko tedduɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Jettooje ngoodani Allah, Jeyɗo winndere nden!
explication: Yettoore nden fow, woodanii Alla seniiɗo toowuɗo On. Ko Kanko hanndi e ɗum. Ko Kanko woni Jeyɗo winndere nden fow. Jeyɗo ɗum alaa, si wanaa Kanko.

arabe: صٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ذِي ٱلذِّكۡرِ
traduction: Saad.[1] Mi wooɗndirii Alqur'aana, jom waa.
explication: Saad: yewtere yawtiino, fii sugu ɗee karfe taƴondirɗe, ka fuɗɗorde simoore Baqarah. E ngol cortewol ɗoo, Allah no woodanira Alqur'aana, yowondirnde e waajitorɗi yimɓe, kon ko nafata ɓe aduna e laakara. Hara wanaa ko sirkooɓe ɓen aaƴotoo, wonnde Allah no mai denndadiijo.

arabe: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةٖ وَشِقَاقٖ
traduction: Si ko woni, yedduɓe ɓe ngonii e townitaare e lurral !
explication: Ko woni kon, heeferɓe ɓen wonii e townitanagol wootinɗinnde Allah, e luutondirgol e Muhammadu (yo o his), e anygol mo.

arabe: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنٖ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٖ
traduction: Ɗuuɗii e gire ɗen Min kalki, ado maɓɓe, ɓe noddi faabo, kono tawi ko bonatno bonii.
explication: Ɗuuɗii e mofte fennuɓe Nulaaɓe mun, ado maɓɓe, ɓe Men halki, ɓen noddi faaboo uma, nde lepte tellato, kono oon waqtu wonaana waqtu faabeede e lepte sakko faabo nafa ɓe.

arabe: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٌ
traduction: Ɓe ŋalɗi, nde jeertinoowo jiyaaɗo e maɓɓe, arata ɓe. Yedduɓe ɓen mbi'i: "Oo, ko bileejo keewuɗo fenaande,
explication: Ɓe ŋalɗi, tuma ɓe yi'unoo Nulaaɗo arɗo ɓe on, ko jertina ɓe e lepte Allah ɗen, ko e maɓɓe o jeyaa. Yedduɓe ɓen nde yi'unoo hujjaaji ɓannginɗi goonga Muhammadu kan, ɓe wi'i: Oo, ko biloowo yimɓe nii, heewuɗo fenaande e ko wi'ata kon, wonnde ko o Nulaaɗo, mo Allah wahayini e mun.

arabe: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهٗا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٞ
traduction: Kere o waɗay deweteeɗi ɗin, deweteeɗo gooto? Pellet, ɗum ko hu'unde haawniinde non".
explication: Kere o waɗay reweteeɗi limtilimtiɗi e mun ɗin fow, reweteeɗo gooto tun? Pellet, ko huunde haɗtirnde haawnagol non.

arabe: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٞ يُرَادُ
traduction: Mbatu maɓɓe ngun huccitiri wiide: "Yehee, tabiton e deweteeɗi mon ɗin. Ɗuum ɗoo, ko hu'unde eɓɓanaande.
explication: Mbatu maɓɓe ngun hucciti, ɓe wi'ani yimɓe maɓɓe ɓen: Yehee, jokkon haaju mun, wata on naatu e diina Muhammadu, tabitee e reweteeɗi mon ɗin. Anndon ko Muhammadu noddi on e mun kon, wiide yo on rewu gooto tun, ko ko o eɓɓani, fii no o waawira'en, waɗten jokkude mo.

arabe: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
traduction: Min nanaali fii ɗum, e diina sakkitiika kan. Ɗum wonaani, si wonaa ko fefkindaa.
explication: Men nanaali fii ko Muhammadu noddata men e mun kon, woni bajjinɗingol Allah ngol, e diina baabiraaɓe amen ɓen, wanaa e diina Iisaa kan. Ko men naniri mo kon wonaali, si wanaa fenaande fefindaande.

arabe: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
traduction: Kere ko e makko Jaŋtoore nden jippotoo hakkunde amen?" Si ko woni, ɓe ngonii e cikkitagol Jantoore am nden. Wurin, ko fii ɓe meeɗaali taho, lepte am ɗen!
explication: Kere ko e makko Alqur'aana jippintee hakkunde amen, o heertora ɗum e hoore amen, menen koohooɓe ɓen? Si ko woni, ɓee sirkooɓe wonii e sikkitagol wayahu mo mi jippini e maaɗa on. Fotde ɓe meeɗaali lepte Allah ɗen, kono hiɓe ɗayintora nennitaneede ɓe. Si ɓe meeɗuno lepte ɗen, ɓe haɓɓitotanooko e yeddugol sirkana Allah, sikkitoo e ko O wahayini kon e maaɗa.

arabe: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
traduction: Kaa ɓe njogiti ngaluuji yurmeende Joomi maa, pooluɗo, Dokko O?
explication: Kaa ɓee sirkooɓe fennooɓe jogiti ngaluuji ɓure Joomi maa, Fooluɗo Mo fooletaake On, Okkoowo mo O muuyani yeɗude. Wano ngalu ngu O yeɗirta Annabaaku, on mo O muuyani. Tawde wanaa kamɓe ɗum wonani, sakko ɓe yeɗa mo ɓe yiɗani, maa ɓe ɗala goɗɗo goo.

arabe: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
traduction: Kaa ko kamɓe woodani laamagol kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin e  ko woni hakkunde majji? Haray yo ɓe ƴeenŋu ɓe ƴawa!
explication: Kaa ko kamɓe woodani laamagol kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin e kon ko woni hakkunde majji? Sakko ɓe heɓa feere yeɗugol e ɗawugol! Si ko non ɓe aaƴori, haray yo ɓe ƴeenŋir kala sabu no ɓe hewtiryta ka kammuuli, fii no ɓe ñaawira ko ɓe yiɗi, woni yeɗugol maa ɗalugol. Kono ɓe hippataa ɗum!

arabe: جُندٞ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
traduction: Ko ɓe konu hoyngu no, foolet e 'peɗle ɗen!
explication: Ɓee fennooɓe Muhammadu jom kisiyee on, ko konu hoyngu, fooliroyteengu wano ɗiya feddeeji fennunooɗi Nulaaɓe mun, ado maɓɓe.

arabe: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
traduction: Ado maɓɓe, yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen njedduno, e Aadi'en e Fir'awna jom-peme,
explication: Wanaa ɓee woni ko adii fennude. Woɗɓe adinoke ɓe e ɗum, woni Yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen, e Aadi'en e Fir'awna lettiraynooɗo yimɓe ɓen, pempe.

arabe: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
traduction: e Samuuda'en, e yimɓe Luutu ɓe, e yimɓe pitaaji ɓen; ko ɓeen ngoni fedde (fennuɓe) ɓeen.
explication: Samuuda'en kadi, e yimɓe Luutu ɓen, e yimɓe Shu'aybu ɓen fow kadi fenni Nulaaɓe mun ɓen. Ko ɓen woni feddeeji hawrunooɗi e fennugol yedda ko Nulaaɓe lun addannooɓe.

arabe: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
traduction: Kala ɓee wonaani, si wonaa o njeddi ii Nulaaɓe ɓen. Lepte Am ɗen jojji e maɓɓe!
explication: Alaa e ɗin feddeeji, mo fennaali Nulaaɓe ɓen. Lepte Allah ɗen jojji e maɓɓe, fii kala ɗe tonngino haa e dumunna.

arabe: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٖ
traduction: Ɓee cabbaaki, si wonaa ha'acaango gooto, ngo alaa ruttorde.
explication: Ɓee fennooɓe Muhammadu (yo o his) habbaaki, si wanaa wuttaandu ɗiɗaɓuru ndun ka alaandu, ndu alaa ruttorde. Lepte ɗen yana e maɓɓe, si ɓe ɓe tuubaali ko adii.

arabe: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
traduction: Ɓe mbii': "Joomi amen, yaccinan min geɗal lepte amen, ado Ñalaande hasboore nden".
explication: Ɓe woni e jalkitugol wi'a: Joomi amen, yaccinan men geɓal lepte amen ɗen aduna, ado Ñalaande Darngal.

arabe: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
traduction: Muñño e kon ko ɓe mbi'ata; annditaa jiyaaɗo Amen on, Daawuuda, joom doole. Ko o ɗuuɗunooɗo tuubugol.
explication: An Nulaaɗo, muñño e ko fennooɓe ɓen wowlata maa kon; annditaa jeyaaɗo Amen on, Daawuuda, jom cemmbe dartorɗe ayɓe mun, muññoo e ɗoftagol Allah. Kanko ko o ɗuuɗunooɗo ruttoragol tuubannde Allah, e gollugol ko welata Mo.

arabe: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
traduction: Min eeltii pelle ɗen, hiɗe cubbunhinoda e makko, ka kiikiiɗe e ka bimmbi.
explication: Men elti pelle ɗen, ko subbunhinoda e Daawuuda, ka kiikiiɗe e ka weetugol.

arabe: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةٗۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
traduction: e colli ɗin, hiɗi mooɓindiraa, kala e majji no tuubana mo.
explication: Men elti kadi colli ɗin, ka ɗi mooɓindiraa ka weeyo, tawi ɗi fow majji, hiɗo ɗoftanii subbunhinanagol Allah.

arabe: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
traduction: Min cemmbini laamu makko ngun, Min yeɗi mo Annabaaku e fasinteegal.
explication: Men semmbiniri fii laamu Makko ngun, mirin mo Men okki mo on, wonndude e waawugol foola ayɓe makko ɓen. Men yeɗi mo Annabaaku, e hawrugol e sawaaba. Men yeɗi Mo ɗemngal laaɓungal.

arabe: ۞ وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ
traduction: Hara kumpital wenooɓe ɓen arii maa, nde ɓe ƴawunoo ka ganngunal !
explication: An Nulaaɗo, hara kabaaru wenjunooɓe ɓen ɗiɗo arii maa, tuma nde ɓe ƴawunoo ka ganngunal Annabi Daawuuda nokku dewirdo mum!

arabe: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
traduction: Nde ɓe naatunoo ka Daawuuda, o ɗenƴii ɓe. Ɓe mbi'i: "Wota a hul ! Ko wennjuɓe ɗiɗo; goɗɗo e amen tooñii oya. Ñaawir goonga hakkunde amen, wota a tooñ, tinndinaa min e laawol Pocciingol ngol.
explication: Tuma nde ɓe naatirnoo e juhal, ka Daawuuda, o ɗeƴii ɓe. Ɓe anndi o ɗenƴike, ɓe wi'ani mo: wata a hulu ! Ko men yeddondirɓe ɗiɗo; goɗɗo e amen tooñii oya. Ko yo a ñaawir nunɗal hakkunde amen, wata a tooñu, tinndinaa men e laawol focciingol ngol, woni laawol sawaaba gol.

arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعٞ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةٗ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ
traduction: Oo ko musiɗɗo am: homo jogii baali cappanɗe jeenay e jeenay, miin miɗo jogii baalii gootii. O wi'i: "Henndinam ngii"; o foolimi e yeewtere.
explication: Gooto e maɓɓe wi'iani Daawuuda: Oo gorko, ko musiɗɗo am: himo jogii baalii cappanɗe jeenay e jeenay, min miɗo jogii baalii gootii. O ɗaɓɓiri lam henndingol mo ngil, o fooli lam e yewtere.

arabe: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٞ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعٗاۤ وَأَنَابَ۩
traduction: O maaki: "Pellet, o tooñirii ma laɓndagol baalii maa ngii, waɗtugol e baali makko ɗin". Ɗuuɗii ko hawtuɓe tooñindirta hakkunde maɓɓe, si wonaa ɓen gooŋɗiinɓe, ɓe ngolli moƴƴuɗi - ɓen non no fanɗi. - Daawuuda felliti, won'de Min njarribike mo. O imsinanii Joomi makko, o suuyiri sujjugol, o tuubi.
explication: Daawuuda ñaawiri hakkunde maɓɓe wi'angol wullitiiɗo on: Pellet, musiɗɗo maa on tooñirii ma, ɗaɓɓugol ɓeydiyude baalii maa ngii, ka baali makko. Ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e hawtuɓe, hino tooñindira hakkunde maɓɓe, si wanaa gomɗimɓe gollooɓe moƴƴuɗi yamiraaɗi ɗin; ɓen ɗon, ko nunɗuɓe hakkunde maɓɓe, kono ɓe ɗuuɗaa. Annabi Daawuuda felliti, wonnde Men jarriborii mo ngol wennjondiro. O ɗaɓɓiri Joomi makko haforaneede, o suuyiri sujjugol, o tuubani Allah.

arabe: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
traduction: Min njaafanii mo ɗum. Pellet non, hino woodani mo ko amen, ɓadal e moƴƴude ruttorde.
explication: Men jaɓirani mo tuubuubuyee, yaafanagol mo ɗum. Pellet non, hino woodani ka Amen, ɓadal e moƴƴugol ruttorde laakara.

arabe: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
traduction: Eey ma Daawuuda, Min mbaɗii ma lomto ka leydi. Ñaawir goonga hakkunde yimɓe ɓen, wota a jokku mbeleeɗe, sakko ɗe majjine e laawol Allah ngol". Pellet, ɓen majjooɓe e laawol Allah ngol, hino woodani ɓe lepte tiiɗuɗe, sabu ko ɓe yejjitiri kon, Ñalaande hasboore nden.
explication: Ko an yo Daawuuda, Men waɗii ma lomto ka hoore leydi. Siinu fiyakuuji diina e aduna ɗin, ñaawiraa nunɗal hakkunde yimɓe ɓen. Wata a jokku mbeleeɗe, tuma ñaawataa hakkunde maɓɓe, sakko tooñataa goɗɗo e maɓɓe, sabu tawde oya on no ɓaɗi maa e jeya maa e weldigal, o majjiniri ɗum, laawol Allah focciingol ngol. Anndaa, pellet, majjooɓe ɓen e ngol Allah focciingol, hino woodani ɓe lepte saɗtuɗe, sabu ko ɓe yejjitiri kon, Ñalaande hasboore nden. Tawde si ɓe annditayno fii mayre, ɓe hula nde, ɓe jokkataano mbeleeɗe.

arabe: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
traduction: Min tagiraali kammu ngun e leydi ndin e ko woni hakkunde majji kon, meere. Ɗum ko sikke yedduɓe ɓen. Bone woodanii ɓen yedduɓe, e Yiite ngeen!
explication: Men tagiraali kammu ngun e leydi ndin meere. Ɗum ko sikke yedduɓe ɓen. Bone Yiite woodanii ɓen yedduɓe, sikkuɓe ɗum, Ñalnde Darngal, si ɓe luttii e keeferaaku sikkitagol Allah ko boni !

arabe: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ
traduction: Ka Min mbɗay ɓen gooŋɗinɓe ɓe ngolli moƴƴi, wano bonnooɓe ɓen ka hoore leydi? Kaa Min mbaɗay gooŋɗuɓe ɓen, wano faajireeɓe ɓeen?
explication: Men waɗataa ɓen gomɗimɓe Allah ɓe jokki Nulaaɗo Makko on, ɓe golli golle moƴƴe, wano ɓen bonnirooɓe ka leydi, geddi e keeferaaku. Men waɗataa kadi hulirɓe Joomi mun ɓen, ɗoftagol yamirooje Makko, woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko, wano heeferɓe ɓen e naafiqiiɓe yooliiɓe e geddi ɓen. Fonnugol ɓe, ko ooñaare nde yahdaa e Allah toowuɗo seniiɗo On. Si ko woni, O yoɓitiray gomɗimɓe ɓen, naatugol Aljanna, O leptira yedduɓe ɓen, naatugol Yiite. Tawde ɓe fotataa ka Allah. Njoɓdi maɓɓe kadi fotataa ka Makko.

arabe: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكٞ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
traduction: Ko deftere barkinaande, woni ko Min njippini e maaɗa, fii no ɓe taskora aayeeje mayre, e ko joomiraaɓe haqqille ɓen mbaajitora.
explication: Ko Deftere heewunde barki e nafa, woni ndee Alqur'aanaare, nde Men jippini e maaɗa. Fii no yimɓe ɓen taskra miijitoo maanaaji mayre, joomiraaɓe haqqille ɓen hisuɗe ɓen, waajitora.

arabe: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
traduction: Min njeɗi Daawuuda Sulaymaana, - jiyaaɗo moƴƴo - Ko o ɗuuɗuɗo tuubugol-ruttoo.
explication: Men yeɗi Daawuuda, geɗal makko Sulaymaana, neema e ɓural Amen, ko ɓernde makko deeƴira. Sulaymaana moƴƴii jeyaaɗo. Ko o ɗuuɗunooɗo tuubugol ruttoo e Allah.

arabe: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ
traduction: Jaŋto nde o hollanoo kiikiiɗe, pucci yooɗuɗi yaawuɗi,
explication: Janto nde o hollanoo kiikiiɗeere, pucci yooɗuɗi yaawuɗi, darorayɗi taape tati, ɓamta nayaɓal ngal. Ɓe seeraali e hollugol mo ɗum, haa naange muti.

arabe: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
traduction: o maaki: "Min ɓurnorii joɗgol jawdi, dii ko mi jaŋtotoo Joomi am kon, haa [na'ange] ngen mutoyii.
