explication: Sulaymaana maaki: Mi ɓurnorii yiɗgol jawdi, wano ɗii pucci, e dow ko mi jantotoo Joomi am kon, haa naange ngen mutoyii, mi faɗii julde alansaraa nden.

arabe: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
traduction: Nduttee kam ɗi". O woni e sodugol ɗi ka taape e ka daaɗe.
explication: Ruttee lam ɗii pucci. Ɓe rutti mo ɗi, o woni e sodirgol ɗi kaafa, ka taape(koyde) e ka daaɗe majji.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدٗا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
traduction: Gooɗii Min njarribike Sulaymaana, Min mbernii e jullere makko nden ɓanndu. refti o tuubi.
explication: Gomɗii Men jarribike Sulaymaana, Men werii e jullere makko laamu nden, seytaniiru, nannditiniindu e neɗɗo, ndu ardii seeɗa e laamu makko ngun. Refti Sulaymaana hettiti laamu makko ngun, o wuurti mbo e seytaniiru ndun.

arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكٗا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
traduction: O maaki: "Joomi am, haforanam, yeɗaa kam laamu, ngu heertantaako goɗɗo goo, ɓaawo am. Pellet, ko an woni jeɗoowo On".
explication: Sulaymaana maaki: Joomi am, haforanam goopi am, yeɗaa lam laamu heeranii ngu lam, ngu haananaa goɗɗo goo, ɓaawo am. Ko An Joomi, woni ɗuuɗugol mawni dokke.

arabe: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ
traduction: Min eeltani mo henndu ndun, tawi hindu wifira e sago makko, neweende, nokku kala to o yiɗi.
explication: Men jaabinani mo toraare nden. Men eltani mo henndu ndun, tawi ndu wifiray neweende, e yamiroore makko, e hoore doole e yaawere mayru fow, ndu naɓa mo ka o faalaa.

arabe: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٖ وَغَوَّاصٖ
traduction: E seytanuuji ɗiin, mahaynooɗi e mutaynooɗi.
explication: Men eltani mo kadi seytanuuji ɗin, ɗi woni e ley konngol makko. No e majji mahaynooɗi, goɗɗi ɗin mutaynooɗi ka maayo, ɗi yaltina kaŋŋe.

arabe: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ
traduction: Goɗɗi ɗi, ko dummbaaɗi e peŋɗe.
explication: Seytanuuji goo, ko rawaniyanke, eltanaaɗi mo. Ɗin ko dummbaaɗi e jolokooje, ka ɗi waawaa memminaade.

arabe: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
traduction: "Ɗuum ko dokkal Amen. Okkitir, maa njogitoraa ko aldaa e laɓnditoreede".
explication: Ɗum ko ko Men yeɗu maa, an Sulaymaana, ka jaabingol toraare maa. Okku mo yiɗanɗaa, maa ɗalaa mo faalaɗaa. A lamnditortaake goɗɗum e mun.

arabe: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
traduction: Ko pellet, hino woodani mo ka amen, ɓadal e moƴƴude ruttorde.
explication: Pellet, Sulaymaana ka Amen, ko jeyaaɗo e ɓadnaaɓe, maranaaɓe ruttorde moƴƴunde, woni Aljanna.

arabe: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبٖ وَعَذَابٍ
traduction: Jaŋto kadi jiyaaɗo Amen on Ayyuuba, nde o noddunoo Joomi makko, won'de : "Seytaane memirii lam tampere e muuseendi".
explication: Janto kadi, an Nulaaɗo, jeyaaɗo Amen on Ayyuuba, nde o torinoo Allah Joomi makko, wonnde: Seytaane memirii lam tampere lebtatnde.

arabe: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدٞ وَشَرَابٞ
traduction: [Allah wi'ani mo]: "Latir tunndawal maa ngal [ka leydi]: Ɗam ɗoo, ko lootorɗam, ɓuuɓɗam e njaram".
explication: Men wi'ani mo: latir tunndawal(koyngal) maa ka leydi. O waɗi ɗum, ɓunndu ɓullitanii mo ɗon: tawi goɗɗam ɗam, ko yaretee ɗam, o lootora ɗama, ko o ittira lorra e tampere memunoonde mo nden.

arabe: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
traduction: Min njeɗi mo ɓeynguure makko nden, e yeru maɓɓe tawti ɓe, yurmeende immorde e amen, e waaju wonan'de marɓe haqqille ɓen.
explication: Men jaabinani mo toraare. Men huncani mo lorra makko kan, Men yeɗi mo ɓeynguure makko nden, Men ɓeydani mo geɗalɓe e taaniraaɓe yeru maɓɓe, yurmeende immorde e Amen, e njoɓdi muñal makko ngal, e fii no joomiraaɓe haqqille hisuɗe ɓen, waajitora, wonnde muñal, adday hoyeende e warjeede.

arabe: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثٗا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرٗاۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
traduction: "Nanngir sookewo maa ngon, tamere huɗo, piyiraa ɗum [cuddiiɗo maa on], fii wata a firtu (woondoore nden)". Min tawu mo, muññiiɗo. O moƴƴii jiyaaɗo. Pellet, ko o ɗuuɗuɗo tuubugol-ruttoo.
explication: Nde Annabi Ayyuuba tikkannoo debbo makko on, o woondiri piyugol mo loyru teemedere. Men wi'ani mo ontuma : Ko an Ayyuuba, nanngiri sookewo maa ngon, tamannde huɗo, piyiraa mo ɗum, no hunniraa woodoore maa nden, hara a firtaa nden. O waɗi ɗum. Men tawu mo, ko o muññiiɗo e ko Men jarribori mo kon. O moƴƴii jeyaaɗo. Pellet, ko o ɗuuɗunooɗo tuubugol ruttoo ka Allah.

arabe: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
traduction: Jaŋto kadi, jiyaaɓe Amen ɓen, Ibraahiima e Ishaaqa e Yaaquuba, joomiraaɓe semmbe e yi'anɗe.
explication: Janto kadi, an Nulaaɗo, jeyaaɓe Amen ɓen ɓe Men suɓii, e Nulaaɓe Amen, ɓe Men immini: Ibraahiima, e Ishaaqa e Yaaquuba. Ɓe laatino joomiraaɓe cemmbe ka ɗoftagol Allah, ɗaɓɓa welayee Makko. Ɓe woni kadi joomiraaɓe giiɗe, jaɓooɓe goonga.

arabe: إِنَّآ أَخۡلَصۡنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٖ ذِكۡرَى ٱلدَّارِ
traduction: Min keertinanii ɓe heertinannde, annditugol galle (laakara) ɗen.
explication: Men heertinanii heertinannde, nden woni wuurnugol ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen, anntidugol fii galle laakara ɗen, hebilaronaɗe, golle moƴƴe, nodda yimɓe ɓen e mum.

arabe: وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
traduction: E kadi ɓee ka amen, ko jiyaaɓe e suɓaaɓe moƴƴuɓe suɓaaɓe.
explication: Kadi, ɓee ka Amen, ko jeyaaɓe e suɓiraaɓe ɗoftagol dewgol Men, suɓiraaɓe tammbitagol Nulal Amen ngal, yottina e yimɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
traduction: Jaŋto kadi Ismaa'iila, e Yuusa'u, e Zal-Kifli, kala maɓɓe, ko jiyaaɓe e suɓaaɓe.
explication: Janto kadi, an Annabiijo, Ismaa'iila geɗal Ibraahiima, e Ysa'u, e Zal-Kifli, mantiraaɓe mantoore labaande, tawde hiɓe hanndi e mun. Kala e maɓɓe, ko jeyaaɓe e suɓaaɓe moƴƴuɓe ɓen ka Allah.

arabe: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرٞۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
traduction: Ɗum ko waaju. Ko pellet, hino woodani gooŋɗuɓe ɓen, ruttorde moƴƴunde.
explication: Ɗum ko annditirgol ɓee, mantoore labaande, ka Alqur'aana. Ko pellet, hino woodani hulirɓe Allah ɓen ɗoftagol Mo woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, ruttorde moƴƴunde, ka galle laakara.

arabe: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٖ مُّفَتَّحَةٗ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبُ
traduction: Ɗuum ko Aljannaaji ñiiɓal, ɗi ɓe udditanaa dame mum,
explication: Nden ruttorde moƴƴunde, ko Aljannaaji ñiiɓal, ɗi ɓe naatoyta Ñalnde Darngal, hara dame majji no udditiranaaɓe, saɗnugol ɓe.

arabe: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ وَشَرَابٖ
traduction: hara ko ɓe soɓɓindii ɓe ton, heɓe nodda ton muuyanteeɗi ɗuuɗuɗi e njaram.
explication: Hara ko ɓe soɓɓindiiɓe e hoore danɗe cuɗinanaaɗe ɓe, hiɓe nodda gollooɓe ton ɓen, lamndooɓe muuyanteeɗi ɗuuɗuɗi serti, e noone kala e njaram, mo ɓe yiɗi, wano sanngara ekw.

arabe: ۞ وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ أَتۡرَابٌ
traduction: Hino woodani ɓe (ton): raɓɓuɓe ndaarɗe, goreeɓe.
explication: Hino woodani ɓe ton: rewɓe raɓɓinayɓe ndaarɗe mun e worɓe mun tun, fotɓe e duuɓi.

arabe: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
traduction: Ko ɗum woni ko podaɗon, fii Ñalaande hasboore ndeen.
explication: Ko ɗum woni ko fodaɗon e njoɓdi laaɓundi, onon gomɗuɓe ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal. Fii golle mon moƴƴe ɗen aduna.

arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
traduction: Pellet, ɗum ko arsike amen, gasugol alanaa mo.
explication: Pellet, njoɓdi jantaandi fii mun ndin ɗoo, ko arsike Amen, mo Men arsikoyta gomɗuɓe ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal. Arsike duumotooɗo, mo taƴondirtaa, o lannataa.

arabe: هَٰذَاۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٖ
traduction: Ɗuum, [ko njoɓdi maɓɓe]. Pellet, hino woodani kadi bewɓe ɓeen, ko ɓuri bonnde e ruttorde,
explication: Ko jantoo kon, ko njoɓdi gomɗuɓe ɓen. Pellet, hino woodani kadi yawtirɓe keeri Allah ɗin geddi e keeferaaku, njoɓdi sertundi; kamɓe on, ko ruttorde ɓurnde bonnde woodani ɓe Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
traduction: woni Jahannama, nge ɓe naatoyta. Nge bonii ndaɗɗudi!
explication: Njoɓdi maɓɓe ndin, ko Jahannama, huuɓitaynge ɓe, nge tampina ɓe nguleeki e ooyeende. Hiɓe mari ton ndaɗɗuɗe, kono ɗe bonii daɗɗuɗe!

arabe: هَٰذَا فَلۡيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٞ وَغَسَّاقٞ
traduction: Ɗuum, ko yo ɓe meeɗ: ko fatata, e ƴiƴƴiri,
explication: Ɗen lepte, ko ndiyam haɗtuɗam e fatugol, e mbor- di ilatndi e ɓalli yimɓe lepteteeɓe ɓen ka Yiite. Yo ɓe sulko ɗam, sabu ko njaram maɓɓe ɗam ittataa ɗonka ɗan non!

arabe: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكۡلِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٌ
traduction: Woɓɓe ɓen, nannduɗe e majje, ko nooneeji.
explication: Hino woodani ɓe lepte goo, nannduɗe e majje. Ɗen ko nooneeji, ɗi ɓe leptiroytee ka laakara.

arabe: هَٰذَا فَوۡجٞ مُّقۡتَحِمٞ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ
traduction: E hino dental naatiroyat ngal doole e mon, toolii alanaa ɓe; tawde ko ɓe naatooɓe Yiite !
explication: Si yimɓe Yiite ɓen naatoyii e magge, ɓe ukkondi- royii hakkunde maɓɓe e weljugol hoynindira, kala e maɓɓe wona e daɗndinagol e oya. Woɗɓe e maɓɓe wi'i: E hino fedde naatidoyay nde e mon ka Yiite. Ɓe jaaboo ɓe: Toolii alanaa ɓe, tawde ko ɓe meeɗirayɓe Yiite ngen, no men meeɗirta nge.

arabe: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
traduction: Ɓeen mbia: bismilla alanaa mon, ko onon ndefi min ɗum". Nge bonii ñiiɓirde.
explication: Fedde jokkunooɓe ɓeya ɓen wi'ana koohooɓe ɓen: ko onon ɓee koohooɓe kan, woni toolii alanaa, ko onon defi men ɗee lepte muusuɗe, sabu ko mojjinirɗon men kon, bewinɗon men. Ndee ñiiɓirde Jahannama ɗoo, nde bonii ñiiɓirde naatooɓe nge fow.

arabe: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابٗا ضِعۡفٗا فِي ٱلنَّارِ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'a: "Joomi amen, defuɗo min ɗuim on, ɓeydan mo leptte cowalle ka Yiite".
explication: Ɓe wi'a kadi: Joomi amen, defuɗo men majjugol on, ɓaawo nde peewal ngal ari e amen, sowan mo lepte ɗen ka Yiite.

arabe: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالٗا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ
traduction: Ɓeya mbi'i: "Ko haɗi men jiugol worɓe, ɓe min limtaynoo e boonɓe ɓen?
explication: Bewɓe townitiiɓe ɓen wi'a: Ko haɗi men yi'ugol ka Yiite gaa, worɓe ɓe men limtaynoo ka aduna, jeyaaɓe e bomɓe, hannduɓe e lepte?

arabe: أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
traduction: Hara min njogitorno ɓe toon jalnori, kaa ko gite (amen) yawti ɓe?"
explication: Hara men falju e kon men jagitornoo ɓe kon jalnori, tawa ɓe handaa e lepte, kaa hara ɓe naatu Yiite, gite amen yawti ɓe?

arabe: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقّٞ تَخَاصُمُ أَهۡلِ ٱلنَّارِ
traduction: Pellet, ka goonga, ko ɗuum woni yeddondiral yimɓe Yiite ɓeen.
explication: Pellet, ko Men jantanii on kon, e ko yedduɓe ɓen wenjorndirta hakkunde maɓɓe Ñalnde Darngal, ko goonga mo sikke alaa e mu'un.

arabe: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٞۖ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
traduction: Maaku: "Anndee ko mi jeertinoowo. Deweteeɗo woo alaa, si wonaa Allah Gooto, pooluɗo On,
explication: An Muhammadu, maakan yimɓe maa yedduɓe ɓen: Anndee ko mi jertinoowo on, e lepte Allah ɗen, fii wata ɗe yanir e mon, sabu yeddugol mon fenna Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen. Anndo kadi, alaa reweteeɗo hannduɗo e dewal, si wanaa Allah Seniiɗo On. Ko Kanko woni Bajjo ka mawngu e sifaaji e ka inɗe Mun, Fooluɗo kala huunde. Mo huunde kala yankinii Ɗum.

arabe: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
traduction: Jeyɗo kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin, e kon ko woni hakkunde ɗin ɗiɗi, pooluɗo, kaforoowo On".
explication: Ko Kanko woni Jeyɗo kammuuli ɗin, e leydi ndin, e kon ko woni hakkunde majji. Fooluɗo e laamu Mun, Mo gooto foolataa. Haforoowo junuubi jeyaaɓe Makko tuubuɓe ɓen.

arabe: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ
traduction: Maaku: "(ndee Alqur'aanaare), ko nde kabaaru mawɗo,
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓee fennooɓe : ndee Alqur'aanaare, ko kumpital mawngal fiyaaku.

arabe: أَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُونَ
traduction: kono hoɗon ɗuurnii ɗum.
explication: Kono hiɗon ɗuurnii e on kabaaru mawnuɗo fiyaaku. On alaa yeƴƴitaade e makko.

arabe: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمِۭ بِٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
traduction: Ganndal alanaano kam, e fii mbatu ngun dowrowu, tuma nde ɓe weeñidaynoo.
explication: Mi heɓataano ganndal, e ko feƴƴaynoo hakkunde Malaa'ika'en, fii tagugol Aadama, si wanaano Allah wahayini ɗum e am, O anndimmi.

arabe: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ
traduction: Wahayinaaka e am, si wanaa won'de min on, ko mi jeertinoowo ɓanngina".
explication: Allah wahayiniraali e am, si wanaa tawde ko mi jertinoowo on, e lepte Makko ɗen, ɓanninano on.

arabe: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن طِينٖ
traduction: Jaŋto nde Joomi maa daalannoo Malaa'ika'en: "Min mi tagiroowo ɓanndiŋke, immorde loopal.
explication: Janto nde Joomi maa daalannoo Malaa'ika'en: Min ko Mi tagiroowo ɓanndinke, woni Aadama (yo o his) immorde e loopal.

arabe: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
traduction: si mi fotindirii mo, Mi wuttii e makko ruuhu am on, haray suuyanee mo cujjon".
explication: Si Mi fotindirii tagu makko ngun, Mi moƴƴintinii mbaadi makko ndin, mi wuttii ruuhu Am on e makko, ko yo on sujjan mo.

arabe: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
traduction: Malaa'ika'en fof cujji ɓe denndaangal.
explication: Malaa'ika'en ɗoftii yamaruyee Joomi maɓɓe on, ɓe sujji ɓe denndaangal, sujuudu teddungal. Alaa mo sujjanaano Aadama e maɓɓe.

arabe: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
traduction: si wonaa Ibuliisa, o mawnintinii, o woni jiyaaɗo e yedduɓe ɓen.
explication: Si wanaa Ibuliisa, o mawnitinii sujjugol ngol, o woni jeyaaɗo e yedduɓe Joomi mun.

arabe: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ
traduction: (Allah) daali: "eey ma yo Ibuliisa, ko haɗu maa sujjangol ko Mi tagiri juuɗe am? A mawnintini kaa a jeya e townitiiɓe ɓeen?"
explication: Allah daali: Ko an yo Ibuliisa, ko honɗum haɗu maa sujjangol Aadama, mo tagirmi juuɗe Am? Ko mawnintinaare haɗu maa kaa hari nun ko a jeyanooɗo e townitaniiɓe Joomi mun ɓen?

arabe: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارٖ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينٖ
traduction: O wi'i: "Ko min ɓuri mo moƴƴude. A tagirii lam e yiite, A tagirii mo kaŋko e loopal".
explication: Ibuliisa wi'i: Ko min ɓuri Aadama moƴƴude. Tawde A tagirii lam immorde e yiite, A tagirii mo kanko e loopal. Sikkugol mo wonnde yiite ɓuri loope teddude.

arabe: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ
traduction: O daali: "Yaltu ton, aan, ko a diiwaaɗo;
explication: Alla daalani ibuliisa: Yaltu ka Aljanna ton, sabu ko a huɗaaɗo Kiitaaɗa.

arabe: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
traduction: pellet, kuddi sm ndin fawike ma haa Ñande njoɓdi diina".
explication: Pellet, raɗeede ka Aljanna fawike ma, haa Ñalaande nɓjodi kuuɗe, nden woni Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
traduction: (Ibuliisa) wi'i : "Joomi am, neeɓnitanam, haa ñande nde ɓe immintintee".
explication: Ibuliisa wi'i: Nennitanam maayugol, haa ñalnde immintaa jeyaaɓe Maa ɓen.

arabe: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
traduction: O daali: "A jeyaama e neeɓnitanteeɓe ɓen,
explication: Allah daali: A jeyaama e nennitanaaɓe ɓen.

arabe: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
traduction: haa e ñalaande happu ganndaaɗo".
explication: A nennitanaama, haa e happu anndaaɗo, halkeede ma.

arabe: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
traduction: O wi'i: "Mi wooɗndirii mawngu maa ngun ! Ma mi bewnuɓe fof maɓɓe,
explication: Ibuliisa wi'i: Mi woondirii kattal e mawngu Maa ngun ! Ma mi majjin ɓiɗɓe Aadama ɓen fow.

arabe: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
traduction: si wonaa jiyaaɓe Maa, laɓɓinaaɓe ɓen e maɓɓe".
explication: Si wanaa ɓen ɓe daɗndu-Ɗaa bone am, heertinir-Ɗaa ɓe e rewugol Am tun.

arabe: قَالَ فَٱلۡحَقُّ وَٱلۡحَقَّ أَقُولُ
traduction: (Allah) daali: "Mi wooɗndirii goonga, ko goonga mi wowlata,
explication: Allah daali: goonga kan ko e Am, ko goonga Mi wowlata, wanaa ko lunndi ɗum.

arabe: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
traduction: ma Mi hebbinire Jahannama, e ɓen jokkuɓe ma fof e maɓɓe".
explication: Ma Mi hebbinire Jahannama Ñande Darngal, an e ɓen jokkuɓe ma, yedduɓe ɓen e banii Aadama ɓen fow.

arabe: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
traduction: Maaku: "Mi laɓndaaki on njoɓdi e fii ɗum; mi wonaali jeyaaɗo e sincooɓe(deftatoobe).
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maakan sirkooɓe ɓen: Mi lamndaaki on e ko mi yottinta e mon kon, njoɓdi. Mi wonaali kadi etotooɗo sincugol ɓeyda e ko mi yamiraa kon.

arabe: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Ndee [Alqur’aanaare] wonaani, si wonaa waaju tageefo ngon.
explication: Alqur'aana wonaali, si wanaa waaju, wonannde hellifaaɓe yimɓe e jinna ɓen.

arabe: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ
traduction: Ma on nganndu (fii) kabaaru mayre, ko neeɓaa !".
explication: Ma on anndu kabaaru ndee Alqur'aanaare, wonnde ko nde goonga, ɓaawo dummunna ɓadiiɗo, tuma nde maayoton.

arabe: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
traduction: Jippagol deftere nden, ko immorde ka Allah, pooluɗo, ñeeño oon.
explication: Jippagol Alqur'aana, ko immorde ka Allah, Fooluɗo Mo gooto foolataa, Ñeeñuɗo e tagu Mun, e toppitagol Mun e sari'a Mun. Wanaa e goɗɗo goo, ko woori Mo, nde jippori.

arabe: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَٱعۡبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
traduction: Min njippiniirii deftere nden e maaɗa, e hoore goonga. rewu allah, laɓɓinanaa mo diina ka.
explication: Men jippinirii Deftere Alqur'aana nden e maaɗa, an Nulaaɗo, e hoore goonga. Kumpite mayre fow ko goonga, ñaawooje mayre fow kadi ko nunɗuɗe. Haray rewu Allah, wootinɗinaa mo, laɓɓinanaa Mo tawhiidi e hoore sirku.

arabe: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡخَالِصُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِي مَا هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبٞ كَفَّارٞ
traduction: Ngaanndee, ko Allah woodani diina laaɓuka kan. Ɓeen non ɓe ɓeya nogitori yiɗɓe ga makko (hara hiɓe wi'a): "Min ngaalaa rewirde ɗi, si wonaa tun no ɗi ɓannira min ka Allah, ɓadal". Pellet, Allah Ñaawoyat hakkunde maɓɓe, e kon ko ɓe woni lurrude e mun. Pellet, Allah feewnata on gonɗo fewnoowo, ɗuuɗuɗo jeddugol.
explication: Anndee, ko Allah woodani, diina laaɓuka e sirku kan. Ɓen non ɓe ɓeya jogitori yiɗɓe gaanin Allah, immorde e sanamuuji e bewinayɗi, ɗi ɓe rewata ɓe acca Allah, ɓe wona e ngantinorgol ɗum, wiide: Men rewiraali ɗii, si wanaa tun no ɓadinira men ka Allah, martaba, ɗi hewtina Mo haajuuji amen, ɗi tefana men ka Makko. Pellet, Allah ñaawoyay hakkunde gomɗimɓe wootimɓe Mo ɓen, e yedduɓe sirkuɓe ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal, e kon ko ɓe luutondiraynoo e mun, ka tawhiidi. Pellet, Allah fewnataa e goonga, on fenoowo dammba e Alla sirku, dullanoowo neemaaji Allah ɗin e makko.

arabe: لَّوۡ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدٗا لَّٱصۡطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
traduction: Sinno Allah yiɗno, nde o siforta ɓiɗɗo, O suɓayno ko o yiɗi woo, e ko o tagi kon. Senaare woodanii mo ! Ko Kaŋko woni Allah, Bajjo, pooluɗo on.
explication: Sinno Allah yiɗuo siforgol ɓiɗɗo, O suɓotono ko O yiɗi, e tagu Makko ngun, O waɗa on ɗon ɓiɗɗo Makko. Kono O senike O laaɓii e kon ko sirkooɓe ɓen wowolata ! Ko Kanko woni Allah Gooto On ka jaati, e ka sijaafi e ka golle Makko. Kafidiiɗo alanaa Mo e ɗin. Ko O Fooluɗo tagu Makko ngun fow.

arabe: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
traduction: O tagirii kammuuji ɗiin e leydi ndin, goonga.Homo suddira jemma on ñalaema oon, O suddira ñalawma on jemma on. O eelti na'ange ngen e lewru ndun, kala majji no doga haa e lajal taƴaangal. Nganndee, ko Kaŋko woni pooluɗo, kaforoowo On.
explication: O tagirii kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, ñenƴal yottiingal, ko fijindaaru alaa e mu'un, wano tooñuɓe ɓen aaƴorta. Himo suddira jemma on, ñalawma on, O suddira kadi ñalorma on, jemma on. O elti naange ngen e lewru ndun, tawi kala majji, hino doga haa e happu eɓɓaaɗo, on woni lannugol ɗam nguurndam. Haray anndee, ko Kanko woni Fooluɗo, yoftotoowo ayɓe Mun, Mo gooto foolataa, Haforoowo junuubi kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجٖۚ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقٗا مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ ثَلَٰثٖۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ
traduction: O tagii on e fittaandu wooturu, refi Owaɗi e ndun, genndo mayru. O jippinani on e neemoraaɗi ɗin, nooneeji jeetati. Homo taga on ka teege yumma mon en, tagu ɓaawo tagu, e ndeer niɓe tati. Ko On mooɗon Allah, woni Joomi mon ! Ko Kaŋko laamu woodani. Deweteeɗo alaa, si wonaa Allah. Ko honno perlitoraɗon [e dewugol Mo]?
explication: Joomi mon, onon ɓee yimɓe, tagii on e fittaandu wooturu, ndun woni Aadama. Refti O tagi e makko, genndo makko on Hawaa. O tagani on gelooɗi e na'i e dammi e be'i, nooneeji jeetati, noone kala, gorel e deyel. Himo tagira on ka teege yumma mon en, sagara naɓi sagara, e nder niɓe reedu e rennga e jowtol. Ko On mooɗon tagoowo ɗum fow, woni Allah, Joomi mon. Ko Kanko laamu woodani. Reweteeɗo e goonga alaa, si wanaa Kanko. Ko honno ferlitoraɗon e rewugol ko tagataa, acca ɗon tagoowo On?

arabe: إِن تَكۡفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمۡۖ وَلَا يَرۡضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَۖ وَإِن تَشۡكُرُواْ يَرۡضَهُ لَكُمۡۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
traduction: Si on njeddii, anndon Allah, ko jondiniiɗo e mon. O jaɓantaa jiyaaɓe makko ɓeen, ke'eferaaku. Si on njettii Mo noon, O weltanoo on ɗuum.Hay gooto roondantaako goɗɗo woo donngal mum. Refti ko ka Joomi mon, woni ruttorde mon; O yeetitoo on, fii kon ko gollatnoɗon. Pellet, ko O gannduɗo, ko woni e ɓerɗe.
explication: Si onon ɓee yimɓe, on yeddii Joomi mon, anndon tun, Allah ko yondiniiɗo e gomɗinal mon, keeferaaku mon, lorrataa Mo. Ko onon ɗum lorrata, tawde Allah kan, O siforaali yamiroowo pankere e ko añinii. Si on yettii Mo non e neemaaji Makko ɗin, on gomɗinii Mo, O weltanto on, O warjoo on e ɗum. Anndon wonii bakkondinki woo, ronndantaako wokki goo. Kala e ko faggitanii hoore mun. Refti ko ka Joomi mon tun, woni ruttorde mon, Ñalnde Darngal; O yeetitoo on, fii ko gollaynoɗon aduna, O yoɓita on, njoɓdi golle mon ɗen. Kanko seniiɗo On, pellet, ko O annduɗo ko woni e ɓerɗe jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Huunde e ko woni e majje, suuɗaaki Mo.

arabe: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مِن قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
traduction: Si loraa memii neɗɗo on, o noddira Joomi makko, ruttagol e makko. Refti si O okkii mo moƴƴere, immorde ka makko, o yejjita ko o noddatno kon ado ɗuum, o waɗana Allah kafidiiɗi, fii no o majjinira (yimɓe ɓeen) e laawol makko ngol. MaAku: "Dakmitor keeferaaku maa ngun, seeɗa. Pellet, ko a jiyaaɗo e yimɓe Yiite ɓeen".
explication: Si lorra heɓii yedduɗo, wono ñawu maa sattireede arsike maa hulugol yoolaade, o toroo nde Joomi makko hunciranta mo ɗum, ruttagol e Makko, Kanko tun. Refti non, si Allah neeminirii mo huncangol mo on lorra, o yejjita fii Allah, Mo O torotonoo On, ado ɗum. O waɗana Mo kafidiiɗi, reweteeɗi, ko wanaa Allah, no o majjinira woɗɓe goo, e laawol Allah ngol. Nulaaɗo, maakan sugu on ɗon : dakmitor yeddugol maa ngol, yeru ko o heddoriɗaa e duuɓi kon. Anndaa pellet, ko a jeyaaɗo e yimɓe duumoytooɓe ka Yiite ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدٗا وَقَآئِمٗا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
traduction: Kaa ko on yankinotooɗo tummbo jemma, ko o cujjoowo, darotooɗo (naafe), hara homo La'akara, homo joortii yurmeende Joomi makko nden... Maaku: "Hara annduɓe ɓen fotay e ɓe nganndaa ɓen?" Anndu ko waajitotoo, ko joomiraaɓe haqqille ɓeen.
explication: Kaa ko on ɗoftiiɗo Allah, feƴƴiniroowo jemma on, sujjangol Mo, darorana Mo naafe, hara himo huli lepte laakara ɗen, himo jortrii yurmeende Joomi makko nden, kaa ko yedduɗo rewoowo Allah on ka saɗteende tun, o yedda Mo ka hoyeende, o waɗana Mo kafidiiɗi? An Nulaaɗo, maaku : Hara ɓen annduɓe ko Allah farli kon e maɓɓe, hino fota e ɓen ɓe anndaa huunde e ɗum? Anndu ko taskotoo kon ko senndi ɗin feddeeji ɗiɗi, ko joomiraaɓe haqqille hisuɗe ɗen.

arabe: قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۗ وَأَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجۡرَهُم بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
traduction: Maaku: "eey mon yo jiyaaɓe Am gooŋɗinɓe, kulee Joomi mon". Hino woodani moƴƴimɓe (golle) ɓen e oo aduna, mbarjaari. Leydi Allah ndin ko yaajundi. Nganndee muññiiɓe ɓeen timminirante njoɓdi maɓɓe ndin, ko aldaa e limoore.
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maakan jeyaaɓe Am gomɗimɓe Lam Min e Nulaaɓe Am ɓen: huliree Joomi mon, ɗoftagol yamaruyeeji Makko, e woɗɗitagol haɗaaɗi Makko. Hino woodani moƴƴimɓe golle ɓen e mon aduna, moƴƴoreede e mun aduna, walleede e cellal e jawdi, ka laakara, hara ko Aljanna. Leydi Allah ndin ko yaajundi, feree e mayri, haa e nokku ka waawoton rewude Mo woo, ka goɗɗo haɗataa on ɗum. Anndon muññiiɓe ɓen, ɓe timminirante njoɓdi maɓɓe ndin Ñalnde Darngal, ko aldaa e limaneede maa etaneede, ɗuuɗi fanɗi.

arabe: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
traduction: Maaku: "Miin mi yamiraama dewugol Allah, laɓɓinana mo diina kan,
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maaku: min mi yamiraama rewugol Allah tun, mi laɓɓinana Mo dewal ngal.

arabe: وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
traduction: Mi yamiraa kadi, gongol arano e jebbiliiɓe ɓeen".
explication: O yamirimmi kadi, wonugol arano e jebbilaniiɓe Mo ɓen, yankinaniiɓe Mo e ɗee mofte.

arabe: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
traduction: Maaku : "Miin miɗo huli, si mi yeddii Joomi am, lepte Ñalaande Mawnde".
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maaku: min miɗo huli, si mi yeddii Allah, mi ɗoftaaki Mo, nde lepte Ñalaande Mawnde nden heɓatammi, nden woni Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُۥ دِينِي
traduction: Maaku: "Ko Allah mi rewata, mi laɓɓinan mo diina am.
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maaku : min ko Allah tun mi rewata, mi laɓɓinana Mo dewal. Wanaa goɗɗo goo, mi waɗanta ɗum.

arabe: فَٱعۡبُدُواْ مَا شِئۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
traduction: ndewee ko njiɗuɗon onon, hara wonaa Kaŋko. Maaku: "Ko woni hayruɓe ɓen, ko ɓeen ɓe tawata Ñande Darngal, ɓe hayrinii ko'e maɓɓe, e ɓeynguureeji maɓɓe". Nganndee ko nden woni hayrere ɓanngunde ndeen.
explication: Onon sirkooɓe ɓen non, rewee ko yiɗuɗon e sanamu, hara wanaa Kanko. Ɗum ko kammbaa ! An Nulaaɗo, maaku: ko woni hayruɓe ɓen tigiri, ko ɓen tawata ɓe hayrinii ko'e maɓɓe e ɓeynguureeji maɓɓe, ɓe ronkoya yiidoyde e maɓɓe, si ɓen naatoyii Aljanna, maa ɓe naatidoya e maɓɓe ka Yiite, tawa ɓe yiitidataa poomaa. Anndee ko ɗum tigiri, woni hayrere ɓanngunde nden, ko sikke alaa e mu'un.

arabe: لَهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
traduction: Hino woodirani ɓe seŋgo dow maɓɓe, kippoodi Yiite, e kippoodi senngo ley maɓɓe. Ko ɗum woni ko Allah hulɓinirta jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Ko onon yo jiyaaɓe Am, kori kulee Kam!
explication: Curki e kippoodi wulndi, hino woodirani ɓe senngo dow maɓɓe, e senngo ley maɓɓe. Ko ɗee lepte jantaaɗe fii mun, woni ko Allah hulɓirnirta jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Ko onon yo jeyaɓɓe Am, kori huliree Lam, ɗoftagol yamiraaɗi Am, woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Am.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ
traduction: Ɓeen woɗɗitorɓe rewugol bewnooji ɗi, ɓe nduttii e Allah, welo-welo no woodani ɓe. Wewlinir jiyaaɓe am ɓeen,
explication: Ɓen woɗɗitiiɓe e rewugol sanamuuji ɗin, e kala ko wonaa Allah, ɓe tuubi ɓe ruttii ka Allah, welo-welo Aljanna no woodani ɓe, tuma ɓe maayata, e ka genaale, e Ñalnde Darngal. An Nulaaɗo, wewlinir jeyaaɓe Am ɓen.

arabe: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
traduction: nanooɓe Konngol ɓeen, ɓe njokka ko ɓuri moƴƴude e maggol. Ko ɓeen woni ɓe Allah feewni ɓen, ko ɓen ngoni joomiraaɓe haqqille ɓeen.
explication: Ɓen nanooɓe Konngol ɓen, ɓe senndindira ko moƴƴi e ko boni e maggol, ɓe jokka ko ɓuri moƴƴude e maggol. Ko ɓen siforiiɓe ɗin sifaaji, woni ɓe Allah fewniri peewal ɓen, ko ɓen woni joomiraaɓe haqqille hisuɗe ɓen.

arabe: أَفَمَنۡ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ
traduction: E ko on mo konngol lepte jojji e mum... E ko aan daɗndata gonɗo ka Yiite?
explication: Kala mo konngol lepte jojjiri e mun, sabu duumagol mo e yeddugol e majjere, a alanaa on feere, an Nulaaɗo, fii no feewira. E ko an Nulaaɗo, waawata daɗndude wa'uɗo non e Yiite ngen?

arabe: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ غُرَفٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهَا غُرَفٞ مَّبۡنِيَّةٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
traduction: Si ko ɓen hulɓe Joomi mun, hino woodani ɓe kuɓeeje [ka Aljanna] e kuɓeeje mahaaɗe dow majje, hara canɗi no ila ley majje. Ko fodoore Allah ! Allah non firtataa fodoore.
explication: Si ko ɓen hulirɓe Joomi mun, ɗoftagol yamiraaɗi Makko, woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko, hino woodani ɓe kuɓeeje toowuɗe fawondiri ka Aljanna, hara canɗi no ila senngo ley majje. Ko Allah fodi ɓe ɗum! Allah non firtataa fodoore Makko.

arabe: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعٗا مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
traduction: E a yiaani, won'de Allah saaƴinirii ndiyam ka kammu, o naadi ɗam e ndeer ɓulli ka leydi; refti o yaltinira ɗam remuru seedundu noone, refti ndu ɗayɗa, yi'aa hindu soyɗi; refti O waɗa ɗum ko muncaa. Pellet, wonii e ɗuum, waaju, wonan'de joomiraaɓe haqqille ɓeen.
explication: Hiɗon anndiri seedagol mon, wonnde Allah saaƴinirii ndiyam ka kammu, O naadi ɗam e ɓulli e canɗ; refi O yaltinira ɗam ndiyam, remuru seedudnu noone, refti O yoorna ndu, yi'aandu an seeditiiɗo on, hindu soyɗi, ɓaawo ndu wonunoo haako; refti O waɗa ɗum ko muncitaa. Pellet, wonii e ko jantaa koo, waaju, wonannde joomiraaɓe haqqille ɓen hisuɗe ɗen.

arabe: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
traduction: E ko on mo Allah yaññani ɓendre mum nden, fii lislaamu, hara homo e ndaygu immorde ka Joomi makko... Bone woodanii ɓen yooruɓe ɓerɗe mum, e jantagol Allah. Ɓeen ngonii e majjere ɓanngunde.
explication: E ko on mo Allah yaññani ɓernde mun fii lislaamu, o feewi e mun, hara himo e ɓanngannduyee immorde ka Joomi makko, wa'ata wa yoora ɓenrdeejo e jantagol Allah? Ɓe fotataa fes. Tawde ko feewuɓe ɓen, daɗata, yoora ɓerɗe'en e jantagol Allah .Ɓen wonii e majjere ɓanngunde.

arabe: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبٗا مُّتَشَٰبِهٗا مَّثَانِيَ تَقۡشَعِرُّ مِنۡهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمۡ وَقُلُوبُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٍ
traduction: Allah jippinii ko ɓuri moƴƴude e yeewtere, deftere nanndunde [ñaawooje], ɗimmitunde. Nde guri ɓen hulooɓe Joomi muyn riɓirta (nanugol nde), refti guri e ɓerɗe maɓɓe deeƴira jaŋtoore Allah nden. Ko ɗuum woni peewal Allah ngal O feewnira on mo muuyani. Kala non mo Allah majjini, haray peewnoowo mo alaa.
explication: Allah jppinii e Nulaaɗo Makko on Muhammadu (yo o his) Alqur'aana, ɓurnde moƴƴude yewtere. O waɗi nden nanndude ka goonga, e ka moƴƴugol, e ka yuɓɓondirgol e waasde luutondirde. Fillayeeji e ñaawooje hino ɗuuɗi e mayre, kañum e fodooje e kammbaa, e sifaaji yimɓe goonga, e yimɓe meere ɓen ekn. Guri ɓen hulooɓe Joomi mun, hino riɓira sabu nanugol kammbaaji ko woni e mayre, refti guri e ɓerɗe maɓɓe deeƴira jantagol Innde Allah, tuma ɓe nani jortagol e welo-welo ko woni e mayre. Koo ko jantaa e ko Alqur'aana battinta, ko peewal Allah, ngal O fewnirta mo O muuyani, O hoyna mo Mo O muuyani. Kala non mo Allah fewnaali, haray fewnoowo mo alaa.

arabe: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجۡهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُونَ
traduction: E ko on reentariiɗo yeeso mun ngon, e lepte bonɗe ɗen Ñande Darngal... Tooñuɓe ɓen mbi'anee on tuma: "Meeɗee kon ko ngonnoɗon faggitanaade".
explication: Kere on mo Allah fewni aduna, O naadoya mo Aljanna laakara, on fotay wa yedduɗo maayi e keeferaaku on, naatoyoowo Yiite, tonnge juuɗe e koyɗe, mo tawata waawoytaa daɗirde Yiite ngen, si wanaa tun o fewtinira nge yeeso makko ngon? Tooñuɓe ɓen feliree wi'aneede ontuma: meeɗen non hannde, kon ko wonunoɗon faggitorde geddi e keeferaaku. Ko njoɓdi mon ndin nii.

arabe: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
traduction: Adinooɓe ɓen njeddiino, lepte ɗeen ardirani ɓe, ka ɓe tinaani.
explication: Mofte adinooɓe ɓee sirkooɓe, kadi fennuno Nulaaɓe mun, lepte ɗen ardirani ɓe juhal, fewndo ka ɓe so'aa-anndude, sakko ɓe hebiloranaɗe tuubugol.

arabe: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Allah meeɗiniri ɓe koyeera, ka nguurndam aduna. Pellet non, ko lepte La'akara ɗen noon, ɓuri mawnude, si tawno heɓe nganndunoo!
explication: Allah meeɗiriɓe sabu ɗum, lepte koyeera, e jaasere, e wirtere ka ngurrndam aduna. Pellet, ko lepte laakara ɗen habbitiiɗe ɓe, ɓuri mawnude e tiiɗe, si tawno hiɓe anndunoo.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
traduction: Gooɗii Min piyanii yimɓe ɓeen, e ndee Alqur'aanaare, kala misal, mbelejo'o, ɓe mbaajitora.
explication: Gomɗii Men piyanii yimɓe ɓen, e ndee Alqur'aanaare jippinaande e Muhammadu (yo o his) noone kala e mise moƴƴere e bone, goonga e meere, gomɗinal e keeferaaku, ekn. Ɗum fow, ko jortagol nde ɓe waajitora, ɓe huutora goonga kan, ɓe sela meere nden.

arabe: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
traduction: Alqur'aanaare (janngeteende) e haala aarabi, nde aldaa e ooñaare, fii no ɓe ngooŋɗira.
explication: Men waɗi nde Alqur'aanaare, janngeteende e haala Aarabu, nde aldaa e ooñaare maa jiɓi-liɓi, jortagol no ɓe hulira Allah, jokkugol yamiraaɗi Makko, woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko.

arabe: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلٗا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلٗا سَلَمٗا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Allah waɗii yeru, gorko mo lurruɓe hawti ɗum, heɓe pooɗondira mo, e gorko laaɓanɗo gorko [goo]: Hara ɓen ɗiɗo fotay e misal? Yettoore woodanii Allah! Kono ɓurɓe ɗuuɗude e maɓɓe, ɓe nganndaa.
explication: Allah waɗii misal hakkunde sirkoowo e wootinɗinoowo, woni gorko mo lurruɓe hawti : si o weltinii woɗɓe ɓen, ɓeya ɓen monoo, o wona e jiɓi-liɓi. Oya gorko, ko laaɓanɗo gorko goo, kanko tun, himo anndi ko deeƴinta oya, e ko wallinta mo ɓernde. Ɓen worɓe ɗiɗo, ɓe fotataa e misal. Yettoore woodanii Allah. Kono ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e maɓɓe, ɓe anndaa. Ko waɗi si ɓe kafida e Allah, goɗɗum goo.

arabe: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٞ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
traduction: Pellet, aan ko a maayoowo, kamɓe kadi ko ɓe maayooɓe;
explication: Pelelt, an Nulaaɗo, ko a maayoowo, kamɓe kadi ko ɓe maayooɓe, feere mun alaa.

arabe: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡ تَخۡتَصِمُونَ
traduction: refti onon, Ñande Darngal, ko to Joomi mon, njeddondiroyton.
explication: Refti onon ɓee yimɓe, Ñalnde Darngal, ko ka Joomi mon yeddondiroyton, e ko pooɗondiraynoɗon fii mun, goonguɗo on seerta e meerenteejo on.

arabe: ۞ فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ إِذۡ جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
traduction: E ko hommbo ɓuri tooñde wa on jedduɗo ɗo e hoore Allah, maa o yeddi goonga kan nde ko arunoo e makko? E wonaa Jahannama woni jaaƴorde yedduɓe ɓeen?
explication: Alaa ɓurɗo tooñude haa hewta on dammbuɗo e Allah, ko yahdaani e Makko, wano waɗangol Mo kafidiiɗo, maa genndo maa ɓiɗɗo. Alaa kadi ɓurɗo tooñde wa on fennuɗo wahyu on mo Nulaaɗo Allah on (yo o his) addi. E wonaa ka Yiite woni jaaƴorde yeddude Allah ɓen, ɓe yeddi ko Nulaaɗo Makko on addi kon? Pellet, ko non woniri, weerde maɓɓe, ko nder ton.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ
traduction: Oon noon garduɗo e goonga, o goongini ɗuum, ko ɓen ngoni gooŋɗuɓe ɓeen.
explication: On non arduɗo e goonga, ka haala e ka kuuɗe maɓɓe, foti ko Annabaajo maa goɗɗo goo, o gomɗini ɗum, o gollitiri. Ko ɓen woni gomɗuɓe ɓen tigiri, ɗoftiiɓe yamaruyeeji Joomi mun, woɗɗitiiɓe haɗaaɗi Makko.

arabe: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
traduction: Hino woodani kala ko ɓe paaletee, ka Joomi maɓɓe; ko ɗuum njoɓdi moƴƴinooɓe ɓeen.
explication: Hino woodani dakammeeji duumotooɗi, ka Joomi maɓɓe; ko ɗum woni njoɓdi moƴƴinooɓe golle ɓen, ka Joomi maɓɓe e jiyaaɓe.

arabe: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: fii no Allah yaawtirana ɓe, ko ɓuri bon'de e ko ɓe golli kon, O yoɓitira ɓe njoɓdi maɓɓe ndiin, ko ɓuri moƴƴude e ko ɓe ngollaynoo kon.
explication: Fii no Allah momtirana ɓe, ko ɓuri bonnde e ko ɓe gollaynoo e geddi aduna, tawde ɓe tuubii e mun, ɓe ruttike e Joomi maɓɓe. O yoɓitira ɓe njoɓdi maɓɓe ndin, ko ɓuri moƴƴude e kon ko ɓe gollunoo.

arabe: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهُۥۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ
traduction: Allah siforaali yonugol jiyaaɗo makko on? Heɓe kulɓinire ɗin ɗi wonaa mo. Kala mo Allah majjini, haray Feewnoowo alanaa mo.
explication: Mbela Allah siforaali yonugol jeyaaɗo Makko on Muhammadu (yo o his) ka fiyakuuji makko diina e aduna, O duñana mo ayɓe makko? Pellet, O yonay mo. Hiɓe hulɓinire, an Nulaaɗo, sabu majjere e ɗaayre maɓɓe, ɗin sanamuuji, ɗi ɓe rewata ɓe acca Allah, wiide ɗi memirte bone. Kala non mo Allah hoyni, O hawrinaani mo fewnude, haray fewnoowo on ɗon, alaa.

arabe: وَمَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٖ ذِي ٱنتِقَامٖ
traduction: Kala non mo Allah feewni, majjinoowo mo alaa. Allah siforaali won'de pooluɗo, Jom lepte?
explication: Kala non mo Allah hawrindini e peewal, alaa haɗtanɗo majjinde mo. Mbela Allah siforaaki wonnde Fooluɗo Mo gooto foolataa, Jom leptugol ɓen heefereɓe yedduɓe Mo? Ko non woniri, Ko O Fooluɗo, Jom lepte.

arabe: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوۡ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكَٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ قُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُۖ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
traduction:
Pellet, si a laɓndike ɓe: "Ko hommbo tagi kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin?", ma ɓe mbi'u: "Ko Allah". Maaku: "Yeewtee kam fii ɗin ɗi ndewoton ga Allah, si Allah faandanike lam lorra, hara ɗi huncanay kam lorra makko kan? Maa si 
o faandanike lam yurmeende, taw si ɗi haɗay kam yurmeende makko nden? Maaku: "Allah yonii kam, ko e makko hoolnotooɓe ɓen tuuginotoo".
explication: Pellet, si an Nulaaɗo, a lamndike ɓee sirkooɓe: Ko hommbo tagi kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin? Ma ɓe wi'u: Ko Allah tagi ɗi. Awa maakan ɓe, feññinanaaɓe, ronkere reweteeɗi maɓɓe ɗin: Yeetee lam fii ɗii sanamuuji, ɗi rewoton gaanin Allah; si Allah faandanike lorra, hara ɗi waaway ittannde lam on lorra? Maa si O faandanike lam moƴƴere Makko, taw si ɗi haɗtani haɗugol lam nden moƴƴere Makko? Maakan ɓee: Allah tun yonii lam, ko e Makko mi fawi kala fiyaaku am, ko e Makko kadi tun, woni ko wakkiltoo ɓen tuuginotoo.

arabe: قُلۡ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنِّي عَٰمِلٞۖ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Maaku: "eey mon yimɓe am, ngollee e laawol mon, min ko e [laawol am] mi ngollirta. Aray ka nganndon.
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maaku: Ko onon yo yimɓe am, golliree no waalorani on, sirkangol Allah. Min ko no Joomi am yamirimmi non, mi gollirta, woni noddugol e tawhiidi, laɓɓinana Mo dewal. Aray ka anndon, battane laawol kala e me'en.

arabe: مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٌ
traduction: ko hommbo lepte koynayɗe ngaroyat e muuɗum, lepte duumiiɗe njippoo e makko.
explication: Aray nde anndon, ko hommbo lepte aduna hoynayɗe aroyta e muuɗum, lepte duumiiɗe jippoyoo e makko Ñalnde Darngal, hara ɗe taƴondirtaa, sakko ɗe lanna.

arabe: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
traduction: Min njippinirii deftere nden e maaɗa, fii yimɓe ɓeen, e hoore goonga. Kala peewuɗo, ko hoore makko [o feewani]; kala kadi majjuɗo, ko hoore makko o majjani. A wonaani wakiil e dow maɓɓe.
explication: Men jippinirii Deftere Alqur'aana nden, e maaɗa an Nulaaɗo, fii yimɓe ɓen, e hoore goonga, no jertiniraaɓe. Kala feewuɗo, ko hoore makko o feewani, Allah nafitortaa peewal makko, tawde ko O yondiniiɗo e ɗum; kala kadi majjuɗo, haray lorra mun on, ko e makko yiltotoo, ɗum lorrataa Allah. A wonaali wakkilaaɗo ɓee, fii daranagol ɓe haa ɓe feewa. Ko yottingol tun, fawi maa e maɓɓe.

arabe: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلۡأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوۡتِهَا وَٱلَّتِي لَمۡ تَمُتۡ فِي مَنَامِهَاۖ فَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَيُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
traduction: Allah homo ƴettita pittaali ɗin, saanga maayde majji, e ɗin ɗi maayaani, ka ɗoyngol majji. O jogitoo ɗiin ɗi ñaawani maayde, O accita ɗiya, haa e lajal taƴaangal. Pellet, Ma'andeeji ngoni e ɗuum, wona nde yimɓe miijitotooɓe.
explication: Allah hino ƴettita pittaali ɗin, tuma lajal majji timmata, e ɗin ɗi lajal mun timmaali, fewndo ɗoyngol majji. O jogitii ɗin ɗi O ñaawani maayde, O accita ɗiya, ɗi O ñaawani heddagol, haa e dumunna happaaɗo ka Makko. Pellet, wonii e ko sifaa koo, maandeeji, wonannde ɓe miijitotooɓe, tinndinayɗi, wonnde waɗoowo ɗum On, hino hattani wuurnitugol yimɓe ɓen, ɓaawo maayde maɓɓe, fii hasbugol ɓe, yoɓa ɓe.

arabe: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَۚ قُلۡ أَوَلَوۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
traduction: Kaa ɓe njogiti tefooji, ga Allah? Maaku: "Hay si tawii ɗi jiyaa hu'unde, ɗi haqqiltaa kadi?"
explication: Kaa ɓee sirkooɓe jogitor sanamuuji maɓɓe ɗin, tefooji, ɗi ɓe jortorii nafa, hara wanaa Allah? An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓe: On jogitoto tefoojo, hay si tawii ɗi jeyanaa on, onon e majji, hay huunde, kadi ɗi haqqiltaa, ko wowlataa, ɗi nanataa, ɗi yi'ataa, ɗi nafataa, ɗi lorrataa?

arabe: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ جَمِيعٗاۖ لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
traduction: Maaku: "Tefoore nden fow, ko Allah heeranii. Ko Kaŋko woodani laamagol kammuuji ɗiin e leydi ndin. refti ko ka makko ndutteteɗon".
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓee sirkooɓe: Tefoore nden fow, ko Allah heeranii. Gooto tefataa ka Makko, si wanaa e duŋayee(sakkitoore) Makko. O jaɓantaa kadi tefoore, si wanaa mo O welanaa. Ko Kanko tun, laamagol kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, woodani. Refti ko ka Makko tun, woni ruttorde mon, Ñalnde Darngal, fii hasbeede, yoɓee. O yoɓa kala mon, e golle mun.

arabe: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُ ٱشۡمَأَزَّتۡ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ
traduction: Si fii Allah tun jaŋtaama, ɓerɓe ɓen ɓe ngooŋɗinaa La'akara ɓen, tamoo. Si fii ɗiya, ɗi wonaa Mo [Kaŋko Allah] jaŋtaama, e jaka yoo, heɓe wewla.
explication: Si fii Allah tun jantaama, ɓerɗe sirkooɓe, ɓe gomɗinaa laakara e ummital e hasboore e njoɓdi ɓen, wona e tamagol. Si fii sanamuuji ɗi ɓe rewata ɗin, gaanin Allah jantaamaa, e jaka yoo, hiɓe wewla weltoo.

arabe: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ عَٰلِمَ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
traduction: Maaku: "Yaa Allah, puɗɗuɗo kammuuji ɗiin e leydi ndin, gannduɗo birniiɗi e peeñɗi, ko Aan ñaawata hakkunde jiyaaɓe Maa ɓeen,  ko ɓe luutondiraynoo e mum".
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maaku: Yaa Allah, tagirɗo kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, no ɗi anndiranooka, Annduɗo ko wirnii e ko feeñi, Mo huunde e ɗin suuɗaaki. Ko An tun, ñaawata hakkunde jeyaaɓe Maa ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal, e kon ko ɓe luutondiraynoo e mun ender aduna. Ɓannginaa goonguɗo e meerente, malaaɗo e malkisaaɗo.

arabe: وَلَوۡ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا وَمِثۡلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفۡتَدَوۡاْ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمۡ يَكُونُواْ يَحۡتَسِبُونَ
traduction: Si tawno no woodanno tooñɓe ɓeen, ko woni kon ka leydi fow, e yeru mum, wond'ude e mum, ɓe sottorayno ɗum, bone lepte ɗen, Ñande Darngal; feeñirana ɓe ka Allah, kon ko ɓe tijjanooki.
explication: Si tawno no woodannoo tooñirɓe sirko e geddi ɓen, kala ko woni kon ka leydi, immorde e jawle, ɓe sottorayno ɗum, lepte saɗtuɗe ɗen ɗe yi'oyta, ɓaawo ummital maɓɓe. Kono ɓe alaa feere ɗum. Hay si ɓe heɓu feere mun, ɓe jaɓanoytaake. Ontuma, feeñirana ɓe ka Allah, noone e lepte, ɗo ɓe tijjanooki.

arabe: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
traduction: boneeji ɗi ɓe paggitinoo ɗin peñana ɓe, ko ɓe njalkitaynoo kon huuɓita ɓe.
explication: Boneeji sirku e geddi, ɗi ɓe faggitinoo ɗin feñana ɓe, lepte ɗe ɓe jalkitaynoo ɗen huuɓita ɓe, ɗen lepte ɗe ɓe hulɓinirtenoo, ɓe wona e jalkitugol.

arabe: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلۡنَٰهُ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمِۭۚ بَلۡ هِيَ فِتۡنَةٞ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Si lorra heɓii neɗɗo on, o nodda Min. Refti si Min ngokkii mo neema, immorde ka amen, o wi'a: "nganndee ko e ganndal [am] mi okkiira ɗum". Ɗuum ko jarrabuyee kan; kono ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e maɓɓe, ɓe anndaa.
explication: Si ñawu maa baasal ekn heɓii neɗɗo keefeero, o nadda Men, fii huncangol mo ɗum. Refti si Men okkii mo neema callal maa jawdi, o wona e wi'ugol: Anndee ko Allah okkiri lam ɗum, ko anndugol Mo, miɗo hanndi e mun. Kono ka goonga, ɗum ko jarrabuyee e ndaarndo; kono ɓurɓe ɗuuɗude e heeferɓe ɓen, ɓe anndaa ɗum, ɓe mantora neema Allah on e maɓɓe.

arabe: قَدۡ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii ɓeen adinooɓe ɓe mbi'iino ɗum. Kono kon ko ɓe paggitotonoo, nafaani ɓe.
explication: Gomɗii heeferɓe adinooɓe ɓen, wowliino ngol konngol. Kono kon ko ɓe faggitotonoo e jawle e kuɓeeje, duncanaano ɓe hay huunde.

arabe: فَأَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَمَا هُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ
traduction: boneeji ɗi ɓe paggitotonoo ɗiin memi ɓe. Tooñɓe ɓeen e maɓɓe, kon ko ɓe wonnoo e paggitagol, memoyat ɓe, ɓe wonaani laawotooɓe.
explication: Njoɓdi boneeji sirku e geddi, ɗi ɓe wonunoo e faggitagil ɗin, memi ɓe. Tooñirɓe ko'e mun ɓen sirku e geddi, jeyaaɓe e ɓee ɗoo ɓen, njoɓdi boneeji ɗi ɓe faggitotonoo ɗin, memiroyaɓe, wano yawtuɓe ɓen. Ɓe wonaa fuutotooɓe Allah, wanaa fii foolugol Mo!

arabe: أَوَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
traduction: E ɓe nganndaa won'de Allah no yaññana arsike on mo o muuyani, O ɓillina [mo o muuyani]? Pellet, Ma'andeeji ngonii e ɗum, wona nde yimɓe gooŋɗinooɓe.
explication: Sirkooɓe ɓen wi'ay ko ɓe wi'i, hara ɓe anndaa wonnde Allah no yaññana arsike on, mo O muuyani, fii jarribagol ontigi, ndaara si o yettay kaa o yedday? Ko wano non kadi O ɓiɗtiniranta mo O muuyani, jarribagol fahin, ontigi, ndaara si o muññoto kaa o monanto eɓɓoore Allah nden? Pellet, wonii e ko jantaa koo, fii yaññaneede maa ɓiɗtinanee arsike, maandeeji, wallitirɗo taskagol fii Allah, wonannde yimɓe gomɗinooɓe. Tawde ko ɓen nafitorta ɗin maandeeji, wanaa yedduɓe yawtooɓe ɗen Aayeeje, hara hiɓe ɗuurnoo ɗe.

arabe: ۞ قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسۡرَفُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: Maaku: eey mon yo jiyaaɓe Am fantimɓe e hoore mum, wota on taƴo yurmeende Allah nden. Pellet, Allah ko kaforoowo junubaajo ɗin fof. Ko Kaŋko woni kaforoowo, jurmotooɗo On".
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maakan jeyaaɓe am yawtirɓe keeri ɓen sirku e geddi: wata on taƴo e yurmeende Allah nden, e ko O haforanta on junubaaji mon. Tawde pellet, Allah ko haforoowo junuubi ɗin fow, wonannde kala tuubanɗo Mo. Ko Kanko woni Haforoowo junuubi tuubayɓe ɓen, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.

arabe: وَأَنِيبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ وَأَسۡلِمُواْ لَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
traduction: Tuubee nduttoɗon ka Joomi mon, jebbilanoɗon mo, ado lepte ɗen arde e mon, hara on paabetaake.
explication: Tuubee ruttoron ka Joomi mon, golle moƴƴe, jebbilanoɗon Mo, ado lepte laakara ɗen arde e mon, hara on heɓirtaa sanamuuji ɗin wanaa yimɓe mon ɓen, faabo.

arabe: وَٱتَّبِعُوٓاْ أَحۡسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ بَغۡتَةٗ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ
traduction: Njokkee ko ɓuri moƴƴude e ko jippinaa e mon, immorde ka Joomi, ado lepte ɗen ado de on, juhal, hara on so'aa anndude.
explication: Jokkee ndee Alqur'aanaare, tawnde ko ɓurnde moƴƴude e ko Joomi mon jippinani on, haa e Nulaaɗo Makko on, gollitiron nde, woɗɗitoɗon e ko nde haɗi, ado lepte ɗen ardude on e juhal, hara on so'aa anndude, sakko hebiloron tuubugol.

arabe: أَن تَقُولَ نَفۡسٞ يَٰحَسۡرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِي جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّٰخِرِينَ
traduction: fii wota woŋkii wi'oy: "Ee nimse am, e ko mi welsindii e fii Allah. Pellet, mi jeyano e ɓeen jalkitooɓe".
explication: Waɗee ko yamiraɗon, ado wonkii wi'oyde tuma nimse nafataa janngo: Ee nimse am, e ko mi welsindii e Allah, geddi e keeferaaku. Ki tabintina wonnde ko jeyano e jalkitaynooɓe yimɓe gomɗimɓe ɗoftii ɓen.

arabe: أَوۡ تَقُولَ لَوۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
traduction: maa ki wi'a: "Si Alah feewnuno kam, mi wonanyno jiyaaɗo e gooŋɗuɓe ɓen".
explication: Maa ki ngantinora kodduruyee, ki wi'ia: Si Allah feewnuno mi, mi jeyeteno e huluɓe Mo ɓen. Mi ɗoftoo yamirooje Makko, mi woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko.

arabe: أَوۡ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلۡعَذَابَ لَوۡ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةٗ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
traduction: Maa ki wi'a, tuma ki yi'ata lepte ɗen: "Si fehre ruttagol no woodannoo kam, mi jeyee e moƴƴinooɓe ɓeen".
explication: Maa ki yelora wi'ugol, nde ki yi'ata lepte ɗen: Si feere ruttagol aduna no woodannoo lam, mi tuubanayno Allah, mi jeyee e moƴƴinooɓe golle ɓen.

arabe: بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتِي فَكَذَّبۡتَ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
traduction: "Gasataa ! Tawde aayeeje Am ɗen aruno e maaɗa, njedduɗaa ɗe, mawnintiniɗaa, laatiɗaa jiyaaɗo e yedduɓe ɓeen".
explication: Ɗum gasatira no faaliraɗaa non feewirde ! Tawde Aayeeje Amen ɗen aruno e maaɗa, fennuɗaa ɗe, mawnintiniɗaa, laatiɗaa jeyaaɗo e yedduɓe Allah ɓen, yeddi Aayeeje Makko ɗen e Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسۡوَدَّةٌۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
traduction: Ñande Darngal, a yi'oya fennonooɓe e hoore Allah ɓen, hino ɓawli je'ece. Wonaa ka Jahannama woni jaaƴorde mawnintiniiɓe ɓeen?
explication: Ñalnde Darngal, a yi'oyay fenunooɓe e hoore Allah ɓen, ɓe dammbi sirku e ɓiɗɗo e Makko, hiɓe ɓawli geece, hakkee ko ɓe malkisaa. Wonaa ka Jahannama woni jaaƴorde mawnintinaniiɓe gomɗingol Allah e Nulaaɗo Makko on? Ko ton tigiri, woni weerde maɓɓe.

arabe: وَيُنَجِّي ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ بِمَفَازَتِهِمۡ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
traduction: Allah na daɗndira gooŋɗuɓe ɓeen, sabu maloore maɓɓe nden. Bone memataa ɓeen, wonaa kamɓe ngoni sunoytooɓe.
explication: Allah hisinira huluɓe Mo ɗoftii haɗitii ɓen, e lepte, O naadaugol ɓe ka maloore Aljanna. Bone lepte memataa ɓen, wanaa kamɓe woni ko sunoytoo, fii ko feƴƴi e geɓoy aduna.

arabe: ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَكِيلٞ
traduction: Ko Allah woni Takɗo kala hu'unde, ko Kaŋko kadi woni pawtiiɗo kala hu'unde.
explication: Ko Allah woni Taguɗo kala huunde, wanaa goɗɗo goɗɗum goo. Ko Kanko kadi woni Fawtiiɗo kala huunde, O Toppitoo fii mayre, O waɗira nde, no O haajiri.

arabe: لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
traduction: Ko Kaŋko sottirɗe kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin woodani. Yedduɓe aayeeje Allah ɓeen non, ko ɓen ngoni hayruɓe(pertuɓe) ɓen.
explication: Ko Kanko tun, jogitii ngaluuji moƴƴere ɗin, ka kammuuli e ka leydi. Himo yeɗa ɗi Mo O haajani, O ɗawa ɗi Mo O muuyi. Yedduɓe Aayeeje Allah ɓen non, ko ɓen woni hayruɓe ɓen. Tawde ɓe faɗii gomɗingol e nguurndam maɓɓe ɗam aduna, e hoore ɓe naatoyay ɓe heddoo ka Yiite, laakara.

arabe: قُلۡ أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأۡمُرُوٓنِّيٓ أَعۡبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ
traduction: Maaku: "E ko woori Allah, njamirton mi, yo mi rew, onon ɓee majjuɓe?"
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓee sirkooɓe jokkuɓe maa, fii rewugol sanamuuji maɓɓe ɗin: E on yamiray lam, onon ɓee majjuɓe fii Joomi mun, nde mi rewata ko woori Allah? Anndee ko Allah tun, hanndi e reweede, mi rewataa, si wanaa Kanko.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ لَئِنۡ أَشۡرَكۡتَ لَيَحۡبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii wahayinaama e maaɗa, e ɓen adinooɓe ma: "Si a sirkii, pellet, golle maa ɗeen bonay njeyiɗaa e hayruɓe ɓeen.
explication: Gomɗii Allah wahayinii maaɗa, an Nulaaɗo, O wahayini kadi e Nulaaɓe adinooɓe ma ɓen: si a kafidii e Allah goɗɗum goo, ko pellet, golle maa moƴƴe ɗen bonay; jeyeɗaa e hayruɓe aduna ɓen, sabu hayruɓe diina maa, hayroyaa kadi e lepte laakara ɗen.

arabe: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعۡبُدۡ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
traduction: Alah rew Allah, njeyeɗaa e yettooɓe (Mo) ɓen.
explication: Ko Allah tun, si a reway, hara a kafidaali Mo e goɗɗum goo, jeyeɗaa e yettooɓe Mo neemajji ɗi O neemini e maaɗa ɗin.

arabe: وَمَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ جَمِيعٗا قَبۡضَتُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ مَطۡوِيَّٰتُۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
traduction: Ɓe mawniniraani Allah, no O foti maninireede, hara le, leydi ndin fof, ko tamannde makko, Ñande Darngal, kammuuji ɗin kadi taggiree ñaamo makko. Senayee woodanii Mo ! O toowii e kon ko ɓe cirkanta mo.
explication: Sirkooɓe ɓen mawniniraali Allah, no O haaniri mawninireede, tuma ɓe kafidunoo Mo e taguuji Makko lo'uɗi, ɓe yejjiti wonnde no jeyaa e kattane Makko ngal, tawde leydi ndin e ko woni mayri kon : immorde e pelle e leɗɗe e canɗi e boyli, fow e mun, Ñalnde Darngal, ko e tamannde Makko wonata, kammuuli ɗin jeeɗiɗi kadi, fow majji taggiree ñaamo Makko ngon. Senayee woodanii Mo ! O laaɓii O toowii kon ko sirkooɓe ɓen fiɓata wowla e Makko.

arabe: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخۡرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ قِيَامٞ يَنظُرُونَ
traduction: Wuttee ka Allaandu, kala ko woni ka kammuuji e ka leydi kon faɗɗee, si wonaa ɓen ɓe Allah muuyani [daɗugol]. refti wuttee e mayru ɗiɗaɓol, tawa ko ɓe dariiɓe cabbitii.
explication: Ñalnde Malaa'ikaajo on wuttoyta ka Allaandu, kala ko woni ko kammuuli e ka leydi fow maayay, refti wuttee e mayru ɗiɗaɓol, fii ummital, tawaa ɓe fow ɓe wuurnitaama, hiɓe darii habbii ko Allah waɗata ɓe.

arabe: وَأَشۡرَقَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَجِاْيٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Leydi ndin jalbira ndaygo Jeydo ndi On; taalkuru nduun wallinee, Annabaaɓe e seedeeɓe maɓɓe ɓen addee; goonga ñaawiree hakkunde maɓɓe, wonaa ɓe tooñeteeɓe;
explication: Leydi ndin jalbirora, tuma Jeyɗo ndi On feeñiroyta ñaawugol hakkunde jeyaaɓe ɓen. Talki golle ɗin sennditee, Annbaaɓe ɓen addee, mofte Muhammadu (jom kisiyee ɗen) ɓadine, fii seeditanagol ɓeya Annabaaɓe, e yimɓe maɓɓe ɓen. Allah ñaawira nunɗal hakkunde maɓɓe, wonaa ɓe tooñeteeɓe nden Ñalnde: goɗɗo ɓeydantaake bonɗi, o ɗuytantaake moƴƴi.

arabe: وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُونَ
traduction: woŋki kala yoɓee ko golli kon. Ko Kaŋko [Allah] ɓuri anndude ko ɓe ngollata.
explication: Allah yoɓita wonki kala, ko ki golli kon, woni bone maa moƴƴere. Ko Kanko Allah ɓuri anndude ko ɓe gollata kon. Huunde suuɗaaki Mo e kuuɗe maɓɓe, woni bonɗe maa moƴƴe. O yoɓitoyay ɓe ɗum, nden Ñalnde.

arabe: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلٞ مِّنكُمۡ يَتۡلُونَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَاۚ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنۡ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
traduction: Yedduɓe ɓen coggiroyee ka Jahannama dente-dente. Haa si ɓe heewtii nge, dame magge udditee, reenuɓe nge ɓen mbi'ana ɓe: "E Nulaaɓe jiyaaɓe e mo'on heewtaano on, janngaynooɓe aayeeje Joomi mon, e mooɗon, ɓe rentina on hawrugol e ndee ñalaande mon?" Ɓe mbi'a: "Ko non tigiri, kono Konngol lepte ngol, jojjiino e yedduɓe ɓeen".
explication: Malaa'ika'en soggiroya yeddunooɓe Allah ɓen, ka Jahannama, dente-dente, hoynaaɓe. Si ɓe hewtii nge, dame magge udditaneeɓe, Malaa'ika ayninaaɓe nge ɓen jaɓɓora ɓe feloore wi'ugol: Enee, Nulaaɓe jeyaaɓe e mooɗon, hewtaano on, ɓe no jannganaynoo on Aayeeje Allah, jippinaaɗe e mon ɗen, ɓe rentinira on, hawrugol e lepte saɗtuɗe Ñalnde Darngal? Ɓe qirritora wi'ugol: Ko non woniri, ko woni tun, hari Konngol lepte ngol jojjiino e yedduɓe ɓen. Menen non, ko men yeddunooɓe.

arabe: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
traduction: [Ɓe] mbi'anee: "Naatiree dame Jahannama ɗen lutton ton. Nge bonii jaaƴorde mawnintiniiɓe ɓeen !".
explication: Ɓe wi'iranee hoyneede, e teƴagol yurmeende Allah e yaltugol ka Yiite ton: naatiree dame Jahannama ngen, lutton ton poomaa. Nge bonii weerde mawnintiniiɓe toownitanii goonga ɓen.

arabe: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡجَنَّةِ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ طِبۡتُمۡ فَٱدۡخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَ
traduction: Hulooɓe Joomi mun ɓen kadi ɗowitiree ka Aljanna, dente-dente. Haa si ɓe heewtii mo, dame makko udditee, reenuɓe mo ɓen mbi'ana ɓe: "Kisal wonii e mon, on laaɓii, naatiree mo, duumagol".
explication: Malaa'ika'en ɗowira muumini'en, hulunooɓe Joomi mun, ɗoftinooɓe yamaruyeeji Makko, ɓe woɗɗitii e haɗaaɗi Makko, teddungal, haa ka Aljannaaji, hara ko dente-dente. Si wonii ɓe hewtii ton, dame majji udditanaama ɓe, Malaa'ikaaɓe ayninaaɓe ton ɓe wi'ana ɓe: on hisii e kala lorra, maa ko huloton. Ɓerɗe mon e golle mon laaɓii. Naatiree Alajanna on, duumagol ton poomaa.

arabe: وَقَالُواْ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعۡدَهُۥ وَأَوۡرَثَنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ حَيۡثُ نَشَآءُۖ فَنِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'a ontuma: "Jettooje ngoodanii Allah, laatinanɗo men fodoore Mum, O ronini min leydi [Aljanna] ndin, meɗen weerira e Aljanna on, kala ka min njiɗi". Mbarjaari gollunooɓe moƴƴere ɓeen moƴƴii.
explication: Muumini'en si naadaama Aljanna, ɓe wi'a: Yettoore woodanii Allah, laatinanɗo men fodoore Makko, e ɗemɗe Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen, wonnde O naadoyay men Aljanna. O ronini men leydi Aljanna ndin, meɗen hoɗira e mayri, kala ka men yiɗi. Mbarjaari gollunooɓe golle moƴƴe ɓen, fii Allah, ndi moƴƴii barjaari.

arabe: وَتَرَى ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنۡ حَوۡلِ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡۚ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ وَقِيلَ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Yi'oyaa Malaa'ikaen, heɓe taarii Arsi kin, heɓe cubbunhinora yettugol Joomi maɓɓe. Goonga ñaawiree hakkunde maɓɓe. Wi'ee on tuma: "Yettoore woodanii Allah, Jeyɗo tagoore".
explication: Nden Ñalnde, a yi'ay Malaa'ika'en no fiiltii Arsi ki, hiɓe senina yettugol Joomi maɓɓe, e huunde ko heeferɓe wi'ata Mo, kon ko haananaa Mo. Allah ñaawira nunɗal, hakkunde tageefo ngon fow: O teddina Mo muuyanaaɓe ɓen, O lepte lepteeɓe ɓen. Ontuma wi'ee: Yettoore woodanii Allah, Jeyɗo tageefo ngon, e fii ko O ñaawiri kon yurmeende, hakkunde jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, O heertinani yurmeende Makko nden, muumini'en, yedduɓe ɓen hanndi e lepte ɗen.

arabe: حمٓ
traduction: Haa, miim.[1]
explication: Haa, Miim: yewtere fii sugu ɗee kalfe yewtanooma ka simoore Al Baqarah.

arabe: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
traduction: Jippagol deftere nde, ko immorde e Allah, poolɗo, ganndo oon.
explication: Jippinde Quraana ummaade e Alla Tedduɗo O hay gooto foolataa Mbo gannduɗo maslahaaji jiyaaɓe Makko e dow Nelaaɗo Makko.

arabe: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوۡبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلۡعِقَابِ ذِي ٱلطَّوۡلِۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
traduction: Kaforoowo bakkatuuji ɗin, Jaɓoowo tuubuubuyee, caɗtuɗo lepte, Joom yaajeende. Deweteeɗo alaa, si wonaa kaŋko. Ko ka makko woni ruttorde nden.
explication: Haforoowo junubaaji ɗin, Jaɓanoowo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Saɗtuɗo leptugol saliiɗo tuubannde Mo, Jom neema yaajuɗo. Reweteeɗo e goonga alaa, si wanaa Kanko tun, ko ka Makko woni ruttorde nden, Ñalnde Darngal. O yoɓa ɓe, ko ɓe hanndi kon.

arabe: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَلَا يَغۡرُرۡكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
traduction: Alaa ko weeñdata e aayeeje Allah ɗen, si wonaa yedduɓe ɓen. Wota a hoditor ko ɓe dillirta kon ka leydi.
explication: Alaa ko wennjata e Aayeeje Allah ɓannginɗe tawhiidi e goonga Nulaaɓe ɓen, si wanaa yedduɓe Allah ɓen, sabu jiiɓagol haqille maɓɓe. Wata a sunor hoditoraa, ko ɓe woni dillirde jawle e neemaaji. Ko ɓe nennitiranaa, ko hebilangol ɓe fewjana ɓe.

arabe: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۖ وَهَمَّتۡ كُلُّ أُمَّةِۭ بِرَسُولِهِمۡ لِيَأۡخُذُوهُۖ وَجَٰدَلُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُواْ بِهِ ٱلۡحَقَّ فَأَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
traduction: Ado maɓɓe, yimɓe Nuuhu ɓeen e peɗle  ɓaawo maɓɓe, yedduno (Nulaaɓe mum ɓeen), mofte kala himmiri nanngugol Nulaaɗo mun oon. Ɓe njeddiri meere, fii no bonnitira (goonga) kan. Kono Min nanngi ɓe. Taskii no nanngal am ngal waɗtinirnoo !
explication: Ado ɓee ɗoo, hari yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen fenniino Nulaaɓe mun, feddeeji ɗin ɓaawo maɓɓe kadi fenni Aadi, e Samuuda, e yimɓe Luutu ɓen, e wonndiiɓe Madyana ɓen e Fir'awna'en fow. Mofte kala e ɓen ɗon, himmiri nanngugol Nulaaɗo mun on, fii warugol mo. Ɓe wennjiri meere maɓɓe, fii bonnitirgol nde goonga kan. Kono Mi nanngi ɓe. Tesko no nanngal Am waɗtinirnoo e maɓɓe. Ɗum ko lepte saɗtuɗe wonunoo.

arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
traduction: Ko wano nii Konngol Joomi maa ngol, jojjiri e yedduɓe ɓeen : "Won'de pellet, ko ɓe yimɓe Yiite".
explication: Ko wano Allah ñaawiri non fii halkugol ɗen mofte fennunooɓe Nulaaɓe mun, Konngol Joomi maa ngol, an Nulaaɗo, jojjiri e yedduɓe ɓen: wonnde pellet, ko ɓe yimɓe Yiite.

arabe: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحۡمِلُونَ ٱلۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۖ رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ رَّحۡمَةٗ وَعِلۡمٗا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
traduction: Ɓeen (Malaa'ikaaɓe) roondiiɓe Arsiki kin, e wonɓe bannge makki ɓen, hiɓe cubbunhinora yettugol Joomi maɓɓe, ɓe ngooŋɗina mo, ɓe insinorana gooŋɗinɓe ɓen (wiide): "Joomi amen, A yaññirii kala hu'unde, yurmeende e ganndal. Yawtan ɓen tuubuɓe, ɓe njokki laawol Maa ngol, daɗndaa ɓe kadi lepte Dulɓoowe ngeen.
explication: Malaa'ikaaɓe ronndiiɓe Arsi Joomi maa kin, an Nulaaɗo, e ɓeya wonɓe sera makki, hiɓe laɓɓina Joomi maɓɓe, e kon ko hanndaa e Makko, ɓe gomɗina Mo, ɓe ɗaɓɓira Mo, haforangol gomɗimɓe Allah ɓen, ɓe wi'a: Joomi amen, ganndal Maa ngal e yurmeende Maa nden, yaajanii kala huunde. Yawtan tuubuɓe ɓen, junuubi maɓɓe ɗin, ɓen jokkuɓe diina Maa kan, daɗndaa ɓe kadi, Yiite ngen.

arabe: رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
traduction: Joomi amen, naaduɓe ka Aljannaaji ñiiɓal, ɗin ɗi poduɗaa ɓe, e kala moƴƴuɗo e baabiraaɓe maɓɓe, e genndiraaɓe maɓɓe, e geñngol maɓɓe. Pellet, ko Aan woni pooluɗo, Ñeeñɗo Oon.
explication: Mala'ika'en wi'a kadi: Joomi amen, naadu gomɗimɓe ɓen ka Aljannaaji ñiiɓal, ɗin ɗi foduɗaa ɓe, waɗtidaaɓe e kala moƴƴinnoɗo golle, immorde e baabiraaɓe maɓɓe, e genndiraaɓe maɓɓe, e ɓiɗɓe maɓɓe. Pellet, ko An woni Fooluɗo Mo gooto foolataa, Ñeeñuɗo e eɓɓoore e toppitannde Mun.

arabe: وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَهُۥۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
traduction: Daɗndaaɓe [kuuɗe] e bonɗe ɗen. Kala mo daɗnduɗaa [kuuɗe] mum bonɗe ɗen nden Ñande, haray pellet, A yurmiii mo". Ko ɗum woni maloore mawnunde ndeen.
explication: Daɗndaa ɓe golle maɓɓe bonɗe ɗen, hara A nanngitiraali ɓe ɗen. Kala non daɗnduɗaa ɗum Ñalnde Darngal, haray A yuminii mo. Ko ɗum woni malal mawnungal ngal sugu mun alaa.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُنَادَوۡنَ لَمَقۡتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُ مِن مَّقۡتِكُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡ إِذۡ تُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكۡفُرُونَ
traduction: Yedduɓe ɓeen noddiroyte: "Ko tikkere Allah nden ɓuri mawnude, e dii ko tikkanɗon ko'e mon ɗum, tuma noddetenoɗon e gooŋɗinal, njeddon.
explication: Yedduɓe e Nulaaɗo Makko on, noddoyte Ñalnde Darngal, tuma ɓe naadaa ka Yiite, ɓe tikkana ko'e maɓɓe, haa ɓe feññina ɗum, wonnde: ko tikkere Allah nden, ɓuri mawnude e dii ko tikkanɗon ko'e mon kon, tuma noddetenoɗon aduna, e fii gomɗingol Allah, yeddon Mo, kafidon Mo e reweteeɗi goo.

arabe: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ وَأَحۡيَيۡتَنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَٱعۡتَرَفۡنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلۡ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٖ مِّن سَبِيلٖ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'a: "Joomi amen, A warii min laawi ɗiɗi, nguurnuɗaa min laawi ɗiɗi: min qirrike bakkaat amen ɗin. Taw si laawol jaltirngol hino woodi?".
explication: Yedduɓ ɓen qirritoo junuubi maɓɓe ɗin, ka qirritagol tuuba nafataa, ɓe wi'a: joomi amen, A warii men laawi ɗiɗi, tawde men woodanooko, taguɗaa Men, refti waruɗaa men ɓaawo ɗum. Wuurnituɗaa men kadi laawi ɗiɗi, ka tawnoo men woodanooka, e ka wuurnituɗaa men ɗon ummital. Haray men qirrike junuubi ɗi men faggitii ɗin. Taw si laawol no woodi, ka men yaltira e ngee Yiite, men yiltitoo aduna, fii moƴƴingol golle amen, jaɓanaa men ɗe?

arabe: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُۥ كَفَرۡتُمۡ وَإِن يُشۡرَكۡ بِهِۦ تُؤۡمِنُواْۚ فَٱلۡحُكۡمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡعَلِيِّ ٱلۡكَبِيرِ
traduction: "Ɗuum mooɗon, ko tawde si Allah tan noddanooma, on njeddon; si O kafidaama, ngooŋɗinon. Ñaawoore nden ko Allah heeranii, Toowɗo, Mawɗo On".
explication: Ɗen lepte ɗe leptiraɗon, ko sabu tawde si Allah tun noddanooma, hara O sirkanaaka, on yeddayno ɗum, waɗanon Mo kafidiiɗi; si tawii non O kafidaama, gomɗinon. Awa ñaawoore nden, ko Kanko tun heeranii, On Toowuɗo e Jaati Mun e Kattal Mun, Mawnuɗo e hoore kala huunde.

arabe: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقٗاۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ
traduction: Ko Kaŋko woni kolloowo on Ma'andeeji makko ɗin, o jippinirana on toɓo ka kammu. Kono taskotaako, si wonaa nduttotooɗo [e Allah].
explication: Ko Allah tun woni holliroowo on maandeeji Makko ɗin, ka tatteeri(jookli) e ka wonkiiji, ko ɓannginana on, Kattal e Gootaagu Makko. O jippinirana on toɓo ka kammu, fii ko arsikireɗon, immorde e puɗi e remuruuji ewk. Alaa non waajitoroowo maandeeji Allah ɗin, si wanaa tuuboowo laɓɓina, ruttoo e Makko on.

arabe: فَٱدۡعُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
traduction: Rewiree Allah, laɓɓinirangol mo diina kan, hay si he'eferɓe ɓeen njɗaa.
explication: Onon ɓee gomɗimɓe, rewiree Allah, laɓɓinirangol Mo dewal e toraare, hara on kafidaali Mo e goɗɗum, hay si tawii ɗum welataa heeferɓe ɓen.

arabe: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُلۡقِي ٱلرُّوحَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ
traduction: Ko o toowuɗo darjaaji, Jeyɗo Arsi kin. Homo jippiniria wahayu oon, yamiroore makko, e on mo o muuyani e jiyaaɓe makko ɓeen, no o jeertinirde ñalnde Kawral ngal,
explication: Ko Kanko hanndi heertinaneede toraare e ɗoftaare, tawde ko O Jom darjaaji toowuɗi ɓanngi e kala tagu Makko ngun, Jeyɗo Arsi mawɗo on. Himo jippinira wahayu on, e mo o muuyani e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, no pittaali maɓɓe wuurira, ɓe wuurniira ɗum woɗɓe goo, e fii yo jertinir yimɓe ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal, nde aramɓe e sakkitiiɓe hawroyta.

arabe: يَوۡمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَۖ لَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنۡهُمۡ شَيۡءٞۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ
traduction: ñande ɓe feeñoyta. Hu'unde suuɗotaako Allah, e fee maɓɓe. Ko hommbo laamu woodani hannde? Ko Allah Bajjo, pooluɗo On.
explication: Ñalnde ɓe feeñoyta nden, hara hiɓe mooɓondiri e nokku gooto. Huunde suuɗotaako Allah, e fii maɓɓe, wanaa kamɓe, wanaa golle maɓɓe ɗen, wanaa kadi njoɓdi maɓɓe ndin.

arabe: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡۚ لَا ظُلۡمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
traduction: Hannde, woŋkii kala yoɓete ko faggitii. Tooñe woo alaa hannde, pellet, Allah ko ñaawɗo ñaawoore.
explication: Hannde, wonkii kala yoɓete ko feggitii e golle: woni moƴƴere maa bone. Tooñe woo alaa hannde, tawde ko Allah ñaawata, pellet, Allah ko yaawuɗo hasboore jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, tawde Himo huɓindii fii maɓɓe.

arabe: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلۡحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَۚ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ حَمِيمٖ وَلَا شَفِيعٖ يُطَاعُ
traduction: Jeertnirtɓe, ñalaande dillere nden, tuma ɓerɗe ɗen ƴawtirta ka konondi, hara heɓe (heewuɓe) ngoƴo. Giɗo woo alanaa tooñooɓe ɓeen, wonaa tefoowo jaɓanteeɗo.
explication: Jertinirɓe an Nulaaɗo, Ñalaande Darngal nden, ɓadiinde, hewtunde. Tawde ko ɓadii fow, ko ko hewti. Nde ñalnde, hakkee ko ɓerɗe ɗen ngoƴata, ɗe ƴawtiray ka konondol, hara ɓe waawataa haalude, si wanaa mo Allah duŋanii e maɓɓe. Tooñirnooɓe sirku e geddi ɓen non, ɓe heɓoytaa giɗo maa musiɗɗo, wanaa kadi tefoowo jaɓanteeɗo, si ɓe aru heɓude on.

arabe: يَعۡلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنِ وَمَا تُخۡفِي ٱلصُّدُورُ
traduction: Homo anndi njamfa gite, e ko ɓerɗe ɗeen cuuɗi.
explication: Allah no anndi ko gite ɗen janforta e ndaarɗe, e ko ɓerɗe ɗen suuɗata. Huunde e mun wirnaaki Mo.

arabe: وَٱللَّهُ يَقۡضِي بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقۡضُونَ بِشَيۡءٍۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
traduction: Allah ko goonga ñaawirta. Ɗi ɓe ndeewata ɗiin non, gaanin makko, hay hu'unde ɗi ñaawirtaa. Pellet, ko kaŋko woni Nanoowo, ji'oowo On.
explication: Allah ko nunɗal ñaawirta, O tooñirtah goɗɗo ɗuytangol mo moƴƴi maa ɓeydangol mo bonɗi. Ɗin ɗi sirkooɓe ɓen rewata ko wanaa Allah, hay huunde ɗi ñaawataa, tawde ɗi jeyaa huunde. Pellet, ko Allah woni Nanoowo haala jeyaaɓe Mun, Yi'oowo annuyeeji e kuuɗe maɓɓe. O yoɓitoya ɓe ɗum.

arabe: ۞ أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗ وَءَاثَارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمۡ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٖ
traduction: Hara ɓee njiilaaki ka leydi, ɓe ndaara no battane ado mabbe ɓen wa'unoo? Ɓeen le no ɓurunoo tiiɗude doole e batteeji, ka leydi. Allah nanngitiri ɓe bakkaauuji maɓɓe ɗiin, ɓe heɓaano daɗndoowo ɓe e (lepte) Allah ɗeen.
explication: Hara ɓee sirkooɓe yiilaaki ka leydi, ɓe taskoo no mofte fennunooɓe ado maɓɓe ɓen wa'unoo? Ko battane bonɗe wonunoo. Hara le ɓeen no ɓurnoo ɓe tiiɗude ɓe doole e batteeji accaaɗi ka leydi, wano kubeeje ɗe ɓee ronki battinorde. Kono Allah halkitirno ɓe junuubi maɓɓe ɗin, ɓe heɓaano daɗndoowo ɓe e lepte Allah ɗen.

arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَانَت تَّأۡتِيهِمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُواْ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِيّٞ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
traduction: Ko waɗi ɗuum, ko tawde Nulaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen ngaddatno ɓe ɓanngannduyeeji, ɓe njedda. Allah halki ɓe. Pellet, ko O Doolnuɗo, caɗtuɗo lepte.
explication: Ko waɗi kon ɓe leptaa, ko tawde Nulaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen addanayno ɓe hujjaaji ɓannguɗi, immorde ka Allah, ɓe yedda Allah, ɓe fenna Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen. E ko ɓe doolnunoo kon fow, Allah naangiri ɓe lepte, O halki fii maɓɓe, tawde pellet, ko O Doolnuɗo, Saɗtuɗo leptugol yedduɗo Mo, fenni Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min nulirii Muusaa aayeeje Amen ɗen, e hujja ɓannguɗo.
explication: Gomɗii Men nulirii Muusaa, Aayeeje Amen bannguɗe ɗen, e hujja ɓannguɗo.

arabe: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَقَٰرُونَ فَقَالُواْ سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٞ
traduction: haa e Fir'awna, e Haamaana, e Qaaruuna. Kono ɓe mbi'i: "Ko bileejo, ɗuuɗuɗo penaande!".
explication: Men nuli mo haa e Fir'awna, e jaagoraaɗo makko on Haamaana, e Qaaruuna. Kono ɓe wi'i: Muusaa, ko mbileejo, ɗuuɗuɗo fenaande, e wi'ugol ko o Nulaaɗo.

arabe: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ مِنۡ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَبۡنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسۡتَحۡيُواْ نِسَآءَهُمۡۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ
traduction: Nde o addannoo ɓe goonga ka, immorde e amen, ɓe mb'iti: "mbaree ɓiɗɓe worɓe gooŋɗinɓe ɓen e makko, accon rewɓe maɓɓe ɓen". Pewje he'eferɓe ɓen wonaani, si wonaa e majjere.
explication: Nde Muusaa addannooɓe hujjaaji ɓannginɗo goonga makko kan, Fir'awna wi'i:waree ɓiɗɓe gomɗimdimɓe ɓen e makko, heddon rewɓe maɓɓe ɓen, hoynugol ɓe. Kono ko heeferɓe ɓen fewjirta ɗuytugol limoore gomɗimɓe ɓen wonaali, si wanaa mulata yaha, hara batte alanaa ɗum.

arabe: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ذَرُونِيٓ أَقۡتُلۡ مُوسَىٰ وَلۡيَدۡعُ رَبَّهُۥٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمۡ أَوۡ أَن يُظۡهِرَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡفَسَادَ
traduction: Fir'awna wi'i: "ngccee mi wara Muusaa. Yo o noddu Joomi makko ! Miɗo huli nde o waylata diina mon kan, maa o feññina bonnere e leydi".
explication: Fir'awana wi'i: Accee mi wara Muusaa, fii yaggingol mo, e no o noddira Joomi makko, fii haɗugol lam ɗum. Min mi haajaaka e ɗum. Mi hulu wata o waylu diina mon kan, maa o feññina bonnere ka leydi, woni warugol e bonnital.

arabe: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
traduction: Muusa maaki: "Mi moolorii Jeyɗo kam on, jeyi on, e bone kala mawnintiniiɗo, mo gooŋɗinaa ñalaande hasboore".
explication: Nde Fir'awna gaynunoo kammbude, Annabai Muusaa maakani mo: Mi moolorii daɗndiragol Jeyɗo lam On, jeyi on, e bone mawnintinaniiɗo goonga e gomɗinal, mo gomɗinaa Ñalnde Darngal, e hasboore e lepte ko woni ton.

arabe: وَقَالَ رَجُلٞ مُّؤۡمِنٞ مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَكۡتُمُ إِيمَٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقۡتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدۡ جَآءَكُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَٰذِبٗا فَعَلَيۡهِ كَذِبُهُۥۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقٗا يُصِبۡكُم بَعۡضُ ٱلَّذِي يَعِدُكُمۡۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٞ كَذَّابٞ
traduction: Gorko gooŋɗinɗo goo, jiyaaɗo e yimɓe Fir'awna ɓen - cuuɗunooɗo gooŋɗinal mum - :"E on waray gorko, fii o wi'i: "Joomi am ko Allah?" Hara le o addanii on ɓanngannduyeeji, immorde ka Joomi mon. Si tawii o fenu, haray fenaande makko ko kaŋko fawii; si tawii kadi o goongu, haray yoga e kon ko kammbirani on, heɓay on". Pellet, Allah feewnata on fantinoowo yeddoowo!
explication: Gorko goo, gomɗinɗo Allah, jeyaaɗo e yimɓe fir'awna ɓen, suuɗunooɗo yimɓe mun, gomɗinal makko ngal, saliiɗo fellitgol maɓɓe warugol Muusa ngol, o wi'i: E on waray gorko mo bonnaa, si wanaa fii o wi'i: Ko Allah woni Joomi am? Hara le o addanii on hujjaaji e ɓannganduyeeji, sembinayɗi goonga makko kan, wiide ko O nulaaɗo Joomi makko? Si tawii ko o fenuɗo, haray lorra fenaande makko nden, ko e makko yantata; si tawii non ko goonguɗo, haray yoga e ko o kammbirani on kon e lepte aduna ɗen, heɓay on. Pellet, Allah fewanataa e goonga, on tawɗo no yawti keeri Allah ɗin, fefindii fenaande, baki e Makko, Kanko e Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: يَٰقَوۡمِ لَكُمُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأۡسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَاۚ قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمۡ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهۡدِيكُمۡ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
traduction: Eey yo yimɓe am, laamu no woodani on hanndi, ko on foolɓe ka leydi. Kono ko hommbo wallata en, e lepte Allah ɗen, si ɗe ngarii e men?" Fir'awna wi'i: "Mi hollataa on, si wanaa ko mi yi'i kon. Mi tindintaa on kadi, si wonaa e laawol peewal ngol".
explication: Ko onon yo yimɓe am, laamu no woodani on hanndi, hiɗon fooli e leydi Misra ndin. Kono ko hommbo daɗndata en, e lepte Allah ɗen, si ɗe arii e men, tuma waruɗen Muusaa? Fir'awna wi'i: Ko feere am nde mi ñaawi nden, jokketee. Mi yi'ii feere warugol Muusaa, fii haɗugol bone e bonnere. Mi tinndintaa on, si wanaa sawaaba.

arabe: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُم مِّثۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
traduction: Gooŋɗinɗo on wi'iti: "eey mon yo yimɓe am, min on miɗo hulani on, sugu ñalaande heɓunoonde peɗle ɗin.
explication: Gomɗinɗo on laaɓani reedu, o wi'itani yimɓe makko ɓen: min on miɗo hulani on - si tawii on arii Muusaa e hoore tooñe e jaggitere - lepte, sugu lepte yimɓe feddeeji ɓen, haɓunooɓe Nulaaɓe mun adinooɓe, Allah halki ɓe.

arabe: مِثۡلَ دَأۡبِ قَوۡمِ نُوحٖ وَعَادٖ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۚ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلۡمٗا لِّلۡعِبَادِ
traduction: Sugu mbowka yimɓe Nuuhu ɓeen, e Aadi'en, e Samuuda'en, e arnooɓe ɓaawo maɓɓe ɓen". Allah faandanaaki tooñde jiyaaɓe ɓen.
explication: Wano mbowka yeddaynooɓe fenna Nulaaɓe ɓen, sugu yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen, e Aadi'en, e Samuuda'en, e arunooɓe ɓaawo maɓɓe ɓen. Allah halkirno ɓe, yeddugol maɓɓe fenna Nulaaɓe ɓen. Allah non faandanaaki jeyaaɓe ɓen, tooñe. Ko junuubi maɓɓe, O leptirta ɓe, njoɓdi hawrondindi e golle maɓɓe ɗen.

arabe: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ
traduction: Eey mon yimɓe am, miin miɗo hulani on, Ñalaande noddindirton
explication: Ko onon yo yimɓe am, min miɗo hulani on, Ñalnde Darngal: nden Ñalaande, nde yimɓe ɓen noddindiroyta, sabu ɓadandiral maa jaahu, sikkugol ɓe ɗum nafay nden Ñalnde hulɓiniinde.

arabe: يَوۡمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدۡبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمٖۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ
traduction: Ñalnde nduŋtindroyton, hoɗon ndoga, hara daɗndoowo on alanaa on e Allah". Kala mo Allah majjini, haray peewnoowo alanaa mo.
explication: Ñalnde huccitiroyton, dugugol, sabu kulol Yiite ngen, hara daɗndoowo on e lepte Allah ɗen, alanaa on nden Ñalnde. Kala mo Allah hoyfii fii mun, O ɗawi mo gomɗingol, haray fewoowo mo alaa. Tawde ko Allah tun fewnata.
