arabe: إِن يَشَأۡ يُسۡكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظۡلَلۡنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٍ
traduction: Si O haajii, O deeƴinay henndu ndun, ndu waɗtinira tabitndu e hoore maggo. Wonii e ɗuum, Ma'andeeji, wona 'de kala muññotooɗo, jettoowo.
explication: Si O haajii deeƴingol henndu naɓay ndu laaɗe ɗen, O waɗay; ndu waɗtina ontuma, tabitu ndu e hoore maayo ngon. Woni e ko jantaa koo, maandeeji ɓannginɗi kattal Allah ngal, wonannde kala muññotooɗo jarrabuyee, yettoowo neema Allah on e dow mun.

arabe: أَوۡ يُوبِقۡهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ وَيَعۡفُ عَن كَثِيرٖ
traduction: Maa yooliraɗe sabu ko ɓe paggitii kon. Himo ya'afoo noon ko ɗuuɗi.
explication: Si Mo yiɗi Kanko Allah, O yooliray ɗen laaɗe, wurtugol heenndu tiiɗundu e majje, sabu bakkaatu ko yimɓe ɓen faggitii kon. Himo yaafoo non, ko ɗuuɗi e bakkatuuji jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: وَيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٖ
traduction: Wennjooɓe ɓeeen e aayeeje Amen ɗen, hino anndi ɓe alaa laaworde.
explication: Tuma O halkirta laaɗe ɗen henndu ndun, wennjaynooɓe e Aayeeje Allah ɗen, fii bonnitugol ɗe, hiɓe wonnde ontuma, wonnde alaa no ɓe laawora e halkaare nden.

arabe: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
traduction: Kala ko ngokkaɗon e hu'unde, ko dakamme nguurndam aduna; ko ko woni ka Allah koon, ɓuri moƴƴude woni kadi ko heddotoo wonan'de gooŋɗinɓe ɓeen fawotooɓe e Joomi maɓɓe.
explication: Kala huunde nde hokkaɗon onon ɓee yimɓe, woni ko jaahu maa ɓiɗɗo, haray ko dakamme nguurndam aduna, ko ko fii mun lannata; neema duumotooɗo on, ko neema Aljanna on mo Allah marani gomɗimɓe Mo ɓen, ɓe gomɗini Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen, hara ko e Joomi maɓɓe tun, woni ɓe fawotoo e fiyaaku maɓɓe kala.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُواْ هُمۡ يَغۡفِرُونَ
traduction: woɗɗitotooɓe bakkaatuuji mawɗi ɗiin e paŋkare ɗeen, si wonii ɓe tikkii, hara ɓe yaafoto,
explication: Ɓen woɗɗitotooɓe e junuubi mawɗi ɗin e pankare ɗen, si wonii ɓe tikkanii fawñoriiɗo ɓe konngol maa kuugal, hara ɓe yaaforay ontigi e ɗum, sabu moƴƴere e maslaha ko woni e mun.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَجَابُواْ لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمۡرُهُمۡ شُورَىٰ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
traduction: ɓeen nootiiɓe Joomi maɓɓe, ɓe ñiɓni juulde nden, ɓe tawata fiyaaku maɓɓe on ko diisondiral hakkunde maɓɓe, nafqooɓe e ko ko Min ngarsiki ɓe,
explication: Ɓen nootoriiɓe Joomi maɓɓe, huuwugol ko O yamiri ɓe, woɗɗitoo e ko O haɗi ɓe, ñiɓnir ɓe julde nden no timmiri, ɓe tawata ko diisondirayɓe hakkunde maɓɓe, e kala fiyaaku maɓɓe, wintotorayɓe fii Allah, e kon ko Men arsiki ɓe.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلۡبَغۡيُ هُمۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
traduction: e ɓeen tawɓe si bewre heɓii ɓe, ɓe njottoto.
explication: E ɓen tawɓe si tooñe yanii e maɓɓe, ɓe yottoray teddingol hoore maɓɓe, tuma tawi hara tooñuɗo on hanndaa e yaafeede. Nden yottannde, ko jojjunde, teŋtinii si nafa alaa e yaafagol ngol.

arabe: وَجَزَٰٓؤُاْ سَيِّئَةٖ سَيِّئَةٞ مِّثۡلُهَاۖ فَمَنۡ عَفَا وَأَصۡلَحَ فَأَجۡرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
traduction: Njoɓdi bonnere, ko bone yeru mum. Kala non yaafiiɗo o moƴƴintini, haray njoɓdi makko ndin ko ka Allah woni. Pellet non, O yiɗaa tooñooɓe ɓeen.
explication: Kala faalaaɗo yottaade, ko hakkee makko. Ko woni tun, hara ko yeru mun, ko aldaa e ɓeydugol maa fantingol. Kala non yaafiiɗo boniiɗo e mun, o moƴƴintini hakkunde maɓɓe, haray njoɓdi makko ndin ko ka Allah woni. Pellet non, O yiɗaa tooñirooɓe yimɓe ɓen, ka wonikiiji e ka jawle e guri maɓɓe; Himo añi ɓen.

arabe: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعۡدَ ظُلۡمِهِۦ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيۡهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ
traduction: Kala noon yottiiɓe ɓaawo ɓe tooñeede, ko ɓen woni ɓe laawol [nanngitireede] fawaaki e mum.
explication: Kala non yottiiɗo, ko ɓen woni ɓe nanngitirtaake ko waɗi kon.

arabe: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظۡلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبۡغُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
traduction: Ko laawol [nanngitireede] fawii e mum, ko tooñooɓe yimɓe ɓeen, hara hiɓe bewira e leydi ndin ko aldaa e goonga: ɓe ɗoon, hino woodani lepte mu'usuuɗe.
explication: Ka nanngitireede lepte fawii e mun, ko tooñooɓe yimɓe ɓen, hara hiɓe huuwa geddi e leydi ndin: ɓen ɗon, lepte muusuɗe hino woodani laakara.

arabe: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ
traduction: Muññiiɗo on kadi o yaafii, ko pellet, ɗuum no jiyaa e pellital fiyakuujI.
explication: Muññiiɗo on kadi o yaafii tooñe ɗen, ko pellet, moƴƴere ngal muñal ɗon, yiltoto e makko wonndude e renndo ngon. Ɗum ko fiyaaku yettiniiɗo, ko jom-geɓal mawngal tun, woni ko hawrondirta e ɗum.

arabe: وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِيّٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلۡ إِلَىٰ مَرَدّٖ مِّن سَبِيلٖ
traduction: Kala mo Allah majjini, haray giɗo (goo) alanaa mo ɓaawo ɗum. A tinay tooñɓe ɓeen, tuma ɓe nji'i lepte ɗeen, hiɓe mbi'a: "Hara laawol ruttorde no woodi?".
explication: Kala mo Allah hoyni gaa e peewal haa O majjini ontigi e goonga kan, haray giɗo goo alanaa mo, mo no heftana mo fiyakuuji makko ɗin. A tinay tooñirnooɓe ko'e mun ɓen geddi e keeferaaku, tuma ɓe yi'i lepte ɗen Ñalnde Darngal, hiɓe yeloo wi'a: hara laawol ruttorde aduna no woodi, men tuubana Allah?

arabe: وَتَرَىٰهُمۡ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا خَٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرۡفٍ خَفِيّٖۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٖ مُّقِيمٖ
traduction: A tinay ɓe kadi, heɓe mbeeɓitee e magge, hara heɓe njankinii koyeera on, heɓe ndaarira ndaarɗe leppagol. Gooŋɗinɓe ɓen mbi'aya: "Ko woni hayru ɓe ɓeen, ko ɓen hayrimɓe ko'e mun e ɓeynguureeji maɓɓe ɗin Ñalnde Darngal". Nganndee pellet, tooñuɓe ɓeen no e lepte duumiiɗe.
explication: A tinay kadi an Nulaaɗo, ɓee tooñuɓe hino weeɓitee e Yiite ngen, hara ko ɓe hoynaaɓe jaasinaa, hiɓe ndaarira yimɓe ɓen, lepaarol, hakkee ko ɓe huli nge. Gomɗimɓe ɓen wi'ay ontuma: ko woni hayruɓe ɓen tigiri, ko hayrimɓe ko'e mun ɓen e ɓeynguureji mun ɗin Ñalnde Darngal, sabu ko ɓe hawri kon e lepte Allah ɗen. Awa anndee pellet, tooñirɓe ko'e mun ɓen geddi e keeferaaku, ɓe wonii e lepte duumiiɗe poomaa.

arabe: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ
traduction: Yiɗɓe alanaa ɓe, ko wallitoo ɓe, hara wonaa Allah. Kala noon mo Allah majjini, haray laawol alanaa mo.
explication: Yiɗɓe alanaa ɓe,ko wallitoo ɓe daɗugol lepte Allah ɗen,Ñalnde Darngal.Kala non mo Allah majjini e goonga kan,haray o heɓataa ko tinndina mo e maggal, haa poomaa.

arabe: ٱسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلۡجَإٖ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٖ
traduction: Nootee Joomi mon, ado ñalaande arde, nde ruttoowo alaa ɗuum ka Allah. Nden ñalnde, faaborde alanaa on, jeddugol kadi alanaa oon.
explication: Onon ɓee yimɓe, nootee Joomi mon, tinnorgol e ko O yamiri kon, woɗɗitoo e ko O haɗi kon, acca kadi caate, ado Ñalaande Darngal nden arde on, nde tawata ruttoowo alanaa nde. Nden ñalnde, fattorde woo alanaa on, yeddugol junuubi mon ɗin ko faggita ka kadi alanaa ton.

arabe: فَإِنۡ أَعۡرَضُواْ فَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيظًاۖ إِنۡ عَلَيۡكَ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةٗ فَرِحَ بِهَاۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ كَفُورٞ
traduction: Si ɓe ɗuurnike non, haray min nuliraali ma, aynoowo ɓe: fawaaki ma, si wonaa joottingol. Si wonii Min meeɗiniri neɗɗanke on neema immorde e Amen, o wewlira mo; si ko bone non heɓi ɓe, sabu kon ko juuɗe maɓɓe ɗen ardiniri, a taway pellet, neɗɗo on ko jedduɗo sanne !
explication: Si ɓe ɗuurnike e ko yamirɗaa ɓe kon, haray Men nuliraali ma an Nulaaɗo, aynugol kuuɗe maɓɓe: fawaaki ma, si wanaa yottingol nulal ngal e maɓɓe, ñaawoore maɓɓe nden, ko ka Allah woni. Si wonii Men meeɗinirii neɗɗanke on neema ngalu e callal ekn, o wewlira ɗum; si bone non woni memiei ɓe sanu junuubi maɓɓe ɗin, a taway ko ɓe anndiraaɓe dullangol Allah, ronka yettude neemaaji Makko ɗin, ɓe wona e tikkangol ko O hoddirani ɓe kon ñeñƴal Makko.

arabe: لِّلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثٗا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
traduction: Ko Allah woodani laamagol kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin. Himo taga ko o muuyi. Homo yeɗa mo o muuyani ɓiɓɓe rewɓe, O yeɗa kadi mo O muuyani ɓiɗɓe worɓe.
explication: Ko Allah heeranii laamagol kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin. Himo tagira worɓe e rewɓe maa ko wanaa ɗum, no O haajiri. Himo yeɗa mo O muuyani ɓiɗɓe rewɓe, O ɗala ontigi ɓiɗɓe worɓe, ko non kadi O yeɗirta mo O muuyani ɓiɗɓe worɓe, O ɗali mo ɓiɗɓe rewɓe, maa O waɗana mo O muuyani kadi ɓiɗɓe e worɓe, O waɗa mo O muuyani wonnde mo jibintaa. Pellet, Himo anndi ko fewndii e ko saatii. Ko ɗum woni timmugol ganndal e ñeñƴal Makko. Huunde wirnanaaki Mo. Wanaa goɗɗum kadi rontinta Mo.

arabe: أَوۡ يُزَوِّجُهُمۡ ذُكۡرَانٗا وَإِنَٰثٗاۖ وَيَجۡعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٞ قَدِيرٞ
traduction: maa O jillira ɓe worɓe e rewɓe; Homo waɗa dimaro, on mo o muuyani. Pellet, ko O ganduɗo, kattanɗo.
explication: Ko Allah heeranii laamagol kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin. Himo tagira worɓe e rewɓe maa ko wanaa ɗum, no O haajiri. Himo yeɗa mo O muuyani ɓiɗɓe rewɓe, O ɗala ontigi ɓiɗɓe worɓe, ko non kadi O yeɗirta mo O muuyani ɓiɗɓe worɓe, O ɗali mo ɓiɗɓe rewɓe, maa O waɗana mo O muuyani kadi ɓiɗɓe e worɓe, O waɗa mo O muuyani wonnde mo jibintaa. Pellet, Himo anndi ko fewndii e ko saatii. Ko ɗum woni timmugol ganndal e ñeñƴal Makko. Huunde wirnanaaki Mo. Wanaa goɗɗum kadi rontinta Mo.

arabe: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحۡيًا أَوۡ مِن وَرَآيِٕ حِجَابٍ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ رَسُولٗا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذۡنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٞ
traduction: Sellantaa neɗɗaŋke, nde Allah yeewtata mo, si wonaa wahayu, maa e ɓaawo heedo, maa o immina Nulaaɗo (Malaa'ikaajo), on wayahina e duŋayee(sakkitoore) makko, ko ko O haaji. Pellet, ko O toowuɗo, Ñeeñɗo.
explication: Sellantaa neɗɗanke, nde Allah yewtata, si wanaa hara ko wahayu maa ko nanndi, maa hara ko no o nanirta yewtere Makko nden, tawa o sutaaki mo, maa O immina Malaa'ikaajo e makko, wano Jibiriilu, on wahayina e neɗɗanke Nulaaɗo on, ko Allah duŋanii mo kon. Pellet, Kanko Allah, ko O Toowuɗo e Jaati e Sifaaji Makko, Ñeeñuɗo e tagu e kattal e sari'a Makko on.

arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ رُوحٗا مِّنۡ أَمۡرِنَاۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدۡرِي مَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُورٗا نَّهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
traduction: Ko wano non Min mbayayinir e maaɗa, ruuhu on [Alqur'aana] e yamiroore Amen. A anndaano ko woni deftere, maa gooŋɗinal; si ko woni, Min mbaɗunde ndaygu, ngu Min peewwnirta on mo Min muuyani e jiyaaɓe Amen ɓen. Pellet, ko a feewnoowo e laawol Pocciingol,
explication: Ko wano Men wahayinirnoo non e Annabaaɓe adinooɓe ma ɓen, Men wahayiniri Alqur'aana e maaɗa, an Nulaaɗo, e yamiroore Amen. A anndaano ko woni Defte jippiiɗe ɗen e ɓeya Nulaaɓe, a anndaano kadi ko woni gomɗinal; si ko woni, Men jippinin ndee Alqur'aanaare, ko nde ndayginnde, ndaygu ngu Men fewnirta mo Men muuyani e jeyaaɓe Amen ɓen. Pellet, ko a fewnoowo yimɓe ɓen, e laawol focciingol, woni diina lislaamu kan.

arabe: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
traduction: laawol Allah, On jeyɗo ko woni kammuuji e ka leydi. ganndee, ko ka Allah, fiyakuuji ɗin nduttotoo.
explication: Laawol Allah, On jeyɗo ko woni kon ka kammuuli e ka leydi, taguɗo laamii toppitii ɗi. Anndee pellet, ko ka Allah tun, woni ko fiyakuuji ɗin ruttotoo, ka eɓɓugol topiitoo.

arabe: حمٓ
traduction: Haa, miim.[1]
explication: Haa, Miim. Yewtere fii sugu ɗee kalfe yawtiino ka cortewol Al baqarah.

arabe: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii defere ɓanngunde ndeen !
explication: Allah woondirii Deftere ɓannginnde laawol peewal ngol.

arabe: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيّٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
traduction: Min maɗii nde janngeteende [e ɗemngal] aarabu, mbelajo'o, on kaqqilay.
explication: Men waɗii nde janngeteende e haala aarabu, no taskoron maanaaji mayre, onon ɓee ɓe nde jippinaa e haala mun, faamon ɗum, egganon mofte goo.

arabe: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِيٓ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ
traduction: Pellet, hende woni ka Amen gaa, ka yumma defte, toownde, ñeñaande.
explication: Pellet, ndee Alqur'aanaare, hino ka Alluwal reenaangal, toowunde darja, ñeñaande e yamirooje e haɗaaɗi Aayeeje mun.

arabe: أَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا أَن كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّسۡرِفِينَ
traduction: E Min ngacciray njippinangol on jantoore ndeen, ɗuurngal on, fii on ngonii yimɓe fantinɓe?
explication: E Men acciray jippinirgol Alqur'aana e mon, ɗuurnoragol on, fii ko fantinirɗon kon sirku e geddi? Men waɗataa ɗum ! Tawde Meɗen yurmaa on.

arabe: وَكَمۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن نَّبِيّٖ فِي ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
traduction: Ɗuuɗii e Annabaaɓe ɓe Min nuli e adinooɓe ɓeen.
explication: Ɗuuɗii e Annabaaɓe ɓe Min nuli e mofte adinooɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
traduction: Annabaajo araali e maɓɓe, si wonaa ɓe njalkitay mo.
explication: Annabaajo Allah araano e ɗen mofte adinooɓe, si wanaa ɓe wonuno e jalkitugol mo.

arabe: فَأَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
traduction: Min kalki ko ɓuri ɓe saɗtude doole ! Toode mise adinooɓe ɓeen jawtiino.
explication: Men halkiino ko ɓuri ɗen mofte saɗtude jawlagol. Wanaa mofte ɓurɗe ɓen ɗon jaasude Men ronkata fii mun ! Toode mise halkanooɓe goo, yawtiino ka Alqur'aana; wano Aadi'en, e Samuuda'en, e yimɓe Luutu ɓen, e wondiiɓe Madyana ɓen.

arabe: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
traduction: Ko pellet, si a lamndike ɓe: "Ko hommbo tagi kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin?" Ɓe mbi'ay: "Ko pooluɗo, gannduɗo on tagi ɗii".
explication: Ko pellet, si an Nulaaɗo a lamndike ɓee sirkooɓe fennuɓe: wiide ko hommbo tagi kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin? Ɓe wi'ay: ko Fooluɗo Mo fooletaake On, Annduɗo kala huunde On tagi ɗi.

arabe: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
traduction: Oon mbaɗiranɗo on leydi ndin weertaandi, O waɗani on ɗate e mayri, fii no ɗoworon.
explication: Allah waɗiranɗo On leydi ndin weertaandi, ka rewnoton teppe mon, O waɗani on kadi laawi e pelle e naɗf mayri, fii no ɗoworon ɗe ka yahdu mon.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرٖ فَأَنشَرۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ
traduction: Oon jippinrɗo toɓo ka kammuu, yeru haaju, Min nguurnitiri ngo leydi maayndi. Ko noon yaltinirteɗon.
explication: On jippinirɗo ndiyam ka kammu, yeru ko yonata on onon e neemoraɗi mon e remuruuji mon. Men wuurnitiri ɗam, leydi yoorundi ndi alah puɗi. Ko non tigiri, woni ko Allah wuurnitiroyta on.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مَا تَرۡكَبُونَ
traduction: On takɗo nooneeji ɗin fow, O waɗirani on e laaɗe ɗen e neemoraaɗi ɗiin, ko mbaɗɗoron,
explication: On taguɗo kala nooneeji ɗin: wano jemma e ñaloram, gorel e deyel ekw, O waɗirani on e laaɗe ɗen e neemoraaɗi ɗin, ko waɗɗoron ka setagol mon: waɗɗoɗon laaɗe ɗen ka maayo, waɗɗoɗon neemoraaɗi ɗin ka njorndi.

arabe: لِتَسۡتَوُۥاْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ إِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُولُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ
traduction: fii yo on potondir e hoore majji, refti ngannditon neema Joomi mon on, tuma potondirɗon e majji, mb'on on tuma: "Senaare woodanii eeltanɗo min ɗuum On, min ngonaano taaqanaaɓe ɗum.
explication: On eltiranii on ɗum fow, fii yo on fotondir e hoore ko waɗɗotoɗon kon ka setagol mon, refti annditon neema Joomi mon On, tuma nde fotondirɗon e majji, wi'on ontuma: Laaɓal e senayee woodanii eltanɗo men ndii baɗɗateeri, menen on, men wonaano haɗtamɓe e mun, si wanaano Allah eltani men.

arabe: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
traduction: minen noon, ko ka Joomi amen woni ko min nduttotoo".
explication: Menen on, ko ka Joomi amen tun, woni ko men ruttoytoo, si men maayii, fii ñaaweede warjee.

arabe: وَجَعَلُواْ لَهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزۡءًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٞ مُّبِينٌ
traduction: Ɓe mbaɗani mo geɗal e jiyaaɓe Makko ɓeen ! Pellet, on neɗɗaŋke ko jedduɗo ɓannguɗo.
explication: Sirkooɓe ɓen aaƴii wonnde tagaaɓe goo, ko jibinaaɓe taguɗo On seniiɗo, tuma ɓe wi'unoo: Malaa'ika'en, ko ɓiɗɓe Allah rewɓe ! Pellet, neɗɗanke wi'oowo sugu ngol konngol, ko yedduɗo ɓannguɗo keeferaaku e majjere.

arabe: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنَاتٖ وَأَصۡفَىٰكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ
traduction: Kaa woo O jogiti ɓiɗɓe rewɓe e ko O tagi kon, O heertinani on ɓiɗɓe worɓe ɓeen?
explication: Kaa hara onon ɓee sirkooɓe, on wi'u wonnde Allah jogitanike hoore Makko ɓiɗɓe rewɓe, e ko O tagi kon, O heertinani on onon, ɓiɗɓe worɓe ɓen? Ko honɗum e senndoore woni kon ko aaƴiɗon?

arabe: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مَثَلٗا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدّٗا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
traduction: Si goɗɗo e maɓɓe wewliniraama ko o waɗirani kon Hinaranke On misal, ye'eso makko ngon niɓɓita metteendi hombo suuɗi.
explication: Si goɗɗo e maɓɓe wewliniraama jibinaneede ɓiɗɗo debbo ko o dammbunoo kon e Joomi makko, yeeso makko ngon niɓɓitira suno, metteendi ndi o wonndi. Ko honno non o dammbirta e Joomi makko, kon ko tikkinta mo, si o humpitiraama ɗum.

arabe: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُاْ فِي ٱلۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِينٖ
traduction: E ko on ne'eteeɗo e cuɗaari, hara kaŋko on ka yeddondiral, wonaa o ɓannginoowo haala?
explication: E ko on ne'eteeɗo e cuɗaari, hara kanko on ka yeddondiral, o ɓannginirtaa haala, sabu ndewaagu makko ngun?

arabe: وَجَعَلُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًاۚ أَشَهِدُواْ خَلۡقَهُمۡۚ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُونَ
traduction: Ɓe mbaɗi Malaa'ikaaɓe tawɓe ɓeen ko jiyaaɓe Joom yurmeende oon, rewɓe ! Kere ɓe seedino tageede ɓeen? Awa fii seedagol maɓɓe ngol winndete, ɓe lamnditoyee.
explication: Ɓe inni Malaa'ikaɓe tawɓe ɓen ko jeyaaɓe Jom Hinaranke On, rewɓe. Kere ɓe seedino fewndo Allah tagate ɓen, haa feeñani ɓe wonnde ko ɓe rewɓe? Awa fii ngol seedagol maɓɓe winndete, ɓe lamnditoyee fii mun, Ñalnde Darngal, ɓe leptiree nden fenaande maɓɓe.

arabe: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنَٰهُمۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'iti: "Si Joom yurmeende On haajuno, min ndewataano ɓe". Ɓe alanaa ɗuum hay e ganndal; ɓe ngonaani, si wonaa hiɓe pena.
explication: Ɓe wii hoɓe hujjaniro koddoruyee, ɓe wi'i: si Allah haajuno, men rewataano Malaa'ika'en. Tawde O haajii ɗum, hollii Himo welaa. Kono ɓe alanaa e kon ko ɓe wowlata, hay e ganndal; ɓee wonaali, si wanaa e fenugol.

arabe: أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُونَ
traduction: Kaa ko defftere Min ngaddani ɓe ado ndee ɗoo, hara ko nden woni ko ɓe njogitii?
explication: Kaa ko Deftere Men addani ɓee sirkooɓe, ado Alqur'aana, daginanaynde ɓe rewugol ko woori Allah, hara ko e nden Deftere woni ko ɓe dallinorta?

arabe: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
traduction: Si ko woni, ɓe mbi'iu: "Minen Min tawu baabiraaɓe amen ɓeen e diina, haray ko e batteeji maɓɓe min peewirta".
explication: Ko woni kon, ɓe dallinor finaa-tawaa wiide: memen men tawu baabiraaɓe amen ɓen e hoore diina, rewaynooɓe sanamu; haray ko e ɗin batteeji ɗon men rewata e mun.

arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي قَرۡيَةٖ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقۡتَدُونَ
traduction: Ko wano non, Min nulaali jeertinoowo aditaade ma e saare woo, si wonaa hooreeɓe maɓɓe neemiiɓe mbi'ay: "Minen Min tawu baabiraaɓe amen ɓen e diina, ɗum non ko batteeji maɓɓe ɗin men ñermtinta".
explication: Ko wano ɓee ɗoo fenniri non, ɓe dallinori baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen, ko non woniri Men nulaali jertinoowo yimɓe mun aditaade ma an Nulaaɗo, si wanaa hooreeɓe maɓɓe ɓen wi'ay: menen men tawu baabiraaɓe amen ɓen e dow diina, ɗum non ko batteeji maɓɓe ɗin men jokkata. Haray wanaa e maa woni ko adii e ɗum.

arabe: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِأَهۡدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَكُمۡۖ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
traduction: O maaki: "Hay si mi addan on ko ɓuri feewude kon ko tawruɗon baabiraaɓe mon ɓen?" Ɓe mbi'i: "Minen dey, ko min jedduɓe ko nulidaɗon e mum koon".
explication: Nulaaɗo maɓɓe on maakani ɓe: on jokkay tun baabiraaɓe mon ɓen, hay si mi addanii on ko ɓuri diina maɓɓe kan moƴƴude? Ɓe wi'i: memen dey, ko men yedduɓe ko nulidaɗon e mun kon.

arabe: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
traduction: Min njottii e maɓɓe. ndaare no battande fennuɓe ɓeen mba'unoo.
explication: Men yottii e ɗen mofte fennunooɓe Nulaaɓe mun ɓen ado maa, Men halki ɓe. Taskii no battane maɓɓe wa'unoo. Ko battane muusunooɗe wonunoo.

arabe: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِي بَرَآءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ
traduction: Jaŋto tuma Ibraahiima maakannoo been makko e yimɓe makko ɓeen: "Min on ko mi daɗndiiɗo e kon ko ndewoton,
explication: Janto kadi yo Nulaaɗo, tuma nde Ibraahiima maakannoo ben makko e yime makko ɓen: min on ko mi daɗndiiɗo e sanamuuji ɗi rewoton ɗin, gaanin Allah.

arabe: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهۡدِينِ
traduction: si wanaa On takɗo lam, Kaŋko oon, O feewnay kam".
explication: Si wanaa Allah taguɗo lam On, On ɗon fewnay lam e jokkugol diina focciika kan.

arabe: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةٗ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
traduction: O waɗi ngool konngol heddotoongol ɓaawo makko, mbelajo'o, ɓe nduttoto.
explication: O waɗi konngol tawhiidi ngol Ibraahiima maaki ngol, heddotoongol e ɓaawo makko, ngol mulataa e geyngol wootinɗinooɓe Allah ɓen ɓe kafidataa Mo e huunde. Belajo'o, ɓe ruttoray e Allah, tuubugol e sirku e geddi.

arabe: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: Si ko woni, Mi dakmitii ɓee ɗoo e baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓeen, haa nde goonga kan ngarnoo e maɓɓe, e Nulaaɗo ɓannguɗo.
explication: Mi hawjaano halkugol ɓee sirkooɓe fennuɓe, Mi dakmitirno ɓe e heddagol e aduna, kamɓe e baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen, haa nde Alqur'aana arunoo e maɓɓe, e Nulaaɗo ɓannguɗo, woni Muhammadu (Jom kisiyee).

arabe: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
traduction: Nde goonga kan arnoo e maɓɓe, ɓe mbi'i: "Ɗuum ko mbilewu, minen ko min njedduɓe ɗuum".
explication: Nde Alqur'aanaare nden ardirunooɓe goonga mo sikke alaa e mu'un, ɓe wi': ɗum ko ko Muhammadu woni mbilɗoraade men, menen non, ko men yedduɓe ɗum.

arabe: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ
traduction: Ɓe mb'iti: "Ko haɗno ndee Alqur'aanaare jippinee e gorko mawɗo ca'e ɗen ɗiɗi?"
explication: Sirkooɓe fennuɓe ɓen wi'i: ko hanno Allah jippinira Alqur'aana e gooto e worɓe koohooɓe Makka maa Taa'ifu ɓen? hara wanaa e Muhammadu baaso alyatimaajo oo?

arabe: أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضٗا سُخۡرِيّٗاۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
traduction: E ko kamɓe senndata yurmeende Joomi maa ndeen? Awa ko Minen ngoni ko senndi nguureeji maɓɓe ɗiin hakkunde maɓɓe, ka nguurndam aduna. Min ɓamti yoga maɓɓe e hoore ɓeya, darjaaji, fii no yoga maɓɓe jogitora yoga eeltane. Haray ko yurmeende Joomi maa ndeen, ɓuri moƴƴude e ko ko ɓe mooɓata.
explication: E ko kamɓe senndata yurmeende Joomi maa nden, an Nulaaɗo, sakko wona ɓe okkay nde mo ɓe yiɗani, ɓe ɗala nde mo ɓe haaji, kaa ko Allah? Awa ko Menen woni ko senndi arsikeeji maɓɓe ɗin hakkunde maɓɓe aduna, Men waɗi e maɓɓe alɗuɓe e waasuɓe, fii no yga maɓɓe wonira eltanaaɓe ɓeya. Haray, ko ko Joomi maa yurmetee jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen kon ka laakara, ɓuri moƴƴude e dii ko ɓee mooɓata e aduna lannoowo on.

arabe: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَن يَكۡفُرُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمۡ سُقُفٗا مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُونَ
traduction: Si wonaano fii wata yimɓe ɓeen ngon mofte goote, Min mbaɗayno e cuuɗi kala jedduɗo Hinnaranke Oon: kiɓɓe kaalisi e ŋabbirɗe ka ɓe ƴawra;
explication: Si wanaa fii wata yimɓe ɓen wonu e mofte goote ka keeferaaku, Men waɗayno e cuuɗi yedduɓe Allah ɓen: kiɓɓale kaalisi, e ŋabbirɗe ka ɓe ƴawra.

arabe: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
traduction: (Min mbaɗayno kadi) e cuuɗi maɓɓe ɗiin, dame e ndaɗɗude ka ɓe soɓɓindoo,
explication: Men waɗayno kadi e cuuɗi maɓɓe ɗin, dame e danɗe e ndaɗɗuɗe ka ɓe soɓɓindoo fii no ɓe unura e fitina on seeɗa-seeɗa.

arabe: وَزُخۡرُفٗاۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
traduction: e cuɗaari. Kono ɗuum fow wonaani, si wonaa dakamme nguurndam aduna. Ko La'akara on ka Joomi maa, woni fii gooŋɗinɓe ɓeen.
explication: Men waɗanayno ɓe kadi cuɗaari kaŋŋe. Kono ɗum fow wonaali, si wanaa ko dakamme nguurndam aduna; nafa mun ko seeɗa mo juutataa. Ko neema laakara on ka Joomi maa an Nulaaɗo, ɓuri moƴƴannde ɗoftiiɓe Allah ɓen, ɓe woɗɗitii e haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin.

arabe: وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَيۡطَٰنٗا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٞ
traduction: Kala ɗuurniiɗo e jaŋtoore Hinaranko On, Min nguurta mo e seytanuuru, hara ko ndun woni ko o coowodata.
explication: Kala ɗuurniiɗo e Alqur'aana, haa o ronki taskagol nde, haray o leptirte wuurteede e setaneeru ndu o seertataa e mun, ko ɓeyda mo bewre.

arabe: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
traduction: Ɗiin (awaseeji) noon, ko sakkorayɗi ɓe e peewal ngal, haa ka ɓe cikkata hiɓe peewi.
explication: Ɗin awaseeji coowodaaɗi non e ɓen ɗuuniiɓe Alqur'aana, ko sakkotooɗi ɓe e diina Allah kan, haa ɓe ronka ɗoftaade Mo, ɓe haɗitoo e haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, hara hiɓe sikka ko ɓe feewuɓe e goonga, ɓe ronka tuubude e nden majjere maɓɓe.

arabe: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ
traduction: Haa si o aroyii e Amin, o wi'a: "Ee bone ! hara hakkunde am e maa woɗɗirayno goɗɗal puɗɗirɗe ɗen ɗiɗi woɗɗiri ! A bonii cinndadiiɗo !".
explication: Haa si on ɗuurninooɗo jantoore Allah nden aroyii Ñalnde Darngal, o yelora wiide: ee bone ! hara hakkunde am e maa, an oo coowodaaɗo, woɗɗirayno goɗɗal fuɗnaange e hiirnaange woɗɗondiri ! Tawde a bonii coowodaaɗo !

arabe: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
traduction: [Ɗuum] nafataa on hannde - nde tawnoo on tooñii - won'de ko ka lepte kaawtuɗon.
explication: Allah daalana heeferɓe ɓen nden Ñalnde: ɗum nafataa on hannde - nde tawnoo on tooñiriino ko'e-mon sirku e geddi - wonnde on hawtoyte ka lepte. Ɓe sirkanɗon ɓe, ronnditantaako on huunde e lepte ɗen.

arabe: أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
traduction: E ko an naninta paaɗuɗo maa feewnaa bunɗo e on wonɗo e ndeer majjere ɓanngunde?
explication: Ɓee ko faaɗuɓe e nanugol goonga, wumiɗuɓe e yi'ugol mo. Hara non ko an Nulaaɗo, woni ko waawata naninnde faaɗuɗo maa fewna bunɗo maa majjuɗo laawol focciingol ngol?

arabe: فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
traduction: Si Min ngar ƴettitude ma,  ko Min yoɓottotooɓe e maɓɓe.
explication: Si Men aru ƴettitude ma ado Men leptude ɓe, haray doo ko Men yottorayɓe e maɓɓe, leptugol aduna e laakara.

arabe: أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ
traduction: maa hara Men holle ko Min kammbirani ɓeen kon, haray noon ko Min gaynooɓe fii maɓɓe.
explication: Maa hara Men holle yoga e ko lepte ɗe Men kammbirani ɓe ɗen, haray doo ko Men gaynooɓe fii maɓɓe. Ɓe haɗtanaa dartagol Men e huunde.

arabe: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
traduction: Jogito kon ko wahayinaa e maaɗa. Pellet, hiɗa jokki laawol pocciingol.
explication: An Nulaaɗo, jogito kon ko Joomi maa wahayini e maaɗa, golitiraa ɗum. Pellet, hiɗa jokki laawol goonga, ngol jilɓuya alah e mum.

arabe: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرٞ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ
traduction: Ndee non [Alqur'aanaare], ko nde teddungal maa an e yimɓe maa ɓeen. Aray nde laɓnditeeɗon.
explication: Ndee Alqur'aanaare non, ko teddungal maaɗa an e yimɓe maa. Arma nde lamnditeɗon fii gomɗingol nde ngol, e rewgol peewal hende ngal, e noddugol e mayre ngol Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةٗ يُعۡبَدُونَ
traduction: Lamndii e ɓeen Nulaaɓe Amen ɓe Min nulunoo ado maa, si Min mbaɗuno ko wanaa Hinnaranke On, deweteeɗi goo?
explication: An Nulaao, lamndii e ɓen ɓe Nulunoo ado maa, si tawii Men waɗuno tanaa Allaahu On, reweteeɗi goo?

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min immindinii Muusaa e aayeeje Amen ɗeen, haa e Fir'awna e mbatu mun ngun, o maaki: "Ko mi Nulaaɗo Jeyɗo tagoore".
explication: Gomɗii Men immindinii Muusaa e Aayeeje Amen ɗen, haa e Fir'awna e mbatu yimɓe makko ɓen, o maakani ɓe: ko mi Nulaaɗo Jeyɗo tageefo ngon fow.

arabe: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ
traduction: Nde o addannooɓe aayeeje Amen ɗren, e jaka yoo hiɓe njalaɗi.
explication: Nde o addannooɓe Aayeeje Amen ɗen, ɓe woni e jalugol ɗe jalkita.

arabe: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ أُخۡتِهَاۖ وَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
traduction: Min hollaali ɓe aaya, si wonaa haray on ɓuri adiiɗo mo on mawnude. Min nanngiri ɓe lepte ɗeen, mbelajo'o, ɓe nduttoto.
explication: Men hollaali Fir'awna e mbatu mun ngun hujja semmbinɗo ko Muusaa addi kon, si wanaa haray ko on ɓuri adiiɗo mo on mawnude. Men nanngiri ɓe lepte ɗen aduna, jortagol nde ɓe ɓoorotoo e keeferaaku, kono ɗum nafaano.

arabe: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Ko an yo mbileejo! Torano min Joomi maa, ko O ahodi kon e maaɗa. Pellet, ko min feewooɓe".
explication: Nde memi ɓe huunde e lepte, ɓe wi'ani Muusaa (yo o his): ko an yo mbileejo! Torano men Joomi maa, ko O jantimaa kon ka fii huncugol lepte ɗen, si wonii men gomɗinii. Tawde pellet, ko men feewooɓe, si O huncanii men lepte ɗen.

arabe: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ
traduction: Nde Min huncannooɓe lepte ɗeen, e jaka yoo, hiɓe pirta [ahadi].
explication: Nde Men huncannooɓe lepte ɗen, e jaka yoo, hiɓe firta ahadi maɓɓe ndin.

arabe: وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِي مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِيٓۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
traduction: Fir'awna noddi e yimɓe ɓeen, o wi'i: "Ko onon yo yimɓe am, wanaa miin jey laamu Misra? E hino ɗii canɗi no ila e ley kuɓeeji am? E on nji'ataa?
explication: Fir'awna noddi e yimɓe makko ɓen, o woni e mantorgol laamu makko ngun, wi'angol ɓe: ko onon yo yimɓe am, wanaa min jey laamu Misra? E hino ɗii canɗi Niilu ngol hino ila e ley kuɓeeje am? E on yi*aani laamu am ngun, haa anndon mawngu am ngun?

arabe: أَمۡ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٞ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
traduction: Kaa mi ɓuraa teddude oo koyɗo mo eɓɓataa laɓɓinnde haala?
explication: Ko min ɓuri teddungal, e dii Muusaa lo'uɗo, on mo lobbintaa haala.

arabe: فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةٞ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ
traduction: Awa ko hanno jawe kaŋŋe mbrnee e makko? Ma Malaa'ika'en arda e makko, na jokkondiri?"
explication: Awa ko hanno Allah werloo jawe kaŋŋe, e oo mo O nuli, no o hollira wonnde ko o Nulaaɗo Makko? Maaɗum Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen arda e makko nun, hara ko ɓe jokkondirɓe?

arabe: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
traduction: O ɗaytini yimɓe makko ɓen, ɓe ɗowtii mo. Pellet, ɓeen ɗon laatino yimɓe faasiqiiɓe.
explication: Fir'awna ɗaytini ɗaytini yimɓe makko ɓen, ɓe ɗoftii majjere makko nden. Pellet, ɓen ɗon laatino yimɓe yaltuɓe e ɗoftaare Allah.

arabe: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
traduction: Nde ɓe tikkinnoo Min, Min yottii e maɓɓe; Min njooli ɓe fof.
explication: Nde ɓe tikkinirnoo Men haɓɓitagol e keeferaaku ngun, Men yottii e maɓɓe; Men yooli ɓe fow maɓɓe.

arabe: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفٗا وَمَثَلٗا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ
traduction: Min mbaɗi ɓe ardiiɓe e yeru, wonan'de sakkiitiiɓe ɓeen.
explication: Men waɗi Fir'awna e yimɓe mun ɓen, adiiɓe yimɓe ɓen e keeferaaku, Men waɗti ɓe waajitorteeɓe, wonannde kala waajitoriiɗo ɓe, fii wata sugu mun heɓu ɗum.

arabe: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّونَ
traduction: Tuma nde geɗal neene Maryama on piyiranoo misal, tawaa yoo, yimɓe maa ɓeen no sooƴira ɗuum.
explication: Nde sirkooɓe ɓen sikkunoo wonnde Iisaa, Mo Annasaara'en rewata on, hino jeyaa e ɓe Allah daali fii mun ɓen :"Pellet, onon e ko rewoton kon gaanin Allah, ko on carmalle Jahannama. Ko on joloyayɓe e magge", e hino le Allah haɗii rewugol mo, no O haɗiri rewugol sanamuuji ɗin non, tawaa yoo, yimɓe maa ɓen, an Nulaaɗo, hino sonka wennjondiree, ɓe wi'i: men weltorii tawde reweteeɗo amen on, ko martaba Iisaa woni. Allah jippini ɗon kisan, ko raddira ɓe: "Pellet, ɓen ɓe moƴƴi ɗin adanii ɗum ka Amen, ɓen ɗon ko woɗɗintinteeɓe e magge"

arabe: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ هُوَۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلَۢاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُونَ
traduction: ɓe mbi'i: "Ko deweteeɗi amen ɗin ɓuri moƴƴude, kaa ko Kaŋko?" Ɓe piyiranaali ma ngal (misal), si wonaa fii wennjugol. Wurin, ko ɓe yimɓe saɗtuɓe mbeñe.
explication: Ɓe wi'i: Ko reweteeɗi amen ɗin ɓuri moƴƴude, kaa ko iisaa? Ibn az-Ziba’raa e nanndo makko piyiranaali ngal misal, fii heɓugol yottaade ka, ko fii tun wennjodnireede. Ɓen ko yimɓe saɗtuɓe wennje.

arabe: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبۡدٌ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَثَلٗا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
traduction: Awa (Iisaa) wonaani, si wanaa jiyaaɗo mo Min neemini e mum, Min mbaɗi mo yeru wonan'de ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓeen.
explication: Iisaa geɗal Maryama on wonaali, si wanaa jeyaaɗo Allah, mo Men neeminiri Annabaaku e Nuleede, Men waɗi mo misal wonannde ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen, ko ɓe dallinora e kattal Allah ngal, nde tawnoo O tagirmo ko aldaa e baaba, wano O tagiri Aadama ko aldaa e jibimɓe.

arabe: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ
traduction: Si Moen kaajuno, Min waɗtitirayno on Malaa'ika, ko lomtoo ka leydi.
explication: Si Men haajuno gaynugol fii mon, onon ɓiɗɓe Aadama ɓen, Men waɗirayno ɗum, waɗtitirgol on Malaa'ika, ko lomtoo on ka leydi, ɓe wona e rewugol Allah, hara ɓe kafidataa Mo e goɗɗum.

arabe: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلۡمٞ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
traduction: Pellet non, ko o anndinorde Darngal. Wota on cikkito fii maggal. Jokkee kam, ko ɗuum woni laawol Pocciingol ngol.
explication: Ko pellet, Iisaa ko maande jeyaande e maandeeji Darngal mawɗi ɗin, tuma o jippoytoo ka jamaanu sakkitoru. Wata on sikkito fii ɗum. Jokkee lam e ko mi addi kon immorde ka Allah, ko ɗum woni laawol focciingol ngol.

arabe: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: Wota seytaane falo on ! tawde pellet, ko o gaño mon ɓannguɗo.
explication: Wata seytaane falor on e laawol focciingol ngol, ɗayne e koomte maako ɗen ! tawde pellet, ko o gaño mon ɓannginɗo ngayngu.

arabe: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
traduction: Nde Iisaa ardunoo e ɓannguɗi ɗin, o maaki: "Gooŋɗii mi ardanii on e ñeeñal, e no mi ɓannginirana on yoga e ko luutondirɗon e muuɗum. Haray kulee Allah, ɗoftoɗon mi.
explication: Nde Iisaa (jom kisiyee) on ardannoo yimɓe makko ɓen hujjaaji ɓannginɗi Nulala makko ngal, o maakani ɓe: Gomɗii mi ardanii on e ñeeñal immorde ka Allah, e no ɓannginirana on yoga e ko luutondirɗon e mun, ka diina mon. Haray huliree Allah, ɗoftagol yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin, e woɗɗitagol haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin. Ɗofton mi e ko yamirta on kon, rentoɗon e ko mi haɗi on e mun kon.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
traduction: Pellet, ko Alla Woni Joomi am e Joomi mon. Ndewee Mo. Ko ɗuum woni laawol pocciingol ngol".
explication: Pellet, ko Allah woni Joomi am e Joomi mon. Reweteeɗo goo alanaa en. Laɓɓinanee mo Kanko tun, dewe ɗen. Ko ɗum woni laawol focciingol ngol.

arabe: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ أَلِيمٍ
traduction: Feddeeji ɗiin luutondiri hakkunde majji. Bone woodanii ɓen yedduɓe, immorde e lepte ñalaande mu'usuuɗe !
explication: Feddeeji Annasaara ɗin luutondiri hakkunde maɓɓe, fii Iisaa: woɗɓe wi'i: ko o reweteeɗo, woɗɓe ɓen wi'i: ko o ɓiɗɗo Allah, woɗɓe goo wi'i: kanko fow e neene makko, ko ɓe reweteeɓe. Awa bone woodanii ɓen tooñirɓe ko'e mun, siforgol Iisaa reweteeɗo, maa ɓiɗɗo maa tammo tammitaaɓe, immorde e lepte muusuɗe, habbitiiɗe ɓe Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
traduction: Hara ɓe habbi si wpnaa nde Darngal ngal ardata ɓe e juhal, hara ɓe so'aa anndude?
explication: Hara ɗii feddeejii luutondirɗi fii Iisaa no habbii si wanaa nde Darngal ngal ardata ɓe e juhal, hara ɓe so'aa anndude fii ɗum? Si ngal arii ɓe e fewndo keeferaaku maɓɓe, haray battane maɓɓe, ko lepte muusuɗe.

arabe: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
traduction: Welduɓe ɓeen, nden ñalnde, yoga maɓɓe ko ayrooɓe yoga; si wonaa gooŋɗuiɓe ɓeen.
explication: Weldunɓe yiɗindiri ɓen e majjere keeferaaku, yoga maɓɓe ayroyay yoga, Ñalnde Darngal; si wanaa hulirɓe Allah ɓen, ɗoftagol yamaruyeeji Makko ɗin, woɗɗitoo e haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin. Ɓen ɗon, weldigal maɓɓe ngal duumoto.

arabe: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ
traduction: Ko onon yo jiyaaɓe Am ! Kulol alanaa on hannde; wonaa on sunotooɓe kadi.
explication: Allah daalano ɓen gomɗumɓe: Ko onon yo jeyaaɓe Am ! Kulol alanaa on hannde, e fii ko yawtiri on kon; wanaa on sunorayɓe kadi, fii geɓoy aduna yawtukoy.

arabe: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
traduction: ɓeen gooŋɗinɓe Aayeeje Amen ɗeen, ɓe ngoni jebbiliiɓe,
explication: Ɓen gomɗimɓe Alqur'aanaare jippiinde nden e Nulaaɗo maɓɓe on, ɓe woni jebbilaniiɓe nde; waajitoray ɓe, ɓe haɗitora kaɗaaɗi mayre kadi.

arabe: ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ أَنتُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُونَ
traduction: naatee ka Aljanna, onon e nannduɓe e mon, hoɗon saɗnee".
explication: Naatee ka Aljanna, onon e nannduɓe e mon gomɗinal, hara hiɗon weltora neemaaji duumotooɗi, ɗi lannataa, taƴondirtaa.

arabe: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافٖ مِّن ذَهَبٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
traduction: [Gollooɓe] hino wannginee e maɓɓe, mirannji kaŋŋe e yedduɗe; hino ton kadi: kala ko wonkii muuyetee, gite dakmitoo. Hara le, ko on duumotooɓe toon.
explication: Gollooɓe hino wanngindinee e maɓɓe, miranji kaŋŋe e ñedduɗe yooɗuɗe. Hino ka Aljanna ton: kala ko wonkii muuyetee, gite dakmitora ndaarugol. Hara non, ko on duumotooɓe ton, on yaltatah haa poomaa.

arabe: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: Ko on ngoni Aljanna mo roniniraɗon, sabu ko ko ngollaynoɗon.
explication: Ko on Aljanna mo sifanaɗon fii mun, woni mo Allah roniniri on ɓural Makko, sabu kon ko gollaynoɗon.

arabe: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ كَثِيرَةٞ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
traduction: Hino woodani on toon, muuyanteeɗi ɗuuɗuɗi, ɗi ñaamoton e mum.
explication: Hino woodani on ton, muuyanteeɗi ɗuuɗuɗi, ɗi taƴondirtaa, ko e ɗin ñaamoton.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
traduction: Pellet, bonɓe ɓen, ko ka lepte Jahannama ɓe luttoyta,
explication: Pellet, bonnirɓe keeferaaku e geddi ɓen, ko ka lepte Janhannama ɓe luttoyta Ñalnde Darngal, ɓe heddoo ton poomaa.

arabe: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
traduction: ɓe koynantaake, tee hara ko ɓe taƴiiɓe toon.
explication: Ɓe hoynantaake lepte ɗen, wurin hara ko ɓe taƴiiɓe e yurmeende Allah nden.

arabe: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
traduction: Min tooñaani ɓe few, si ko woni, ko kamɓe woni tooñuɓe ɓeen.
explication: Men tooñiraali ɓe naadugol ɓe Yiite, si ko woni, ko kamɓe tooñirnoo ko'e maɓɓe keeferaaku.

arabe: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
traduction: Ɓe nodda: "Ko an yo Maaliku ! Yo Joomi maa gaynu fii amen !" O wi'i: "Pellet, ko on luttooɓe [toon] !"
explication: Ɓe nodda Malaa'ikaajo halfinaaɗo Yiite ngen on, ɓe wi'a: ko an yo Maaliku ! Yo Joomi maa gaynu fii amen, men foofto e lepte ɗen. O jaabitoo ɓe: pellet, ko e ɗen lepte luttoton poomaa, on maayataa ton, sakko lepte ɗen taƴondira e mon.

arabe: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
traduction: "Gooŋɗii Min ngaddanii on goonga kan ; kono ɗuuɗuɓe e mon, ko añɓe goonga".
explication: Gomɗii Men addanno on goonga ka sikke alaa e mu'un ; kono ɗuuɗuɓe e mon, ko añunooɓe goonga.

arabe: أَمۡ أَبۡرَمُوٓاْ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّا مُبۡرِمُونَ
traduction: Kaa ɓe eɓɓu fehre ? Doo ko Min fewjooɓe !
explication: Si ɓe fewjanii Annabiijo on (yo o his), haray doo ko Men fewjanooɓe ɓe feere ɓurnde nden ɗon.

arabe: أَمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوَىٰهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
traduction: Maa hara ɓe cikku Min nanataa gunndooji maɓɓe e sirru maɓɓe? Oo’owoye! Nulaaɓe Amen ɓeen hino maandina takko maɓɓe.
explication: Kaa hara ɓe sikku wonnde Men nanataa gunndooji maɓɓe ɗin e sirruuji maɓɓe ɗin? Ko pellet, Men nanay ɗi fow ! Wuri Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen hino maandina kala ko ɓe huuwi.

arabe: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٞ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡعَٰبِدِينَ
traduction: Maaku: "Si Hinaranko on no njogitii ɓiɗɗo, ko miin adotonoo rewude oon".
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maakan dammbuɓe ɓiɗɓe rewɓe ɓen e Allah: wonnde O siforaali jogitagol ɓiɗɗo ! O laaɓii O senike e ɗum ! Si ɗum wonuno, ko min woni adiiɗo rewude Alla ceniiɗo O.

arabe: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
traduction: Senaare woodanii Jeyɗo kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin, Jeyɗo Arsi kin; laaɓuɗo e kon ko ɓe cifrotta mo.
explication: Senyanee woodanii Jeyɗo kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, Jeyɗo kadi Arsi kin e kon ko ɓee sirkooɓe dammbirta Mo debbo e ɓiɗɗo.

arabe: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
traduction: Accuɓe ɓe jumpa, ɓe pija haa ɓe hawroya e ñalaande maɓɓe ndeɓe fodaa.
explication: Nulaaɗo, accuɓe ɓe jumpa e meere nde ɓe woni e mun, ɓe fija haa ɓe hawroya e ñalaande maɓɓe nde ɓe fodaa, ndeen woni Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٞ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَٰهٞۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
traduction: Ko Kaŋko woni On deweteeɗo ka kammu e deweteeɗo ka leydi, ko Kaŋko kadi woni Ñeeño, gannduɗo On.
explication: Ko Kanko Allah woni reweteeɗo e goonga On ka kammu e ka leydi, ko Kanko kadi woni Ñeeño e tagu Mun e eɓɓoore Mun e toppitagol Mun, Annduɗo fiyakuuji jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Mo tawata huunde suuɗaaki Mo e fii maɓɓe.

arabe: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
traduction: Barke heewanii on mo woodani ɗum, laamu kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin e ko woni hakkunde majji. Ko ka makko anndal fii Darngal woni. Ko ka makko kadi ndutteteɗon.
explication: Moƴƴere Allah e barki Makko ɓeydanike Mo, Kanko On Mo woodani ɗum laamu kammuuli ɗin e leyd ndin e ko woni hakkunde majji. Ko ka Makko tun, anndal fii daragol Darngal woni, goɗɗo goo anndaa ɗum. Ko ka Makko tun kadi, woni ruttorde mon laakara, fii ñaaweede yoɓitee.

arabe: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Ɗi ɓe ndewata ɗin ga makko jeyah tefoore, si wonaa seediiɓe goonga ɓeen, hara heɓe nganndi.
explication: Ɗi sirkooɓe ɓen rewata ɗin acca Allah, ɗi waawataa tefoygol ka Allah, si wanaa ɓen seediiɓe konngol liimaanu ngol, hara hiɓe anndi ko ɓe seedii kon: wano Iisaa, e‘Uzayru, e Malaa'ika'en.

arabe: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
traduction: Ko pellet, si a lamndike ɓe, ko hommbo woni ko tagi ɓe? Ɓe mbi'ay: "Ko Allah". Ko holno non ɓe njiiliraa?
explication: Ko pellet, si a lamndike ɓe, ko hommbo woni ko tagi ɓe? Ɓe wi'ete: Ko Allah. Ko honno non ɓe yiiliraa e rewugol Mo, ɓaawo ɓe qirritaade ɗum?

arabe: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
traduction: [Himo anndi kadi] fii ko (Nulaaɗo) oon maakunoo kon: "Ko an yo Joomi, pellet, ɓee ko yimɓe ɓe ngooŋɗintaa".
explication: Allah hino anndi kadi fii ko Nulaaɗo wullitornoo fennugol yimɓe makko ɓen, nde ɓe maakunoo: ko an Joomi, pellet, ɓee ko yimɓe ɓe gomɗitaa ko nuluɗaa lam e maɓɓe kon.

arabe: فَٱصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلَٰمٞۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Yaafo ɓe, maakaa: "Kisal !" Aray ndebe ngannda.
explication: Awa ɗuurno ɓe, maakanaa ɓe ko duñata bone maɓɓe on - ɗum ko Makka waɗi - aray nde annda ko sabbitiiɓe kon e yaggineede.

arabe: حمٓ
traduction: Haa, miim.[1]
explication: Haa, Miim. Yewtere fii sugu ɗee kalfe yawtiino ka simoore Al baqarah.

arabe: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii defere ɓanngunde nde !
explication: Allah woondirii Deftere ɓannginnde laawol peewal ngol.

arabe: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
traduction: Min njippinirii nde e jemma barkinaaɗo, Min siforii won'de jeertinooɓe.
explication: Men jippinirii Alqur'aana, e jemma laylatul qadiri: jemma hebbiniraaɗo barki, Men siforii wonde jertinirooɓe ndee Alqur'aanaare.

arabe: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ
traduction: Ko e on (jehma) woni ko seerndetee kala fiyaaku ñeñaaɗo.
explication: Ko e nder on jemma, woni ko kala fiyaaku ñeñaaɗo, humondirɗo e arsike maa lajal ekn, woni ko Allah siinata e nden hitaande.

arabe: أَمۡرٗا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
traduction: Ɗuum ko yamiroore immorde ka amen. Min siforii won'de Nulooɓe.
explication: Meɗen senndira kala fiyaaku ñeñaaɗo immorde ka Amen. Men siforii wonde imminooɓe Nulaaɓe.

arabe: رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
traduction: yurmeende immornde ka Joomi maa. Pellet, ko Kaŋko woni Nanoowo, gannduɗo oon.
explication: Meɗen imminira Nulaaɓe ɓen, yurmeende Joomi maa an Nulaaɗo, yurmegol Nulaaɓe e mun ɓen. Pellet, Kanko Allah, ko O Nanoowo haalaaji jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Annduɗo kuuɗe e annuyeeji maɓɓe ɗin. Hunnde e ɗin suuɗaaki Mo.

arabe: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
traduction: Jeyɗo kammuuji ɗiin e leydi ndiin e ko woni kon hakkunde majji, si wonii ko on yananaaɓe.
explication: Jeyɗo kadi kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin e ko woni kon hakkunde majji, si wonii ko on yananaaɓe ɗum, haray gomɗinee Nulaaɓe Am ɓen.

arabe: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
traduction: Deweteeɗo goo alaa, si wanaa Kaŋko. Homo wuurna, Himo wara. Jeyɗo on Jeyi baabiraaɓe mon aramɓe ɓeen.
explication: Reweteeɗo e goonga woo alaa, si wanaa Kanko. Himo wuurna, Himo wara, wuurnoowo wara alaa, si wana Kanko. Jeyɗo on Jeyi baabiraaɓe mon adinooɓe ɓen.

arabe: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ
traduction: Ko woni tan, ɓe wonii e sikke, heɓe pija.
explication: Ɓee sirkooɓe yananaaka e ɗum. Si ko woni, hiɓe sikkitiiɗi ɗum, ɓe woni e fijugol e meere.

arabe: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٖ مُّبِينٖ
traduction: Habbito ñande kammu ngun ardata e curki feeñuuki,
explication: Habbitoyo Nulaaɗo, lepte yimɓe maa ɓadiiɗe hewtuɗe, ñalnde kammu ngun ardata e curki feeñayngu e gite maɓɓe, hakkee ko ɓe sattina heege muusnge.

arabe: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
traduction: suddayki yimɓe ɓen. [Ɓe mbi'anee]: "Ɗuum ko lepte mu'usuuɗe" !
explication: Hara curki kin hino sudda yimɓe ɓen, ɓe wi'anee ontuma: ko lepte muusuɗe woni ko heɓi on.

arabe: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
traduction: "Joomi amen, huncan min lepte ɗeen. Minen ko men gooŋɗinɓe".
explication: Ɓe wona e tororgol Joomi maɓɓe wi'ugol: Joomi amen, huncan men ɗee lepte, haray ko men gomɗinooɓe ma e Nulaaɗo Maa on, si A huncanii men ɗe.

arabe: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: Ko honno ɓe mbaajitorta, ko goongo Nulaaɗo ɓannginɗo ariino ɓe?
explication: Ko honno ɓe waajitorta, ɓe tuubana Joomi maɓɓe, hara le Nulaaɗo ariino ɓe, ɓannginani ɓe Nulal ngal, ɓe anndi le ko o goonguɗo hoolniiɗo?

arabe: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٞ مَّجۡنُونٌ
traduction: Refti ɓe nduŋti, ɓe mb'i: "Ko tinndinaaɗo, kaangaaɗo".
explication: Refti ɓe ɗuurnii e goongingol mo ngol, ɓe wi'i mo: ko goɗɗo goo woni e anndinnde mo, o wonah Nulaaɗo, haa ɓe wi'oyi: ko o haangaaɗo.

arabe: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
traduction: Awa ko Min ittooɓe lepte ɗen seeɗa; kono pellet, ko on ruttitotooɓe.
explication: Tuma Men huncani on lepte ɗen yeru seeɗa; pellet, on ruttitoto e keeferaaku e fennugol mon ngol.

arabe: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
traduction: Ñande Min nanngiroyta bippannde mawnde nden, pellet, ko Min yoɓtoytooɓe.
explication: Habbito ɓe yo Nulaaɗo, haa Ñalnde Men nanngiroyta yimɓe maa yedduɓe ɓen, wippannde manwde nden Badri, haray pellet, ko Men yottoytooɓe e ko ɓe yeddiri kon Allah, ɓe fenni Nulaaɗo Makko on.

arabe: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ كَرِيمٌ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min njarribinoke ado maɓɓe, yimɓe Fir'awna ɓen, Nulaaɗo tedduɗo ari e maɓɓe,
explication: Gomɗii Men jerribinoke ado maɓɓe, yimɓe Fir'awna ɓen, Nulaaɗo Allah tedduɗo, ari e maɓɓe, himo nodda ɓe e wootinɗingol rewa Allah: on woni Muusaa (yo o his).

arabe: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
traduction: won'de: "mbaɗee e juuɗe am, jiyaaɓe Allah ɓeen. Min ko mi Nulaaɗo e mon, koolniiɗo.
explication: Muusaa maakani Fir'awna e yimɓe mun ɓen: accidee lam e ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen, tawde ko ɓe jeyaaɓe Allah. Haqqe alanaa on e maccinɗingol ɓe. Awa min wonannde on, ko mi Nulaaɗo Allah e mon, hoolniiɗo e ko Allah nuli lam yottingol kon, mi ɗuytataa mi ɓeydataa e mun.

arabe: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
traduction: E won'de wota on townitano Allah, tawde mi addanay on hujja ɓannguɗo.
explication: E wonde wata townitanor Allah, tertagol rewude Mo, townitanoo jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, tawde min on, mi addanay on hujja ɓannguɗo.

arabe: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
traduction: Min kadi noon, mi moolorii Jeyɗo kam oon Jeyi on, nde piɗotonmi kaaƴe.
explication: Min kadi non, mi moolorii Jeyɗo lam On Jeyi on, nde warirtonmi kaaƴe.

arabe: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
traduction: Si on ngooŋɗinaa kam, haray celee kam".
explication: Si on gomɗinaa ko mi addi kon, haray woɗɗitee lam, hara on hewtiraali lam bone.

arabe: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
traduction: O noddi Joomi makko, won'de: "Ɓee ɗoo, ko yimɓe bonɓe".
explication: Annabi Muusaa noddiri Joomi mun, wonnde ɓee yimɓe Fir'awna ɗoo e dental mun ɗoo, ko bomɓe hannduɓe e yaccinaneede lepte.

arabe: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
traduction: "Yaadir e jiyaaɓe Am ɓen jehma; nganndon ko on sukketeeɓe.
explication: Allah yamiri Muusaa yaadugol e yimɓe makko ɓen jemma, O humpiti mo, wonnde Fir'awna e yimɓe non, ko jokkitooɓe mo.

arabe: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
traduction: Ngaccaa maayo ngoon deeƴa [si on lummbii] ɓeya kan, ko konu yooleteengu".
explication: Allah yamiri mo lummbidugol e ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen ka maayo, O acca ngo ko deeƴa, tawde Fir'awna e konu mun ngun, kalkirete yooleteede ka maaya.

arabe: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
traduction: Ɗuuɗii ko ɓe ngacci e gese e ɓulli,
explication: Ɗuuɗii ko Fir'awna e yimɓe mun acci ɓaawo maɓɓe, immorde e gese e ɓulli ilooji.

arabe: وَزُرُوعٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ
traduction: e remuruuji e koɗan'de tedduɗe,
explication: Ɓe acci kadi remuruujo e koɗanɗe labaaɗe.

arabe: وَنَعۡمَةٖ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
traduction: e dokke ɓe ngonnoo e neeminireede.
explication: E koɓe acci caggal mum en e nguurndam ɓe wonunoo neeminireede.

arabe: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
traduction: Ko wano noon. Hooti Min ndonini ɗi yimɓe woɓɓe.
explication: Ko wano siforanoɗon non, feƴƴirnoo e maɓɓe. Men ronini ɗin neemaaji maɓɓe, yimɓe goo, ɓen woni ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen.

arabe: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
traduction: Kammu nguun toɓaali ɓe, wonaa leydi ndin, ɓe ngonaani kadi muñanteeɓe.
explication: Kammu ngun wullaali yoolagol Fir'awna e yimɓe mun ɓen, wanaa leydi ndin, ɓe wonaali kadi muññoranteeɓe no ɓe tuubira.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min ndaɗndii ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓeen e lepte koyneeje;
explication: Gomɗii Men daɗndii ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓn e lepte hoynooje, tawde Fi'awna e yimɓe mun ɓen, laatino warooɓe ɓiɗɓe maɓɓe worɓe, ɓe acca rewɓe ɓen.

arabe: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
traduction: immorde e Fir'awna, tawde o laatino townitiiɗo, jiyaaɗo e fantimɓe ɓeen.
explication: Men daɗndi mo e lepte Fir'awna ɗen, tawde o wonuno mawnintiniiɗo fantini e yawitagol yamaruyee e diina Allah kan.

arabe: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min cuɓorike ɓe e dow ganndal e hoore winndere ndeen,
explication: Gomɗii Men suɓorike ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen e dow anndal Amen, e hoore winndere jamaanu maɓɓe, tawde ɓe ɗuuɗirano Annabaaɓe.

arabe: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٞاْ مُّبِينٌ
traduction: Min ngokki ɓe Ma'andeeji, ɗi jarrabuyee ɓannguɗo woni e mum.
explication: Men okki ɓe hujjaaji ɗi Men semmbiniri Muusaa, ɗi neema feeñirani ɓe e mun, wano manna e colli juɗaaɗi.

arabe: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
traduction: Ɓee kan no mbi'a:
explication: Ɓee sirkooɓe fennooɓe no wi'a e yeddugol ummital:

arabe: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
traduction: "Ndee wonaani, si wonaa maayde amen aranere nden tan. Min wonatah immintinoyteeɓe.
explication: Ndee maayde wonaali, si wanaa aranere nden tun, men wonaali kadi immintinoyteeɓe ɓaawo mun.

arabe: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
traduction: Awa artiree baabiraaɓe amen ɓeen, si wonii ko on gooŋɗuɓe".
explication: Awa Muhammadu, an e jokkuɓe ma ɓen, artiree baabiraaɓe amen maaynooɓe ɓen, si wonii ko e goonga wonɗon, wonnde Allah immintinay maayɓe ɓen, fii ñaaweede yoɓitee.

arabe: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
traduction: Kere ko kamɓe ɓuri moƴƴude kaa ko yimɓe "Tubba'in" ɓeen e ɓeya adinooɓe ɓe? Min kalkuno ɓeen, tawde hari ko ɓe bonɓe.
explication: Kere ko ɓee sirkooɓe fennuɓe ma an Nulaaɗo, ɓuri cemmbe e neema, kaa ko yimɓe "Tubba'in" ɓen e ɓeya adinooɓe ɓe, wano 'Adi'en e Samuuda'en, Men halkuno ɓen fow, tawde ko ɓe laatina bomɓe.

arabe: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
traduction: Min tagiraali kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin e ko woni hakkunde majji kon, fijooɓe.
explication: Me tagiraali kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin e ko woni hakkunde majji kon, fijooɓe e ɗum.

arabe: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Min tagiraali ɗin ɗiɗi, si wonaa e goonga. Kono ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e maɓɓe, ɓe nganndaa.
explication: Men tagiraali kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, si wanaa fii ñeñƴal faandaangal. Kono ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e sirkooɓe ɓen, ɓe anndaa ɗum.

arabe: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
traduction: Pellet, ko Ñalaande Seerndindiro ngon, woni ko ɓe saatinanaa, kamɓe fof.
explication: Pellet, ko Ñalnde Darngal, woni ko Allah saatini senndindirgol hakkunde jeyaaɓe ɓen, ɓe fow maɓɓe, tuma ɓe mooɓindiraa.

arabe: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلٗى شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
traduction: Ñalnde nde giɗo duncanoytaa giɗo [mum] hay hu'unde; ɓe wonaani kadi walloyteeɓe,
explication: Ñalnde nde giɗo woo nafoytaa giɗo mun ; ɓe wonaali kadi daɗooɓe lepte Allah ɗen, tawde Laamu ngun nden Ñalnde, ko Allah woodani, wanaa goɗɗo e nodditoraynooɓe ngu.

arabe: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: si wonaa mo Allah yurmaa woo. Pellet, ko Kaŋko woni pooluɗo, jurmotooɗo On.
explication: Si wanaa neɗɗo mo Allah yurmaa woo, on ɗon nafitoroy golle makko moƴƴe ɗen. Pellet, Allah ko Fooluɗo Mo fooletaake, Hinnotooɗo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
traduction: Pellet, lekki Zaqquumi Kini.
explication: Pellet, leggal Zaqquumi ngal Allah fuɗini ngal ka asli Yiite,

arabe: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ
traduction: ko ñaametee bakkodinɓe ɓeen.
explication: Ko ngal woni ñaamdu ɗuuɗuɓe bakkaatu ɓen, woni heefero o na nyaama e ɓesnooje makki coɓɗe ɗe.

arabe: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ
traduction: A sikkay ko taayinaa ; hino fata ka ndeer deedi.
explication: Nde ɓesnaande na nanndi e nebban ɓale nde taayinaa, hara hino fata e deedi maɓɓe ɗin, hakkee ko wuli.

arabe: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
traduction: Wano ngulɗam fatirta.
explication: Wano ndiyam wulɗam jaw nguli fatirta.

arabe: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
traduction: Nanngee mo pooɗiron ka hakkunde dulɓatnge.
explication: Ayninaayɓe Yiite ngen wi'anee: nanngee mo pooɗiron doole, haa ka hakkunde Jahiimi.

arabe: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
traduction: refti njuppon ka hoore makko, lepte patinaaɗe ɗeen.
explication: Refti yuppon ka hoore makko, ndiyam fasnaaɗam ɗam, hara o seertataa e lepte ɗen.

arabe: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ
traduction: Meeɗu noon ! Asn [sikkunooɗo] ko a poolɗo, tedduɗo.
explication: O wi'anee ontuma: awa meeɗu non lepte muusuɗe ɗen ! An sikkunooɗo ko a fooluɗo mo dartetaake, tedduɗo hakkunde yimɓe mun.

arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
traduction: Awa ko ɗuum woni kon ko cikkitiɗon e mum.
explication: Awa ko ɗee lepte woni ko sikkitinoɗon si laatotono Ñalnde Darngal sikke iwii e mon caggal On fellitii hannde.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٖ
traduction: Pellet, gooŋɗuɓe ɓren ngonii e weerde koolniinde,
explication: Pellet, hulirɓe Joomi mun ɓen ɗoftagol Mo haɗitoo e haɗaaɗi Makko, ɓen wonii e weerde hoolniinde e kala bone.

arabe: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
traduction: e ndeer gese e ɓulli,
explication: E nder gese e ɓulli ilayɗi.

arabe: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٖ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
traduction: heɓe ɓoornoo ko ɗaati e ko tekki, hara hiɓe peewtondiri.
explication: Hiɓe ɓoornoo ka Aljanna ton, comci ɗaatuɗi e tekkuɗi, hara hiɓe fewtondiri, ɓe runtandirtaa.

arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ
traduction: Ko wano noon. Min ndesini ɓe kadi yaacɓe gite.
explication: Ko wano Men teddiniri ɓe non ɗin jantaaɗi, Men resiniri ɓe kadi ka Aljanna, rewɓe yaajuɓe gite, tiiɗuɓe ɓaleeri gite.

arabe: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
traduction: Hiɓe nodda toon, kala muuyanteeɗi, hara ko ɓe hooliiɓe.
explication: Hiɓe gollooɓe ton ɓen, fii addangol ɓe kala muuyanteeɗi ɗi ɓe faaletee, hara ko ɓe hooliiɓe e anngal taƴondirgol ɗi maa lorra majji.

arabe: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
traduction: Ɓe meeɗataa toon maayde, si wonaa maayde aranere nden. O daɗnda ɓe lepte Jahiimi ɗeen.
explication: Ko ɓe duumotooɓe ton, ɓe meeɗataa ton maayde woo, si wanaa maayde aranere nden aduna, Joomi maɓɓe daɗnda ɓe lepte Yiite ngen.

arabe: فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
traduction: ko dokkal noon, immorde ka Joomi maa. Awa ko ɗuum woni maloore mawnde ndeen.
explication: Ɗum ko dokkal e moƴƴere immorde ka Joomi maa. Haray ko jantaa koo, e naadeede ɓen Aljanna, daɗnda ɓe Yiite, ko ɗum woni maloore mawnde nden, nde sugu mun alaa.

arabe: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
traduction: Ko Min newiniri nde e ɗamngal maaɗa, ko no ɓe mbaajitora.
explication: Ko Men newinirani ndee Alqur'aanaare jippinirgol nde e ɗemngal maa, aarabu ngal, an Nulaaɗo, ko no ɓe waajitora.

arabe: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ
traduction: Habito. Kamɓe ne ko ɓe habbitiiɓe.
explication: Habbito faabo maa ngon e halkeede ɓe nden. Kamɓe ko ɓe habbitiiɓe maayde maa.

arabe: حمٓ
traduction: Haa, miim.[1]
explication: Haa, Miim. Yewtere fii sugu ɗee kalfe yawtiino ka cortewol Al baqarah.

arabe: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
traduction: Jippagol deftere nde, ko immorde ka Allah, pooluɗo, Ñeeño O.
explication: Jippagol Alqur'aana, ko immorde ka Allah, Fooluɗo Mo fooletake On, Ñeeñuɗo e tagu Mun e kattal Mun e toppitagol Mun.

arabe: إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Pellet, hino e tagugol kammuuji ɗiin e leydi ndin, Ma'andeeji wonan'de gooŋɗinɓe ɓeen.
explication: Pellet, hino e kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, tinndinayɗi kattal e gootaagu Allah ngun, wonannde gomɗimɓe ɓen. Tawde ko ɓen taskorta maandeeji ɗin.

arabe: وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
traduction: Hino e takgol oon ngol kadi, e kon ko O saaki e ruugayɗi, ko Ma'andeeji wonan'de yimɓe yananaaɓe ɓeen.
explication: Hino e tagugol on ngol kadi, onon yimɓe ɓen, immorde e toɓɓere maniiyu, refti huyre, refti heɗɗere, e ngun tagu ngu Allah saaki ka leydi hino ruuga, ko maandeeji wonii e ɗum fow, wonannde yimɓe yananaaɓe wonnde ko Allah woni taguɗo On.

arabe: وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقٖ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
traduction: E luutondirgol jehma e ñalawma ngol, e kon ko Allah jippiniri ka kammu, immorde e toɓo, O wuurnitiri ngo leydi ndin ɓaawo ndi yo'orude, e firlitagol keneeli ɗin, ko Ma'andeeji wonan'de yimɓe haqqilooɓe ɓen.
explication: Wonii kadi e luutongol jemma e ñalorma ngol, e kon ko Allah jippiniri ka kammu, immorde e ndiyam, O wuurnitiri ɗam leydi ndin, fewndo ndi yoorunoo ndi alaa puɗi, e firlitagol keneeli ɗin, yiltindira ɗi senngo kala, tuma woo, fii nafa mon, ko maandeeji non, wonannde yimɓe haqqilooɓe ɓen. Ɓe dallinora ɗum, e wootinɗingol Allah ngol, e wonnde Himo haɗtani ummitingol, O haɗtani huunde kala.

arabe: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
traduction: Ɗiin ko Ma'andeeji Allah ɗi Min njanngirante hoore goonga. E ko holɗum e yewtere ɓe gooŋɗinta, ɓaawo [yewtere] Allah nden e Aayeeje makko ɗeen?
explication: Ɗin ko maandeeji e hujjaaji ɗi Men janngirta e dow maaɗa, an Nulaaɗo, e hoore goonga. Si tawii ɓe gomɗinaali yewtere Allah e hujjaaji mun jippinaaɗi e Jeyaaɗo Makko on, haray ko yewtere honnde goo ɓe gomɗinoyta?

arabe: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ
traduction: Bone woodanii kala penoowo bakkodin'ɗo !
explication: Halkaare e lepte Allah woodanii kala ɗuuɗuɗo fenaande e bakktuuji !

arabe: يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
traduction: Mo no nana Aayeeje Allah ɗen hino janngee e dow makko, refti o hedditora e toownitaare, wa si tawii o nanaani ɗe. Awa weltinir mo lepte mu'usuuɗe.
explication: On geddo hino nana Aayeeje Allah ɗen ka Alqur'aana hino janngee e dow makko, refti o duumoo e geddi e keeferaaku makko, o townitanoo jokkugol goonga kan, wa si tawii o nanaano ɗen Aayeeje janngaaɗe e dow makko. Awa an Nulaaɗo, humpitu on bone makko laakara, ɗum le ko lepte muusuɗe hino habbitii mo ton.

arabe: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيۡـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
traduction: Si o anndii goɗɗum e aayeeje Amen ɗeen, o jogitora ɗum jalnori. Ɓeen ɗoon, hino woodani lepte koynooje:
explication: Si goɗɗum hewtii mo e Alqur'aana, o jogitora ɗum jalnori makko. Ɓen siforɓe ngol jalkitugol Alqur'aana, hino woodani lepte hoynooje, Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
traduction: Jahannama hino caggal maɓɓe. Ko ɓe paggitinoo duncanoytaaɓe hay hu'unde, wonaa kon ko ɓe jogitinoo yiɗɓe ko wonaa Allah. Hino woodani ɓe lepte mawɗe.
explication: Jahannama hino yeeso maɓɓe, habbitii ɓe laakara. Jawle ɗe ɓe faggitinoo duncanoytaaɓe huunde ka Allah, wanaa sanamuuji ɗi ɓe jogitinoo reweteeɗi ɗin gaanin Allah, woni ko duncanoyta ɓe. Hino woodani ɓe Ñalnde Darngal, lepte mawɗe.

arabe: هَٰذَا هُدٗىۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ
traduction: Ndee [deftere]ko peewal. Ɓeen yedduɓe noon aayeeje Joomi maɓɓe ɗen, hino woodani lepte coɓɗe mu'usuuɗe.
explication: Ndee deftere nde Men jippini e Nulaaɗo Amen on Muhammadu, ko ɗowoore e goonga. Ɓen yedduɓe non Aayeeje Joomi maɓɓe ɗen, hino woodani ɓe lepte bonɗe muusuɗe.

arabe: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ فِيهِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
traduction: Ko Alla oon woni ko eeltanta mon maaya ngam laaɗe ndoga e hengo e dow yamiroore makko, ngam ɗaɓɓon e ɓural makko e yaama joo njetton.
explication: Ko Alla gooto O woni eeltanɗo mon- ono yimɓe- maaya ngo ngam laaɗe ndiyam ndoga e hengo, haa ɗaɓɓon e ɓural makko e nooneeji paggitaaɗe dagiiɗe, mbela joo njetton neemaaji Alla e dow mon.

arabe: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا مِّنۡهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
traduction: O eeltani on ko woni e kammuuji e ka leydi fof, wonii e ɗuum kaawisaaji wonan'de yimɓe miijatooɓe.
explication: Alla mbo senaade woodani eeltanii mon denndaangal ko woni e kammuuji hono naange e lewru e koode, e ko woni e leydi hono caatli e leɗɗe e montaanji eken, wonii e eeltude ɗiin noon dallilaajim baawka Alla e ngootaagu Makko, wonande yimɓe miijatooɓe kaawisaaji makko ɗi ɓe teskooɗi.

arabe: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَغۡفِرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجۡزِيَ قَوۡمَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
traduction: Maakan ɓeen goonɗinɓe yooɓe njaafa ɓeen ɓe tijjaaki nyalɗi Alla ngam O yoɓa ɓe yimɓe koɓe paggittono ko.
explication: Maakan aan Nulaaɗo, ɓeen goonɗinɓ Alla e nulal Nullaaɗo Makko : yoɓe njaafa ɓeen heefereɓe bonɓe e mum en ɓe ngannduɗa paalaaka neemaaji Alla e lepte makko e dow mum en, Ma Alla yoɓ goonɗinɓe munyɓe e heefrɓe jaggitɓe koɓe paggittono e golle nder aduna;

arabe: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ
traduction: Kalo golluɗo ko moƴƴi,ko fii hoore-makko; kala kadi bonnuɗo, yantat e makko refti ko ka Joomi maa woni ruttorde mon.
explication: Kala golluɗɗo golle lobbe ko hoore mum o gollani, Alla na yondani e golle mum he, kala kadi mo golli golle bonɗe ko lepte ɗe ngonata e dow mum, bone golle mum loratah Alla, refti koto Alla ɓe nduttoto nyande darngon gooto fof yoɓe ko haandi ko.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Min tottii banii Israa*iil deftere e ñeeñal e annabaagal Min njeɗiɓe e dagiiɗi Min ɓurniɓe ko heewi e binnde he.
explication: Ko goongo Min njonnii Banii Israa*iil Tawreet e senndude hakkunde aade en min waɗi ko ɓuri heewde e Annabaaɓe ko Annabi Ibraahiima njalti yo jam e kisal ngon e mum, Min ngarsikini ɓe e nooneeji laaɓɗi, Min ɓurniɓe e yimɓe jamaanu mum en.

arabe: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
traduction: Min totti dallillaaji ɓannginooji ɓe luuraani si wonah caggal nde ganndal ari e mum en sabu bewre hakkunde maɓɓe pellet Jooma na ñaawa hakkunde maɓɓe ñande darnga koɓe njeddandiratnoo ko.
explication: Min toottiɓe dallillaaji ɓannguɗi ceerndooji hakkunde goongo e fenaande, ɓe luuraani si wonah caggal nde hujjaaji neleede Muhamed pawii e maɓɓe, alah fof ko fooɗiɓe e ngal luural si wonah bewre e reerɗude e laamu kam e koongu, Joomo noo Aan Nulaaɗo na seernda hakkunde mum en koɓe yeddandiratno ka aduna, O seernda jom goongo e jom fenaande.

arabe: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ فَٱتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Refti min mbaɗma e laawol e yamiroore amen, woto rew belaaɗe ɓeen ɓe ngannda.
explication: Refti Min mbaɗma e laawol e sunna e dow yamiroore Amen nde Min njamiri annabaaɓe adiiɓe, nodda e Iimaan e golle lobbe, rew o sariya, woto belaaɗe ɓeen ɓe nganndah goonga, belaaɗe maɓɓe na majjinaɓe gaa e goonga.

arabe: إِنَّهُمۡ لَن يُغۡنُواْ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٖۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
traduction: Pellet ɓeen ɓe nafataama gaa e Alla hay hu'unde pellet tooñooɓe yogo e mum en ko weldiiɓe, Alla woni keeda hulɓe ɓe.
explication: Pellet ɓeen ɓe nganndah goonga ɓe curantaa Ma lepte Alla hay huunde si a rewii belaaɗe maɓɓe, toonyooɓe seertuɓe laabi yogo e mum en wallat yogo goo, ɓe mballandira e dow juulɓe, Alla noon wallat hulɓe Koɓe ciini jamirooje makko deenii kaɗaaɗe Makko.

arabe: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
traduction: O quraana kombo gite e peewal e yurmeende wonan'de yananaaɓe ɓe.
explication: O quraana kombo gite ɗe yimɓe njiirata goongo e peewal faade e goongo, e yurmeende wonande yananaaɓe, sabu ko e mammbo ɓe peewrata faade e laawol poocingol ngam Joomi mum en weleeɓe, O naatnaɓe aljanna, O deestinaɓe yiite.

arabe: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَرَحُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءٗ مَّحۡيَاهُمۡ وَمَمَاتُهُمۡۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
traduction: Mbele ɓeen waɗɓe boneeji na nanndi e gooŋɗinɓe ɓe ngolli golle lobbe hoɓe fota e nguurndam mum en e maayde maɓɓe bonii koɓe ñaawata.
explication: Mbela ɓeen faggitiriiɓe terɗe mum en keefeeru e goopi cikkat ma Min mbaɗ njoɓdi mum en hono njoɓdi ɓeen golluɓe golle lobbe, ɓe ngoonɗini, ɓe pota aduna e laakara? kaanii ñaawoore mum en.

arabe: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Alla tagrii kammuuji e leydi goonga ngam kala fittaandu yoɓee kondu fagginoo ko kamɓe ɓe tooñetaake.
explication: O tagri kammuuji e leydi ñeeñal timmungal, O tagiraaniɗi fijirde, e ngam O yoɓa kala fittaandu kondu faggino ko boni wolla ko lobbi, Alla toonyataaɓe ustude moƴƴi mum en ma ɓeydude bonɗi mum en.

arabe: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٖ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهِۦ وَقَلۡبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةٗ فَمَن يَهۡدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱللَّهِۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
traduction: Mbele a yiaani oon jaggirɗo belaaɗe makko deweteeɗo Alla majjini mbo e dow ganndal O uddi nanɗe makko e ɓernde makko, o waɗi e gite makko hee cuddi ko hombo feewnata oon caggal Alla mate on miictaaka.
explication: Ndaar -aan nulaado- faade e oon dewɗo belaaɗe mum o waɗiɗe hono dewetooɗo mbo o lunndataaka, Alla majjanii mbo e ganndal ummaade e makko, sabu hombo haandi e majjineede, O ommbi ɓernde makko o nanatah nangol naftaraade, O muuri ndaarɗe makko haa o sutataako goonga, hombo hawrinta oon e goonga caggal de Alla majjani mbo? Mbela on miccataaka lorlo rewde belaaɗe, e nafoore rewde sariya.

arabe: وَقَالُواْ مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا يُهۡلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهۡرُۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
traduction: He'eferɓe mbii ɗum wona si wona nguurndam aduna min maaya min nguura, halkataa min si wona jamaanu, ɓe ngalana ɗuum ganndal ɓe cikkita tan.
explication: Heefareeɓe yedduɓe ummital wii: Nguurndam alah si wonah nguurndam amen aduna ɗam, nguurndam alah caggal ɗaam, njiirle na maaya nduttataaka, jiirle kadi nguura, alah ko warata min si wonah lomtandirde jemma e nyalawma, ɓe ngalah ganndal koɓe njeddi ko ummital, ɓe ngonah si wonah sikkooɓe, te sikke nafatah goonga hay ndiga;

arabe: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
traduction: Si aayeeje amen ɓannguɗe njanngaama e mum en hujja maɓɓe wonata si wona ngaddee baabiraaɓe amen si on ngonii gooŋɗuɓe.
explication: Si aayeeje Amen njanngaama e sirkuɓe yedduɓe ummital, ɓe ndañatah hujja mbo kujjinorto si wonah wiide Nulaaɗo yo o his e wondiiɓe makko: nguurtinane min baabiraaɓe amen si on ngonii goonɗuɓe e ko noddittaɗon wonde ma min ummita caggal maayde amen:

arabe: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Maaku ko alla wuurnata on refti o wara on refti renndina on fa'ade ñalawma darnga mbo sikke alah e mum, kono ko ɓuri heewde e yimɓe ngannda.
explication: Maakanɓe Aan Nulaaɗo: Alla na wuurna mon e takde mon refti O wara mon, refti O renndina on caggal maayde mon faade darorde nyalngu darnga ngam haasbo e njoɓdi, oon nyalawma sikke alah e gargol mammbo, kono ko ɓuri heewde e yimɓe nganndah, ko ɗum waɗi ɓe keblorantaaka ɗum golle moƴƴe.

arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَخۡسَرُ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ
traduction: Woodanii Alla laamu kammuuji e leydi, ñande darnga darii ñande heen meerenteeɓe ɓe perta.
explication: Ko Alla tan laamu kammuuji e leydi ngoodani, alah potɗo reweede e goonga mbo wona Alla, nyande darnga darii Alla ummitini maayɓe ngam hasbeede e njoɓdi nyande heen de meeranteeɓe rewatnooɓe ko wonah Alla yahatnooɓe ngam bonnude goonga cemmbina meere perta.

arabe: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٖ جَاثِيَةٗۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٖ تُدۡعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: Haɗa yiya -aan nulaaɗa- kala leñol na gurfanii e koppi mum,kala leñol na noddiree deftere mum hannde woni ko njoɓeteɗon ko ngollatnaɗon e ndeer aduna.
explication: Haɗa yiya - aan nulaaɗo- e oon nyalawma kala lenyol na gurfanii e koppi mum na fadi ko waɗate, kala lenyol na nodde e deftere golle mum nde malaykaaji binndooji mbinnduno, nguu ñallngu ma on njoɓe ko ngollatnaɗon e aduna fofti ko lobbum wolla ko bonɗum.

arabe: هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسۡتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: Ndee ko deftere amen honde wowla goonga, min ngoniina min ceeraani won'de emin njamira nde winndate ko ngollatna ɗon.
explication: Ndee ko deftere Amen- nde malaykaaji amen mbinndatno golle mon- honde seedoo e mon goonga njanngee nde, Min ngoniina yamirooɓe malaykaaji binndooji nde mbinndata golle mon ka aduna.

arabe: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
traduction: Tawi ko ɓeen gooŋɗinɓe ɓe ngolli golle lobbe O naatnatɓe e yurmeende makko, ko ɗuum woni mala ɓanngungal.
explication: Tawi ko ɓeen goonɗinɓe ɓe ngolli golle moƴƴe Joomi mum en ma O naatnuɓe aljana e yurmeende mum, ndiin njoɓdi ndi Alla tottiɓe woni malal laaɓngal ngal mal malal goɗngal waawah ɓadaade.

arabe: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡ وَكُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّجۡرِمِينَ
traduction: Tawi ko ɓeen he'efareeɓe mbele aayeeje am ɗe njanngetanooke e dow mon mawnikiniɗon laatiɗon yimɓe bonɓe.
explication: Tawii ko been yeddube Alla be wi*nee woynude ɓe: Mbele aayeeje Am njanngetanaake e mon mawnakinadon dow iimanaagal, gondon yimɓe bonɓe, paggitadon heeefeeru e goopi.

arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهَا قُلۡتُم مَّا نَدۡرِي مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنّٗا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُسۡتَيۡقِنِينَ
traduction: Si ɓe mbiaama pellet fodoore Alla ko goonga sikke alah heen mbi'on min ngannda ko woni darnga, min cikkiti cikkitagol min ngonaani yananaaɓe.
explication: Siɓe mbi*aama:pellet fodoore Alla fodani jiyaabe mum wonde ma O ummitibe O yobabe ko goonga mbo alah sikke, darnga ko goonga sikke alah heen ngoolonee mbo, mbi*on: Min nganndah o darnga, min cikkiti sikke loodo wonde ma mbo ar, min njananaaka gargol mammba.

arabe: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
traduction: boneeji ɗi ɓe paggitinoo ɗiin feñana ɓe, ko ɓe njalkitatnoo kon fiiltoo ɓe.
explication: Feeñaniɓe boneeji golle mum en nder aduna ummorde e keefaraagu e goopi, lepte ɗeɓe njalkitatno tellii e mum en ɗeɓe njeertinteno e mum.

arabe: وَقِيلَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
traduction: ɓe mbi'ana hannde min njejjita mon hono no njejjitirɗon pottal ñangu mon hannde ngu, ko yiite woni hoɗorde mon on ndañata walladiiɓe.
explication: Alla daalaniɓe: hannde Min acca on e yiite hono no yejjatirɗon ñalngu mon hannde ngu, on keblanaani ngu iimaan e golle lobbe, ko yiite woni ñiiɓirde, on ngalah balla diiwanoowo mon leɓte.

arabe: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوٗا وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُونَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ
traduction: ɗuum noon ko sabu on njaggarii aayeeje Alla ɗe njalkito nguurndam aduna hoomti on,hannde ɓe njaltata e yiite ɓe nduttataaka aduna ɓe ngolla golle lobbe haa Alla weleeɓe.
explication: Leɓte ɗe ɗe lepteɗon sabu ko njaggirno ɗon aayeeje Alla ɗe saboote e jalkitde, nguurndam aduna ɗam hodiri mon dakamme e tuuyooji majjam, hannde ɓe heeferɓe jalkitatnooɓe aayeeje Alla njaltatah yiite, ɓe keddato e henge haa pooma, ɓe nduttetaake e nguurndam aduna haa ɓe ngolla golle lobbe, Joomi mum en weletaake ɓe.

arabe: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
traduction: Woodanii Alla jettooje nder kammuuji e leydi Jom binnde.
explication: Ko Alla tan woodani jettoode, Jom kammuuji e leydi, Jom denndaangal tagu.

arabe: وَلَهُ ٱلۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
traduction: Na woodani mbo manngu ndeer kammuuji e leydi ko Kaŋko woni mbo gooto foolata ñeeñɗo.
explication: Ina woodani Mbo teddungal e manngu nder kammuuji e leydi, kanko woni poolɗo mbo gooto foolatah, nyeenya e tagu makko e hoddira makko e jiilgol makko e sariya makko.

arabe: حمٓ
traduction: Haa, miim.[1]
explication: Haa, Miim. Yewtere fii sugu ɗee kalfe yawtiino ka simoore Al baqarah.

arabe: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
traduction: Jippagol deftere nden, ko immorde ka Allah, pooluɗo, ñeeño on.
explication: Jippagol Alqur'aana, ko immorde ka Allah, hay foolondirtah e Makko, Ñeeñuɗo e tagu Mun e kattal Mun e toppitagol e sariya Mun.

arabe: مَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُواْ مُعۡرِضُونَ
traduction: Min tagiraali kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin e  ko woni hakkunde majji, si wonaa e goonga e lajala happaangal [fii mum]. Yedduɓe ɓen ko ɗuurniiɓe e ko ɓe ndentiniraa kon.
