explication: Pellet, Allah no anndi wirniiɗi kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin. Huunde e mun suuɗaaki Mo. Allah ko Reenuɗo ko golloton kon. Huunde e golle mon ɗen suuɗaaki Mo. O yoɓitoyay on ko boni e ko moƴƴi e majje.

arabe: قٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡمَجِيدِ
traduction: Qaaf.[1] Mi wooɗndirii Alqur'aanaare teddunde ndeen!
explication: Qaaf : yewtere fii sugu ɗee kalfe yawtiino ka fuɗɗorde cortewol Al-Baqarah. Allah woondirii Alqur'aanaare teddunde nden, moftunde maanaaji e moƴƴere e barkeeji ɗuuɗuɗi, wonnde ko pellet, on immintinoy on Ñalnde Darngal, fii ñaaweede yoɓitee.

arabe: بَلۡ عَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٌ
traduction: Si ko woni, ɓe ŋalɗu ko tawi kon jeertinoowo arii ɓe iwɗo e maɓɓe ; he'eferɓe ɓen mbi'i: "Ɗuum ɗoo ko hu'unde haawniinde.
explication: Ɓe saloraaki sikkitagol ɓe wonnde a fenay, hiɓe anndi ko e goonga wonɗaa. Si ko woni, ɓe ŋalɗu ko tawi kon Nulaaɗo jertinoowo arii ɓe jeyaaɗo e maɓɓe, hara wanaa jeyaaɗo e Malaa'ika. Ɓe wi'i: Arugol Nulaaɗo ɓanndinke on e meeɗen, ko huunde haawniinde.

arabe: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗاۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعُۢ بَعِيدٞ
traduction: Kere si min maayii, min ngoontii mbulmbuldi...? Ɗuum ɗon ko duttitagol goɗɗungol noon !"
explication: Kere men immintinoyte si men maayii men wontii mbulmbuldi? Ngol immintinegol ruttitoo e nguurndam ɓaawo fii amen gaynude, ko huunde woɗɗiinde, nde laatotaako.

arabe: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ
traduction: Gooŋɗii miɗen nganndi ko leydi ndin ñaamata kon e maɓɓe ; hino ka Amen gaa deftere reennde.
explication: Gomɗii Meɗen anndi ko leydi ndin ñaamata kon e ɓalli maɓɓe ɗin, ɓaawo maayde maɓɓe, ɗum suuɗaaki Men ; hino ka Amen gaa deftere reenude kala ko Allah eɓɓani ɓe ka nguurndam e ɓaawo maayde maɓɓe nden.

arabe: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَمۡرٖ مَّرِيجٍ
traduction: Si ko woni, ɓe njeddu goonga kan tuma nde ka arnoo e maɓɓe, hiɓe e ndeer fiyaaku jilɓuɗo.
explication: Si ko woni, ɓee sirkooɓe fennu Alqur'aana, tuma nde Nulaaɗo on ardannooɓe e mayre, hiɓe e fiyaaku jilɓuɗo ; ɓe tabitataa e huunde wootere fii mayre.

arabe: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٖ
traduction: E ɓee ndaaraani kammu ngun dow maɓɓe, ko honno Min mahiri ngun Min cuɗini ngu ; hara perɗi alanaa ngu?
explication: E ɓee fennooɓe ummital teskaaki kammu ngun dow maɓɓe, ko honno Men tagiri ngun Men mahi, Men cuɗiri ngu koode ɗe Men waɗi e maggu; hara perɗi woo alanaa ngu ko itta ella e maggu? Awa taguɗa ɗin kammuuli On, O ronkataa wuurnitude maayɓe.

arabe: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجٖ
traduction: Leydi ndin kadi, Min mbeerti ndi Min mberlii e mayri pelle, Min puɗini e mayri kala nooneeji [puɗi] gooɗuɗi.
explication: Leydi ndin kadi, Men weertiri ndi ka hoɗee e mun, Men werlii e mayri pelle ko tabintina ndi, Men fuɗini e mayri kala nooneeji puɗi e leɗɗe wooɗuɗe.

arabe: تَبۡصِرَةٗ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبۡدٖ مُّنِيبٖ
traduction: fii tasakuyee e waaju wonan'de kala jiyaaɗo duttotooɗo.
explication: Men tagiri ɗum fow, ko wana teskuya waaju kala jeyaaɗo ruttorayɗo ka Joomi mun ɗoftaare.

arabe: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ مُّبَٰرَكٗا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٖ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ
traduction: Min njippini kadi ndiyam mbarkinaaɗam ummaade ka kammu, Min puɗiniri ɗam gese e gabbe coñeteeɗe.
explication: Men jippini kadi ndiyam keewɗam barke e moƴƴere ka kammu, Men fuɗiniri ɗam gese e gabbe soñeteeɗe ekw.

arabe: وَٱلنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتٖ لَّهَا طَلۡعٞ نَّضِيدٞ
traduction: e leɗɗe tamaro juutɗe gon'dude e piindi fawondirndi,
explication: Men fuɗiniri ɗam kadi leɗɗe tamaro juutuɗe toowuɗe, wonduɗe e piindi fawondirndi.

arabe: رِّزۡقٗا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ
traduction: ko arsike jeyaaɓe ɓen. Min nguurnitiri ɗam kadi leydi yoorundi. Awa ko noon woni fii ummital ngal.
explication: Men fuɗiniri ɗam ɗin ɗon fow: fii arsike jeyaaɓe ɓen, ka ɓe wuura. Men wuurnitiri ɗam kadi leydi yoorundi ndi alaa puɗi. Ko wano Men wuurnitiri non leydi yoorundi ndin ɗam ndiyam, ko non Men wuurnitirta maayɓe ɓen, ɓe yalta e gennale ɗen hiɓe wuuri.

arabe: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
traduction:
Ado maɓɓe, yimɓe nuuhu ɓen, e yimɓe Ɓunndu ɓeen e Samuuda'en [fof] f
Njedduno,
explication: Ado ɓee fennooɓe ɓe ɗoo an Nulaaɗo, hari yimɓe goo fenniino Annabaaɓe mun : Yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen, e yimɓe Ɓunndu ɓen e Samuuda'en fow fennuno.

arabe: وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ وَإِخۡوَٰنُ لُوطٖ
traduction: e 'Aadi'en, e Fir'awna e musiɗɓe Luutu ɓeen.
explication: Aadi'en kadi fenni, e Fir'awna e yimɓe Luutu ɓen.

arabe: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖۚ كُلّٞ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
traduction: e yimɓe fitaare nden, e yimɓe Tubba' ɓeen. Kala maɓɓe jedɗuno Nulaaɓe ɓeen, kammbaa am on jojji.
explication: yimɓe Su'aybu e Yimɓe Tubba Laamɗo Yaman ɓe fof pennii nulaaɓe Alla ɓe O nuli ɓe, tabiti e mum en ko Alla fodani ɓe e lepte.

arabe: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسٖ مِّنۡ خَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٖ
traduction: Kere Min ndoŋkuno fii tagoore ado nde? Ko woni kamɓe, hiɓe e jiɓaare fii tagiteede laawol kesol.
explication: Kere Men ronkuno tagugol ka arannde, sakko Men ronka fii immintingol on? Ko woni kamɓe, hiɓe e jiɓaare fii tagu hesu, ɓaawo ɓe tageede ka laawol aranol.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min tagii neɗɗaŋke on, Meɗen nganndi ko woŋkii makko kin sowinsinirta mo. Ko Minen ɓuri ɓadaade mo e dii ɗaɗol (makko) daande ngol.
explication: Gomɗii Men tagii neɗɗanke on, Meɗen anndi miijooji ko yiilotoo e wonkii makko. Ko Meɗen ɓuri mo ɓadaade e dii ɗaɗol makko daande ngol jogondirgol e ɓernde nden.

arabe: إِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلۡمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٞ
traduction: tuma nde jaɓɓoytooɓe ɓeen ɗiɗo jaɓɓoroytoo [golle makko ɗeen] ñaamo e nano, hara hiɓe njooɗii.
explication: Tuma nde Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen ɗiɗo jaɓɓoroytoo golle makko ɗen nano e ñaamo, hara gooto kala e maɓɓe no jooɗorii senngo.

arabe: مَّا يَلۡفِظُ مِن قَوۡلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٞ
traduction: O wowlataa konngol, si wonaa hino takko makko binndoowo tawaaɗo.
explication: O wowlataa konngol, si wanaa hino takko makko ɗon, Malaa'ikaajo winndoowo ko o wowlata kon, tawaaɗo.

arabe: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيدُ
traduction: Ɗeɗɗere maayde nden ardi e goonga : "Ko ɗuum wonnnoo ko ndogaynoɗaa".
explication: Faɗɗere maayde nden ardi e goonga ka sikke alaa e mu'un : awa ko ɗum wonunoo ko -an neɗɗanke on, welsandiiɗa- ko leelatnaɗa ana dogaa.

arabe: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ
traduction: Wuttee ka alaandu ; ko nden woni Ñalaande kammbaa ndeen.
explication: Mala'iikaajo halfinaaɗo alaandu ndun wutta e mayru ɗiɗaɓol ; ko nden woni Ñalnde Darngal ; Ñalaande kammbanaande leptugol heeferɓe e yedduɓe ɓen.

arabe: وَجَآءَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٞ وَشَهِيدٞ
traduction: Woŋkii kala ara, hara hiki won'di e coggoowo e ceedotooɗo.
explication: Wonkii kala ara, hara hiki wonni e Malaa'ikaajo soggoowo ki, e goɗɗo goo ko seeditoo e golle makko ɗen.

arabe: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدٞ
traduction: "Gooŋɗii a laatinoke belsindiiɗo e ndee. Min kunci wirngallo maa ngon kisan; gite maa ɗeen hannde ko ceeɓɗe".
explication: On neɗɗo soggaaɗo wi'anee : Gomɗii a laatinoke welsindiiɗo e ndee Ñalaande, sabu hoomteede maa nden e tuuyooiji maa e dakkemmeeji maa. Men hunci welsindaare maa nden kisan, lepte e wemmbaare ko wonuɗaa naɓude kon; awa hannde on, gite maa ɗen hino yi'ude kon ko welsindotonoɗaa e mun.

arabe: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
traduction: Gonndiijo makko on wi'a: "Ko ɗuum ɗoo woni ka am ɗoo, maandinaa-ɗum".
explication: Malaa'ikaajo mo o halfinaa on wi'a: ko ɗum woni ka am ɗoo, e golle makko tawnaaɗe ko aldaa e ɗuytugol maa ɓeydugol.

arabe: أَلۡقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٖ
traduction: Bugee ka Jahannama onon ɗiɗo, kala jedduɗo canndallo.
explication: Alla daalana Malaa'ika'en ɗiɗo - soggoowo e seedotooɗo on - : Bugee ka nder Jahannama, kala yedduɗo goonga, salii ka.

arabe: مَّنَّاعٖ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٖ مُّرِيبٍ
traduction: Kaɗoowo moƴƴere, jaggitoowo, cikkitiiɗo,
explication: ɗuuɗuɗo haɗugol goonga ka Allah waɗɗini kan e makko, yawtoowo keeri Allah ɗin, sikkitotooɗo kala fodoore maa kammba ko O humpitata fii mun.

arabe: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلۡقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
traduction: on baɗiduɗo e Allah deweteeɗo goo. Bugee mo ka ndeer lepte caɗtuɗe".
explication: On waɗiduɗo e Allah reweteeɗo goo, ko o kafida Mo ka dewal. Haray bugee mo ka nder lepte saɗtuɗe.

arabe: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطۡغَيۡتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدٖ
traduction: Cinndadiijo makko (seytaane) on wi'i: "Joomi amen, mi bewinaali oo; si ko woni, ko e majjere woɗɗunde o wonnoo e mum".
explication: Teekonjo makko seytaniiru ndun e hisnagol e makko wi'ugol : Joomi amen, mi majjinaali oo; si ko woni, ko e majjere woɗɗunoonde goonga o wonunoo e mun.

arabe: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ إِلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡوَعِيدِ
traduction: [Allah] daala : "Wota on njeddondir ka Am ɗoo ! Nde tawnoo Mi ardiniino e mon kammbaa.
explication: Allah daala : Wata on yeddondir ka Am ɗoo, nafa woo alaa e mun ! Nde tawnoo Mi addiniino e mon ka aduna, kammbaa saɗtuɗo mo Nulaaɓe Am ɓen ardunoo e mun on, e hoore kala yedduɗo Lam.

arabe: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
traduction: Konngol waɗtitetaake ka am ɗoo ; Mi siforaa kadi tooñoowo jiyaaɓe ɓen".
explication: Konngol waɗtitetaake ka Alla ɗoo, wanaa fodoore Am Mi firtata ; wanaa kadi Mi tooñiroowo jeyaaɓe ɓen, ɗuytugol moƴƴi maɓɓe ɗin maa ɓeydana ɓe bonɗi ; ko yeru golle maɓɓe ɗen Mi yoɓata ɓe.

arabe: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدٖ
traduction: Ñande Min mbi'anoyta Jahannama o : "E a heewii?" Nge wi'a: "Ko ɓeydee hino woodi?"
explication: Ñalnde Men wi'anoyta Jahannama on : Heeferɓe e yedduɓe bugaaɓe e maaɗa ɓen hebbinii ma? Nge jaabora Joomi : Ko ɓeydee hino woodi? Nge ɗaɓɓira ɗum, fii tikkere nga Joomi magge nden.

arabe: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ
traduction: Aljanna on ɓaɗtinanee gooŋɗuɓe ɓen, hara wonaa ka woɗɗi.
explication: Aljanna on ɓaɗtinanee hullirɓe Joomi mun ɓen ɗoftagol Mo woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, ɓe ceedoo neemaaji makko ɗin, hara wanaa ka woɗɗi ɓe.

arabe: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٖ
traduction: "Ko ɗum ɗoo woni ko podaɗon, wonan'de kala duttiiɗo [e Joomi mun] deeniiɗo.
explication: Ɓe wi'anee : ko ɗum ɗoo woni ko Joomi mon fodi on, wonannde kala ruttorɗo e Joomi mun tuubugol, reeniiɗo e ko O waɗɗini mo e mun kon.

arabe: مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبٖ مُّنِيبٍ
traduction: oon kuluɗo Joom Hinaranke oon ka wirnii, o ardi e ɓernde laaɓunde.
explication: On huluɗo Allah e gunndoo mo tawata ko Allah tun reeni mo, o hawroyi e Allah, wonndude e ɓenrde hisunde laaɓani Allah, ɗuuɗunde ruttagol e Makko.

arabe: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٖۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُلُودِ
traduction: Naatiree mo e jam". Ko nden woni ñalaande luttaynde ndeen.
explication: Ɓe wi'anee ontuma : naatiree Aljanna on hisugol kala ko añuɗon. Ko nden woni ñalaande luttaynde, nde wonnde goo artataa ɓaawo mun.

arabe: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيدٞ
traduction: Hino woodani ɓe toon kala ko ɓe faaletee, hara kadi ɓeydaari hino ka Amen.
explication: Hino woodani ɓe ton neemaaji kala ɗi lannataa ko ɓe faaletee, hara kadi ɓeydaari mun hino ka Amen ko gite yi'aali, nowru nanaali wanaa sakko ɓernde neɗɗo miijoo fii mun; ɗum ko wano yi'ugol Allah seniiɗo On.

arabe: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ هَلۡ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
traduction: Ɗuuɗii e gire ɗen Min kalki ado maɓɓe, ko ɓeen ɓurnooɓe doole, ɓeen mbanngorii e leydi ndiin, ndaarugol taw si ɓe keɓay laaworde.
explication: Ɗuuɗii e mofte ɗen Men halki ado ɓee yimɓe Makka sirkooɓe fenna, ɓen yiilorii e leydi ndin, ndaarugol si ɓe heɓay laaworde lepte ɗen, kono ɓe ronki heɓude.

arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلۡبٌ أَوۡ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٞ
traduction: Pellet, woni e ɗuum, waajo wonan'de kala jom ɓernde, maa tuɗuɗo noppi hara ko tawaaɗo.
explication: Pellet, wonii e koo ko jantaa e halkugol mofte adinooɓe, jantoore e waaju wonannde kala jom ɓernde haqqilirayɗo nde, maa heɗtorii noppi hara ɓernde makko nden no tawaa, mo welsindaaki.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٖ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min tagii kammuuji ɗiin e leydi ndin e kon ko woni hakkunde majji, ndeer balɗe jeegoo, tampere woo heɓaani Min.
explication: Gongii Men tagii kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin e kon ko woni hakkunde majji, nder balɗe joogoo, e hoore non Meɗen haɗtannoo tagugol ɗi nder hinƴaango. Tampere woo heɓaali Men, wano Alyahuuda'en aaƴorta.

arabe: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ
traduction: Muñño e ko ɓe kaalata kon, subbunhinanoɗaa Joomi maa ado puɗal na'ange ngen e ado mutal ngal.
explication: Awa an Nulaaɗo, muñño e ko Alyahuuda e woɗɓe goo wowlete kon, juuliranaa Joomi maa yettugol Mo ka julde fajiri ado puɗal naange ngen, juulaa alansaraa on ado mutal ngal.

arabe: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَأَدۡبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
traduction: Jemma on kadi, subbunhinanoɗaa mo e ka battane [juluɗe] farlaaɗe.
explication: Jemma on kadi, juulanaa Mo, subbunhinanoɗaa Mo ɓaawo farlaaɗe ɗen.

arabe: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٖ قَرِيبٖ
traduction: Heɗo, ñande noddoowo o noddoyta e nokkuure ɓattiinde,
explication: Heɗo an Nulaaɗo, ñalnde Malaa'ikaajo halfinaaɗo wuttugol ka allaandu noddiroyta wuttaandu ɗiɗaɓuru ndun, e nokkuure ɓadiinde.

arabe: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ
traduction: ñande ɓe naniroyta ha'acaango ngon e hoore goonga. Ko ndeen woni Ñande yaltugol ngol [ka genaale].
explication: Ñalnde tagu ngun naniroyta haacaango ngon e hoore goonga, mo sikke alaa e mu'un. Ko nden Ñalnde woni yaltugol maayɓe ɓen ka genaale maɓɓe, fii ñaaweede yoɓee.

arabe: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
traduction: Pellet, ko Monen nguurnata Min mbara, ko ka amen kadi woni ruttorde nde.
explication: Pellet, ko Menen wuurnata Men wara, wanaa goɗɗo goo kippi fii ɗum, ko ka Amen tun kadi woni ruttorde jeyaaɓe ɓen Ñalnde Darngal, fii ñaaweede yoɓee.

arabe: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرٞ
traduction: Ñalnde leydi ndiin seekotoo [ɓe njaltira] keñagol; ko nde woni mooɓirde newaniinde Min.
explication: Ñalnde leydi ndin seekotoo, ɓe yaltira heñagol; ko nden woni mooɓirde newaniinde Men.

arabe: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارٖۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
traduction: Ko Minen ɓuri anndude ko ɓe kaalata kon. A wonaa dooloowoɓe. Haray waajor Alqur'aanaare nden, kala kuloowo kammbaa an on.
explication: Ko Menen ɓuri anndude ko ɓee fennooɓe wowlata kon. An Nulaaɗo, a wonaa saɗtinanoowo ɓe fii gomɗingol, golle maa ko yottingol tun ko Allah nulu maa kon. Haray waajor Alqur'aanaare nden, kala huloowo kammbaa Am on hakkunde heeferɓe e yedduɓe ɓen. Tawde ko huloowo waajitotoo, o jaɓa si on waajaama.

arabe: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوٗا
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii keneeli jarorayɗi (leydi) jaragol !
explication: Allah woondirii keneeli jarotooɗi leydi ndin !

arabe: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرٗا
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii duule donndotooɗe toɓo tiiɗngo !
explication: Mi woondirii kadi duule ronndotooɗe toɓo tiiɗngo !

arabe: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرٗا
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii laaɗe dogirayɗe newaare !
explication: Mi woondirii kadi laaɗe dogirayɗe ka maayo ɗen no newori !

arabe: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا
traduction: E peccooji  e yamiraande.
explication: E malaykaaji peccooji ko Alla yamiri yo fecce ko e fiyakuuji jiyaaɓe.

arabe: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٞ
traduction: ko podete ɗon ko, ko ɗum goongo.
explication: Ko Alla fodata on ko e hasbeede e yoɓeede ko goongo mbo alah jeddi.

arabe: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٞ
traduction: Haasbeede ko ko wonata.(e goonga).
explication: Haasbeede ko ko wonat nyande darngo alah e sago.

arabe: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii kammu jom ɗate nguun !
explication: Allah woondirii kammu labaangu tagu jom ɗate ngun.

arabe: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلٖ مُّخۡتَلِفٖ
traduction: Pellet, hoɗon e konngol luurrangol.
explication: Pellet, onon yimɓe Makka ɓee, hiɗon e konngol piyondirngol : nde wonnde wi'on : Alqur'aana ko mbilewu, nde wonnde kadi wi'on : ko nde gimi, ma wi'on kadi nde wonnde: Muhammadu ko mbileejo, e wonnde goo wi'on : ko yimoowo.

arabe: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ
traduction: Hino yiltee e makko kala firlitaaɗo e gooŋɗinal.
explication: Hino yiltee e gomɗingol Alqur'aana e Annabiijo on (yo o his) kala firlitaaɗo e anndal Allah, e gomɗinal ngal; anndugol Mo wonnde onɗon gomɗintaa, ko ɗum waɗi si O firlitaa.

arabe: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّٰصُونَ
traduction: Fenooɓe ɓeen kuɗaama.
explication: Ɓee fenuɓe e hoore Alqur'aana e Annabiijo maɓɓe on fow ɓe huɗaama.

arabe: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةٖ سَاهُونَ
traduction: ɓeen yolliiɓe e majjere welsindiiɓe.
explication: Ɓen yooliiɓe e majjere, welsindiiɓe fii galle laakara ɗen.

arabe: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
traduction: Heɓe laɓndoo : "Ko honnde woni Ñalaande njoɓdi kuuɗe?"
explication: Hiɓe lamndoo : ko honnde woni Ñalaande njoɓdi kuuɗe? Hara non ɓe alaa gollannde nde !

arabe: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ
traduction: Ñalaande nde ɓe leptoyteeɓe ta Yiite :
explication: Allah jaaboo lamndal maɓɓe ngal : ko Ñalaande nde ɓe leptoytee ka Yiite.

arabe: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
traduction: "Meeɗee lepte mon ɗeen; ko ɗum woni ko keppatnoɗon ko".
explication: Ɓe wi'ane : meeɗee non lepte mon ɗen ; ko ɗum woni ko hawjiraynoɗon kon, waɗton jalnori, tuma jertintenoɗon.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ
traduction: Pellet, gooŋɗuɓe ɓen wonii e aljannaaji e ɓulli.
explication: Pellet ɓeen hulirɓe Joomi mum en ɗoftaade jamirooje Makka, e reenaade kaɗaaɗe Makka ñande darngo hoɓe e jardeeji e caalli dogooji.

arabe: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
traduction: Jaggitooɓe ko Joom maɓɓe okkiɓe ɓe  ko adii ɗuum koɓe moƴƴinatnooɓe.
explication: Jaggatnooɓe ko Alla okkataɓe e njoɓdi teddundi, ɓe pellet ko adii ndii njoɓdi hoɓe moƴƴinatno golle ka aduna.

arabe: كَانُواْ قَلِيلٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
traduction: Heɓe pamɗuno koɓe ɗaanatoo jehma.
explication: Hoɓe njuulatno jemma, ɓe ɗaanatanooko si wonah setta.

arabe: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ
traduction: E saanga ndoogu heɓe toro yaafeede.
explication: E saanga ndoogu hoɓe toro yaafeede bakkatuuji mum en ummorde ka Alla.

arabe: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
traduction: Ina e jawɗe mu'en hakke wonan'de ñaagatooɓe e ɓe ñaagataako.
explication: Ina e jawle mum en he hakke-hoɓe ngattoo heen- yimɓe ñaagatooɓe e ɓe ñaagataako,yimɓe haɗiraaɓe arsuko e kala sabaabu.

arabe: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ
traduction: Ina e ndeer leydi he Ma'andeeji wonan'de yananaaɓe.
explication: E nder leydi ko Alla waɗi ko e hendi ummaade e tule haa e maaje e caalli e leɗɗe e puɗi e kulle, ko dallillaaji mbaawko Alla wonande yananaaɓe wonde ko Alla woni takɗo mbaadinɗo.

arabe: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
traduction: E ndeer pittaali mon mate on teskataaka.
explication: Ina e nder pittaali mon - onon aade en- dallillaaji kollirooji mbaawko Alla, mbela on ndaaratah ngam teska ɗon?

arabe: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
traduction: Ina e kammu arsuka mon e ko podante ɗon ko.
explication: Ina nder kammu arsuko mon aduna, ina e hembo ko podante ɗon e moƴƴe e bonannde.

arabe: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقّٞ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ
traduction: E Joom kammu e leydi ko ɗum goongo hono no kaalirton nih.
explication: Mi woondirii Jom kammu e leydi, pellet ummital ko goongo mbo alah sikke e mum, hono no sikke waasi wonde e haala mon saanga nde kaalaton.

arabe: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
traduction: Mbele arii e maa yeewtere hoɗɓe Ibraahiima teddinaaɓe ɓe.
explication: Mbela arii e ma -Aan Nulaaɗo- yeewtere hoɗɓe Ibraahiima jeyaaɓe e malaykaaji, ɓe Alla teddini.

arabe: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ
traduction: Tuma ɓe naatnoo ka makko ɓe mbi'i: "Salaam (Kisal mon)". O maaki: "Minen ko men ɗenƴii ɓe on".
explication: Ndeɓe naati e makko, ɓe mbi*ni mbo salaaman: Ibraahiima ruttiɓe salminaandu, nduun woni salaam, O maaki e fittaandu makko: ɓe ko yimɓe ɓe nganndaaka.

arabe: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٖ سَمِينٖ
traduction: O naayii fa'ade e koreeji makko o addori ngaari payndi.
explication: O fayi to yimɓe makko e mbaadi cuuiindi, o addori toon ngaari payndi, sabu o sikkuno koɓe yimɓe.

arabe: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
traduction: O ɓadaniɓe ndi o wii on ñaamata?
explication: O ɓanni ɓe ngaari ndi, o haaldi e maɓɓe e newuya: mbela on ñaamatah?

arabe: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ
traduction: O so*i e mu,'en kulol, ɓe mii woto hul, ɓe mbeltiniriɓe cuklel.
explication: Nede ɓe waasno ñaamde o so*i e fittaandu makko he kulol, ɓe paami ɗuum, ɓe lelnir ɓernde makko wiide taa hulu, minen komin nulaaɓe ummaade ka Alla, ɓe kabri mbo ko welata mbo, ɗuum woni ma o heɓ keewɗo ganndal, ko oon woni Ishaaqa.

arabe: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةٖ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٞ
traduction: Jom suudu makko ari hombo wulla o hellii ye'esa makko, o wii nayeejo dimara.?.
explication: Nde jom suudu makko nani o wela wela o ari homo wulla ngam weltaare, o hellii yeeso makko, o wii hombo haawa: mbela nayeeja na jibina, te kanko ko o dimara.

arabe: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
traduction: Maleykaaji ɗi mbii ko hono nih Joom ma daali ko Kaŋko woni ñeeño Ganndo.
explication: Malaykaaji ɗi mbi* imbo ko min kabru ma ko woni ko Joom ma daali, ko O daali ko noon ruttetaake, ko Kanko woni ñeeñuɗo e tagu Makko e hoddiro Makko, ganndo tagu Makko e ko nafataɓe.

arabe: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
traduction: [Annabai Ibraahiima] maaki: "Ko ho ɗum woni fii mon, onon ɓee nelaaɓe?"
explication: Annabi Ibraahiima maaki Malaa'iɓe ɓen : ko honɗum woni fii mon? E ko faanditiɗon?

arabe: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbi'i: "Minen Min nela e yimɓe bonɓe ɓen,
explication: Malaa'ika'en jaabii mo wonnde : menen, Allah neli men e yimɓe bomɓe ɓen faggitotooɓe kuuɗe bonɗe.

arabe: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن طِينٖ
traduction: fii yo min ngaccitu e maɓɓe, kaaƴe iwɗe e loope (juɗaaɗe),
explication: Fii yo men accitu e maɓɓe, kaaƴe iwɗe e loope juɗaaɗe

arabe: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
traduction: maandiniraaɗe ka Joomi maa, fii fantinooɓe ɓeen".
explication: Maandiniraaɗe ka Joomi maa an Ibraahiima, wurtaaɗe e yawtooɓe keeri Allah ɓen, fantinooɓe yeddugol Mo ngol.

arabe: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Min njaltini toon kala gooŋɗinɓe wonunooɓe toon.
explication: Men yaltini taho kala gomɗimɓe wonunooɓe e saare yimɓe Luutu ɓen, fii wata lepte bomɓe ɓen hawru e maɓɓe.

arabe: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
traduction: Min tawaano ton, si wonaa suudu juulɓe wo'oturu.
explication: Men tawaano e nden saare, si wanaa suudu juulɓe wooturu, ndun le ko suudu ɓeynguure Luutu nden (yo o his).

arabe: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
traduction: Min ngacci ton Ma'ande, wonan'de ɓen hulooɓe lepte mu'usuuɗe ɗen.
explication: men acci e nden saare yimɓe Luutu, batteeji lepte ɗen, ko holla wonnde ɗe yanuno e maɓɓe, wona waajitorɗum kala huloowo lepte muusuɗe ɗen yanunooɗe e maɓɓe, ontigi hula waɗugol sugu kuuɗe maɓɓe ɗen, fii daɗugol ɗen lepte.

arabe: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
traduction: [Min ngacci kadi ma'ande] e Muusaa, tuma nde Min nulunoo mo e Fir'awna, wond'ude e hujja ɓannguɗo.
explication: Men acci kadi maande e Muusaa, tuma nde Men nulunoo mo e Fir'awna, wonndude e hujjaaji ɓannguɗi, wonannde kala huloowo e lepte muusuɗe ɗen.

arabe: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٞ
traduction: Kono o ɗuurnodii e semmbe makko, o wi'i [Muusaa]: "Ko bileejo maa feetuɗo".
explication: Kono Fir'awna ɗuurni fawaade e cemmbe e konu makko fow salii goonga, o wi'i Muusaa : ko mbilɗotooɗo yimɓe maa hara feetuɗo.

arabe: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
traduction: Min nanngi mo kaŋko e koneeli makko ɗin, Min bugodii ɓe ka maayo, tawde ko o pelniiɗo.
explication: Men nanngi mo kanko e koneeli makko ɗin fow, Men weddii ɓe ka maayo, ɓe yoolii ɓe halkii, tawde Fir'awna ko feliraaɗo fennugol mo ngol nodditoo reweteeɗo.

arabe: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ
traduction: E 'Adi'en, tuma Min ngurtunoo henndu bonndu ndun e maɓɓe.
explication: Men acci kadi maande e 'Adi'en, yimɓe Huudu ɓen, wonannde kala huloowo lepte muusuɗe ɗen, tuma nde Men wurtunoo e maɓɓe henndu ndu ardaa e toɓo, ndu worgintaa leɗɗe ndu aldaa kadi e barke.

arabe: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
traduction: ndu accataa hay hu'unde nde ndu arani, si wonaa ndu waɗtay nde wa ndoondi.
explication: Ndu accataa hay wonkii maa jawdi ekw e kon ko ndu arani, si wanaa ndu muncay fii mun, ndu waɗta ɗum wano rappunde sariinde.

arabe: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
traduction: E Samuuda'en kadi, tuma nde ɓe mbi'ananoo : "ndakmitee haa seeɗa !"
explication: Men waɗi kadi maande e Samuuda'en, yimɓe Annabi Saalih ɓen, wonannde kala huloowo lepte muusuɗe ɗen, tuma nde ɓe wi'ananoo : awa dakmitoree nguurndam mon ɗam, ado lajal mon gal timmude.

arabe: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
traduction: Ɓe townitanii yamiroore Joomi maɓɓe nden, ha'acaango ngon nanngi ɓe, tawi heɓe ƴeewa.
explication: Ɓe townitanii yawmiroore Joomi maɓɓe gomɗingol e ɗoftagol Mo ngol, haacaango lepte ngon nanngi ɓe, tawi hiɓe ƴeewa ko ɗum jippotoo kon. Tawde ɓe kammbirano lepte ɗen, balɗe tati ado ɗe jippaade.

arabe: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامٖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
traduction: Ɓe mbaawaano daragol (laawoo), ɓe wonaano kadi faabaaɓe.
explication: Ɓe waawaano duñugol lepte ɗen gaay e maɓɓe, ɓe heɓaano kadi feere faabeede.

arabe: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
traduction: Ko noon kadi yimɓe Nuuhu ɓeen ko adii[ɓe]. Ɓen ko yimɓe faasiqiiɓe ngonnoo.
explication: Gomɗii kadi Men halkiriino yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen ado ɓee jantaaɓe ɗoo, yoolagol. Pellet, ɓen ko yimɓe yaltunooɓe e ɗoftaare Allah, waɗi si ɓe hanndi e lepte Makko ɗen.

arabe: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدٖ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
traduction: Kammu ngun, Min mahir ngu doole Amen. Pellet, ko Min yaññuɓe.
explication: Kammu ngun, Men mahir ngu doole Amen, Men ɗiggini ɗum. Pellet, ko Men yaanooɓe cebe mammba.

arabe: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ
traduction: Leydi ndin kan, Min mbeertundi. Min moƴƴii weertuɓe.
explication: Leydi ndin kan, Men weertiranndi hoɗooɓe ɓen, wano ndaɗɗundi maɓɓe. Men moƴƴii weertan ɓe ndi.

arabe: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
traduction: E kala hu'unde, Min tagii noone ɗiɗi; mbelajo'o on mbaajitoray.
explication: E kala huunde, Men tagii noone ɗiɗi: wano deyel e gorel, kammu e leydi, njodrndi e maayo; balajo'o on waajitoray gootaagu Allah taguɗo ɗin On, teskoɗon fii kattal Makko ngal.

arabe: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: "Awa ndogee kisan fa'ade e Allah. Min, wonan'de on immorde ka makko, ko mi jeertinoowo ɓannguɗo.
explication: Dogee lepte Allah ɗen, yaccoron e mbarjaari Makko ndin, ɗoftaare e anngal yeddugol Mo. Min, wonannde on onon ɓee yimɓe, ko mi jertinoowo e lepte Makko ɗen, ɓannguɗo jertinol.

arabe: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
traduction: Wota on mbaɗidane Allah deweteeɗo goo. Min, wonan'de on immorde ka makko, ko mi jeertinoowo ɓannguɗo".
explication: Wata on waɗde e Allah reweteeɗo goo ko rewon. Min, wonannde on immorde ka Makko, ko mi ɓannguɗo jertinol.

arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
traduction: Ko wano non. Nulaaɗo araani e ɓeen adinooɓe ɓe, si wonaa ɓe mbi'ay : "Ko bileejo maa feetuɗo!".
explication: nKo wano yimɓe Makko ɓen fenniri nii, mofte adinooɓe ɓen fennirnoo. Nulaaɗo Allah araali e ɓen, si wanaa ɓe wi'ay mo : ko mbileejo maa feetuɗo!

arabe: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ
traduction: Hara ɓe mbasondir e ɗuum? Ko woni kon, ɓee ko yimɓe bewɓe.
explication: Hara heeferɓe adinooɓe ɓen yamondirno e sakkitiiɓe ɓen e ngol fennugol Nulaaɓe? Oo'o woye. Ko woni kon, ko bewre renndiniɓe e mum.

arabe: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٖ
traduction: Ruŋto ɓe, a felnaaki [e fiiaɓɓe.
explication: An Nulaaɗo, selu ɓee fennooɓe, a wonaa felniiɗo. Ko pellet, a yottinii ko nulaɗaa kon e maɓɓe.

arabe: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
traduction: Waajo tan; sabu baajagol ngol, hino nafa gooŋɗinɓe ɓen.
explication: Haɗataa si a selii ɓe, waajoraa ɓe anndintinaa ɓe; tawde waajagol anndina ngol, hino nafa gomɗimɓe Allah ɓen.

arabe: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
traduction: Mi tagiraali jinna e yimɓe, si wonaa fii yo ɓe ndewam
explication: Mi tagiraali jinna e yimɓe, si wanaa fii yo ɓe rewan Min tun. Wanaa dey fii yo ɓe waddam e goɗɗum goo.

arabe: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقٖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
traduction: Mi ɗaɓɓiraa ɓe arsike; mi ɗaɓɓaa yo ɓe ñamminam.
explication: Mi ɗaɓɓiraa ɓe arsike; Mi ɗaɓɓiraa ɓe yo ɓe ñamminam.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
traduction: Pellet, ko Allah woni garsikoowo on, Jom semmbe tiiɗuɗe.
explication: Pellet, ko Allah woni arsikoowo jeyaaɓe ɓen, fow no hatonjini e arsike Makko On, Kanko Jom cemmbe tiiɗuɗe ɗe huunde foolataa. Denndangal jinna e yimɓe ko cemmbe Makko ɗen yankinanii.

arabe: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبٗا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
traduction: Haray hino woodani ɓen tooñɓe, bakkaat yeru bakkaat nanndo maɓɓe'en, wota ɓe hawju.
explication: Haray hino woodani tooñirɓe ko'e mun ɓen fennugol ma, an Nulaaɗo, geɓal e lepte, yeru geɓal nanndo maɓɓe'en adinooɓe ɓen. Ɗum no happanaa lajal, wata ɓe ɗaɓɓiram yaccinangol ɓe ɗum ado happu mun on.

arabe: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
traduction: Bone woodanii ɓeen yedduɓe, e nde Ñalaande maɓɓe nde ɓe kammbanaa!
explication: Halkaare woodanii ɓen yedduɓe Allah, ɓe fenni Nulaaɗo Makko on, e nden Ñalaande Darngal nde ɓe kammbiranaa yanugol lepte ɗen e maɓɓe.

arabe: وَٱلطُّورِ
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii [Fello] Tuuri ngo!
explication: Allah woondirii Fello ngo O yewtidi e Annabi Muusaa ngon.

arabe: وَكِتَٰبٖ مَّسۡطُورٖ
traduction: E deftere winndaande nde,
explication: O woondiri kadi Deftere winndannde nden.

arabe: فِي رَقّٖ مَّنشُورٖ
traduction: e ɗeer portaaɗi!
explication: E ɗeri fontoriiɗi wa Defte jippinaaɗe ɗen.

arabe: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ
traduction: E Suudu wuurnraandu ndu!
explication: O woondiri kadi Suudu ndu Malaa'ika'en wuurniri ndin rewugol Allah ka kammu.

arabe: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ
traduction: E Kippoodi (mboodi)toowundi ndi
explication: O woondiri kadi kammu toowungu, wonu ngu kippoodi e leydi ndin.

arabe: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ
traduction: E maayo heewno ngo!
explication: O woondiri kadi maayo hebbiniraango ndiyam ngon.

arabe: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٞ
traduction: Pellet, lepte Jooma ɗe ko janooje.
explication: Pellet, lepte Joomi maa ɗen an Nulaaɗo, ko yanooje e heeferɓe ɓen, feere mun alaa.

arabe: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٖ
traduction: Ala duñoowo ɗe.
explication: Alaa ko duñanaɓe ɗe, haa ɗe ronka yanude e maɓɓe.

arabe: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرٗا
traduction: Ñande kammu ngu dillirta dillere,
explication: Ñalnde kammu ngun dillirta dillere, ngu folwo hollirde daragol Darngal ngal.

arabe: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرٗا
traduction: pelle ɗeen njaha e jahgol,
explication: Pelle ɗen woni e sottugol nokku majje, watta yahugol.

arabe: فَوَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
traduction: haray nden ñande, bone woodanii yedduɓe ɓe.
explication: Haray nden ñalnde, halkaare e hayrere woodanii fennuɓe lepte ɗe Allah kammbirani yedduɓe ɓen.

arabe: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ
traduction: ɓeen wonɓe e jumpugol, heɓe pija.
explication: Ɓen wonuɓe e jumpugol fija e nder meere, hara ɓe tefaa fii ummital e caakagol.

arabe: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
traduction: Ñande ɓe duñiroytee doole e Yiite Jahannama duñannde,
explication: Ñalnde ɓe duñiroytee doole ka Yiite Jahannama duñannde.

arabe: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
traduction: [Ɓe mbi'anee] : "Ko ngee Yiite woni ko njeddtnoɗon.
explication: Ɓe wi'anoyee nde ñalnde : awa ko ngee Yiite woni ko fennaynoɗon, fewndo Nulaaɓe mon ɓen hulɓiniraynoo on nge.

arabe: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
traduction: E ko mbilewu nii? Kaa hara on ngla yi'ide?
explication: E ko mbilewu woni ɗee lepte ɗe sutiɗon? Kaa hara on alaa e yi'ude?

arabe: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: Cumee e magge! Muññiɗon ma on muññaaki, fof no fota e mon. Nganndee ko njoɓeteɗon, ko  ko ngollaynoɗon".
explication: Meeɗee nguleeki ngee Yiite sumon nge ! Muññiɗon ɗum maa hara on muññaaki, fow no fota e mon. On yoɓetaake hannde, si wanaa ko geddi e keeferaaku ko gollaynoɗon kon aduna.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَعِيمٖ
traduction: Pellet, gooŋɗuɓe ɓeen hino e Aljannaaji e neemaaji,
explication: Pellet, hulirɓe Joomi mun ɓen ɗoftagol yamiraaɗi Makko woɗɗitoo e haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, hino e Aljannaaji e naamaaji mawɗi, ɗi taƴondirtaa.

arabe: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
traduction: ko ɓe dakimitotooɓe ko Joomi maɓɓe okki ɓe, Joomi maɓɓe daɗndi ɓe lepte Jahiimi ɗeen.
explication: Ko ɓe dakmitorayɓe dakammeeji ñaametee e njaram e desal ko Allah okki ɓe, Joomi maɓɓe daɗnda ɓe lepte Jahiimi ɗen. Ɓe maliree dañugol dakamme yela maɓɓe on, e daɗndeede lepte.

arabe: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
traduction: [Ɓe mbi'anee] : "Ñaamee njaron, ko newi moɗdeum, sabu koko ngollaynoɗon.
explication: Ɓe wi'anee ontuma : ñaamee yaron kala ko yiɗuɗon, ko hannduɓe e mun, wata on hulu lorra ko ñaamoton maa ko yaroton kon. Ɗum ko njoɓdi mon, e golle mon laaɓuɗe ɗen aduna.

arabe: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّصۡفُوفَةٖۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ
traduction: hara ko on soɓɓindiiɓe e hoore danɗe weertindiraaɗe", Min ndesina ɓe kadi yooɗa e yaaJa gite en
explication: Hara ko on soɓɓindiiɓe e hoore danɗe cuɗinaaɗe weertindiraa. Men resini ɓe kadi rewɓe yooɗa giteeɓe.

arabe: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٞ
traduction: Ɓeen gooŋɗinɓe, geñngol maɓɓe ngol kadi jokki ɓe e gooŋɗinal, Min tawtindinay ɓe e geñngol maɓɓe ngol. Min istantaa ɓe hu'unde e golle maɓɓe ɗeen; neɗɗo kala ko faggitii kon no tiginaa.
explication: Ɓen gomɗimɓe, genyngol maɓɓe ngol kadi jokki ɓe e gomɗinal ngal, Men tawtindinay ɓe e geyngol maɓɓe ngol, fii no ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɓuuɓira e fee maɓɓe, hay si ɓen golliraano wano maɓɓe. E hoore Men ɗuytanoytaaɓe huunde e baraaji golle maɓɓe ɗin; tawde neɗɗo kala ko tiginnde e bonɗi ɗi o faggitii ɗin, gooto ronnditantaako mo ko golli kon.

arabe: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٖ وَلَحۡمٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
traduction: Min ɓeydani ɓe muuyanteeɗi e tebbeeli kala ko ɓe tuuyetee.
explication: Men ɓeydanii ɓee yimɓe Aljanna, nooneeje e muuyanteeɗi e kala ko ɓe tuuyetee e teewu.

arabe: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا لَّا لَغۡوٞ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمٞ
traduction: Heɓe njaɓondira toon, ñedduɗe ɗe jillaa mehre wonaa ko bakkondinta.
explication: Hiɓe jaaondira ka nder Aljanna ton : ñedduɗe ɗe jillaa njaram wa'uɗam wa njaramji goo aduna; woni ko siwrinta adda cona-cana maa ko sabimbinta bakkaatu.

arabe: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٞ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
traduction: Sukaaɓe no eeltanaaɓe hino wanngoo hakkunde maɓɓe, wa'aɓe wa kaŋŋe maraaɗe.
explication: Hara sukaaɓe no eltanaaɓe hino wanngoo e maɓɓe, wa'uɓe wa kaŋŋe reenaaɗe, hakkee ko ɓe jalbi.

arabe: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
traduction: Yoga maɓɓe feewtita yoga, ɓe laɓndondira;
explication: Woɗɓe e yimɓe Aljanna ɓen fewtita ɓeya, ɓe lamndondira fii fiyaaku maɓɓe on aduna.

arabe: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
traduction: ɓe mbi'a: "Pellet, min laatino ado [hannde], hulnooɓe [lepte ɗeen] hakkunde yimɓe amen";
explication: Ɓe jaabora ɓe wiide : pellet, men laatino aduna, ko men hulunooɓe lepte Allah ɗen, hakkunde yimɓe amen ɓen.

arabe: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
traduction: Allah moƴƴii e amen, O daɗni meon lepte Norngal.
explication: Allah moƴƴorii e amen, feewugol e lislaamu, O daɗandi men lepte norngal Yiite.

arabe: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
traduction: Min laatino ado [hannde], torotonooɓe Mo. Pellet, ko Kaŋko woni moƴƴo, jurmotooɗo tooɗo on".
explication: Men laatino e nguurndam amen aduna, meɗen rewaynoo Mo men toroo Mo daɗndugol men Yiite. Tawde pellet, ko Kanko woni moƴƴo goonguɗo e ko O fodi jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen kon, Hinnotooɗo ɓe. Hino jeyaa e ko O moƴƴorii e amen O yurmii men : fewnugol men e gomɗinal, naada men Aljanna, woɗɗina men e Yiite.

arabe: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٖ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
traduction: Anndintin tan, sabu neema Joomi maa oon, a wonaa ndureejo wonaa a kaangaaɗo.
explication: An Nulaaɗo, anndintinir tun Alqur'aanaa, sabu ko neema gomɗinal e haqqil ko Allah yeɗu maaɗa kon, a wonaa ndureejo gollidoowo e jinna, a wonaa kadi feetuɗo.

arabe: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٞ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
traduction: Kaa ɓe mb'ay won'de : "Ko jimoowo ! Min habbitani mo tan jikke maayde".
explication: Kaa ɓee fennooɓe wi'au wonnde : Muhammadu wanaa Nulaaɗo, ko yimoowo ! Mo men habbitanii tun biftagol maayde, men pooftoo e makko.

arabe: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
traduction: Maaku : "kabbitee ! Miin kadi miɗo habbitodi e mon".
explication: An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓe : awa habbitee maayde am ! Min kadi miɗo habbitii nde lepte ɗen yanata e mon, sabu ko fennuɗo lam kon.

arabe: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ
traduction: Kaa ko haqqille maɓɓe ɗeen yamirɓe ɗuum? Kaa hara ko ɓe yimɓe bewɓe tan?
explication: Kaa ko haqqille maɓɓe ɗen yamiri ɓe wi'ugol : ko o ndureejo e feetuɗo? Ɓe hawtita ko hawtitaa e neɗɗo. Si ko woni, ɓee yimɓe yawtuɓe tun keeri. Ɓe ruttotaako e sari'a wanaa e haqqil.

arabe: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
traduction: Kaa ɓe mbi'ay won'de : "O sincu nde?" Si ko woni, wonaa ɓe gooŋɗinooɓe.
explication: Kaa ɓe wi'ay wonnde : Muhammadu tafu nde Alqur'aanaare, huunde wahayinaaka e makko? Oo'owoye... Si ko woni, ɓee ko townitaniiɓe gomɗingol nde, waɗi si ɓe wiide o sincu nde.

arabe: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
traduction: Yoo ɓe ngaddu yeewtere sugu mayre, si wonii ko ɓe gooŋɗuɓe.
explication: Awa yo ɓe addii yewtere goo sugu mayre, hay si ko fefindaande, si wonii ko e goonga ɓe woni, wiide ko nde tafaande.

arabe: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
traduction: Kaa ɓe tagira ɓaawo takɗo? Kaa ko kamɓe ngoni tagooɓe ɓen?
explication: Kaa ɓe tagira ɓaawo tagoowo? Kaa ko kamɓe woni taguɓe ko'e maɓɓe? Pellet, huunde tagaaka ɓaawo taguɗo nde, ko tagaa kadi tagataa. Ko haɗi ɓe rewa taguɗo ɓe on kisan?

arabe: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
traduction: Kaa (ko) kamɓe tagi kammuuji ɗin e leydi ndin? Ko woni kon, ɓe njananaaka.
explication: Kaa ko kamɓe tagi kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin? Ko woni goonga, ɓee yananaaka wonnde ko Allah tagi ɓe. Tawde si ɓe yanananoo ɗum, ɓe wootinɗinanyno Mo, ɓe gomɗina Nulaaɗo Makko on.

arabe: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
traduction: Kaa ɓe njogiti ngaluuji Joomi maa ɗiin? Kaa ko kamɓe ngoni huɓindiiɓe ɓeen?
explication: Kaa ɓe jogiti ngaluuji arsike Joomi maa ɗin, sakko ɓe salanoo ɗi mo ɓe yiɗanaa? Maa Annabaaku ngun, sakko ɓe yeɗa ngun mo ɓe yiɗani, ɓe salanoo ngu mo ɓe yiɗanaa? Kaa ko kamɓe woni huɓindiiɓe e piiji ɗin, hara ɓe hiɓe gerdira ɗi no ɓe haajiri?

arabe: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٞ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ
traduction: Kaa ɓe njogiti ɓargal ngal ɓe njentorta? yoo keɗitiiɗo e maɓɓe oon addu hujja ɓannguɗo !
explication: Kaa ɓe jogiti ƴawirgal ka kammu, ngal ɓe heɗitorta wayahu Allah wi'oowo ɓe ko e goonga ɓe woni? Awa yo heɗitiiɗo on e maɓɓe addu on wahayu, wonndude e hujja ɓannguɗo, goonginoowo ko nodditorɗon kon, wonnde ko e goonga wonɗon.

arabe: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
traduction: Maa ko ɓiɗɓe rewɓe ngoodanta mo, onon kam worɓe ɓeen?
explication: Kaa hara ko ɓiɗɓe rewɓe ɓe añanɗon ko'e mon ɓen, woodanta seniiɗo On toowuɗo On, onon kan woodanii on ɓiɗɓe worɓe ɓen?

arabe: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
traduction: Kaa a laɓndi ɓe njoɓdi, hara joɓugol ndi no teddani ɓe?
explication: Kaa a lamndi ɓe njoɓdi, an Nulaaɗo, e ko yottinirtaa kon e maɓɓe, immorde ka Joomi maa? Hara non ɗum wontanay ɓe donŋgal ngal ɓe townataa?

arabe: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
traduction: Kaa ɓe nganndu fii wirniiɗi ɗiin, hara heɓe mbinnda?
explication: Kaa ɓe anndu fii wirniiɗi ɗin, haa hiɓe winndana yimɓe ɓen, ko ɓe ƴellitii e majji, ɓe humpita ɓe kala ko ɓen faalaa e mun?

arabe: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗاۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
traduction: Maa ɓe paala fewjoore?  ko yedduɓe ɓeen, woni fooleteeɓe pewje ɓen.
explication: Kaa ɓee fennuɓe faala fewjannde ma an e diina maa kan? Awa hoolo Allah. Tawde ɓen yedduɓe Allah e Nulaaɗo Makko on, ko kamɓe woni fooleteeɓe pewje ɓen, wanaa an.

arabe: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
traduction: Kaa heɓe mari deweteeɗo ko woori Allah? Senaare woodanii Allah, e kon ko ɓe cirkata !
explication: Kaa hiɓe mari reweteeɗo goo e goonga, ko wanaa Allah? Allah senike O laaɓii e kon ko ɓe dammbata e Makko, immorde e sirku ! Kala ko yawti kon, wanaa non woniri, jaɓirtaake non kadi !

arabe: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطٗا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٞ مَّرۡكُومٞ
traduction: Si ɓe nji'ii taƴatine immornde ka kammu no yani, ɓe mbi'a: "Ko duule pawondirɗe".
explication: Si ɓe yi'ii taƴatine iwrunde ka kammu no yani, ɓe wi'a : ko duule fawondiri ɗoo, wano woowiri non. Ɓe ronka tasakaade maa ɓe gomɗina.

arabe: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
traduction: Terto ɓe, haa ɓe kawroya e ñalaande maɓɓe nde ɓe leptoytee e mum;
explication: Nulaaɗo, accuɓe e sattere feere maɓɓe e yeddugol maɓɓe, haa ɓe hawroya e ñalaande maɓɓe nde ɓe leptoytee e mun. Woni Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
traduction: Ñande nde pewje maɓɓe duncanoytaa ɓe hay hu'unde, ɓe ngonaa kadi walloyteeɓe.
explication: Ñalnde nde pewje maɓɓe ɗen duncanoytaa ɓe hay huunde, ɗuuɗi fanɗi, wanaa kadi ɓe faaboroyteeɓe daɗndeede lepte.

arabe: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
traduction: Ko pellet, hino woodani tooñɓe ɓeen, lepte goo ko wonaa ɗen ɗon. Ko ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude kon e maɓɓe, ɓe nganndaa.
explication: Ko pellet, hino woodani tooñirɓe ko'e mun ɓen sirku e geddi, lepte adiiɗe lepte laakara ɗen: ɗen woni wareede e daheede, ka genaale kadi ɓe leptee. Kono ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude ko e maɓɓe, ɓe anndaa ɗum. Ko ɗum waɗi si ɓe ñiiɓa e keeferaaku maɓɓe.

arabe: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
traduction: Muñño ñaawoore Joomi maa ndeen. Tawde pellet, haɗa e ndenka amen. Seniniraa yettugol Joomi maa, tuma ɓaŋotoɗaa.
explication: An Nulaaɗo, muñño ñaawoore Joomi maa nden, e ñenƴal sari'a Makko on. Tawde pellet, hiɗa e ndenka Amen. Seninaa Joomi maa, tuma ɓaŋotoɗaa e ɗoyngol maa.

arabe: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
traduction: Jehma on kadi, subbunhinanoɗaa mo e ka mutugol koode.
explication: Jemma on kadi, subbunhinanoɗaa Joomi maa, Juulanaa Mo, juulaa subaka on, tuma ka koode ɗen mutirta ɗon feeɗugol ñallal ngal.

arabe: وَٱلنَّجۡمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
traduction: Mi wooɗndirii hoodere si konde fukkiima
explication: Alla woondirii hoodere sinde fukkiima.

arabe: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمۡ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
traduction: Gondiijo mon majjaani o bewaani.
explication: Nelaaɗo-yo o his- ooñaaki gaa e laawol peewal, o wonaani bewɗo, kono ko o peewɗo.

arabe: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ
traduction: O haalata kadi belaaɗe.
explication: O haalatah e o quraana tawa hombo rewi e belaaɗe makko.

arabe: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحۡيٞ يُوحَىٰ
traduction: Ndee [Alqur’aanaare] wonaani, si wonaa waajo bahyateeɗo.
explication: O quraana mbo wonah si wonah wahyu, mbo Alla wahyato faade e makko ummaade e Jibriil.

arabe: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡقُوَىٰ
traduction: Ko joom semmbe janngini ɗum mbo.
explication: Ko malayka jom semmbe oon woni Jibriil anndini ɗum mbo.

arabe: ذُو مِرَّةٖ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ
traduction: Joom mbaadi yooɗndi o fotondiri.
explication: E jibriil-yo o his- jom mbaadi njooɗndi, o fotondiri e mu, hombo feenyani annabi-yo o his- e mbaadi ndi Alla tagri mbo.

arabe: وَهُوَ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
traduction: Hombo woni e jookli toowɗi.
explication: Jibriir hombo e jookli toowɗi.

arabe: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
traduction: refti o ɓadi o ɓattii.
explication: Refti Jibriir ɓadii o ɓeydi ɓattaade.

arabe: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوۡسَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَدۡنَىٰ
traduction: O woni ɓadiiɗo fotde lahñe ɗiɗe wolla ko ɓuri ɓadaade.
explication: O ɓadinoo mbo fotde laanye ɗiɗe wolla ko ɓuri ɓadaade.

arabe: فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ مَآ أَوۡحَىٰ
traduction: O wahyii e maccuɗo makko ko o wahyii ko.
explication: Jibriir wahyii faade e maccuɗo Alla muhamadu-yo o his- ko O wahyii ko.

arabe: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلۡفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
traduction: ɓernde mum fennaani e ko o yi'i ko.
explication: ɓernde muhamadu -yo o his- fennaani ko O yi*i ko.

arabe: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
traduction: mbele hoɗon njeddandira e mum ko yi'i.
explication: mbela hoɗon njeddandira e makko-onon heefareeɓe-ko Alla holli mbo ko ñande jemma israa mbo Alla nawi mbo?

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ نَزۡلَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
traduction: Ko noon tigi o yi'i Jibriir laawol goɗngol.
explication: Ko goonga tigi muhamadu-yo o his- yi*ii e mbaadi makko laawol goɗngol e jemma israa he.

arabe: عِندَ سِدۡرَةِ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
traduction: ka lekki jaaɓi njani sanne(haaɗtirdi).
explication: ka lekki sidra haaɗtirki, kiin ka lekki mawki to kammu jeeɗiɓo.

arabe: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰٓ
traduction: ko kiin lekki woni aljanna koɗirɗo.
explication: ka kiin lekki woni aljanna koɗirɗo.

arabe: إِذۡ يَغۡشَى ٱلسِّدۡرَةَ مَا يَغۡشَىٰ
traduction: Nde muurata e lekki jaaɓi-he ko naatata.
explication: Nde naati e sidra-Jaaɓi- he huunde mawnde ummaade e jamirooje Alla, hay gooto anndah no ɗuum laatarii si wonah Alla.

arabe: مَا زَاغَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
traduction: Gite ɗe oonñaaki nde njawtaani keerol.
explication: Yitere Nelaaɗo-yo o his- ooñaaki nyaama wolla nana, nde yawtaani keerol.

arabe: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ
traduction: Ko goonga o yi'i e kaawsaaji Alla ɓurɗi he mawnide.
explication: Muhamadu-yo o his- yi*ii jemma seteede mbo MiiraaJ kaawisaaji Alla mawɗi kollirooji kattane Makko, O yi*i aljanna e yiite e goɗɗum.

arabe: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلۡعُزَّىٰ
traduction: Onon he'eferɓe mbelr on nji'i laata e ujjaa.
explication: Mbela on nji*ii-onon heefereeɓe- sanamuuji ndewaton ɗi ko aldah e Alla:Laata e Ujjaa.

arabe: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ
traduction: E manaata tataɓiija goɗɗo oon ne.
explication: E manaata tatɓiija goɗɗo o e sanamuuji mon. kabree kam mbela hoɓe njoganii on nafoore wolla lorla.

arabe: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
traduction: Mbele hina woodani on gorko na woodani Mbo debbo.
explication: Mbela na woodani on-onon heeferɓe- gorko ko yiɗɗon ko, na woodani Mboko Joomiraawo demmbo mbo nganñɗon o?

arabe: تِلۡكَ إِذٗا قِسۡمَةٞ ضِيزَىٰٓ
traduction: ɗuum de wadde ko peccugol ngol nuunɗaani.
explication: Ndeen fecccoore nde peccirɗon belaaɗe mon ko nde tooñnde.

arabe: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءٞ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
traduction: ɗi ngonah si wonah inɗe ɗe innuɗon onon e baabiraaɓe mon Alla jippinaani heen daliil ɓe ndewaani si wona sikke e mbelamme pittaali ko goongo peewal arii e maɓɓe ummaade to Joom mu'en.
explication: ɗi sanamuuji ɗi ngonah si wonah inɗe ɗe ngalah maana, ɗi ngalah hay geɗal e sifaaji Alliyankeewal on inniriiɗi onon e baabiraave mon ummaade e ko*e mon, Alla jippinaani heen hay daliil, sirkuɓe ɓe ndewata si wonah sikke e belaaɗe pittaali mum en e ko seytaane suɗi e ɓerɗe mum en, arii e mum en ummaade e Joom mum en peewal e ɗemngal nelaaɗo-yo o his- te ɓe peewaani.

arabe: أَمۡ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
traduction: wolla mbele na woodani neɗɗo ko o wooɗa ko.
explication: Mbela na woodani neɗɗa ko o wooɗa ko e tefnga sanamuuji faade Alla?

arabe: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
traduction: Ko Alla woodani ko sakkati e ko adii ko.
explication: Alah, alanah mbo ko o wooɗa ko, ko Alla tan woodani ko sakkati e ko adii, O okka heen ko O wela O haɗa ko O haaja.

arabe: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
traduction: Heewii e maleykaaji e ndeer kammuuji ɗi tefoore majji nafatah hu'unde tawi wonah caggal de Alla sakkitani wonan'de mbo O wela O.
explication: Hono foti malayka nder kammuuji ɗi tefoore majji nafatah hay huunde soɗi faalaama tefande gooto si wonah caggal de Alla sakkiti tefnga wonande Mbo O haaja e ɓeen, O wele tefnanteeɗo o, Alla sakkitantah oon baɗanɗo Mbo nandadiijo, O weletaake oon tefnanteeɗo dewoowo ko wonah Alla.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
traduction: Pellet ɓeen ɓe ngoonɗinaani La'akara hoɓe innira maleykaaji inɗe rewɓe.
explication: ɓeen ɓe goonɗinaani ummital to laakira maɓe innir malaykaaji ɗi inɗe rewɓe sabu sikkude ɓe koɓe ɓiɓɓe Alla, Alla toowii e konngi mum en hee toowal manngal.

arabe: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـٔٗا
traduction: Woodanaani ɓe ganndal, alah koɓr ndewata si wona sikke, pellet sikke nafatae goonga hay hu'unde.
explication: Woodanaaniɓe ganndal tuugnorgal e koɓe innirta ko malaykaaji inɗe rewɓe, alah koɓe ndewata e ɗuum si wonah sikke e ko laaɓaani, sikke noon nafatah e goonga hay huuunde nyande darnga.

arabe: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
traduction: ɗuurno oon nduntiiɗa jikru amen mbo yiɗah si wona nguurndam aduna.
explication: ɗuuna-aan aan nulaaɗa- oon duntiiɗo innude Alla o faalaako nde, alah ko o faala si wonah nguurndam aduna, o gollanataaka laakara, sabu o goonɗinaani mbo.

arabe: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
traduction: Ko ɗoon ganndal mum en haaɗi, pellet ko Alla ɓuri anndude oon majjuɗo laawol makko, ko Kaŋko kadi ɓuri anndude oon peewɗo.
explication: Ko sirkuɓe ɓe kaalata ko, ko faati e innirde malaykaaji inɗe rewɓe, fotde ganndal mum en ko ɗoon haaɗi, sabu koɓe majjuɓe, ɓe ɓe njottaaki e yananeede, ko joom ma noon ɓuri anndude oon gooñiiɗo acci laawol peewal, ko Kanko ɓuri anndude kadi oon peewɗo e laawol makko he, alah fof ko wirnii e Makko hay huunde.

arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى
traduction: Ko Alla woodani kala ko woni e kammuuji e leydi ngam o yoɓa ɓeen bonnuɓe koɓe mbonni ko, o yoɓa kadi moƴƴinɓe  moƴƴoore.
explication: Ko Alla tan woodani ko woni e nder kammuuji, na woodani Mbo ko woni e leydi to bannge jeyal e takgo e jiiloowo, ngam O yoɓa bonnuɓe e aduna koɓe kaandi ko e lepte, O yoɓa goonɗinɓe golluɓe ko moƴƴi aljanna.

arabe: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةٞ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
traduction: ɓeen woɗɗitotooɓe bakkatuuji mawɗi ɗin e paŋkare [ɓe paggitotaako] si wonaa tokoosi ɗin. Pellet, Joomi maa ko jaacɗo yaafuyee. Ko Kaŋko ɓuri anndude on gila O puɗɗunoo on ummaade e leydi, e nde ngonnoɗon fuƴƴannde ka deedi neeniraaɓe mon. Wota on mantu ko'e mon; ko Kaŋko ɓuri anndude gooŋɗuɓe ɓren.
explication: Ɓen woɗɗitotooɓe junuubi mawɗi ɗin, e geddi kaanuɗi ɗin, ɓe faggitotaako si wanaa tokoosi ɗin. Ɗin no yaaforee accitugol mawnuɗi ɗin, e ɗuɗɗinirde dewe. Pellet, Joomi maa an Nulaaɗo, ko yaajuɗo yaafuyee. Himo yaafoo junuubi kala tuubuɓe e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Ko Kanko Seniiɗo On, ɓuri anndude fii mon gila O tagirnoo ben mon Aadama e leydi, haa nde wonunoɗon saawaaɓe e deedi neeniraaɓe mon; hiɗon tagiree sagara naɓi sagara. Huunde e ɗum suuɗaaki Mo. Haray wata on mantir ko'e hulugol Allah. Ko Kanko ɓuri anndude huluɓe Mo ɓen, ɗoftii yamaruyeeji Makko, woɗɗitii haɗaaɗi Makko.

arabe: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ
traduction: E a tinaali ɗuurniiɗo oon,
explication: E a tinaali bonnde fiyaaku ɗuurniiɗo lislaamu on, fewndo ka o ɓadinoo mo?

arabe: وَأَعۡطَىٰ قَلِيلٗا وَأَكۡدَىٰٓ
traduction: hino okkira seeɗaa, hooti o ɗawa?
explication: Himo okka seeɗa e jawdi, hooti o ɗawa; tawde nguddan ko jikku makko. E hoore ɗum, himo manta hoore-makko.

arabe: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
traduction: Kere o jogi ganndal mbirniiɗi ngal o yi'irta?
explication: Kere o jogi ganndal wiirniiɗi ngal o ndaarirta o yewta fii mun?

arabe: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
traduction: Kaa o humpitaaka ko woni kon e ɗeri Muusa ɗiin
explication: Kaa hara o fefindi o takki e Allha? Hara o humpitaaka fii ko woni kon ka ɗeri arani ɗi Allah jippini ɗin e Muusaa?

arabe: وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِي وَفَّىٰٓ
traduction: e [ka ɗeri] Ibraahiima kuuɓnuɗo [ahadi yottini]
explication: E ko woni kon ka ɗeri Ibraahiima hunnoɗo kala ko Joomi makko nulunoo mo yo o yottingol kon.

arabe: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰ
traduction: won'de woŋkii [woo] ronndotaako doŋgal (bakkaat) woɗkii goo,
explication: Wonnde neɗɗo woo ronnditotaako bakkaatu goɗɗo goo.

arabe: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
traduction: e won'de alanaa neɗɗanke, si wonaa ko o golli kon;
explication: E wonnde alanaa neɗɗanke on, si wanaa yeru baraaji golle makko ɗen.

arabe: وَأَنَّ سَعۡيَهُۥ سَوۡفَ يُرَىٰ
traduction: e won'de golle makko ɗeen, aray ka yi'ee,
explication: E wonnde golle makko ɗen, aray ka yi'ee Ñalnde Darngal.

arabe: ثُمَّ يُجۡزَىٰهُ ٱلۡجَزَآءَ ٱلۡأَوۡفَىٰ
traduction: Refti o yoɓire ɗe njoɓdi timmundi,
explication: Refti o yoɓiree golle makko ɗen, njoɓdi timmundi di ustaaki.

arabe: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
traduction: e wonan'de ko ka Joomi ma woni haattirde ndeen.
explication: E wonnde ko ka Joomi maa an Nulaaɗo, woni ruttorde jeyaaɓe ɓen si ɓe maayii.

arabe: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضۡحَكَ وَأَبۡكَىٰ
traduction: e won'de ko Kaŋko woni beltinoowo gullinoowo
explication: E wonnde ko Kanko woni weltinoowo Mo O yiɗi, O jalna ontigi, O sunina mo O yiɗi, O wullina ontigi.

arabe: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحۡيَا
traduction: ko Kaŋko kadi woni barooro Wuurnita,
explication: E wonnde ko Kanko woni Waroowo wuuruooɓe aduna ɓen, O wuurnita ɓe ɓaawo mun.

arabe: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
traduction: e won'de O tagii resindirayɗi ɗin ɗiɗi : gorel e deyel,
explication: E wonnde O tagii nooneeji ɗin : gorel e deyel.

arabe: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ إِذَا تُمۡنَىٰ
traduction: immorde e toɓɓere maniiyu si yuppaama,(e raŋŋa).
explication: Immorde e toɓɓere maniiyu si rufaama e rennga.

arabe: وَأَنَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ
traduction: e wonnode ko Kaŋko woodani tagitugol ɗimmum.
explication: E wonnde ko Kanko woodani tagitugol ɗin ɗiɗi ɓaawo ɗi maayude.

arabe: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغۡنَىٰ وَأَقۡنَىٰ
traduction: e won'de ko Kaŋko woni galɗinɗo e gokkuɗo,
explication: E wonnde ko Kanko alɗiniri jeyaaɓe Makko ɓe yiɗani jawdi, O yeɗi ɓe jawle ɗe yimɓe ɗaɓɓata.

arabe: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعۡرَىٰ
traduction: e won'de ko Kaŋko woni Jeyɗo hoodere Si'ira ndeen,
explication: E wonnde ko Kanko woni Jeyɗo hoodere Si'iraa, nde yoga e sirkooɓe rewata kafida nde e Allah.

arabe: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهۡلَكَ عَادًا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
traduction: e won'de ko Kaŋko halki Aadi'en adinooɓe,
explication: E wonnde ko Kanko halkunoo Aadi'en adinooɓe, ɓen woni yimɓe Huudi ɓen, fewndo ɓe haɓɓitinoo e keeferaaku ngun.

arabe: وَثَمُودَاْ فَمَآ أَبۡقَىٰ
traduction: e Samuuda'en, o heddaano hay e gooto,
explication: O halki kadi Samuuda'en, yimɓe Saalih ɓen, O heddinaano hay gooto e maɓɓe.

arabe: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
traduction: Ko non kadi yimɓe Nuuhu ɓeen ko adii[ɓe], pellet, ɓeen laatino ɓurɓe tooñude e bewde.
explication: Ko non kadi O hlkirnoo yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen ado Aadi'en e Samuuda'en. Pellet, yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen laatino ɓurɓe tooñude e tiiɗude bewre diini Aadi'en e Samuuda'en. Tawde Nuuhu wonnduno e maɓɓe duuɓi ujunere ŋakkirɗum cappanɗe jowi, himo nodda ɓe e wootinɗingol Allah, kono ɓe salii nootagol mo.

arabe: وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَةَ أَهۡوَىٰ
traduction: e yimɓe fitaare ɓeen (ɓe) o waylitunoo:
explication: E ca'e yimɓe Luutu ɓen ɓen O wayliti haa ka kammu, refti O wayliti ɓe ka leydi.

arabe: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
traduction: O hippiri ɗe ko ko o hippiri.
explication: O hippiri ɗe kaaƴe ɗen ɗe O hippi e maɓɓe ɓaawo O townude ɓe ka kammu, O liɓde ka leydi.

arabe: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
traduction: Ko holɗum e neemaaji Joomi ma ɗiin cikkitotoɗaa?
explication: Ko honɗum e neemaaji Joomi maa tinndinayɗi e kattal Makko woni wennjata fii mun, ronkaa waajitorde ɗum, an oo neɗɗanke?

arabe: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٞ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ
traduction: Oo ko jeertinoowo jiyaaɗo e jeertinooɓe adinooɓe.
explication: Awa oo Nulaaɗo immninaaɗo e mon, ko jeyaaɗo e Nulaaɓe adinooɓe.

arabe: أَزِفَتِ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةُ
traduction: Darngal ngal noon ɓadiima.
explication: Darngal hewtungal ngal ɓadike.

arabe: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
traduction: Duñoowo ngal ko woori Allah, ala.
explication: Duñoowo ngal itta, maa ƴellitotooɗo fii maggal, alaa si wanaa Allah.

arabe: أَفَمِنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ تَعۡجَبُونَ
traduction: E ko ndee yeewtere [Alqur'aana] kaawetoɗon?
explication: E ko ndee yewtere Al*ur'aana janngeteende e dow mon, woni ko haawetoɗon wiide ko ka Allah nde iwri?

arabe: وَتَضۡحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبۡكُونَ
traduction: Hoɗon njala, on ngullataa?
explication: Hiɗon jala jalkita nde, on wullataa tuma nanuɗon waaju mayre?

arabe: وَأَنتُمۡ سَٰمِدُونَ
traduction: Te ko on welsindiiɓe?
explication: Hara ko on weldiiɓe, ɓe haajaaka e mayre?

arabe: فَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ وَٱعۡبُدُواْ۩
traduction: Kooni cujjanee Allah, ndewon [mo].
explication: Koni sujjanee Allah, laɓɓinanon Mo dewal.

arabe: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
traduction: Darngal ngal ɓattiima, lewru ndun kadi se'ekiima
explication: Darngal ngal hewtii, lewru ndun kadi seekinoke gila fewndo Annabiijo (jom kisiyee on). Seekagol ndu ngol woni maande laaɓunde.

arabe: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٞ مُّسۡتَمِرّٞ
traduction: Si ɓe nji''ii Ma'ande, ɓe ɗuurnoo ɓe mbi'a: "Ko mbilewu jokkondirngu".
explication: Si sirkooɓe ɓen yi'ii maande e hujja goonginɗo Nulaaɗo on (yo o his), ɓe ɗuurnoo jaɓugol ɗum, ɓe wi'a: ɗii hujjaaji e ɓannganduyeeji ɗi men yi'i, ko mbilewu meerente.

arabe: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرٖ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
traduction: Ɓe njeddi, ɓe njokki mbeleeɗe maɓɓe. Hara le hu'unde kala no mari ñiiɓirde.
explication: Ɓe fenni goonga ka o addani ɓe kan, ɓe jokki mbeleeɗe maɓɓe fennugol ngol. Hara le fiyaaku kala - moƴƴi maa boni - ko waɗayɗum no haaniri non Ñalande Darngal.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
traduction: Gooŋɗii kumpite arii e maɓɓe, ɗe kaɗitorɗum woni e mum;
explication: Gomɗii kumpite mofte ɗe Alllah halkirnoo yeddugol tooña arii e maɓɓe, yeru ko ɓe haɗitora yeddugol tooña.

arabe: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةٞۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
traduction: [Ɗuum] ko ñeñƴal jottiingal. Kono jeertingol ngol nafaani.
explication: Kon ko ari e maɓɓe, ko ñeñƴal timmungal, fii no wonira hujja e maɓɓe. Kono jertingol nafataa yimɓe ɓe gomɗintaa Allah e Ñalaande sakkitiinde.

arabe: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ نُّكُرٍ
traduction: Sel ɓe. Ñande noddoowo on noddoyta e hu'unde añiniinde.
explication: Si ɓe salanike ma an Nulaaɗo, selu ɓe ɗuurnoɗaa ɓe, habbitoɗaa ñalnde noddoowo halfinaaɗo wuttoygol ngol ka allaandu noddoyta e huunde añiniinde, nde tawata tageefo anndaano sugu mayre ko adii.

arabe: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٞ مُّنتَشِرٞ
traduction: ja'asɓe ndaarɗe, hiɓe njaltira e genaale ɗeen wano kanuuji caratooɗi.
explication: Jaasuɓe e ndaarɗe, hiɓe yaltira e genaale ɗen faade ka ñaawirde, wano kanuuji carotooɗi, hakkee hawjere.

arabe: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٞ
traduction: heñaniiɓe noddoowo on. He'eferɓe ɓeen mbi'a: "Ndee ko ñalaande saɗtunde".
explication: Heñaniiɓe noddoowo on ka ñaawirde. Heeferɓe ɓen wi'a: ndee ɗoo ko ñalaande sattunde. Tawde hinde wonnde e caɗeele e kulhuli.

arabe: ۞ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونٞ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
traduction: Ado maɓɓe, yimɓe nuuhu ɓeen yedduno. Ɓe njedfi jiyaaɗo Amen on, ɓe wi'i : "Ko jinnaaɗo!", o kammbanaa.
explication: Ado ɓee yedduɓe ma ɗoo an Nulaaɗo, hari yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen yeddiino. Ɓe fenni ko Men nuli kon jeyaaɗo Amen on Nuuhu e maɓɓe, ɓe wi'i woo: ko jinnaaɗo ! ɓe purii mo noone fow wiide si o accaali noddugol ɓe.

arabe: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبٞ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
traduction: O torii Joomi makko, won'de : "Miin on ko mi poolaaɗo, faabo [kam]".
explication: O torii Joomi makko, wonnde : yimɓe am ɓen foolii lam, ɓe jaɓanaali lam. Faaboram jippinirgol leopte e dow maɓɓe.

arabe: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٖ مُّنۡهَمِرٖ
traduction: Min ngudditiri dammbuɗe kammu ngun, ndiyam wanncoojam,
explication: Men udditiri dammbuɗe kammu ngun, ndiyam saaƴayɗam jokkondira.

arabe: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونٗا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
traduction: Min puccitiri leydi ndin ɓulli. Ndiye ɗern fottiri e yamiroore hoddiranoonde.
explication: Men tuɓɓiniri leydi ndin ɓulli ndiyam. Ndiyam ɗam ka kammu e ɗam ka leydi fottiri yamiroore Allah hoddiranoonde ko ɓooyi. Ɗam yooli fow, si wanna ɓe Allah daɗnunoo ɓe.

arabe: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحٖ وَدُسُرٖ
traduction: Min ndoondori mo e [laana] lesaaka marka alluwe e peŋe,
explication: Men roondorii Nuuhu e laana lesaaka marka alluwe e peŋe. Men daɗndi mo kanko e wondunooɓe e maɓɓe ɓen yoolagol.

arabe: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءٗ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
traduction: hika dogira e ndenka amen. Ɗuum ko njoɓdi [Nuuhu] jeddanooɗo oon.
explication: Ka laana no dogira e mororonje maayo e ngon, ndenka Amen. Ɗum ko faabo Nuuhu ngon non e ko yimɓe makko ɓen fenni mo kon, ɓe yeddi ko o addani ɓe kon immorde ka Allah.

arabe: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min ngaccirii [kon ko Min mbaɗi ɓe] tasakuyee. Taw si woodi baajitorayɗo?
explication: Gomɗii Men fillitorii kon ko Men leptirnoo ɓe, waaju e tasakuyee. Taw non si woodi waajitryɗo ɗum?

arabe: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
traduction: Tesko ko hono lepte Am e jeertingol (am) wa'anoo?
explication: Taskii ko honno lepte Am ɗen wa'unoo? E ko honno jertinol Am halkugol ɓe ngol wa'unoo?

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min newinirii Alqur'aanare nden baajitorgol. Hara wooday baajitorɗo?
explication: Gomɗii Men newinirii Alquur'aanaare nden waajitorgol. Hara no woodi waajitorayɗo tasakuyeeji mayre.

arabe: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
traduction: Aadi'en njedduno. Taskee ko hono lepte am e jeertingol (sm) wa'anoo?
explication: Aadi'en fennuno Annabaajo maɓɓe on Huudu. Onon yimɓe Makka, teskee ko honno lepte Am ɗen wa'unoo e maɓɓe? Taskoɗon kadi ko honno Mi jertinirnoo ɗe woɗɓe goo?

arabe: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٖ مُّسۡتَمِرّٖ
traduction: Min ngurtu e maɓɓe henndu saɗtundu, e ñalaande hiitaande, duumiinde;
explication: Men wurtu e maɓɓe henndu tiiɗundu ɓuuɓol, e ñalaande ɓaleere, duumodaynde e maɓɓe haa ka Jahiimi.

arabe: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٖ مُّنقَعِرٖ
traduction: hindu bippitira yimɓe ɓeen, wa si tawii ko ɓe daƴƴe tamaro irtaaɗe.
explication: Hindu wippitira yimɓe ɓen e leydi ndin, ndu bugora ɓe ko'e maɓɓe ɗen, wa si tawii ko ɓe daƴƴe ɗoofaade e jayru.

arabe: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
traduction: Taskee ko hono lepte am ɗen e jertingol (am) ngol wa'anoo?
explication: Taskee onon yimɓe Makka ɓen, ko honno lepte Am ɗen wa'unoo e maɓɓe? Taskoɗon kadi ko honno Mi jertinirnoo ɗe woɗɓe goo?

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min newinirii Alqur'aanare nden sabu baajitorgol. Hara wooday baajitorɗo?
explication: Gomɗii Men newinirii Alquur'aanaare nden waajitorgol. Hara no woodi waajitorayɗo tasakuyeeji mayre.

arabe: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
traduction: Samuuda'en njedduno waajo ngo,
explication: Samuuda'en fennuno waaju Nulaaɗo maɓɓe on Saalih (yo o his).

arabe: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٗا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدٗا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٍ
traduction: ɓe mb'i: "Kere ko neɗɗo gooto e amen woni ko min njokkata? Haray min ngonii on tumba e nderr majjere e tamperere.
explication: Ɓe wi'i hiɓe yedda : kere ko neɗɗo gooto e amen woni ko men jokkata? Si men waɗii ɗum, haray ontuma men wonii woopuɓe sari'a ooñiini e mun, woni kadi e tampere.

arabe: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٞ
traduction: Hara ko e makko jaŋtoore nden wernaa hakkunde amen? Si ko woni, ko penoowo nii, townitiiɗo".
explication: Hara ko e makko wahayu on jippinaa hakkunde amen? O heertora ɗum hakkunde amen? Si ko woni, ko fenoowo nii, townitiiɗo.

arabe: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدٗا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
traduction: Aray ɓe ngaannda (Ñalnde) Janngo, ko hommbo woni penoowo toownitiiɗo on.
explication: Aray ɓe annda Ñalnde Janngo, ko hommbo woni fenoowo townitiiɗo on? Anndon si Saalih kaa ko kamɓe?

arabe: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
traduction: Ko Min wurtirooɓe ngelooba ndewa ba ngam, jarribagol ɓe. Aynitu ɓe, muññoɗaa.
explication: Ko Men yaltinirooɓe ngelooba ndewa mbam ka fetere, Men wurtira mba e maɓɓe, jarribagol ɓe. Aynituɓe ɓe an Saalih, tinaa ko ɓe waɗata mba e ko ɓe huuwetee ontuma, muññoɗaa lorra maɓɓe.

arabe: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبٖ مُّحۡتَضَرٞ
traduction: Humpitu ɓe won'de ndiyam ɗam ko sennndaaɗam hakkunde maɓɓe [e ngelooba ba]; kala yaray geɗal mum.
explication: Humituɓe wonnde ndiyam woyndu maɓɓe ndun, ko senndaaɗam hakkunde e maɓɓe e ngelooba mbam: mba yara ñallal, ɓe yara ñallal. Kala maɓɓe yara geɓal mun kañum tun, e ñalaande mun nden.

arabe: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
traduction: Ɓe noddi gon'diijo maɓɓe, o jonni [kaafa kan], o sodi [ba].
explication: Ɓe noddiri wonndiiɗo maɓɓe on, fii warugol mba. O jonni kaafa kan, o wari mba e yamaruyee yimɓe makko ɓen.

arabe: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
traduction: Teskii ko hono lepte am ɗeen e jeertingol (am) ngol wa'anoo?
explication: Taskee onon yimɓe Makka ɓen, ko honno lepte Am ɗen wa'unoo e maɓɓe? Taskoɗon kadi ko honno Mi jertinirnoo ɗum e woɗɓe goo?

arabe: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
traduction: Ko ha'acaango wooturu tun Min ngurti e maɓɓe, ɓe mba'i wa ledde yo'orude muncaaɗe.
explication: Ko haacaango wooturu tun Men wurtunoo e maɓɓe, ngo halki ɓe, ɓe wa'i leɗɗe caŋe yooruɗe ɗe gaynaako wallitorta dammi mun.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min newinirii Alqur'aanare nden baajitorgol. Hara wooday baajitorɗo?
explication: Gomɗii Men newinirii Alquur'aanaare nden waajitorgol. Hara no woodi waajitorayɗo tasakuyeeji mayre.

arabe: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
traduction: Yimɓe Luutu ɓen njedduno jeertine ɗeen.
explication: Yumɓe Luutu ɓen fennuno waaju Nulaaɗo maɓɓe on Luutu (yo o his).

arabe: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٖۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٖ
traduction: Min ngurtuno henndu kaaƴe e maɓɓe, si wonaa e ɓeynguure Luutu nden, Min daɗndirno ɓeen ka wenndo,
explication: Men wurtuno henndu kaaƴe e maɓɓe, si wanaa e ɓeynguure Luutu nden (yo o his) lepte ɗen hewtaano ɓe, tawde Men daɗnuno ɓe fewndo o yaltidunoo e maɓɓe ka wenndoogo, ado lepte ɗen yanude e ɓeya.

arabe: نِّعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
traduction: moƴƴere immorde e Amen. Ko non Min nkoɓitirta kala kettuɗo [neema Allah on].
explication: Men daɗniri ɓe lepte ɗen, moƴƴere Amen e maɓɓe. Ko wano Men yoɓitiri non Luutu, Men yoɓitirta kala yettuɗo neema Allah on e makko.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
traduction: Gooŋɗii le o jeretinirno ɓe nanngal amen cattungal ngal. Kono ɓe cikkitii jeertinol ngol.
explication: Gomɗii le Luutu hulɓinirno ɓe lepte Amen ɗen. Kono ɓe yeddondiri e jertinol makko gol, ɓe fenni mo.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
traduction: Gooŋɗii ɓe ɗaɓɓirno mo [bonidugol e hoɗɓe makko ɓeen]. Min mehi gite maɓɓe ɗeen. "Meeɗee lepte ɗeen e jeertingol am ngol".
explication: Gomɗii ɓe ɗaɓɓirno Luutu accidugol ɓe e hoɗɓe makko ɓen, fii no ɓe huuwira paŋnkare e maɓɓe. Laatii Men mahi gite maɓɓe ɗen, ɓe acci yi'ude, ɓe wi'ani ɓe: meeɗee non lepte ɗen e bone salagol jertinol Am ngol.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
traduction: Gooŋɗii ko bimmbi law, woni ko lepte duumiiɗe ndawirani ɓe.
explication: Gomɗii lepte duumiiɗe dawiranno ɓe bimmbi law, ko heddoda e maɓɓe haa laakara, lepte ɗen ton kadi heɓa ɓe.

arabe: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
traduction: "Meeɗee lepte e jeertingol am".
explication: Ɓe wi'aee ontuma: Meeɗee lepte Am ɗe Mi liɓi e mon ɗen, e salagol mon jertiaango Luutu ngol.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min newinirii Alqur'aanare nden baajitorgol. Hara wooday baajitorɗo?
explication: Gomɗii Men newinirii Alquur'aanaare nden waajitorgol. Hara no woodi waajitorayɗo tesakuyeeji mayre.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
traduction: Gooŋɗii jeertinaango ngon arii e yimɓe Fir'awna ɓeen.
explication: Gomɗii jertinaango Amen ngon arii e yimɓe Fir'awna ɓen, e dow ɗemngal Muusaa e Haaruuna, yo ɓe his.

arabe: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
traduction: Ɓe njeddi aayeeje amen ɗen fof. Min nanngiri ɓe, nanngal pooluɗo kattanɗo.
explication: Ɓe fenni kala hujja e ɓanngannduyeeji immorɗi e Amen. Men yagginiri ɓe fennugol ɓe ngol, lepte Fooluɗo Mo fooletaake, Hattanɗo Mo ronkataa hay huunde.

arabe: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
traduction: Ko he'eferɓe mon ɓen ɓuri ɓeya moƴƴude? Kaa ko daɗgol woodani on ka Ɗeri?
explication: Kere ko heeferɓe mon ɓen onon yimɓe Makkah ɓen, ɓuri moƴƴude e dii ɓeya heeferɓe jantaaɓe (Yimɓe Nuuhu, e Aadi'en, e Samuuda'en, e Yimɓe Luutu ɓen e Fir'awna e yimɓe mun?) Kaa ko daɗugol e lepte Allah ɗen woni maandinanaa on e Defte jippiiɗe ɗen?

arabe: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ
traduction: Kaa hara ɓe mbi'ay : "Minen ko min dental wallindirooɓe"?
explication: Kaa hara ɓee heeferɓe Maakkah wi'ay: menen ko men dental wallindirooɓe e hoore kala faandaniiɗo men bone, eɓɓuɗo senndugol men?

arabe: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
traduction: Aray nde dental [maɓɓe] ngal foolee, ɓe ndunntina ɓabbe maɓɓe.
explication: Aray nden dental ɓee heeferɓe foolee, ɓe huccintina ɓabbe, yeeso gomɗimɓe ɓen. Ɗum waɗuno ñalnde hare nde Badri.

arabe: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
traduction: Wurin ko Darnga ngo woni kammbaa maɓɓe on, Ko Darnga noon ɓuri mawnude e haaɗude.
explication: Wurin ko Darngal ngal ɓe fennunoo ngal, woni fodoore leptugol ɓe ngol. Ko Darngal non ɓuri mawnude e saɗtude lepte dii ko ɓe leptanoo kon aduna ka Badri.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ
traduction: Pellet, bonɓe ɓen ngonii e majjere e ooyunge.
explication: pellet, bonnirɓe geddi e keeferaaku ɓen, wonii e majjere woɗɗiinde goonga, e lepte e tampere kadi.

arabe: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
traduction: Ñande ɓe daasiroytee je'ece maɓɓe ɗeen ka nder Yiite, (ɓe mbi'anee): "Meeɗee meemugol Saqara".
explication: Ñalnde ɓe daasiroytee geece maɓɓe ɗen ka nder Yiite, ɓe wi'anee : meeɗee non lepte Yiite ngen.

arabe: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ
traduction: Minen Min tagir hu'unde kala e eɓɓoore,
explication: Men tagir huunde kala e eɓɓoore Amen yawtunde, tippude e anndal e muyɗe Amen, wonndude e ko Men winndunoo ka Alluwal reenaangal.

arabe: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
traduction: Yamiroore amen wonaani, si wonaa [konngol] gootol pet, [yaawira] wa hinƴaango yiitere.
explication: Si Men faandanike huunde, yamiroore Amen e mayre wonataa, si wanaa konngol gootol pet, woni wiide : laato, nde laatora no Men faaliraa, yaawira wa hinƴaango yiitere.

arabe: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
traduction: Gooŋɗii Min kalkiino yeradiiɓe mon. Hara wooday baajitorayɗo?
explication: Gomɗii Men halkiino goreeɓe mon heeferɓe mofte adinooɓe. Hara wooday waajitorayɗo ɗum, o ɓooroo e keeferaaku makko?

arabe: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
traduction: Kala hu'unde nde ɓe ngolli no ka ndeer ɗeri,
explication: Kala huunde nden jeyaaɓe ɓen huuwi, hino maandinaa ka nder ɗeri Malaa'ika'en halfinaaɓe ɗum ɓen, ɓe winnday fow.

arabe: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
traduction: kala kadi toksum e mawnukum, ko binndaa ɗum.
explication: Kala ko fanɗi e kuugal maa haala, e ko mawni e mun, hino winndaa e ɗeri golle ɗin, maraa ka Alluwal reenaanagl. Aray nde ɓe yoɓitoyee ɗum.

arabe: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ
traduction: Pellet, gooŋɗuɓe ɓren ngonii e Aljannaaji e caatli,
explication: Pellet, hulirɓe Joomi mun siinuɓe yamiraaɗi Makko woɗɗitoo e haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, hino e Aljannaaji ɗi ɓe neeminotoo e mun, canɗi ialyɗi.

arabe: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
traduction: e toolorde goonga, ka Laamɗo kattanɗo.
explication: E toolorde goonga, nde alaa haala meere wanaa bakkaatu, ka Laamɗo jogitiiɗo kala huunde On, Hattanɗo Mo huunde ronkintaa. wota a lamda fii neemaaji maɓɓe duumotooɗi ton ɗin.

arabe: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ
traduction: Joom yurmeende e on.
explication: Jom Hinaraŋke On, Jom yurmeende yaajunde On.

arabe: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ
traduction: O anndinii alqur'aana.
explication: O anndinirii yimɓe ɓen Alqur'aana, newingol hunjagol nde, newo faamugol nde.

arabe: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ
traduction: O tagi neɗɗaŋke o.
explication: O tagi neɗɗaŋke O fotindir, O labini mbaadi makko.

arabe: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلۡبَيَانَ
traduction: O anndini mo ɓanngingol.(laɓɓin'gol)
explication: A anndini mo ɓannginirgol ko woni e fonndo makko, haalugol e winndugol.

arabe: ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ بِحُسۡبَانٖ
traduction: Nayange ngen e lewru ndun [hiɗi ndogira] limoore,
explication: Naange ngen e lewru ndun, O eɓɓanii ɗi, dogugol yeru eɓɓoore ñeñaande, no yimɓe ɓen anndira limoore kitaale e limre.

arabe: وَٱلنَّجۡمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسۡجُدَانِ
traduction: koode ɗeen kadi e leɗɗe ɗeen, hino cujjude.
explication: Delbi ɗin e leɗɗe ɗen kadi, hino sujjannde Allah seniiɗo On, yankinoo jebbilanoo Mo.

arabe: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
traduction: Kammu ngun, o toowni ngu. O waɗi nunɗal ngal,
explication: Kammu ngun, O toownu ngu dow leydi ndin O waɗi kippoodi mun. O ñinni nunɗal ngal ka leydi, O yamiri ɗum jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.

arabe: أَلَّا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡمِيزَانِ
traduction: fii wota on mbewu ka pe'esirɗe.
explication: O ñinniri nunɗal ngal, fii wata on bewu on yimɓe ɓen, hodon ka peesuugol maa ka betugol.

arabe: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
traduction: Ñinniron petgol ngol no nunɗiri. Wata on ustu pe'esirɗe ɗeen.
explication: Ñinniron etugol ngol no nunɗiri. Wata on ɗutu etirɗe ɗen e mandakke ɗen tuma etoton maa mandikoton.

arabe: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡأَنَامِ
traduction: Leydi ndiin, O waɗanndi tagoore ndeen:
explication: Leydi ndin, O weƴƴitirnde ka tagoore nden ñiiɓa e mun.

arabe: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَٱلنَّخۡلُ ذَاتُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَامِ
traduction: Muuyanteeɗi hino e mayri, e leɗɗe tamaro marɗe poƴƴi.
explication: Leɗɗe rimayɗe muuyanteeɗo hino e mayri, e leɗɗe tamaro marɗe poƴƴi.

arabe: وَٱلۡحَبُّ ذُو ٱلۡعَصۡفِ وَٱلرَّيۡحَانُ
traduction: e gabbe marɗe ña'ande, e uurngol.
explication: Hino ton gabbe marɗe ñaande: wano muutiri e mahe, hino ton kadi puɗi ɗi uurngol mun welanto on.

arabe: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
traduction: E ko holɗi e ne'emaaji Joomi mon ɗin woni ko njeddoton?
explication: Ko honɗi e neemaaji Allah ɗuuɗuɗi e mo'on, woni ko fennaton onon denndaangal jinneeji e yimɓe?.

arabe: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ
traduction: O tagiri neɗɗo on immorde e loopal, ba'ngal e ko juɗaa.
explication: O tagirii Aadama (yo o his) immorde e loopal yoorungal, ngal senlaango mun nanorta wa loope juɗaaɗe.

arabe: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ
traduction: O tagiri jinnaaji ɗiin, immorde e lew lewndu yiite laaɓuki.
explication: O tagiri jinnaaji ɗin, immorde e lew lewndu yiite, ki jillaa curki.

arabe: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
traduction: E ko holɗi e ne'emaaji Joomi mon ɗiin njeddoton?
explication: Ko honɗi e neemaaji Allah ɗuuɗuɗi e mo'on, woni ko fennaton onon denndaangal jinneeji e yimɓe ?.

arabe: رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ
traduction: Jeyɗo fuɗirɗe ɗeen ɗiɗi Jeyi kadi mutirɗe ɗeen ɗiɗi.
explication: Jeyɗo fuɗirɗe naange ngen e lewru ndun e mutirɗe majje ɗe, dabbunde e ceeɗu.

arabe: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
traduction: E ko holɗi e ne'emaaji Joomi mon ɗin njeddoton?
explication: Ko honɗi e neemaaji Allah ɗuuɗuɗi e mo'on, woni ko fennaton onon denndaangal jinneeji e yimɓe ?.

arabe: مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ
traduction: O Tuppindiri maaje ɗeen ɗiɗi, hiɗe potta.
explication: Allah tuppindirii maaje ɗen ɗiɗi, ngo lamɗam e deeƴungo, fottirayɗe no gite yiirata.
